text.id: Disebut bersama Wisnu dan Siwa dalam Upanishad Maitrayaniya yang kemungkinan disusun sekitar akhir milenium pertama SM; sektenya ada pada masa pasca-Weda, tetapi menjelang abad ke-7 ia kehilangan kepentingannya.
text.en: Mentioned with Vishnu and Shiva in the Maitrayaniya Upanishad, probably composed around the late 1st millennium BCE; his sect existed in the post-Vedic period, but by the 7th century he had lost his significance.

cultural_context.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam sumber Hindu awal seperti Mahabharata Brahma tertinggi dalam triad dewa besar, tetapi dalam Purana yang lebih kemudian ia tidak lagi dipuja dan mitos-mitosnya diserahkan kepada dewa lain, walaupun kedudukannya sebagai pencipta tetap. Di India masa kini ia tidak menikmati pemujaan populer dan jauh lebih kecil kepentingannya daripada dua anggota Trimurti lainnya.
cultural_context.en: The World History Encyclopedia says that in early Hindu sources such as the Mahabharata Brahma stands highest in the triad of great gods, while in later Puranas worship of him ceases and his myths pass to other gods, though his standing as creator never changes. In contemporary Hinduism he receives no popular worship and counts for substantially less than the other two Trimurti members.

who.id: Dewa pencipta dalam agama Hindu, disebut Sang Pencipta dalam Trimurti.
who.en: The creator god of Hinduism, called the Creator in the Trimurti.

origin.id: Agama Hindu; ia sering disamakan dengan dewa Weda Prajapati.
origin.en: Hinduism; he is often identified with the Vedic god Prajapati.

role.id: Pencipta segala sesuatu dan dikaitkan dengan pengetahuan dan Weda.
role.en: Creator of everything, associated with knowledge and the Vedas.

famous_for.id: Empat kepala yang melambangkan empat Weda dan kisah penciptaan dari telur emas.
famous_for.en: Four heads symbolizing the four Vedas and the creation story of the golden egg.

did_you_know.id: Nama negara Burma diturunkan dari Brahma, dan dalam teks abad pertengahan negeri itu disebut Brahma-desa.
did_you_know.en: The name of the country Burma is derived from Brahma, and in medieval texts it is called Brahma-desa.

name.en: Creation of the universe and beings

description.id: Dalam sastra Purana pasca-Weda Brahma menciptakan tetapi tidak memelihara maupun menghancurkan apa pun. Brahma dikaitkan dengan penciptaan segala sesuatu; menurut Brahmanda Purana ia menciptakan alam semesta, bumi, dan hal-hal lain setelah lahir dari telur emas, dan menurut World History Encyclopedia ia menciptakan dewa, iblis, leluhur, dan manusia.
description.en: In post-Vedic Puranic literature Brahma creates but neither preserves nor destroys anything. Brahma is associated with the creation of everything; according to the Brahmanda Purana he created the universe, the earth and other things after being born from the golden egg, and according to the World History Encyclopedia he created gods, demons, ancestors and men.

description.id: Purana menggambarkan Brahma sebagai dewa yang menciptakan waktu.
description.en: The Puranas describe Brahma as the god creating time.

description.id: Brahma dikaitkan dengan pengetahuan dan Weda; keempat kepalanya melambangkan empat Weda.
description.en: Brahma is associated with knowledge and the Vedas; his four heads represent the four Vedas.

name.id: Ketergantungan pada dewa yang lebih tinggi

description.id: Dalam kebanyakan teks Purana kegiatan penciptaan Brahma bergantung pada kehadiran dan kekuatan dewa atau dewi yang lebih tinggi; ia juga dianggap fana menurut kitab suci.
description.en: In most Puranic texts Brahma's creative activity depends on the presence and power of a higher god or goddess; he is also considered mortal according to scriptures.

description.id: Wujud Brahma dalam budaya Thai; arcanya terdapat di Kuil Erawan di Bangkok dan di kubah Gedung Pemerintah Thailand.
description.en: The Thai representation of Brahma; his statue stands at the Erawan Shrine in Bangkok and in the dome of the Government House of Thailand.

description.id: Brahma dalam seni Kamboja digambarkan berkepala empat dan sering menunggang angsa suci hamsa.
description.en: In Cambodian art Brahma is shown with four heads and often riding the sacred goose, the hamsa.

description.id: Di Tibet Brahma dikenal sebagai Tshangs-pa atau Brahma Putih, sering menunggang kuda dan membawa banteng putih dan pedang.
description.en: In Tibet Brahma is known as Tshangs-pa or White Brahma, often riding a horse and carrying a white bull and a sword.

summary.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma muncul dari telur emas kosmis lalu menciptakan baik dan buruk, terang dan gelap, dan empat golongan: dewa, iblis, leluhur, dan manusia, yang pertama adalah Manu.
summary.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma sprang from the cosmic golden egg and created good and evil, light and dark, and four kinds of beings: gods, demons, ancestors and men, the first being Manu.

title.id: Telur emas dan pemisahan langit dan bumi
title.en: The golden egg and the dividing of heaven and earth

role.id: Makhluk yang lahir dari telur dan pencipta
role.en: The being born from the egg, and creator

summary.id: Menurut Brahmanda Purana, mula-mula hanya ada samudra abadi dan dari situ muncul telur emas Hiranyagarbha; Brahma lahir di dalamnya lalu menciptakan alam semesta. Hukum Manu (terjemahan Bühler) menyebut telur itu menjadi tempat sang ilahi tinggal setahun penuh sebelum dibelah menjadi langit dan bumi.
summary.en: According to the Brahmanda Purana there was at first only an eternal ocean, from which the golden egg Hiranyagarbha emerged; Brahma was born within it and then created the universe. The Laws of Manu (Bühler's translation) say the divine one stayed in the egg a whole year before dividing it into heaven and earth.

role.en: The creator who abandons his body

summary.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, tubuh yang ditinggalkan Brahma setelah menciptakan iblis menjadi Malam dan setelah menciptakan dewa yang baik menjadi Siang, sehingga iblis unggul pada malam hari dan para dewa berkuasa pada siang hari.
summary.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, the body Brahma abandoned after creating demons became Night and after creating the good gods became Day, so demons gain the ascendancy at night and the gods rule the day.

summary.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam satu mitos perempuan pertama ciptaan Brahma adalah juga Kematian, kekuatan yang membawa keseimbangan bagi alam semesta dan mencegahnya penuh sesak.
summary.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in one myth Brahma's first female is also Death, a force that brings balance to the universe and ensures it does not become over-crowded.

title.en: The column of fire and the fifth head

role.id: Pihak yang berbohong dan dihukum Siwa
role.en: The party who lied and was punished by Shiva

summary.id: Menurut kisah dari Siwa Purana, Brahma dan Wisnu mencari ujung kolom api, yaitu Siwa; Wisnu menjelma babi hutan menuju bumi dan Brahma menjelma angsa menuju langit. Siwa lalu memenggal satu dari lima kepala Brahma karena ketidakjujurannya. World History Encyclopedia menyebut sebab lain bagi hilangnya kepala kelima.
summary.en: According to the account from the Shiva Purana, Brahma and Vishnu sought the end of a column of fire that was Shiva; Vishnu took the form of a boar toward the earth and Brahma that of a swan toward the sky. Shiva then cut off one of Brahma's five heads for his dishonesty. The World History Encyclopedia gives a different reason for the loss of the fifth head.

role.en: The god whose worship is restricted

summary.id: Legenda menyebut bahwa Savitri, istri Brahma, mengucapkan kutukan yang membatasi pemujaan Brahma hanya di Pushkara.
summary.en: According to legend, his wife Savitri uttered a curse that confined his worship to Pushkara.

title.en: Creation according to the Laws of Manu

role.en: Brahman, progenitor of the whole world

summary.id: Menurut Hukum Manu (terjemahan Bühler), alam semesta semula berwujud Kegelapan; sang Svayambhu menampakkan diri, menciptakan air, dan lahir sebagai Brahman dalam telur emas. Pada akhir siang dan malam Brahman, ia yang tertidur terbangun dan menciptakan pikiran; penciptaan dan penghancuran dunia tak terhitung jumlahnya, dan Brahman mengulanginya berulang kali.
summary.en: According to the Laws of Manu (Bühler's translation), the universe first existed in the shape of Darkness; the Self-existent appeared, created the waters and was born as Brahman in a golden egg. At the end of Brahman's day and night he who was asleep awakes and creates mind; the creations and destructions of the world are numberless, and Brahman repeats them again and again.

description.id: Kuil Brahma paling terkenal di India; Pushkar juga tempat upacara tahunan untuk menghormati Brahma menurut World History Encyclopedia.
description.en: The best-known Brahma temple in India; according to the World History Encyclopedia Pushkar also hosts an annual ceremony honouring Brahma.

description.id: Tempat arca Brahma (Phra Phrom) yang masih dihormati hingga kini.
description.en: The site of a statue of Brahma (Phra Phrom) that is still revered today.

description.id: Salah satu dari tiga candi terbesar di kompleks ini dipersembahkan kepada Brahma.
description.en: One of the three largest temples in this complex is dedicated to Brahma.

description.id: Di Angkor Wat, Kamboja, terdapat sebuah kuil Brahma.
description.en: A shrine of Brahma can be found at Angkor Wat in Cambodia.

description.id: Salah satu penyebutan paling awal Brahma bersama Wisnu dan Siwa terdapat dalam Upanishad Maitrayaniya, yang kemungkinan disusun sekitar masa ini; teks itu tidak menggambarkannya sebagai salah satu unsur trifungsi gagasan Trimurti.
description.en: One of the earliest mentions of Brahma with Vishnu and Shiva is in the Maitrayaniya Upanishad, probably composed around this time; the text does not depict him as one of the trifunctional elements of the Trimurti idea.

description.id: Menjelang abad ke-7 Brahma kehilangan kepentingannya, dibayangi Wisnu, Siwa, dan Mahadewi; para sejarawan menyebut bangkitnya Saiwa dan Waisnawa sebagai salah satu alasan utamanya.
description.en: By the 7th century Brahma had lost his significance, overshadowed by Vishnu, Shiva and Mahadevi; historians name the rise of Shaivism and Vaishnavism among the major reasons.

description.id: Kompleks Candi Prambanan abad ke-9 M memuat sebuah candi yang dipersembahkan kepada Brahma.
description.en: The 9th-century CE Prambanan complex includes a temple dedicated to Brahma.

note.id: Anggota Trimurti bersama Brahma dan Siwa; Purana yang berpusat pada Wisnu menyebut Brahma lahir dari teratai di pusar Wisnu.
note.en: A Trimurti member with Brahma and Shiva; Vishnu-focused Puranas say Brahma was born from a lotus in Vishnu's navel.

note.id: Anggota Trimurti; dalam kisah Purana Siwa memenggal satu kepala Brahma, dan menurut World History Encyclopedia Brahma menunjuk Siwa memerintah manusia.
note.en: A Trimurti member; in Puranic accounts Shiva cut off one of Brahma's heads, and according to the World History Encyclopedia Brahma appointed Shiva to rule over humanity.

note.id: Dewa Weda yang sering disamakan dengan Brahma.
note.en: The Vedic god often identified with Brahma.

note.id: Istri Brahma; menurut World History Encyclopedia juga disebut putrinya.
note.en: Brahma's wife; the World History Encyclopedia also calls her his daughter.

note.id: Istri Brahma yang menurut legenda mengucapkan kutukan yang membatasi pemujaannya.
note.en: Brahma's wife who, according to legend, pronounced a curse restricting his worship.

note.id: Putra Brahma, salah satu dari Tujuh Resi; menurut kitab suci Brahma menciptakan anak-anaknya dari pikirannya sehingga mereka disebut Manasaputra.
note.en: A son of Brahma, one of the Seven Sages; according to the scriptures Brahma created his children from his mind, and they are called Manasaputra.

note.id: Putra Brahma, pembawa pesan antara dewa dan manusia.
note.en: A son of Brahma, the messenger between gods and men.

note.id: Manusia pertama di antara golongan manusia yang diciptakan Brahma.
note.en: The first among the men created by Brahma.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa dewa pencipta justru jarang dipuja dibandingkan dewa lain dalam Trimurti?
learning_questions.en: Why is the creator god worshipped less than the other Trimurti gods?

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana berbagai Purana yang berbeda menceritakan asal-usul Brahma, dan apa artinya bagi cara kita membaca kitab suci?
learning_questions.en: How do different Puranas tell Brahma's origin differently, and what does that mean for how we read scripture?

summary.en: Some early Puranas: Brahma created himself within the golden egg Hiranyagarbha (Svayambhu).

summary.id: Purana yang berpusat pada Wisnu: Brahma lahir dari teratai di pusar Wisnu.
summary.en: Vishnu-focused Puranas: Brahma was born from a lotus in Vishnu's navel.

summary.id: Purana yang berpusat pada Siwa: Brahma dan Wisnu lahir dari sisi kanan dan kiri pinggang Siwa.
summary.en: Shiva-focused Puranas: Brahma and Vishnu were born from the right and left sides of Shiva's waist.

summary.id: Sumber lain: Tridewi menciptakan Brahma, Wisnu, dan Siwa.
summary.en: Other texts: the Tridevi created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

topic.en: Why Brahma lost his fifth head

summary.id: Menurut kisah dari Siwa Purana, Siwa memenggalnya karena Brahma berbohong dalam adu mencari ujung kolom api.
summary.en: According to the account from the Shiva Purana, Shiva cut it off because Brahma lied in the contest to find the end of the column of fire.

summary.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Siwa yang murka memenggal atau membakarnya karena Brahma menginginkan putrinya Sandhya.
summary.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, an outraged Shiva cut it off or burned it because Brahma lusted after his daughter Sandhya.

short_description.id: Brahma adalah dewa Hindu yang disebut Sang Pencipta dalam Trimurti bersama Wisnu dan Siwa, dikaitkan dengan penciptaan, pengetahuan, dan Weda, dan digambarkan berkepala empat dan duduk di atas teratai.
short_description.en: Brahma is a Hindu god called the Creator in the Trimurti alongside Vishnu and Shiva, associated with creation, knowledge and the Vedas, and shown with four heads, seated on a lotus.

long_description.id: Brahma adalah dewa Hindu yang disebut Sang Pencipta dalam Trimurti, bersama Wisnu dan Siwa. Ia dikaitkan dengan penciptaan segala sesuatu, pengetahuan, dan kitab Weda, dan banyak disebut dalam kisah penciptaan; menurut beberapa Purana ia menciptakan dirinya sendiri dalam janin emas yang disebut Hiranyagarbha. Brahma sering disamakan dengan dewa Weda Prajapati, dan menurut World History Encyclopedia ia juga dikenal sebagai Kakek.
long_description.en: Brahma is a Hindu god known as the Creator in the Trimurti, together with Vishnu and Shiva. He is tied to the making of all things, to knowledge and to the Vedas, and features strongly in creation stories; some Puranas say he created himself inside a golden embryo called the Hiranyagarbha. Brahma is often identified with the Vedic god Prajapati, and according to the World History Encyclopedia he is also known as the Grandfather.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah penciptaan, menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma muncul dari telur emas kosmis lalu menciptakan baik dan buruk, terang dan gelap, serta dewa, iblis, leluhur, dan manusia. Brahmanda Purana menyebut mula-mula hanya ada samudra abadi, dari mana muncul telur emas Hiranyagarbha tempat Brahma lahir dengan nama Svayambhu. Hukum Manu (terjemahan Bühler) menyebut sang ilahi tinggal setahun penuh di dalam telur itu lalu membelahnya menjadi langit dan bumi.
long_description.en: In the creation story, according to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma sprang from the cosmic golden egg and then created good and evil, light and dark, and gods, demons, ancestors and men. The Brahmanda Purana says there was at first only an eternal ocean, from which the golden egg Hiranyagarbha emerged, and Brahma was born in it with the name Svayambhu. The Laws of Manu (Bühler's translation) say the divine one stayed a whole year inside the egg and then divided it into heaven and earth.

long_description.id: Sumber berbeda tentang asal-usul Brahma: Purana yang berpusat pada Wisnu menyebutnya lahir dari teratai di pusar Wisnu, Purana yang berpusat pada Siwa menyebutnya lahir dari pinggang Siwa, dan sumber lain menyebut Tridewi menciptakannya. Dalam kebanyakan teks Purana ia pencipta sekunder yang kegiatannya bergantung pada dewa atau dewi yang lebih tinggi, dan menurut kitab suci ia fana. Hukum Manu menyebut satu hari Brahman sama dengan seribu zaman para dewa.
long_description.en: Sources differ on Brahma's origin: Vishnu-focused Puranas make him born from a lotus in Vishnu's navel, Shiva-focused Puranas from Shiva's waist, and other texts say the Tridevi created him. In most Puranic texts he is a secondary creator whose activity depends on a higher god or goddess, and according to scriptures he is mortal. The Laws of Manu says one day of Brahman equals one thousand ages of the gods.

long_description.id: Brahma biasanya digambarkan sebagai laki-laki berjanggut berkulit merah atau keemasan dengan empat kepala dan empat tangan; keempat kepalanya melambangkan empat Weda dan menghadap empat arah mata angin. Ia duduk di atas teratai dan wahananya adalah hamsa, dan tangannya memegang lambang pengetahuan dan penciptaan, bukan senjata. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, semula ia berkepala lima, dan Siwa memenggal satu kepalanya. Manasara, buku panduan desain kuno, menyatakan arca Brahma hendaknya berwarna emas.
long_description.en: Brahma is usually shown as a bearded red or golden man with four heads and four hands; the heads stand for the four Vedas and face the four directions. He sits on a lotus and his mount is the hamsa, and his hands hold symbols of knowledge and creation, not weapons. According to the World History Encyclopedia he originally had five heads, and Shiva cut one off. The Manasara, an ancient design manual, says a statue of Brahma should be gold in colour.

long_description.id: Pada masa pasca-Weda Brahma dewa terkemuka dengan sekte sendiri, tetapi menjelang abad ke-7 pengaruhnya surut dan ia dibayangi Wisnu, Siwa, dan Mahadewi. Di India masa kini hanya sedikit kuil yang dipersembahkan kepadanya, yang paling terkenal Kuil Brahma di Pushkar, Rajasthan. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia masih dihormati dengan upacara tahunan di Pushkar dan tetap populer di Asia Tenggara, terutama di Thailand dan Bali.
long_description.en: In the post-Vedic period Brahma was a prominent god with his own sect, but by the 7th century his standing had faded and he was overshadowed by Vishnu, Shiva and Mahadevi. Today only a few temples in India are devoted to him, the best known being the Brahma Temple at Pushkar in Rajasthan. According to the World History Encyclopedia he is still honoured with a yearly ceremony at Pushkar and remains popular in Southeast Asia, especially Thailand and Bali.

claims.quote: is a Hindu god, referred to as "the Creator" within the Trimurti, the trinity of supreme divinity that includes Vishnu and Shiva. He is associated with creation of everything, knowledge, and the Vedas. Brahma is prominently mentioned in creation legends. In some Puranas, he created himself in a golden embryo known as the Hiranyagarbha.

statement.id: Brahma (ब्रह्मा) adalah dewa Hindu yang disebut Sang Pencipta dalam Trimurti bersama Wisnu dan Siwa, dikaitkan dengan penciptaan, pengetahuan, dan Weda; menurut beberapa Purana ia menciptakan dirinya dalam janin emas Hiranyagarbha.
statement.en: Brahma (ब्रह्मा) is a Hindu god called the Creator in the Trimurti with Vishnu and Shiva, associated with creation, knowledge and the Vedas; some Puranas say he created himself in the golden embryo Hiranyagarbha.

claims.quote: Brahma is frequently identified with the Vedic god Prajapati. During the post-Vedic period, Brahma was a prominent deity and his sect existed; however, by the 7th century, he had lost his significance.

statement.id: Brahma sering disamakan dengan dewa Weda Prajapati; pada masa pasca-Weda ia dewa terkemuka dan sektenya ada, tetapi menjelang abad ke-7 ia kehilangan kepentingannya.
statement.en: Brahma is often identified with the Vedic god Prajapati; in the post-Vedic period he was a prominent deity and his sect existed, but by the 7th century he had lost his significance.

claims.quote: Brahma is commonly depicted as a red or golden-complexioned bearded man with four heads and hands. His four heads represent the four Vedas and are pointed to the four cardinal directions. He is seated on a lotus and his vahana (mount) is a hamsa

statement.id: Brahma digambarkan sebagai laki-laki berjanggut berkulit merah atau keemasan dengan empat kepala dan tangan; kepalanya melambangkan empat Weda dan menghadap empat arah; ia duduk di atas teratai dan kendaraannya hamsa.
statement.en: Brahma is shown as a bearded red or golden man with four heads and hands; the heads represent the four Vedas and face the four directions; he sits on a lotus and rides a hamsa.

claims.quote: Few temples dedicated to him exist in India, the most famous being the Brahma Temple, Pushkar in Rajasthan.

statement.id: Hanya sedikit kuil yang dipersembahkan kepadanya di India, yang paling terkenal adalah Kuil Brahma di Pushkar, Rajasthan.
statement.en: Few temples dedicated to him exist in India, the most famous being the Brahma Temple at Pushkar in Rajasthan.

claims.quote: He is still honoured today with an annual ceremony at the pilgrimage site of Pushkar in Rajasthan, India and he remains a popular figure in Southeast Asia, especially in Thailand and Bali.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma masih dihormati dengan upacara tahunan di Pushkar, Rajasthan, India, dan tetap populer di Asia Tenggara, terutama di Thailand dan Bali.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma is still honoured with an annual ceremony at Pushkar, Rajasthan, India, and remains popular in Southeast Asia, especially Thailand and Bali.

claims.quote: In the beginning, Brahma sprang from the cosmic golden egg and he then created good & evil and light & dark from his own person. He also created the four types: gods, demons, ancestors, and men (the first being Manu).

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma muncul dari telur emas kosmis lalu menciptakan baik dan buruk, terang dan gelap, serta empat golongan: dewa, raksasa, leluhur, dan manusia.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma sprang from the cosmic golden egg and created good and evil, light and dark, and four kinds: gods, demons, ancestors and men.

claims.quote: He was also overshadowed by other major deities like Vishnu, Shiva, and Mahadevi and demoted to the role of a secondary creator, who was created by the major deities.

statement.id: Ia juga dibayangi dewa-dewa utama lain seperti Wisnu, Siwa, dan Mahadewi dan diturunkan menjadi pencipta sekunder yang diciptakan oleh dewa-dewa utama.
statement.en: He was also overshadowed by other major deities such as Vishnu, Shiva and Mahadevi and demoted to the role of a secondary creator, created by the major deities.

claims.quote: Historians believe that some of the major reasons for Brahma's downfall were the rise of Shaivism and Vaishnavism, their replacement of him with Mahadevi in the Smarta tradition, and the frequent attacks by Buddhists, Jains, Hindus who worship Shiva and Vishnu.

statement.id: Para sejarawan berpendapat bahwa alasan utama kemerosotan Brahma adalah bangkitnya Saiwa dan Waisnawa, penggantian dirinya oleh Mahadewi dalam tradisi Smarta, dan serangan terus-menerus dari umat Buddha, Jain, dan penganut Hindu pemuja Siwa dan Wisnu.
statement.en: Historians believe that the major reasons for Brahma's downfall were the rise of Shaivism and Vaishnavism, their replacement of him with Mahadevi in the Smarta tradition, and frequent attacks by Buddhists, Jains and Hindus who worship Shiva and Vishnu.

claims.quote: One of the earliest mentions of Brahma with Vishnu and Shiva is in the fifth Prapathaka (lesson) of the Maitrayaniya Upanishad, probably composed around the late 1st millennium BCE.

statement.id: Salah satu penyebutan paling awal Brahma bersama Wisnu dan Siwa terdapat pada Prapathaka kelima Upanishad Maitrayaniya, yang kemungkinan disusun sekitar akhir milenium pertama SM.
statement.en: One of the earliest mentions of Brahma together with Vishnu and Shiva is in the fifth Prapathaka (lesson) of the Maitrayaniya Upanishad, probably composed around the late 1st millennium BCE.

claims.quote: While the Maitrayaniya Upanishad maps Brahma with one of the elements of the guṇas theory of Hinduism, the text does not depict him as one of the trifunctional elements of the Hindu Trimurti idea found in later Puranic literature.

statement.id: Meskipun Upanishad Maitrayaniya memetakan Brahma pada salah satu unsur teori guna, teks itu tidak menggambarkannya sebagai salah satu unsur trifungsi gagasan Trimurti yang terdapat dalam sastra Purana yang lebih kemudian.
statement.en: While the Maitrayaniya Upanishad maps Brahma to one of the elements of the guna theory, the text does not depict him as one of the trifunctional elements of the Trimurti idea found in later Puranic literature.

claims.quote: Early texts like the Brahmanda Purana describe that there was nothing but an eternal ocean. From this, a golden egg called Hiranyagarbha, emerged. The egg broke open and Brahma, who had created himself within it, came into existence (gaining the name Svayambhu). Then, he created the universe, the earth, and other things.

statement.id: Teks awal seperti Brahmanda Purana menyebut bahwa semula hanya ada samudra abadi; dari situ muncul telur emas bernama Hiranyagarbha. Telur itu pecah dan Brahma, yang telah menciptakan dirinya di dalamnya, lahir (dengan nama Svayambhu); lalu ia menciptakan alam semesta, bumi, dan hal-hal lain.
statement.en: Early texts such as the Brahmanda Purana say there was nothing but an eternal ocean, from which a golden egg called Hiranyagarbha emerged; the egg broke open and Brahma, who had created himself within it, came into existence (gaining the name Svayambhu), and then created the universe, the earth and other things.

claims.quote: Vishnu-focused Puranas describe that Brahma was born from a lotus emerging from the navel of the god Vishnu and Shiva was born from a fire emerging from the forehead of the god Vishnu.

statement.id: Purana yang berpusat pada Wisnu menyebut bahwa Brahma lahir dari teratai yang muncul dari pusar Wisnu, dan Siwa lahir dari api yang muncul dari dahi Wisnu.
statement.en: Vishnu-focused Puranas describe Brahma as born from a lotus emerging from the navel of Vishnu, and Shiva as born from a fire emerging from Vishnu's forehead.

claims.quote: In contrast, the Shiva-focused Puranas describe Brahma and Vishnu to be born from Shiva's right and left sides of his waist

statement.id: Sebaliknya, Purana yang berpusat pada Siwa menyebut Brahma dan Wisnu lahir dari sisi kanan dan kiri pinggang Siwa.
statement.en: In contrast, Shiva-focused Puranas describe Brahma and Vishnu as born from the right and left sides of Shiva's waist.

claims.quote: Yet others describe that the Tridevi created Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, and these texts then state that Brahma is a secondary creator of the world working respectively on their behalf.

statement.id: Sumber lain menyebut bahwa Tridewi menciptakan Brahma, Wisnu, dan Siwa, dan teks-teks itu menyatakan Brahma pencipta sekunder dunia yang bekerja atas nama mereka.
statement.en: Yet other texts describe the Tridevi as having created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, and state that Brahma is a secondary creator of the world working on their behalf.

claims.quote: Brahma creates all the forms in the universe, but not the primordial universe itself. Thus in most Puranic texts, Brahma's creative activity depends on the presence and power of a higher god or higher goddess.

statement.id: Brahma menciptakan segala bentuk di alam semesta, tetapi bukan alam semesta primordial itu sendiri; dalam kebanyakan teks Purana, kegiatan penciptaannya bergantung pada kehadiran dan kekuatan dewa atau dewi yang lebih tinggi.
statement.en: Brahma creates all the forms in the universe but not the primordial universe itself; in most Puranic texts his creative activity depends on the presence and power of a higher god or goddess.

claims.quote: In the post-Vedic Puranic literature, Brahma creates but neither preserves nor destroys anything.

statement.id: Dalam sastra Purana pasca-Weda, Brahma menciptakan tetapi tidak memelihara maupun menghancurkan apa pun.
statement.en: In post-Vedic Puranic literature Brahma creates but neither preserves nor destroys anything.

claims.quote: The Puranas describe Brahma as the god creating time.

statement.id: Purana menggambarkan Brahma sebagai dewa yang menciptakan waktu.
statement.en: The Puranas describe Brahma as the god creating time.

claims.quote: Brahma, despite being believed to be the creator, is considered mortal according to scriptures. The Age of Brahma, according to Hindu cosmology, spans vast epochs of time. A kalpa is a day of Brahmā

statement.id: Meskipun diyakini sebagai pencipta, Brahma dianggap fana menurut kitab suci. Usia Brahma menurut kosmologi Hindu mencakup kurun waktu yang sangat panjang, dan satu kalpa adalah satu hari Brahma.
statement.en: Despite being believed to be the creator, Brahma is considered mortal according to scriptures. The Age of Brahma spans vast epochs in Hindu cosmology, and a kalpa is a day of Brahma.

claims.quote: Brahma is traditionally depicted with four faces and four arms. Each face of his points to a cardinal direction. His hands hold no weapons, rather symbols of knowledge and creation.

statement.id: Brahma secara tradisional digambarkan berwajah empat dan berlengan empat; setiap wajahnya menghadap satu arah mata angin, dan tangannya tidak memegang senjata melainkan lambang pengetahuan dan penciptaan.
statement.en: Brahma is traditionally depicted with four faces and four arms; each face points to a cardinal direction, and his hands hold no weapons but symbols of knowledge and creation.

claims.quote: Chapter 51 of the Manasara, an ancient design manual in Sanskrit for making murtis and temples, states that a Brahma statue should be gold in color.

statement.id: Bab 51 Manasara, buku panduan desain kuno berbahasa Sanskerta untuk membuat murti dan kuil, menyatakan bahwa arca Brahma hendaknya berwarna emas.
statement.en: Chapter 51 of the Manasara, an ancient Sanskrit design manual for making murtis and temples, states that a Brahma statue should be gold in colour.

claims.quote: Brahma's wife is the goddess Sarasvati. She is the embodiment of his power, the instrument of creation and the energy that drives his actions.

statement.id: Istri Brahma adalah dewi Sarasvati, perwujudan kekuatannya, sarana penciptaan, dan tenaga yang menggerakkan tindakannya.
statement.en: Brahma's wife is the goddess Sarasvati, the embodiment of his power, the instrument of creation and the energy that drives his actions.

claims.quote: Legends tell that Savitri, Brahma's wife, pronounced a curse restricting his worship to Pushkara.

statement.id: Legenda menyebut bahwa Savitri, istri Brahma, mengucapkan kutukan yang membatasi pemujaan Brahma hanya di Pushkara.
statement.en: Legends tell that Savitri, Brahma's wife, pronounced a curse restricting his worship to Pushkara.

claims.quote: Shiva then took his true form and cut off one of Brahma's five heads for his dishonesty, proclaiming that he would no longer receive an active following to his worship and would get a low status of popularity.

statement.id: Menurut kisah dari Siwa Purana, Siwa lalu menampakkan wujud aslinya dan memenggal satu dari lima kepala Brahma karena ketidakjujurannya, serta menyatakan bahwa Brahma tidak akan lagi memiliki pengikut aktif dan akan berkedudukan rendah dalam kepopuleran.
statement.en: In the account drawn from the Shiva Purana, Shiva then took his true form and cut off one of Brahma's five heads for his dishonesty, proclaiming that Brahma would no longer receive an active following and would have a low status of popularity.

claims.quote: Vishnu assumed the form of a boar as Varaha and journeyed towards the earth and Brahma assumed the form of a swan as Hamsa and journeyed towards the sky.

statement.id: Dalam kisah itu Wisnu menjelma babi hutan Waraha menuju bumi, sedangkan Brahma menjelma angsa Hamsa menuju langit.
statement.en: In that account Vishnu assumed the form of a boar, Varaha, and journeyed towards the earth, while Brahma assumed the form of a swan, Hamsa, and journeyed towards the sky.

claims.quote: A statue of Brahma is present at the Erawan Shrine in Bangkok, Thailand and continues to be revered in modern times. The golden dome of the Government House of Thailand houses a statue of Phra Phrom (Thai representation of Brahma).

statement.id: Sebuah arca Brahma terdapat di Kuil Erawan di Bangkok, Thailand, dan masih dihormati hingga kini; kubah emas Gedung Pemerintah Thailand memuat arca Phra Phrom, wujud Brahma dalam budaya Thai.
statement.en: A statue of Brahma stands at the Erawan Shrine in Bangkok, Thailand, and is still revered today; the golden dome of the Government House of Thailand houses a statue of Phra Phrom, the Thai representation of Brahma.

claims.quote: One of the three largest temples in the 9th-century CE Prambanan temples complex in Yogyakarta, central Java (Indonesia) is dedicated to Brahma, the other two to Shiva (largest of three) and Vishnu respectively.

statement.id: Salah satu dari tiga candi terbesar di kompleks Candi Prambanan abad ke-9 M di Yogyakarta, Jawa Tengah (Indonesia), dipersembahkan kepada Brahma; dua lainnya untuk Siwa (yang terbesar) dan Wisnu.
statement.en: One of the three largest temples in the 9th-century CE Prambanan complex in Yogyakarta, central Java (Indonesia), is dedicated to Brahma, the other two to Shiva (the largest) and Vishnu.

claims.quote: A shrine of Brahma can be found in Cambodia's Angkor Wat.

statement.id: Sebuah kuil Brahma terdapat di Angkor Wat, Kamboja.
statement.en: A shrine of Brahma can be found in Cambodia's Angkor Wat.

claims.quote: The name of the country Burma is derived from Brahma. In medieval texts, it is referred to as Brahma-desa.

statement.id: Nama negara Burma diturunkan dari Brahma; dalam teks abad pertengahan negeri itu disebut Brahma-desa.
statement.en: The name of the country Burma is derived from Brahma; in medieval texts it is referred to as Brahma-desa.

claims.quote: According to the scriptures, Brahma created his children from his mind and thus, they are referred to as Manasaputra.

statement.id: Menurut kitab suci, Brahma menciptakan anak-anaknya dari pikirannya sehingga mereka disebut Manasaputra.
statement.en: According to the scriptures, Brahma created his children from his mind, and so they are called Manasaputra.

claims.quote: Brahma is the Hindu creator god. He is also known as the Grandfather and as a later equivalent of Prajapati, the primeval first god. In early Hindu sources such as the Mahabharata, Brahma is supreme in the triad of great Hindu gods which includes Shiva and Vishnu.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma adalah dewa pencipta Hindu, juga dikenal sebagai Kakek dan sebagai padanan kemudian Prajapati, dewa pertama yang purba; dalam sumber Hindu awal seperti Mahabharata ia tertinggi dalam triad dewa besar Hindu bersama Siwa dan Wisnu.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma is the Hindu creator god, also known as the Grandfather and as a later equivalent of Prajapati, the primeval first god; in early Hindu sources such as the Mahabharata he is supreme in the triad of great Hindu gods that includes Shiva and Vishnu.

claims.quote: In later Puranas (Hindu epics) Brahma is no longer worshipped and other gods are assigned his myths, even if he always maintains his status as the creator god.

statement.id: Dalam Purana yang lebih kemudian, menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma tidak lagi dipuja dan mitos-mitosnya diberikan kepada dewa lain, meskipun ia selalu tetap berstatus dewa pencipta.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in later Puranas Brahma is no longer worshipped and other gods are assigned his myths, even though he always keeps his status as the creator god.

claims.quote: Brahma's epithet is ekahamsa, the One Swan. His vahanam ('vehicle') is a peacock, swan or goose.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, julukan Brahma adalah ekahamsa, "Angsa Tunggal", dan wahananya adalah merak, angsa, atau angsa liar.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma's epithet is ekahamsa, "the One Swan", and his vahanam (vehicle) is a peacock, swan or goose.

claims.quote: In the process of creating, perhaps in a moment of distraction, the demons were born from Brahma's thigh and so he abandoned his own body which then became Night. After Brahma created good gods he abandoned his body once again, which then became Day, hence demons gain the ascendancy at night and gods, the forces of goodness, rule the day.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam proses mencipta para iblis lahir dari paha Brahma sehingga ia meninggalkan tubuhnya yang lalu menjadi Malam; setelah menciptakan dewa-dewa yang baik ia meninggalkan tubuhnya lagi, yang lalu menjadi Siang, sehingga iblis unggul pada malam hari dan para dewa, kekuatan kebaikan, berkuasa pada siang hari.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in creating, the demons were born from Brahma's thigh and he abandoned his body, which became Night; after creating the good gods he abandoned his body again, which became Day, so demons gain the ascendancy at night and the gods, forces of goodness, rule the day.

claims.quote: Brahma then appointed Shiva to rule over humanity although in later myths Brahma becomes a servant of Shiva.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma kemudian menunjuk Siwa untuk memerintah umat manusia, meskipun dalam mitos yang lebih kemudian Brahma menjadi pelayan Siwa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma then appointed Shiva to rule over humanity, although in later myths Brahma becomes a servant of Shiva.

claims.quote: Brahma had several wives, the most important being his daughter Sarasvati who, after the Creation, bore Brahma the four Vedas (holy books of Hinduism), all branches of knowledge

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma memiliki beberapa istri, yang terpenting putrinya Sarasvati, yang setelah Penciptaan melahirkan bagi Brahma keempat Weda (kitab suci Hindu) dan semua cabang pengetahuan.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma had several wives, the most important being his daughter Sarasvati, who after the Creation bore Brahma the four Vedas (holy books of Hinduism) and all branches of knowledge.

claims.quote: Besides Daksa, Brahma had other notable sons including the Seven Sages (of whom Daksa was one), and the four famous Prajapatis (deities): Kardama, Pancasikha, Vodhu, and Narada, the latter being the messenger between gods and men.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, selain Daksa, Brahma memiliki putra terkemuka lain, termasuk Tujuh Resi (salah satunya Daksa) dan empat Prajapati termasyhur: Kardama, Pancasikha, Vodhu, dan Narada, yang terakhir adalah pembawa pesan antara dewa dan manusia.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, besides Daksa Brahma had other notable sons including the Seven Sages (Daksa being one) and the four famous Prajapatis: Kardama, Pancasikha, Vodhu and Narada, the latter the messenger between gods and men.

claims.quote: In another myth Brahma's first female is also Death, the evil force that brings balance to the universe and which ensures there is no over-crowding of it.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam mitos lain perempuan pertama ciptaan Brahma adalah juga Kematian, kekuatan jahat yang membawa keseimbangan bagi alam semesta dan mencegahnya penuh sesak.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in another myth Brahma's first female is also Death, the evil force that brings balance to the universe and ensures it does not become over-crowded.

claims.quote: Originally Brahma had five heads but when he lusted after his daughter Sandhya an outraged Shiva cut off the head which had ogled the goddess (or burned it with his central eye).

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, semula Brahma berkepala lima, tetapi ketika ia menginginkan putrinya Sandhya, Siwa yang murka memenggal kepala yang menatap sang dewi (atau membakarnya dengan mata tengahnya).
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma originally had five heads, but when he lusted after his daughter Sandhya an outraged Shiva cut off the head that had ogled the goddess (or burned it with his central eye).

claims.quote: Brahma is often represented in red with four heads, symbolic of his creation of the four Vedas. Thus he is often called Caturanana/Caturmukha or 'four-faced' and Astakarna or 'eight-eared'.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma sering digambarkan berwarna merah dengan empat kepala, lambang penciptaan empat Weda; karena itu ia sering disebut Caturanana atau Caturmukha, "berwajah empat", dan Astakarna, "bertelinga delapan".
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma is often shown in red with four heads, symbolic of his creation of the four Vedas, and so is often called Caturanana or Caturmukha, "four-faced", and Astakarna, "eight-eared".

claims.quote: In Cambodian art, Brahma - known as Prah Prohm - is again represented with four heads and often riding a sacred goose, the hamsa

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Kamboja Brahma, yang dikenal sebagai Prah Prohm, kembali digambarkan berkepala empat dan sering menunggang angsa suci hamsa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in Cambodian art Brahma, known as Prah Prohm, is again shown with four heads and often riding the sacred goose, the hamsa.

claims.quote: In Tibet, where Brahma is known as Tshangs-pa or White Brahma (Tshangs-pa dkar-po), he often rides a horse and carries a white bull and a sword.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, di Tibet Brahma dikenal sebagai Tshangs-pa atau Brahma Putih (Tshangs-pa dkar-po), sering menunggang kuda dan membawa banteng putih dan pedang.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in Tibet Brahma is known as Tshangs-pa or White Brahma (Tshangs-pa dkar-po) and often rides a horse and carries a white bull and a sword.

claims.quote: He, desiring to produce beings of many kinds from his own body, first with a thought created the waters, and placed his seed in them. ... That (seed) became a golden egg, in brilliancy equal to the sun; in that (egg) he himself was born as Brahman, the progenitor of the whole world.

statement.id: Menurut Hukum Manu (terjemahan Bühler), sang Svayambhu, ingin menghasilkan makhluk dari tubuhnya, pertama-tama dengan pikiran menciptakan air dan menaruh benihnya di dalamnya; benih itu menjadi telur emas secemerlang matahari, dan di dalamnya ia sendiri lahir sebagai Brahman, leluhur seluruh dunia.
statement.en: According to the Laws of Manu (Bühler's translation), the Self-existent, desiring to produce beings from his own body, first created the waters with a thought and placed his seed in them; the seed became a golden egg as bright as the sun, and in it he himself was born as Brahman, the progenitor of the whole world.

claims.quote: The divine one resided in that egg during a whole year, then he himself by his thought (alone) divided it into two halves; ... And out of those two halves he formed heaven and earth, between them the middle sphere, the eight points of the horizon, and the eternal abode of the waters.

statement.id: Menurut Hukum Manu, sang ilahi tinggal di dalam telur itu selama setahun penuh, lalu dengan pikirannya sendiri membelahnya menjadi dua bagian, dan dari kedua belahan itu ia membentuk langit dan bumi, ruang tengah di antaranya, delapan penjuru, dan tempat abadi air.
statement.en: According to the Laws of Manu, the divine one stayed in the egg for a whole year, then by his thought alone divided it into two halves, and out of the halves formed heaven and earth, the middle sphere between them, the eight points of the horizon and the eternal abode of the waters.

claims.quote: But know that the sum of one thousand ages of the gods (makes) one day of Brahman, and that his night has the same length.

statement.id: Menurut Hukum Manu, seribu zaman para dewa berjumlah satu hari Brahman, dan malamnya sama panjang.
statement.en: According to the Laws of Manu, one thousand ages of the gods make one day of Brahman, and his night has the same length.

claims.quote: At the end of that day and night he who was asleep, awakes and, after awaking, creates mind, which is both real and unreal.

statement.id: Menurut Hukum Manu, pada akhir siang dan malam itu ia yang tertidur terbangun dan setelah bangun menciptakan pikiran, yang sekaligus nyata dan tidak nyata.
statement.en: According to the Laws of Manu, at the end of that day and night he who was asleep awakes and, after awaking, creates mind, which is both real and unreal.

claims.quote: The Manvantaras, the creations and destructions (of the world, are) numberless; sporting, as it were, Brahman repeats this again and again.

statement.id: Menurut Hukum Manu, manvantara, penciptaan dan penghancuran dunia, tak terhitung jumlahnya; seolah bermain-main, Brahman mengulangi hal ini berulang kali.
statement.en: According to the Laws of Manu, the Manvantaras, the creations and destructions of the world, are numberless; sporting, as it were, Brahman repeats this again and again.

claims.quote: This (universe) existed in the shape of Darkness, unperceived, destitute of distinctive marks, unattainable by reasoning, unknowable, wholly immersed, as it were, in deep sleep.

statement.id: Menurut Hukum Manu, alam semesta ini semula berwujud Kegelapan, tak terindra, tanpa ciri pembeda, tak terjangkau nalar, tak terpahami, seakan terbenam sepenuhnya dalam tidur lelap.
statement.en: According to the Laws of Manu, this universe existed in the shape of Darkness, unperceived, without distinctive marks, unattainable by reasoning, unknowable, wholly immersed as if in deep sleep.

claims.quote: In contemporary Hinduism, Brahma does not enjoy popular worship and has substantially less importance than the other two members of the Trimurti.

statement.id: Dalam agama Hindu masa kini, Brahma tidak menikmati pemujaan populer dan jauh lebih kecil kepentingannya daripada dua anggota Trimurti lainnya.
statement.en: In contemporary Hinduism Brahma does not enjoy popular worship and has substantially less importance than the other two members of the Trimurti.

text.id: Disebut bersama Wisnu dan Siwa dalam Upanishad Maitrayaniya yang kemungkinan disusun sekitar akhir milenium pertama SM; sektenya ada pada masa pasca-Weda, tetapi menjelang abad ke-7 ia kehilangan kepentingannya.
text.en: Mentioned with Vishnu and Shiva in the Maitrayaniya Upanishad, probably composed around the late 1st millennium BCE; his sect existed in the post-Vedic period, but by the 7th century he had lost his significance.

cultural_context.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam sumber Hindu awal seperti Mahabharata Brahma tertinggi dalam triad dewa besar, tetapi dalam Purana yang lebih kemudian ia tidak lagi dipuja dan mitos-mitosnya diserahkan kepada dewa lain, walaupun kedudukannya sebagai pencipta tetap. Di India masa kini ia tidak menikmati pemujaan populer dan jauh lebih kecil kepentingannya daripada dua anggota Trimurti lainnya.
cultural_context.en: The World History Encyclopedia says that in early Hindu sources such as the Mahabharata Brahma stands highest in the triad of great gods, while in later Puranas worship of him ceases and his myths pass to other gods, though his standing as creator never changes. In contemporary Hinduism he receives no popular worship and counts for substantially less than the other two Trimurti members.

who.en: The creator god of Hinduism, called the Creator in the Trimurti.

name.en: Creation of the universe and beings

description.id: Dalam sastra Purana pasca-Weda Brahma menciptakan tetapi tidak memelihara maupun menghancurkan apa pun. Brahma dikaitkan dengan penciptaan segala sesuatu; menurut Brahmanda Purana ia menciptakan alam semesta, bumi, dan hal-hal lain setelah lahir dari telur emas, dan menurut World History Encyclopedia ia menciptakan dewa, iblis, leluhur, dan manusia.
description.en: In post-Vedic Puranic literature Brahma creates but neither preserves nor destroys anything. Brahma is associated with the creation of everything; according to the Brahmanda Purana he created the universe, the earth and other things after being born from the golden egg, and according to the World History Encyclopedia he created gods, demons, ancestors and men.

description.id: Purana menggambarkan Brahma sebagai dewa yang menciptakan waktu.
description.en: The Puranas describe Brahma as the god creating time.

description.en: Brahma is associated with knowledge and the Vedas; his four heads represent the four Vedas.

description.en: In most Puranic texts Brahma's creative activity depends on the presence and power of a higher god or goddess; he is also considered mortal according to scriptures.

summary.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma sprang from the cosmic golden egg and created good and evil, light and dark, and four kinds of beings: gods, demons, ancestors and men, the first being Manu.

title.en: The golden egg and the dividing of heaven and earth

role.id: Makhluk yang lahir dari telur dan pencipta
role.en: The being born from the egg, and creator

summary.id: Menurut Brahmanda Purana, mula-mula hanya ada samudra abadi dan dari situ muncul telur emas Hiranyagarbha; Brahma lahir di dalamnya lalu menciptakan alam semesta. Hukum Manu (terjemahan Bühler) menyebut telur itu menjadi tempat sang ilahi tinggal setahun penuh sebelum dibelah menjadi langit dan bumi.
summary.en: According to the Brahmanda Purana there was at first only an eternal ocean, from which the golden egg Hiranyagarbha emerged; Brahma was born within it and then created the universe. The Laws of Manu (Bühler's translation) say the divine one stayed in the egg a whole year before dividing it into heaven and earth.

role.en: The creator who abandons his body

summary.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, tubuh yang ditinggalkan Brahma setelah menciptakan iblis menjadi Malam dan setelah menciptakan dewa yang baik menjadi Siang, sehingga iblis unggul pada malam hari dan para dewa berkuasa pada siang hari.
summary.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, the body Brahma abandoned after creating demons became Night and after creating the good gods became Day, so demons gain the ascendancy at night and the gods rule the day.

summary.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam satu mitos perempuan pertama ciptaan Brahma adalah juga Kematian, kekuatan yang membawa keseimbangan bagi alam semesta dan mencegahnya penuh sesak.
summary.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in one myth Brahma's first female is also Death, a force that brings balance to the universe and ensures it does not become over-crowded.

title.en: The column of fire and the fifth head

role.id: Pihak yang berbohong dan dihukum Siwa
role.en: The party who lied and was punished by Shiva

summary.id: Menurut kisah dari Siwa Purana, Brahma dan Wisnu mencari ujung kolom api, yaitu Siwa; Wisnu menjelma babi hutan menuju bumi dan Brahma menjelma angsa menuju langit. Siwa lalu memenggal satu dari lima kepala Brahma karena ketidakjujurannya. World History Encyclopedia menyebut sebab lain bagi hilangnya kepala kelima.
summary.en: According to the account from the Shiva Purana, Brahma and Vishnu sought the end of a column of fire that was Shiva; Vishnu took the form of a boar toward the earth and Brahma that of a swan toward the sky. Shiva then cut off one of Brahma's five heads for his dishonesty. The World History Encyclopedia gives a different reason for the loss of the fifth head.

role.en: The god whose worship is restricted

summary.id: Legenda menyebut bahwa Savitri, istri Brahma, mengucapkan kutukan yang membatasi pemujaan Brahma hanya di Pushkara.
summary.en: According to legend, his wife Savitri uttered a curse that confined his worship to Pushkara.

title.en: Creation according to the Laws of Manu

role.en: Brahman, progenitor of the whole world

summary.id: Menurut Hukum Manu (terjemahan Bühler), alam semesta semula berwujud Kegelapan; sang Svayambhu menampakkan diri, menciptakan air, dan lahir sebagai Brahman dalam telur emas. Pada akhir siang dan malam Brahman, ia yang tertidur terbangun dan menciptakan pikiran; penciptaan dan penghancuran dunia tak terhitung jumlahnya, dan Brahman mengulanginya berulang kali.
summary.en: According to the Laws of Manu (Bühler's translation), the universe first existed in the shape of Darkness; the Self-existent appeared, created the waters and was born as Brahman in a golden egg. At the end of Brahman's day and night he who was asleep awakes and creates mind; the creations and destructions of the world are numberless, and Brahman repeats them again and again.

description.en: By the 7th century Brahma had lost his significance, overshadowed by Vishnu, Shiva and Mahadevi; historians name the rise of Shaivism and Vaishnavism among the major reasons.
