short_description.id: Brahma adalah dewa Hindu yang disebut Sang Pencipta dalam Trimurti bersama Wisnu dan Siwa, dikaitkan dengan penciptaan, pengetahuan, dan Weda, dan digambarkan berkepala empat dan duduk di atas teratai.
short_description.en: Brahma is a Hindu god called the Creator in the Trimurti alongside Vishnu and Shiva, associated with creation, knowledge and the Vedas, and shown with four heads, seated on a lotus.

long_description.id: Brahma adalah dewa Hindu yang disebut Sang Pencipta dalam Trimurti, bersama Wisnu dan Siwa. Ia dikaitkan dengan penciptaan segala sesuatu, pengetahuan, dan kitab Weda, dan banyak disebut dalam kisah penciptaan; menurut beberapa Purana ia menciptakan dirinya sendiri dalam janin emas yang disebut Hiranyagarbha. Brahma sering disamakan dengan dewa Weda Prajapati, dan menurut World History Encyclopedia ia juga dikenal sebagai Kakek.
long_description.en: Brahma is a Hindu god known as the Creator in the Trimurti, together with Vishnu and Shiva. He is tied to the making of all things, to knowledge and to the Vedas, and features strongly in creation stories; some Puranas say he created himself inside a golden embryo called the Hiranyagarbha. Brahma is often identified with the Vedic god Prajapati, and according to the World History Encyclopedia he is also known as the Grandfather.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah penciptaan, menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma muncul dari telur emas kosmis lalu menciptakan baik dan buruk, terang dan gelap, serta dewa, iblis, leluhur, dan manusia. Brahmanda Purana menyebut mula-mula hanya ada samudra abadi, dari mana muncul telur emas Hiranyagarbha tempat Brahma lahir dengan nama Svayambhu. Hukum Manu (terjemahan Bühler) menyebut sang ilahi tinggal setahun penuh di dalam telur itu lalu membelahnya menjadi langit dan bumi.
long_description.en: In the creation story, according to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma sprang from the cosmic golden egg and then created good and evil, light and dark, and gods, demons, ancestors and men. The Brahmanda Purana says there was at first only an eternal ocean, from which the golden egg Hiranyagarbha emerged, and Brahma was born in it with the name Svayambhu. The Laws of Manu (Bühler's translation) say the divine one stayed a whole year inside the egg and then divided it into heaven and earth.

long_description.id: Sumber berbeda tentang asal-usul Brahma: Purana yang berpusat pada Wisnu menyebutnya lahir dari teratai di pusar Wisnu, Purana yang berpusat pada Siwa menyebutnya lahir dari pinggang Siwa, dan sumber lain menyebut Tridewi menciptakannya. Dalam kebanyakan teks Purana ia pencipta sekunder yang kegiatannya bergantung pada dewa atau dewi yang lebih tinggi, dan menurut kitab suci ia fana. Hukum Manu menyebut satu hari Brahman sama dengan seribu zaman para dewa.
long_description.en: Sources differ on Brahma's origin: Vishnu-focused Puranas make him born from a lotus in Vishnu's navel, Shiva-focused Puranas from Shiva's waist, and other texts say the Tridevi created him. In most Puranic texts he is a secondary creator whose activity depends on a higher god or goddess, and according to scriptures he is mortal. The Laws of Manu says one day of Brahman equals one thousand ages of the gods.

long_description.id: Brahma biasanya digambarkan sebagai laki-laki berjanggut berkulit merah atau keemasan dengan empat kepala dan empat tangan; keempat kepalanya melambangkan empat Weda dan menghadap empat arah mata angin. Ia duduk di atas teratai dan wahananya adalah hamsa, dan tangannya memegang lambang pengetahuan dan penciptaan, bukan senjata. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, semula ia berkepala lima, dan Siwa memenggal satu kepalanya. Manasara, buku panduan desain kuno, menyatakan arca Brahma hendaknya berwarna emas.
long_description.en: Brahma is usually shown as a bearded red or golden man with four heads and four hands; the heads stand for the four Vedas and face the four directions. He sits on a lotus and his mount is the hamsa, and his hands hold symbols of knowledge and creation, not weapons. According to the World History Encyclopedia he originally had five heads, and Shiva cut one off. The Manasara, an ancient design manual, says a statue of Brahma should be gold in colour.

long_description.id: Pada masa pasca-Weda Brahma dewa terkemuka dengan sekte sendiri, tetapi menjelang abad ke-7 pengaruhnya surut dan ia dibayangi Wisnu, Siwa, dan Mahadewi. Di India masa kini hanya sedikit kuil yang dipersembahkan kepadanya, yang paling terkenal Kuil Brahma di Pushkar, Rajasthan. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia masih dihormati dengan upacara tahunan di Pushkar dan tetap populer di Asia Tenggara, terutama di Thailand dan Bali.
long_description.en: In the post-Vedic period Brahma was a prominent god with his own sect, but by the 7th century his standing had faded and he was overshadowed by Vishnu, Shiva and Mahadevi. Today only a few temples in India are devoted to him, the best known being the Brahma Temple at Pushkar in Rajasthan. According to the World History Encyclopedia he is still honoured with a yearly ceremony at Pushkar and remains popular in Southeast Asia, especially Thailand and Bali.

sources.title: Sacred Books of the East, Volume 25: Laws of Manu, Chapter 1 (translated by Georg Bühler)
sources.author: Georg Bühler (translator)

claims.quote: is a Hindu god, referred to as "the Creator" within the Trimurti, the trinity of supreme divinity that includes Vishnu and Shiva. He is associated with creation of everything, knowledge, and the Vedas. Brahma is prominently mentioned in creation legends. In some Puranas, he created himself in a golden embryo known as the Hiranyagarbha.

statement.id: Brahma (ब्रह्मा) adalah dewa Hindu yang disebut Sang Pencipta dalam Trimurti bersama Wisnu dan Siwa, dikaitkan dengan penciptaan, pengetahuan, dan Weda; menurut beberapa Purana ia menciptakan dirinya dalam janin emas Hiranyagarbha.
statement.en: Brahma (ब्रह्मा) is a Hindu god called the Creator in the Trimurti with Vishnu and Shiva, associated with creation, knowledge and the Vedas; some Puranas say he created himself in the golden embryo Hiranyagarbha.

claims.quote: Brahma is frequently identified with the Vedic god Prajapati. During the post-Vedic period, Brahma was a prominent deity and his sect existed; however, by the 7th century, he had lost his significance.

statement.id: Brahma sering disamakan dengan dewa Weda Prajapati; pada masa pasca-Weda ia dewa terkemuka dan sektenya ada, tetapi menjelang abad ke-7 ia kehilangan kepentingannya.
statement.en: Brahma is often identified with the Vedic god Prajapati; in the post-Vedic period he was a prominent deity and his sect existed, but by the 7th century he had lost his significance.

claims.quote: Brahma is commonly depicted as a red or golden-complexioned bearded man with four heads and hands. His four heads represent the four Vedas and are pointed to the four cardinal directions. He is seated on a lotus and his vahana (mount) is a hamsa

statement.id: Brahma digambarkan sebagai laki-laki berjanggut berkulit merah atau keemasan dengan empat kepala dan tangan; kepalanya melambangkan empat Weda dan menghadap empat arah; ia duduk di atas teratai dan kendaraannya hamsa.
statement.en: Brahma is shown as a bearded red or golden man with four heads and hands; the heads represent the four Vedas and face the four directions; he sits on a lotus and rides a hamsa.

claims.quote: Few temples dedicated to him exist in India, the most famous being the Brahma Temple, Pushkar in Rajasthan.

statement.id: Hanya sedikit kuil yang dipersembahkan kepadanya di India, yang paling terkenal adalah Kuil Brahma di Pushkar, Rajasthan.
statement.en: Few temples dedicated to him exist in India, the most famous being the Brahma Temple at Pushkar in Rajasthan.

claims.quote: He is still honoured today with an annual ceremony at the pilgrimage site of Pushkar in Rajasthan, India and he remains a popular figure in Southeast Asia, especially in Thailand and Bali.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma masih dihormati dengan upacara tahunan di Pushkar, Rajasthan, India, dan tetap populer di Asia Tenggara, terutama di Thailand dan Bali.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma is still honoured with an annual ceremony at Pushkar, Rajasthan, India, and remains popular in Southeast Asia, especially Thailand and Bali.

claims.quote: In the beginning, Brahma sprang from the cosmic golden egg and he then created good & evil and light & dark from his own person. He also created the four types: gods, demons, ancestors, and men (the first being Manu).

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma muncul dari telur emas kosmis lalu menciptakan baik dan buruk, terang dan gelap, serta empat golongan: dewa, raksasa, leluhur, dan manusia.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma sprang from the cosmic golden egg and created good and evil, light and dark, and four kinds: gods, demons, ancestors and men.

claims.quote: He was also overshadowed by other major deities like Vishnu, Shiva, and Mahadevi and demoted to the role of a secondary creator, who was created by the major deities.

statement.id: Ia juga dibayangi dewa-dewa utama lain seperti Wisnu, Siwa, dan Mahadewi dan diturunkan menjadi pencipta sekunder yang diciptakan oleh dewa-dewa utama.
statement.en: He was also overshadowed by other major deities such as Vishnu, Shiva and Mahadevi and demoted to the role of a secondary creator, created by the major deities.

claims.quote: Historians believe that some of the major reasons for Brahma's downfall were the rise of Shaivism and Vaishnavism, their replacement of him with Mahadevi in the Smarta tradition, and the frequent attacks by Buddhists, Jains, Hindus who worship Shiva and Vishnu.

statement.id: Para sejarawan berpendapat bahwa alasan utama kemerosotan Brahma adalah bangkitnya Saiwa dan Waisnawa, penggantian dirinya oleh Mahadewi dalam tradisi Smarta, dan serangan terus-menerus dari umat Buddha, Jain, dan penganut Hindu pemuja Siwa dan Wisnu.
statement.en: Historians believe that the major reasons for Brahma's downfall were the rise of Shaivism and Vaishnavism, their replacement of him with Mahadevi in the Smarta tradition, and frequent attacks by Buddhists, Jains and Hindus who worship Shiva and Vishnu.

claims.quote: One of the earliest mentions of Brahma with Vishnu and Shiva is in the fifth Prapathaka (lesson) of the Maitrayaniya Upanishad, probably composed around the late 1st millennium BCE.

statement.id: Salah satu penyebutan paling awal Brahma bersama Wisnu dan Siwa terdapat pada Prapathaka kelima Upanishad Maitrayaniya, yang kemungkinan disusun sekitar akhir milenium pertama SM.
statement.en: One of the earliest mentions of Brahma together with Vishnu and Shiva is in the fifth Prapathaka (lesson) of the Maitrayaniya Upanishad, probably composed around the late 1st millennium BCE.

claims.quote: While the Maitrayaniya Upanishad maps Brahma with one of the elements of the guṇas theory of Hinduism, the text does not depict him as one of the trifunctional elements of the Hindu Trimurti idea found in later Puranic literature.

statement.id: Meskipun Upanishad Maitrayaniya memetakan Brahma pada salah satu unsur teori guna, teks itu tidak menggambarkannya sebagai salah satu unsur trifungsi gagasan Trimurti yang terdapat dalam sastra Purana yang lebih kemudian.
statement.en: While the Maitrayaniya Upanishad maps Brahma to one of the elements of the guna theory, the text does not depict him as one of the trifunctional elements of the Trimurti idea found in later Puranic literature.

claims.quote: Early texts like the Brahmanda Purana describe that there was nothing but an eternal ocean. From this, a golden egg called Hiranyagarbha, emerged. The egg broke open and Brahma, who had created himself within it, came into existence (gaining the name Svayambhu). Then, he created the universe, the earth, and other things.

statement.id: Teks awal seperti Brahmanda Purana menyebut bahwa semula hanya ada samudra abadi; dari situ muncul telur emas bernama Hiranyagarbha. Telur itu pecah dan Brahma, yang telah menciptakan dirinya di dalamnya, lahir (dengan nama Svayambhu); lalu ia menciptakan alam semesta, bumi, dan hal-hal lain.
statement.en: Early texts such as the Brahmanda Purana say there was nothing but an eternal ocean, from which a golden egg called Hiranyagarbha emerged; the egg broke open and Brahma, who had created himself within it, came into existence (gaining the name Svayambhu), and then created the universe, the earth and other things.

claims.quote: Vishnu-focused Puranas describe that Brahma was born from a lotus emerging from the navel of the god Vishnu and Shiva was born from a fire emerging from the forehead of the god Vishnu.

statement.id: Purana yang berpusat pada Wisnu menyebut bahwa Brahma lahir dari teratai yang muncul dari pusar Wisnu, dan Siwa lahir dari api yang muncul dari dahi Wisnu.
statement.en: Vishnu-focused Puranas describe Brahma as born from a lotus emerging from the navel of Vishnu, and Shiva as born from a fire emerging from Vishnu's forehead.

claims.quote: In contrast, the Shiva-focused Puranas describe Brahma and Vishnu to be born from Shiva's right and left sides of his waist

statement.id: Sebaliknya, Purana yang berpusat pada Siwa menyebut Brahma dan Wisnu lahir dari sisi kanan dan kiri pinggang Siwa.
statement.en: In contrast, Shiva-focused Puranas describe Brahma and Vishnu as born from the right and left sides of Shiva's waist.

claims.quote: Yet others describe that the Tridevi created Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, and these texts then state that Brahma is a secondary creator of the world working respectively on their behalf.

statement.id: Sumber lain menyebut bahwa Tridewi menciptakan Brahma, Wisnu, dan Siwa, dan teks-teks itu menyatakan Brahma pencipta sekunder dunia yang bekerja atas nama mereka.
statement.en: Yet other texts describe the Tridevi as having created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, and state that Brahma is a secondary creator of the world working on their behalf.

claims.quote: Brahma creates all the forms in the universe, but not the primordial universe itself. Thus in most Puranic texts, Brahma's creative activity depends on the presence and power of a higher god or higher goddess.

statement.id: Brahma menciptakan segala bentuk di alam semesta, tetapi bukan alam semesta primordial itu sendiri; dalam kebanyakan teks Purana, kegiatan penciptaannya bergantung pada kehadiran dan kekuatan dewa atau dewi yang lebih tinggi.
statement.en: Brahma creates all the forms in the universe but not the primordial universe itself; in most Puranic texts his creative activity depends on the presence and power of a higher god or goddess.

claims.quote: In the post-Vedic Puranic literature, Brahma creates but neither preserves nor destroys anything.

statement.id: Dalam sastra Purana pasca-Weda, Brahma menciptakan tetapi tidak memelihara maupun menghancurkan apa pun.
statement.en: In post-Vedic Puranic literature Brahma creates but neither preserves nor destroys anything.

claims.quote: The Puranas describe Brahma as the god creating time.

statement.id: Purana menggambarkan Brahma sebagai dewa yang menciptakan waktu.
statement.en: The Puranas describe Brahma as the god creating time.

claims.quote: Brahma, despite being believed to be the creator, is considered mortal according to scriptures. The Age of Brahma, according to Hindu cosmology, spans vast epochs of time. A kalpa is a day of Brahmā

statement.id: Meskipun diyakini sebagai pencipta, Brahma dianggap fana menurut kitab suci. Usia Brahma menurut kosmologi Hindu mencakup kurun waktu yang sangat panjang, dan satu kalpa adalah satu hari Brahma.
statement.en: Despite being believed to be the creator, Brahma is considered mortal according to scriptures. The Age of Brahma spans vast epochs in Hindu cosmology, and a kalpa is a day of Brahma.

claims.quote: Brahma is traditionally depicted with four faces and four arms. Each face of his points to a cardinal direction. His hands hold no weapons, rather symbols of knowledge and creation.

statement.id: Brahma secara tradisional digambarkan berwajah empat dan berlengan empat; setiap wajahnya menghadap satu arah mata angin, dan tangannya tidak memegang senjata melainkan lambang pengetahuan dan penciptaan.
statement.en: Brahma is traditionally depicted with four faces and four arms; each face points to a cardinal direction, and his hands hold no weapons but symbols of knowledge and creation.

claims.quote: Chapter 51 of the Manasara, an ancient design manual in Sanskrit for making murtis and temples, states that a Brahma statue should be gold in color.

statement.id: Bab 51 Manasara, buku panduan desain kuno berbahasa Sanskerta untuk membuat murti dan kuil, menyatakan bahwa arca Brahma hendaknya berwarna emas.
statement.en: Chapter 51 of the Manasara, an ancient Sanskrit design manual for making murtis and temples, states that a Brahma statue should be gold in colour.

claims.quote: Brahma's wife is the goddess Sarasvati. She is the embodiment of his power, the instrument of creation and the energy that drives his actions.

statement.id: Istri Brahma adalah dewi Sarasvati, perwujudan kekuatannya, sarana penciptaan, dan tenaga yang menggerakkan tindakannya.
statement.en: Brahma's wife is the goddess Sarasvati, the embodiment of his power, the instrument of creation and the energy that drives his actions.

claims.quote: Legends tell that Savitri, Brahma's wife, pronounced a curse restricting his worship to Pushkara.

statement.id: Legenda menyebut bahwa Savitri, istri Brahma, mengucapkan kutukan yang membatasi pemujaan Brahma hanya di Pushkara.
statement.en: Legends tell that Savitri, Brahma's wife, pronounced a curse restricting his worship to Pushkara.

claims.quote: Shiva then took his true form and cut off one of Brahma's five heads for his dishonesty, proclaiming that he would no longer receive an active following to his worship and would get a low status of popularity.

statement.id: Menurut kisah dari Siwa Purana, Siwa lalu menampakkan wujud aslinya dan memenggal satu dari lima kepala Brahma karena ketidakjujurannya, serta menyatakan bahwa Brahma tidak akan lagi memiliki pengikut aktif dan akan berkedudukan rendah dalam kepopuleran.
statement.en: In the account drawn from the Shiva Purana, Shiva then took his true form and cut off one of Brahma's five heads for his dishonesty, proclaiming that Brahma would no longer receive an active following and would have a low status of popularity.

claims.quote: Vishnu assumed the form of a boar as Varaha and journeyed towards the earth and Brahma assumed the form of a swan as Hamsa and journeyed towards the sky.

statement.id: Dalam kisah itu Wisnu menjelma babi hutan Waraha menuju bumi, sedangkan Brahma menjelma angsa Hamsa menuju langit.
statement.en: In that account Vishnu assumed the form of a boar, Varaha, and journeyed towards the earth, while Brahma assumed the form of a swan, Hamsa, and journeyed towards the sky.

claims.quote: A statue of Brahma is present at the Erawan Shrine in Bangkok, Thailand and continues to be revered in modern times. The golden dome of the Government House of Thailand houses a statue of Phra Phrom (Thai representation of Brahma).

statement.id: Sebuah arca Brahma terdapat di Kuil Erawan di Bangkok, Thailand, dan masih dihormati hingga kini; kubah emas Gedung Pemerintah Thailand memuat arca Phra Phrom, wujud Brahma dalam budaya Thai.
statement.en: A statue of Brahma stands at the Erawan Shrine in Bangkok, Thailand, and is still revered today; the golden dome of the Government House of Thailand houses a statue of Phra Phrom, the Thai representation of Brahma.

claims.quote: One of the three largest temples in the 9th-century CE Prambanan temples complex in Yogyakarta, central Java (Indonesia) is dedicated to Brahma, the other two to Shiva (largest of three) and Vishnu respectively.

statement.id: Salah satu dari tiga candi terbesar di kompleks Candi Prambanan abad ke-9 M di Yogyakarta, Jawa Tengah (Indonesia), dipersembahkan kepada Brahma; dua lainnya untuk Siwa (yang terbesar) dan Wisnu.
statement.en: One of the three largest temples in the 9th-century CE Prambanan complex in Yogyakarta, central Java (Indonesia), is dedicated to Brahma, the other two to Shiva (the largest) and Vishnu.

claims.quote: A shrine of Brahma can be found in Cambodia's Angkor Wat.

statement.id: Sebuah kuil Brahma terdapat di Angkor Wat, Kamboja.
statement.en: A shrine of Brahma can be found in Cambodia's Angkor Wat.

claims.quote: The name of the country Burma is derived from Brahma. In medieval texts, it is referred to as Brahma-desa.

statement.id: Nama negara Burma diturunkan dari Brahma; dalam teks abad pertengahan negeri itu disebut Brahma-desa.
statement.en: The name of the country Burma is derived from Brahma; in medieval texts it is referred to as Brahma-desa.

claims.quote: According to the scriptures, Brahma created his children from his mind and thus, they are referred to as Manasaputra.

statement.id: Menurut kitab suci, Brahma menciptakan anak-anaknya dari pikirannya sehingga mereka disebut Manasaputra.
statement.en: According to the scriptures, Brahma created his children from his mind, and so they are called Manasaputra.

claims.quote: Brahma is the Hindu creator god. He is also known as the Grandfather and as a later equivalent of Prajapati, the primeval first god. In early Hindu sources such as the Mahabharata, Brahma is supreme in the triad of great Hindu gods which includes Shiva and Vishnu.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma adalah dewa pencipta Hindu, juga dikenal sebagai Kakek dan sebagai padanan kemudian Prajapati, dewa pertama yang purba; dalam sumber Hindu awal seperti Mahabharata ia tertinggi dalam triad dewa besar Hindu bersama Siwa dan Wisnu.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma is the Hindu creator god, also known as the Grandfather and as a later equivalent of Prajapati, the primeval first god; in early Hindu sources such as the Mahabharata he is supreme in the triad of great Hindu gods that includes Shiva and Vishnu.

claims.quote: In later Puranas (Hindu epics) Brahma is no longer worshipped and other gods are assigned his myths, even if he always maintains his status as the creator god.

statement.id: Dalam Purana yang lebih kemudian, menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma tidak lagi dipuja dan mitos-mitosnya diberikan kepada dewa lain, meskipun ia selalu tetap berstatus dewa pencipta.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in later Puranas Brahma is no longer worshipped and other gods are assigned his myths, even though he always keeps his status as the creator god.

claims.quote: Brahma's epithet is ekahamsa, the One Swan. His vahanam ('vehicle') is a peacock, swan or goose.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, julukan Brahma adalah ekahamsa, "Angsa Tunggal", dan wahananya adalah merak, angsa, atau angsa liar.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma's epithet is ekahamsa, "the One Swan", and his vahanam (vehicle) is a peacock, swan or goose.

claims.quote: In the process of creating, perhaps in a moment of distraction, the demons were born from Brahma's thigh and so he abandoned his own body which then became Night. After Brahma created good gods he abandoned his body once again, which then became Day, hence demons gain the ascendancy at night and gods, the forces of goodness, rule the day.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam proses mencipta para iblis lahir dari paha Brahma sehingga ia meninggalkan tubuhnya yang lalu menjadi Malam; setelah menciptakan dewa-dewa yang baik ia meninggalkan tubuhnya lagi, yang lalu menjadi Siang, sehingga iblis unggul pada malam hari dan para dewa, kekuatan kebaikan, berkuasa pada siang hari.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in creating, the demons were born from Brahma's thigh and he abandoned his body, which became Night; after creating the good gods he abandoned his body again, which became Day, so demons gain the ascendancy at night and the gods, forces of goodness, rule the day.

claims.quote: Brahma then appointed Shiva to rule over humanity although in later myths Brahma becomes a servant of Shiva.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma kemudian menunjuk Siwa untuk memerintah umat manusia, meskipun dalam mitos yang lebih kemudian Brahma menjadi pelayan Siwa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma then appointed Shiva to rule over humanity, although in later myths Brahma becomes a servant of Shiva.

claims.quote: Brahma had several wives, the most important being his daughter Sarasvati who, after the Creation, bore Brahma the four Vedas (holy books of Hinduism), all branches of knowledge

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma memiliki beberapa istri, yang terpenting putrinya Sarasvati, yang setelah Penciptaan melahirkan bagi Brahma keempat Weda (kitab suci Hindu) dan semua cabang pengetahuan.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma had several wives, the most important being his daughter Sarasvati, who after the Creation bore Brahma the four Vedas (holy books of Hinduism) and all branches of knowledge.

claims.quote: Besides Daksa, Brahma had other notable sons including the Seven Sages (of whom Daksa was one), and the four famous Prajapatis (deities): Kardama, Pancasikha, Vodhu, and Narada, the latter being the messenger between gods and men.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, selain Daksa, Brahma memiliki putra terkemuka lain, termasuk Tujuh Resi (salah satunya Daksa) dan empat Prajapati termasyhur: Kardama, Pancasikha, Vodhu, dan Narada, yang terakhir adalah pembawa pesan antara dewa dan manusia.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, besides Daksa Brahma had other notable sons including the Seven Sages (Daksa being one) and the four famous Prajapatis: Kardama, Pancasikha, Vodhu and Narada, the latter the messenger between gods and men.

claims.quote: In another myth Brahma's first female is also Death, the evil force that brings balance to the universe and which ensures there is no over-crowding of it.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam mitos lain perempuan pertama ciptaan Brahma adalah juga Kematian, kekuatan jahat yang membawa keseimbangan bagi alam semesta dan mencegahnya penuh sesak.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in another myth Brahma's first female is also Death, the evil force that brings balance to the universe and ensures it does not become over-crowded.

claims.quote: Originally Brahma had five heads but when he lusted after his daughter Sandhya an outraged Shiva cut off the head which had ogled the goddess (or burned it with his central eye).

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, semula Brahma berkepala lima, tetapi ketika ia menginginkan putrinya Sandhya, Siwa yang murka memenggal kepala yang menatap sang dewi (atau membakarnya dengan mata tengahnya).
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma originally had five heads, but when he lusted after his daughter Sandhya an outraged Shiva cut off the head that had ogled the goddess (or burned it with his central eye).

claims.quote: Brahma is often represented in red with four heads, symbolic of his creation of the four Vedas. Thus he is often called Caturanana/Caturmukha or 'four-faced' and Astakarna or 'eight-eared'.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Brahma sering digambarkan berwarna merah dengan empat kepala, lambang penciptaan empat Weda; karena itu ia sering disebut Caturanana atau Caturmukha, "berwajah empat", dan Astakarna, "bertelinga delapan".
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Brahma is often shown in red with four heads, symbolic of his creation of the four Vedas, and so is often called Caturanana or Caturmukha, "four-faced", and Astakarna, "eight-eared".

claims.quote: In Cambodian art, Brahma - known as Prah Prohm - is again represented with four heads and often riding a sacred goose, the hamsa

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Kamboja Brahma, yang dikenal sebagai Prah Prohm, kembali digambarkan berkepala empat dan sering menunggang angsa suci hamsa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in Cambodian art Brahma, known as Prah Prohm, is again shown with four heads and often riding the sacred goose, the hamsa.

claims.quote: In Tibet, where Brahma is known as Tshangs-pa or White Brahma (Tshangs-pa dkar-po), he often rides a horse and carries a white bull and a sword.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, di Tibet Brahma dikenal sebagai Tshangs-pa atau Brahma Putih (Tshangs-pa dkar-po), sering menunggang kuda dan membawa banteng putih dan pedang.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in Tibet Brahma is known as Tshangs-pa or White Brahma (Tshangs-pa dkar-po) and often rides a horse and carries a white bull and a sword.

claims.quote: He, desiring to produce beings of many kinds from his own body, first with a thought created the waters, and placed his seed in them. ... That (seed) became a golden egg, in brilliancy equal to the sun; in that (egg) he himself was born as Brahman, the progenitor of the whole world.

statement.id: Menurut Hukum Manu (terjemahan Bühler), sang Svayambhu, ingin menghasilkan makhluk dari tubuhnya, pertama-tama dengan pikiran menciptakan air dan menaruh benihnya di dalamnya; benih itu menjadi telur emas secemerlang matahari, dan di dalamnya ia sendiri lahir sebagai Brahman, leluhur seluruh dunia.
statement.en: According to the Laws of Manu (Bühler's translation), the Self-existent, desiring to produce beings from his own body, first created the waters with a thought and placed his seed in them; the seed became a golden egg as bright as the sun, and in it he himself was born as Brahman, the progenitor of the whole world.

claims.quote: The divine one resided in that egg during a whole year, then he himself by his thought (alone) divided it into two halves; ... And out of those two halves he formed heaven and earth, between them the middle sphere, the eight points of the horizon, and the eternal abode of the waters.

statement.id: Menurut Hukum Manu, sang ilahi tinggal di dalam telur itu selama setahun penuh, lalu dengan pikirannya sendiri membelahnya menjadi dua bagian, dan dari kedua belahan itu ia membentuk langit dan bumi, ruang tengah di antaranya, delapan penjuru, dan tempat abadi air.
statement.en: According to the Laws of Manu, the divine one stayed in the egg for a whole year, then by his thought alone divided it into two halves, and out of the halves formed heaven and earth, the middle sphere between them, the eight points of the horizon and the eternal abode of the waters.

claims.quote: But know that the sum of one thousand ages of the gods (makes) one day of Brahman, and that his night has the same length.

statement.id: Menurut Hukum Manu, seribu zaman para dewa berjumlah satu hari Brahman, dan malamnya sama panjang.
statement.en: According to the Laws of Manu, one thousand ages of the gods make one day of Brahman, and his night has the same length.

claims.quote: At the end of that day and night he who was asleep, awakes and, after awaking, creates mind, which is both real and unreal.

statement.id: Menurut Hukum Manu, pada akhir siang dan malam itu ia yang tertidur terbangun dan setelah bangun menciptakan pikiran, yang sekaligus nyata dan tidak nyata.
statement.en: According to the Laws of Manu, at the end of that day and night he who was asleep awakes and, after awaking, creates mind, which is both real and unreal.

claims.quote: The Manvantaras, the creations and destructions (of the world, are) numberless; sporting, as it were, Brahman repeats this again and again.

statement.id: Menurut Hukum Manu, manvantara, penciptaan dan penghancuran dunia, tak terhitung jumlahnya; seolah bermain-main, Brahman mengulangi hal ini berulang kali.
statement.en: According to the Laws of Manu, the Manvantaras, the creations and destructions of the world, are numberless; sporting, as it were, Brahman repeats this again and again.

claims.quote: This (universe) existed in the shape of Darkness, unperceived, destitute of distinctive marks, unattainable by reasoning, unknowable, wholly immersed, as it were, in deep sleep.

statement.id: Menurut Hukum Manu, alam semesta ini semula berwujud Kegelapan, tak terindra, tanpa ciri pembeda, tak terjangkau nalar, tak terpahami, seakan terbenam sepenuhnya dalam tidur lelap.
statement.en: According to the Laws of Manu, this universe existed in the shape of Darkness, unperceived, without distinctive marks, unattainable by reasoning, unknowable, wholly immersed as if in deep sleep.

claims.quote: In contemporary Hinduism, Brahma does not enjoy popular worship and has substantially less importance than the other two members of the Trimurti.

statement.id: Dalam agama Hindu masa kini, Brahma tidak menikmati pemujaan populer dan jauh lebih kecil kepentingannya daripada dua anggota Trimurti lainnya.
statement.en: In contemporary Hinduism Brahma does not enjoy popular worship and has substantially less importance than the other two members of the Trimurti.

cultural_context.id: Dalam tradisi Saiwa, Siwa dipuja sebagai Tuhan Yang Mahatinggi. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia dewa terpenting bagi sekte Saiwa serta pelindung para yogi, brahmana, dan Weda; Wikipedia mencatatnya pula sebagai dewa pelindung yoga, meditasi, dan seni.
cultural_context.en: In the Shaiva tradition Shiva is worshipped as the Supreme Lord. According to the World History Encyclopedia he is the most important god for the Shaivism sect and the patron of yogis, Brahmins and the Vedas; Wikipedia also records him as patron god of yoga, meditation and the arts.

literal_meaning.id: mujur, menguntungkan, pemurah, ramah, baik hati, bersahabat
literal_meaning.en: auspicious, propitious, gracious, benign, kind, benevolent, friendly

who.id: Salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu.
who.en: One of the principal Hindu deities.

origin.id: Agama Hindu, terutama tradisi Saiwa.
origin.en: Hinduism, especially Shaivism.

role.id: Dewa pelebur sekaligus pelindung dalam Trimurti, dan Tuhan Yang Mahatinggi bagi pemuja Saiwa.
role.en: Destroyer and protector within the Trimurti, and the Supreme Lord for Shaiva devotees.

famous_for.id: Mata ketiga, Sungai Gangga di rambutnya, dan tarian kosmis Nataraja.
famous_for.en: His third eye, the Ganga in his hair and the cosmic dance of Nataraja.

did_you_know.id: Kisah Nilakantha, Si Leher Biru, punya dua versi: World History Encyclopedia menceritakan racun bisa Vasuki, sedangkan Mahabharata menyebut racun Kalakuta yang muncul selama pengadukan.
did_you_know.en: The tale of Nilakantha, Blue Throat, comes in two versions: the World History Encyclopedia tells of Vasuki's venom, whereas the Mahabharata names the Kalakuta poison that appeared during the churning.

description.id: Pada akhir tiap siklus ia meleburkan alam semesta sehingga penciptaan baru dapat terjadi.
description.en: At the end of each cycle he destroys the universe so that a new creation can begin.

description.id: Dari mata ketiganya ia melepaskan api; ia menyambar sapi-sapi Surabhi dengan api itu.
description.en: He looses fire from his third eye, with which he struck Surabhi's cows.

description.id: Ia memiliki senjata kesayangan yang disebut Pasuputa atau Pasupata; menurut Mahabharata, senjata itu dapat menghancurkan seluruh alam semesta bila dilepaskan, dan Arjuna memperolehnya darinya.
description.en: He has a favourite weapon called the Pasuputa or Pasupata; in the Mahabharata it may destroy the whole universe if hurled, and Arjuna obtains it from him.

description.id: Ia digambarkan membawa busur Pinaka dan disebut pemegang Pinaka dalam Mahabharata.
description.en: He is shown carrying the Pinaka bow and is called wielder of the Pinaka in the Mahabharata.

summary.id: Dalam Mahabharata, atas permintaan Brahman, Siwa menelan racun Kalakuta yang muncul selama pengadukan demi keselamatan ciptaan, dan tenggorokannya menjadi biru sehingga ia disebut Nilakantha. World History Encyclopedia menceritakan versi lain: Siwa meminum bisa yang hendak dimuntahkan Vasuki.
summary.en: In the Mahabharata, at Brahman's request, Shiva swallows the Kalakuta poison that rose during the churning, for the safety of creation, and from then on is called Nilakantha. The World History Encyclopedia tells another version in which Shiva drinks the venom Vasuki threatened to spew.

role.id: Dewa yang menyamar dan menganugerahkan senjata
role.en: God in disguise who grants a weapon

summary.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Hara mengambil rupa seorang Kirata bersama Uma dalam rupa perempuan Kirata; dalam ringkasan epos itu, Arjuna memperoleh senjata Pasupata setelah menyenangkan sang dewa mata tiga yang menyamar sebagai pemburu dalam pertempuran.
summary.en: In the Mahabharata, Hara takes the form of a Kirata with Uma as a Kirata woman; a summary passage of the epic says Arjuna obtained the Pasupata weapon after pleasing the three-eyed god, disguised as a hunter, in combat.

title.en: The sacrifice of Daksha and the death of Sati

role.id: Suami Sati yang murka lalu mengampuni
role.en: Husband of Sati, wrathful and then forgiving

summary.id: Daksha mengadakan upacara kurban untuk semua dewa kecuali Siwa, dan Sati menceburkan diri ke api kurban. Siwa menciptakan Virabhadra dan Rudrakali yang memenggal Daksha, lalu menghidupkannya kembali dengan kepala domba atas permohonan para dewa.
summary.en: Daksha held a sacrifice for all gods but Shiva, and Sati threw herself on the sacrificial fire. Shiva created Virabhadra and Rudrakali, who beheaded Daksha, then revived him with a ram's head at the gods' appeal.

summary.id: Setelah menyadari kekeliruannya, Siwa mencari kepala baru bagi anak itu; kepala terdekat adalah kepala gajah, sehingga lahirlah Ganesha.
summary.en: Realising his error, Shiva sought a new head for the boy; the nearest was an elephant's, and Ganesha was born.

role.en: He who breaks the river's fall

summary.id: Siwa menangkap Gangga dalam sanggul rambutnya agar jatuhnya sungai itu ke bumi tidak menghancurkan peradaban.
summary.en: Shiva caught the Ganga in his hair topknot so that her fall to earth would not destroy civilisation.

summary.id: Susu sapi-sapi Surabhi membanjiri tempat tinggal Siwa; ia menyambar sapi-sapi itu dengan api dari mata ketiganya, dan para dewa menenangkannya dengan mempersembahkan banteng Nandi.
summary.en: The milk of Surabhi's cows flooded Shiva's home; he struck the cows with fire from his third eye, and the gods calmed him by offering the bull Nandi.

description.id: Tempat Siwa hidup bertapa sebagai yogi; Mahabharata menyebut tempat tinggalnya di pegunungan (Kailasa).
description.en: Where Shiva lives as an ascetic yogi; the Mahabharata places his abode on the mountains (of Kailasa).

topic.en: Origin of the Nilakantha poison story

summary.id: World History Encyclopedia: Vasuki, raja ular, hendak memuntahkan bisa ke lautan; Siwa dalam wujud kura-kura raksasa menampung bisa itu di telapak tangannya dan meminumnya, dan racun itu meninggalkan bekas biru di tenggorokannya.
summary.en: World History Encyclopedia: Vasuki, king of the serpents, threatened to vomit venom across the seas; Shiva, as a giant tortoise, collected the venom in his palm and drank it, and the poison left a blue scar on his throat.

summary.id: Mahabharata (terjemahan Ganguli): racun Kalakuta muncul selama pengadukan, dan Siwa menelannya atas permintaan Brahman demi keselamatan ciptaan.
summary.en: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation): the Kalakuta poison arose during the churning, and Siva swallowed it at Brahman's request for the safety of creation.

summary.en: Monier-Williams dictionary: śiva means "auspicious, propitious, gracious, benign, kind, benevolent, friendly".

summary.id: Sharma: akar kata śarv- berarti "melukai" atau "membunuh", sehingga nama itu berarti "yang dapat membunuh kekuatan kegelapan".
summary.en: Sharma: the root śarv- means "to injure" or "to kill", so the name connotes "one who can kill the forces of darkness".

short_description.id: Siwa, juga disebut Mahadewa, adalah salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu, Yang Mahatinggi dalam tradisi Saiwa, dan anggota Trimurti yang berperan sebagai pelebur dan pelindung.
short_description.en: Shiva, also called Mahadeva, is one of the principal deities of Hinduism, the Supreme Being in Shaivism, and a member of the Trimurti who acts as destroyer and protector.

long_description.id: Siwa, yang namanya berarti "mujur" atau "menguntungkan", juga dikenal sebagai Mahadewa dan Sankara, adalah salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu. Dalam tradisi Saiwa ia Yang Mahatinggi, Tuhan yang mencipta, memelihara, dan mengubah alam semesta. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia anggota Trimurti bersama Brahma dan Wisnu, berperan sebagai Pelindung, dan sebagai penguasa Waktu ia pelebur sekaligus pencipta segala sesuatu.
long_description.en: Shiva, whose name means "auspicious" or "propitious", is also called Mahadeva and Sankara and ranks among the chief gods of Hinduism. In Shaivism he is the highest being, the Lord who creates, protects and transforms the universe. According to the World History Encyclopedia he belongs to the Trimurti with Brahma and Vishnu, serves as the Protector, and as lord of Time is both destroyer and creator of all things.

long_description.id: Siwa memiliki banyak aspek, yang welas asih maupun yang menakutkan. Dalam aspek welas asihnya ia digambarkan sebagai yogi mahatahu yang hidup bertapa di Kailasa sekaligus kepala keluarga bersama istrinya, Parwati, dan kedua anaknya, Ganesha dan Kartikeya; dalam aspek garangnya ia sering digambarkan membinasakan raksasa. Menurut World History Encyclopedia ia pertapa agung yang memusatkan diri pada meditasi, tetapi juga memiliki sisi gelap sebagai pemimpin roh jahat dan hantu serta penguasa pencuri, penjahat, dan pengemis. Ia dikenal pula sebagai Adiyogi, yogi pertama, pelindung yoga, meditasi, dan seni.
long_description.en: Shiva shows both gentle and terrifying sides. In his gentle forms he appears as an all-knowing ascetic yogi dwelling on Kailasa, and also as a family man with his consort Parvati and their sons Ganesha and Kartikeya; in his wrathful forms he is frequently portrayed destroying demons. According to the World History Encyclopedia he is the great ascetic who concentrates on meditation, yet he also has a darker side as leader of evil spirits and ghosts and master of thieves, villains and beggars. He is also honoured as Adiyogi, the first yogi, patron of yoga, meditation and the arts.

long_description.id: Ciri ikonografinya antara lain raja ular Vasuki di lehernya, bulan sabit, Sungai Gangga yang mengalir dari rambut gimbalnya, mata ketiga di dahinya, trisula sebagai senjatanya, dan kendang damaru; ia biasanya dipuja dalam wujud lingga, lambang kesuburan atau energi ilahi yang terdapat di kuil-kuilnya. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Asia ia biasanya mewakili Nataraja yang membawakan tarian kosmis Tandava dalam lingkaran api, dan kadang membawa busur perak Pinaka serta menunggang banteng putih. Siwa dipuja luas oleh umat Hindu di India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, dan Indonesia, terutama di Jawa dan Bali.
long_description.en: Among his emblems are the serpent king Vasuki around his neck, a crescent moon, the holy Ganga flowing from his matted hair, a third eye on his forehead, the trident as his weapon and the damaru drum; he is usually worshipped in the aniconic form of the lingam, a symbol of fertility or divine energy found in his temples. According to the World History Encyclopedia, in Asian art he usually represents Nataraja, performing the Tandava cosmic dance within a circle of fire, and is sometimes shown with the silver bow Pinaka and riding a white bull. Hindus honour Shiva across India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Indonesia, notably in Java and Bali.

long_description.id: Kisah-kisahnya memperlihatkan kekuatannya. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Siwa menciptakan Virabhadra dan Rudrakali dari rambutnya, yang kemudian memenggal Daksha, menangkap Gangga dalam sanggulnya agar jatuhnya sungai itu tidak menghancurkan peradaban, dan menyambar sapi-sapi Surabhi dengan api dari mata ketiganya sebelum para dewa menenangkannya dengan banteng Nandi. Dalam Mahabharata, ia menelan racun yang muncul selama pengadukan, dan sejak itu disebut Nilakantha, serta mengambil rupa seorang Kirata dan menurut ringkasan epos itu menganugerahkan senjata Pasupata kepada Arjuna.
long_description.en: His stories show his power. According to the World History Encyclopedia, Shiva created Virabhadra and Rudrakali from his hair, who then beheaded Daksha, caught the Ganga in his topknot so that her fall would not destroy civilisation, and struck Surabhi's cows with fire from his third eye before the gods calmed him with the bull Nandi. In the Mahabharata he swallows the poison that appeared during the churning and is called Nilakantha from then on, and he takes the form of a Kirata and, according to a summary passage of the epic, grants the Pasupata weapon to Arjuna.

claims.quote: is one of the principal deities of Hinduism. He is the Supreme Being in Shaivism, one of the major traditions within Hinduism.

statement.id: Siwa adalah salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu dan Yang Mahatinggi dalam tradisi Saiwa.
statement.en: Shiva is one of the principal deities of Hinduism and the Supreme Being in Shaivism.

claims.quote: In the Shaivite tradition, Shiva is the Supreme Lord who creates, protects and transforms the universe.

statement.id: Dalam tradisi Saiwa, Siwa adalah Tuhan Yang Mahatinggi yang mencipta, memelihara, dan mengubah alam semesta.
statement.en: In the Shaiva tradition Shiva is the Supreme Lord who creates, protects and transforms the universe.

claims.quote: Shiva has many aspects, benevolent as well as fearsome. In benevolent aspects, he is depicted as an omniscient yogi who lives an ascetic life on Kailasa as well as a householder with his wife Parvati and his two children, Ganesha and Kartikeya. In his fierce aspects, he is often depicted slaying demons.

statement.id: Siwa memiliki aspek welas asih dan menakutkan: ia digambarkan sebagai yogi mahatahu yang bertapa di Kailasa dan kepala keluarga bersama Parwati serta anak-anaknya, Ganesha dan Kartikeya, dan dalam aspek garangnya membinasakan raksasa.
statement.en: Shiva has benevolent and fearsome aspects: an omniscient ascetic yogi on Kailasa and a householder with Parvati and their children Ganesha and Kartikeya, and in fierce aspects a slayer of demons.

claims.quote: Shiva is also known as Adiyogi (the first yogi), regarded as the patron god of yoga, meditation and the arts.

statement.id: Siwa juga dikenal sebagai Adiyogi (yogi pertama), dewa pelindung yoga, meditasi, dan seni.
statement.en: Shiva is also known as Adiyogi (the first yogi), patron god of yoga, meditation and the arts.

claims.quote: The iconographical attributes of Shiva are the serpent king Vasuki around his neck, the adorning crescent moon, the holy river Ganga flowing from his matted hair, the third eye on his forehead (the eye that turns everything in front of it into ashes when opened), the trishula or trident as his weapon, and the damaru. He is usually worshiped in the aniconic form of lingam.

statement.id: Ciri ikonografi Siwa antara lain raja ular Vasuki di lehernya, bulan sabit, Sungai Gangga yang mengalir dari rambut gimbalnya, mata ketiga di dahinya, trisula, dan damaru; ia biasanya dipuja dalam wujud lingga.
statement.en: Shiva's attributes include the serpent king Vasuki round his neck, the crescent moon, the Ganga flowing from his matted hair, the third eye, the trident and the damaru; he is usually worshipped as the lingam.

claims.quote: Shiva is a pan-Hindu deity, revered widely by Hindus in India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Indonesia (especially in Java and Bali).

statement.id: Siwa adalah dewa seluruh umat Hindu yang dipuja luas di India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, dan Indonesia (terutama Jawa dan Bali).
statement.en: Shiva is a pan-Hindu deity revered widely in India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Indonesia (especially Java and Bali).

claims.quote: Though associated with Vedic deity Rudra, Shiva may have non-Vedic roots

statement.id: Meski dikaitkan dengan dewa Weda Rudra, Siwa mungkin berakar dari luar tradisi Weda.
statement.en: Though associated with the Vedic deity Rudra, Shiva may have non-Vedic roots.

claims.quote: In Hinduism, the universe is thought to regenerate in cycles (every 2,160,000,000 years). Shiva destroys the universe at the end of each cycle which then allows for a new Creation.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam agama Hindu alam semesta beregenerasi dalam siklus, dan Siwa meleburnya pada akhir setiap siklus sehingga penciptaan baru dapat terjadi.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in Hinduism the universe regenerates in cycles, and Shiva destroys it at the end of each cycle, allowing a new creation.

claims.quote: The poison burned his throat and left a permanent blue scar, hence one of his many titles became Nilakantha or Blue Throat.

statement.id: Racun yang diminum Siwa membakar tenggorokannya dan meninggalkan bekas biru permanen, sehingga ia bergelar Nilakantha, Si Leher Biru.
statement.en: The poison Shiva drank burned his throat and left a permanent blue scar, so he became Nilakantha, Blue Throat.

claims.quote: According to the Monier-Williams Sanskrit dictionary, the word "śiva" (Devanagari: शिव ... means "auspicious, propitious, gracious, benign, kind, benevolent, friendly"

statement.id: Menurut kamus Sanskerta Monier-Williams, kata "śiva" (Devanagari: शिव) berarti "mujur, menguntungkan, pemurah, ramah, baik hati, bersahabat".
statement.en: According to the Monier-Williams Sanskrit dictionary, the word "śiva" (Devanagari: शिव) means "auspicious, propitious, gracious, benign, kind, benevolent, friendly".

claims.quote: Sharma presents another etymology with the Sanskrit root śarv-, which means "to injure" or "to kill", interpreting the name to connote "one who can kill the forces of darkness".

statement.id: Sharma mengajukan etimologi lain dari akar kata Sanskerta śarv-, yang berarti "melukai" atau "membunuh", dan menafsirkan nama itu sebagai "yang dapat membunuh kekuatan kegelapan".
statement.en: Sharma presents another etymology from the Sanskrit root śarv-, meaning "to injure" or "to kill", interpreting the name as "one who can kill the forces of darkness".

claims.quote: Shiva (Siva) is one of the most important gods in Hinduism and a member of the holy trinity (trimurti) with Brahma and Vishnu. Shiva is a complex character who may represent goodness and benevolence, and he serves as the Protector.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Siwa (Siva) adalah salah satu dewa terpenting dalam agama Hindu dan anggota tritunggal suci (trimurti) bersama Brahma dan Wisnu; ia tokoh yang kompleks, dapat melambangkan kebaikan dan kemurahan hati, dan berperan sebagai Pelindung.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Shiva (Siva) is one of the most important gods in Hinduism and a member of the holy trinity (trimurti) with Brahma and Vishnu; a complex character who may represent goodness and benevolence, he serves as the Protector.

claims.quote: Shiva is also associated with Time, and in this capacity, he is both the destroyer and creator of all things.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Siwa juga dikaitkan dengan Waktu, dan dalam kapasitas itu ia pelebur sekaligus pencipta segala sesuatu.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Shiva is also associated with Time, and in that capacity he is both the destroyer and the creator of all things.

claims.quote: Shiva is also the great ascetic, abstaining from all forms of indulgence and pleasure, concentrating rather on meditation as a means to find perfect happiness. He also has a darker side as the leader of evil spirits, ghosts and as the master of thieves, villains and beggars.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Siwa adalah pertapa agung yang menjauhi segala kenikmatan dan memusatkan diri pada meditasi; ia juga memiliki sisi gelap sebagai pemimpin roh jahat dan hantu serta penguasa pencuri, penjahat, dan pengemis.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Shiva is the great ascetic who abstains from all indulgence and pleasure and concentrates on meditation; he also has a darker side as leader of evil spirits and ghosts and master of thieves, villains and beggars.

claims.quote: Shiva is the most important Hindu god for the Shaivism sect, the patron of Yogis and Brahmins, and also the protector of the Vedas, the sacred texts.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Siwa adalah dewa terpenting bagi sekte Saiwa, pelindung para yogi dan brahmana, serta pelindung Weda, kitab-kitab suci.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Shiva is the most important god for the Shaivism sect, the patron of yogis and Brahmins, and the protector of the Vedas, the sacred texts.

claims.quote: Daksha did not approve of Sati's marriage to Shiva and even went further and held a special sacrificial ceremony to all the gods except Shiva. Outraged at this slight, Sati threw herself on the sacrificial fire.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Daksha tidak menyetujui pernikahan putrinya Sati dengan Siwa dan mengadakan upacara kurban untuk semua dewa kecuali Siwa; tersinggung, Sati menceburkan diri ke api kurban itu.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Daksha disapproved of Sati's marriage to Shiva and held a sacrificial ceremony for all the gods except Shiva; outraged at the slight, Sati threw herself on the sacrificial fire.

claims.quote: Shiva reacted to this tragedy by creating two demons (Virabhadra and Rudrakali) from his hair who wreaked havoc on the ceremony and beheaded Daksha. The other gods appealed to Shiva to end the violence and, complying, he brought Daksha back to life but with the head of a ram (or goat).

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Siwa menciptakan dua iblis (Virabhadra dan Rudrakali) dari rambutnya yang mengacaukan upacara dan memenggal Daksha; atas permohonan para dewa, Siwa menghentikan kekerasan itu dan menghidupkan kembali Daksha dengan kepala domba (atau kambing).
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Shiva created two demons (Virabhadra and Rudrakali) from his hair, who wreaked havoc on the ceremony and beheaded Daksha; at the gods' appeal he ended the violence and revived Daksha with the head of a ram (or goat).

claims.quote: Realising his error, Shiva then sent for a new head with which to make the boy whole again but the nearest at hand was of an elephant. And so Ganesha, the elephant-headed god, was born.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, setelah menyadari kekeliruannya Siwa meminta kepala baru untuk memulihkan anak itu, dan kepala terdekat adalah kepala gajah, sehingga lahirlah Ganesha, dewa berkepala gajah.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, realising his error, Shiva sent for a new head to make the boy whole again, and the nearest was an elephant's, so Ganesha, the elephant-headed god, was born.

claims.quote: To cushion Ganga's fall to the earth, and prevent such a great river destroying civilisation, Shiva caught her in his hair topknot

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, untuk meredam jatuhnya Gangga ke bumi dan mencegah sungai sebesar itu menghancurkan peradaban, Siwa menangkapnya dalam sanggul rambutnya.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, to cushion Ganga's fall to earth and stop so great a river from destroying civilisation, Shiva caught her in his hair topknot.

claims.quote: Angry at this disturbance to his meditation, the god struck the cows with fire from his third eye.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam kisah tentang sapi Surabhi, Siwa yang terganggu meditasinya menyambar sapi-sapi itu dengan api dari mata ketiganya.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in the story of Surabhi's cows, Shiva, angry at the disturbance to his meditation, struck the cows with fire from his third eye.

claims.quote: Still angry, the other gods sought to calm Shiva down by offering him a magnificent bull - Nandi, the son of Surabhi and Kasyapa - which Shiva accepted and rode.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, para dewa menenangkan Siwa dengan mempersembahkan seekor banteng agung, Nandi, putra Surabhi dan Kasyapa, yang diterima dan ditunggangi Siwa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, the gods calmed Shiva by offering him a magnificent bull, Nandi, the son of Surabhi and Kasyapa, which Shiva accepted and rode.

claims.quote: Shiva is closely associated with the Linga (or Lingham) - a phallus or symbol of fertility or divine energy found in temples to the god.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Siwa lekat dengan Linga (Lingam), lambang kesuburan atau energi ilahi yang terdapat di kuil-kuil sang dewa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Shiva is closely associated with the Linga (Lingham), a symbol of fertility or divine energy found in temples to the god.

claims.quote: he usually represents Nataraja and performs the Tandava cosmic dance within a circle of fire which represents the never-ending cycle of time.
claims.locator: How is Shiva Represented in Art?

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Asia, Siwa biasanya mewakili Nataraja yang membawakan tarian kosmis Tandava dalam lingkaran api yang melambangkan siklus waktu tanpa akhir.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in Asian art Shiva usually represents Nataraja, performing the Tandava cosmic dance within a circle of fire that stands for the never-ending cycle of time.

claims.quote: Sometimes he also rides his white bull, carries a silver bow (Pinaka), holds an antelope, and wears a tiger or elephant skin, all symbolic of his famed prowess as a hunter.
claims.locator: How is Shiva Represented in Art?

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Siwa kadang digambarkan menunggang banteng putihnya, membawa busur perak (Pinaka), memegang kijang, dan mengenakan kulit harimau atau gajah, semuanya lambang keahliannya sebagai pemburu.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Shiva is sometimes shown riding his white bull, carrying a silver bow (Pinaka), holding an antelope and wearing a tiger or elephant skin, all symbolic of his famed prowess as a hunter.

claims.quote: But with the churning still going on, the poison Kalakuta appeared at last ... And then Siva, being solicited by Brahman, swallowed that poison for the safety of the creation. The divine Maheswara held it in his throat, and it is said that from that time he is called Nilakantha (blue-throated).

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata (terjemahan Ganguli), atas permintaan Brahman, Siwa menelan racun yang muncul selama pengadukan demi keselamatan ciptaan; Maheswara menahannya di tenggorokan, dan sejak itu ia disebut Nilakantha (berleher biru).
statement.en: In the Mahabharata (Ganguli translation), at Brahman's request Siva swallowed the poison for the safety of creation; the divine Maheswara held it in his throat and from that time is called Nilakantha (blue-throated).

claims.quote: the illustrious Hara—assuming the form of a Kirata resplendent as a golden tree, and with a huge and stalwart form like a second Meru ... the handsome god of gods was accompanied by Uma in the guise of a Kirata woman ... Sankara in the guise of a Kirata suddenly bade him stop

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Hara mengambil rupa seorang Kirata bersosok besar dan kekar seperti Meru kedua, berkilau bagai pohon emas, ditemani Uma dalam rupa perempuan Kirata; Sankara juga disebut tampil dalam rupa Kirata.
statement.en: In the Mahabharata, Hara takes the form of a Kirata, resplendent as a golden tree, with a huge, stalwart form like a second Meru, accompanied by Uma in the guise of a Kirata woman; Sankara is also said to appear in the guise of a Kirata.

claims.quote: I will give to thee that favourite weapon of mine called the Pasuputa ... this weapon should not be hurled without adequate cause; for if hurled at any foe of little might it may destroy the whole universe.

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata, sang dewa menyatakan akan memberikan senjata kesayangannya yang disebut Pasuputa, dan memperingatkan bahwa senjata itu tidak boleh dilepaskan tanpa alasan memadai karena bila dilepaskan kepada musuh yang lemah pun ia dapat menghancurkan seluruh alam semesta.
statement.en: In the Mahabharata, the god says he will give his favourite weapon, called the Pasuputa, and warns that it must not be hurled without adequate cause since, hurled even at a weak foe, it may destroy the whole universe.

claims.quote: O god of gods, O Mahadeva, O thou of blue throat, O thou of matted locks ... Thou art Siva in the form of Vishnu, and Vishnu in the form of Siva. Thou destroyedest of old the great sacrifice of Daksha.

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Arjuna menyapa sang dewa sebagai dewa para dewa, Mahadewa, yang berleher biru dan berambut gimbal, dan berkata bahwa ia adalah Siwa dalam wujud Wisnu dan Wisnu dalam wujud Siwa, yang dahulu menghancurkan kurban agung Daksha.
statement.en: In the Mahabharata, Arjuna addresses the god as god of gods, Mahadeva, of blue throat and matted locks, and says he is Siva in the form of Vishnu and Vishnu in the form of Siva, who of old destroyed the great sacrifice of Daksha.

claims.quote: that wielder of the Pinaka-that one who had his abode on the mountains (of Kailasa)—accompanied by Uma

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Mahadewa disebut pemegang Pinaka yang tinggal di pegunungan (Kailasa) bersama Uma.
statement.en: In the Mahabharata, Mahadeva is described as the wielder of the Pinaka who had his abode on the mountains (of Kailasa), accompanied by Uma.

claims.quote: Sati was eventually reincarnated as Parvati in her next life and she re-married Shiva.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Sati akhirnya terlahir kembali sebagai Parwati pada kehidupan berikutnya dan menikah lagi dengan Siwa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Sati was eventually reincarnated as Parvati in her next life and re-married Shiva.

claims.quote: self-sacrifice is emphasised when Vasuki, the king of Serpents, threatened to vomit snake venom across the seas. Shiva, assuming the form of a giant tortoise or turtle, collected the venom in his palm and drank it.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ketika Vasuki, raja ular, mengancam memuntahkan bisa ke lautan, Siwa dalam wujud kura-kura raksasa menampung bisa itu di telapak tangannya dan meminumnya.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, when Vasuki, king of the serpents, threatened to vomit snake venom across the seas, Shiva, assuming the form of a giant tortoise or turtle, collected the venom in his palm and drank it.

claims.quote: And Hara, beholding the wonder of Arjuna and seeing that his body had been emaciated with ascetic austerities, spake unto him ... I will as I have been pleased with thee, grant thee an irresistible weapon. Soon shall thou be able to wield that weapon of mine.

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Hara, melihat keajaiban sikap Arjuna dan tubuhnya yang kurus karena pertapaan, menyatakan senang dan akan menganugerahkan senjata tak tertahankan yang tak lama lagi dapat digunakan Arjuna.
statement.en: In the Mahabharata, Hara, beholding the wonder of Arjuna whose body was emaciated by ascetic austerities, says he is pleased and will grant him an irresistible weapon of his that Arjuna will soon be able to wield.

claims.quote: Arjuna, having, in combat, pleased the god of gods, Tryambaka (the three-eyed) in the disguise of a hunter, obtained the great weapon Pasupata

statement.id: Dalam ringkasan kisah pada Mahabharata, Arjuna, setelah menyenangkan dewa para dewa Tryambaka (si mata tiga) yang menyamar sebagai pemburu dalam pertempuran, memperoleh senjata agung Pasupata.
statement.en: In a summary passage of the Mahabharata, Arjuna, having pleased in combat the god of gods Tryambaka (the three-eyed) in the disguise of a hunter, obtained the great weapon Pasupata.

cultural_context.id: Dalam tradisi Saiwa, Siwa dipuja sebagai Tuhan Yang Mahatinggi. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia dewa terpenting bagi sekte Saiwa serta pelindung para yogi, brahmana, dan Weda; Wikipedia mencatatnya pula sebagai dewa pelindung yoga, meditasi, dan seni.
cultural_context.en: In the Shaiva tradition Shiva is worshipped as the Supreme Lord. According to the World History Encyclopedia he is the most important god for the Shaivism sect and the patron of yogis, Brahmins and the Vedas; Wikipedia also records him as patron god of yoga, meditation and the arts.

literal_meaning.id: mujur, menguntungkan, pemurah, ramah, baik hati, bersahabat
literal_meaning.en: auspicious, propitious, gracious, benign, kind, benevolent, friendly

who.id: Salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu.
who.en: One of the principal Hindu deities.

origin.id: Agama Hindu, terutama tradisi Saiwa.
origin.en: Hinduism, especially Shaivism.

role.id: Dewa pelebur sekaligus pelindung dalam Trimurti, dan Tuhan Yang Mahatinggi bagi pemuja Saiwa.
role.en: Destroyer and protector within the Trimurti, and the Supreme Lord for Shaiva devotees.

famous_for.id: Mata ketiga, Sungai Gangga di rambutnya, dan tarian kosmis Nataraja.
famous_for.en: His third eye, the Ganga in his hair and the cosmic dance of Nataraja.

did_you_know.id: Kisah Nilakantha, Si Leher Biru, punya dua versi: World History Encyclopedia menceritakan racun bisa Vasuki, sedangkan Mahabharata menyebut racun Kalakuta yang muncul selama pengadukan.
did_you_know.en: The tale of Nilakantha, Blue Throat, comes in two versions: the World History Encyclopedia tells of Vasuki's venom, whereas the Mahabharata names the Kalakuta poison that appeared during the churning.

description.id: Pada akhir tiap siklus ia meleburkan alam semesta sehingga penciptaan baru dapat terjadi.
description.en: At the end of each cycle he destroys the universe so that a new creation can begin.

description.id: Dari mata ketiganya ia melepaskan api; ia menyambar sapi-sapi Surabhi dengan api itu.
description.en: He looses fire from his third eye, with which he struck Surabhi's cows.

description.id: Ia memiliki senjata kesayangan yang disebut Pasuputa atau Pasupata; menurut Mahabharata, senjata itu dapat menghancurkan seluruh alam semesta bila dilepaskan, dan Arjuna memperolehnya darinya.
description.en: He has a favourite weapon called the Pasuputa or Pasupata; in the Mahabharata it may destroy the whole universe if hurled, and Arjuna obtains it from him.

description.id: Ia digambarkan membawa busur Pinaka dan disebut pemegang Pinaka dalam Mahabharata.
description.en: He is shown carrying the Pinaka bow and is called wielder of the Pinaka in the Mahabharata.

summary.id: Dalam Mahabharata, atas permintaan Brahman, Siwa menelan racun Kalakuta yang muncul selama pengadukan demi keselamatan ciptaan, dan tenggorokannya menjadi biru sehingga ia disebut Nilakantha. World History Encyclopedia menceritakan versi lain: Siwa meminum bisa yang hendak dimuntahkan Vasuki.
summary.en: In the Mahabharata, at Brahman's request, Shiva swallows the Kalakuta poison that rose during the churning, for the safety of creation, and from then on is called Nilakantha. The World History Encyclopedia tells another version in which Shiva drinks the venom Vasuki threatened to spew.

role.id: Dewa yang menyamar dan menganugerahkan senjata
role.en: God in disguise who grants a weapon

summary.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Hara mengambil rupa seorang Kirata bersama Uma dalam rupa perempuan Kirata; dalam ringkasan epos itu, Arjuna memperoleh senjata Pasupata setelah menyenangkan sang dewa mata tiga yang menyamar sebagai pemburu dalam pertempuran.
summary.en: In the Mahabharata, Hara takes the form of a Kirata with Uma as a Kirata woman; a summary passage of the epic says Arjuna obtained the Pasupata weapon after pleasing the three-eyed god, disguised as a hunter, in combat.

title.en: The sacrifice of Daksha and the death of Sati

role.id: Suami Sati yang murka lalu mengampuni
role.en: Husband of Sati, wrathful and then forgiving

summary.id: Daksha mengadakan upacara kurban untuk semua dewa kecuali Siwa, dan Sati menceburkan diri ke api kurban. Siwa menciptakan Virabhadra dan Rudrakali yang memenggal Daksha, lalu menghidupkannya kembali dengan kepala domba atas permohonan para dewa.
summary.en: Daksha held a sacrifice for all gods but Shiva, and Sati threw herself on the sacrificial fire. Shiva created Virabhadra and Rudrakali, who beheaded Daksha, then revived him with a ram's head at the gods' appeal.

summary.id: Setelah menyadari kekeliruannya, Siwa mencari kepala baru bagi anak itu; kepala terdekat adalah kepala gajah, sehingga lahirlah Ganesha.
summary.en: Realising his error, Shiva sought a new head for the boy; the nearest was an elephant's, and Ganesha was born.

role.en: He who breaks the river's fall

summary.id: Siwa menangkap Gangga dalam sanggul rambutnya agar jatuhnya sungai itu ke bumi tidak menghancurkan peradaban.
summary.en: Shiva caught the Ganga in his hair topknot so that her fall to earth would not destroy civilisation.

summary.id: Susu sapi-sapi Surabhi membanjiri tempat tinggal Siwa; ia menyambar sapi-sapi itu dengan api dari mata ketiganya, dan para dewa menenangkannya dengan mempersembahkan banteng Nandi.
summary.en: The milk of Surabhi's cows flooded Shiva's home; he struck the cows with fire from his third eye, and the gods calmed him by offering the bull Nandi.

description.id: Tempat Siwa hidup bertapa sebagai yogi; Mahabharata menyebut tempat tinggalnya di pegunungan (Kailasa).
description.en: Where Shiva lives as an ascetic yogi; the Mahabharata places his abode on the mountains (of Kailasa).

description.id: Di Indonesia Siwa dipuja terutama di Jawa dan Bali.
description.en: In Indonesia Shiva is revered especially in Java and Bali.

note.id: Istri Siwa.
note.en: Shiva's wife.

note.id: Putri Daksha yang menikah dengan Siwa dan akhirnya terlahir kembali sebagai Parwati.
note.en: Daughter of Daksha who married Shiva and was later reincarnated as Parvati.

note.id: Putra Siwa dan Parwati, dewa berkepala gajah.
note.en: Son of Shiva and Parvati, the elephant-headed god.

note.id: Putra Siwa dan Parwati.
note.en: Son of Shiva and Parvati.

note.id: Bersama Brahma dan Wisnu, Siwa termasuk dalam Trimurti; Arjuna menyapa Siwa sebagai Wisnu dalam wujud Siwa.
note.en: Shiva forms the Trimurti with Brahma and Vishnu; Arjuna addresses Shiva as Vishnu in the form of Siva.

note.id: Bersama Wisnu dan Siwa membentuk Trimurti.
note.en: With Vishnu forms the Trimurti with Shiva.

note.id: Dewa Weda yang dikaitkan dengan Siwa.
note.en: The Vedic deity associated with Shiva.

note.id: Banteng yang diterima dan ditunggangi Siwa.
note.en: The bull Shiva accepted and rode.

note.id: Sungai suci yang ditangkap Siwa dalam rambutnya.
note.en: The holy river Shiva caught in his hair.

note.id: Raja ular yang melingkar di leher Siwa.
note.en: The serpent king around Shiva's neck.

note.id: Iblis yang diciptakan Siwa dari rambutnya bersama Rudrakali.
note.en: Demon Shiva created from his hair, together with Rudrakali.

note.id: Daksha tidak menyetujui pernikahan Sati dengan Siwa dan mengadakan kurban tanpa Siwa; Siwa kemudian menghidupkannya kembali.
note.en: Daksha disapproved of Sati's marriage to Shiva and held a sacrifice without him; Shiva later revived him.

note.id: Penerima senjata Pasupata dalam Mahabharata.
note.en: Recipient of the Pasupata weapon in the Mahabharata.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa satu dewa dapat dipandang sebagai pelebur sekaligus pencipta?
learning_questions.en: Why can one god be seen as both destroyer and creator?

learning_questions.id: Mengapa dua sumber menceritakan kisah racun dan leher biru Siwa dengan cara yang berbeda?
learning_questions.en: Why do two sources tell the story of Shiva's poison and blue throat in different ways?

learning_questions.id: Apa yang dikatakan kisah Kirata tentang hubungan antara dewa dan pemujanya?
learning_questions.en: What does the Kirata story say about the relationship between a god and his devotee?

topic.en: Origin of the Nilakantha poison story

summary.id: World History Encyclopedia: Vasuki, raja ular, hendak memuntahkan bisa ke lautan; Siwa dalam wujud kura-kura raksasa menampung bisa itu di telapak tangannya dan meminumnya, dan racun itu meninggalkan bekas biru di tenggorokannya.
summary.en: World History Encyclopedia: Vasuki, king of the serpents, threatened to vomit venom across the seas; Shiva, as a giant tortoise, collected the venom in his palm and drank it, and the poison left a blue scar on his throat.

summary.id: Mahabharata (terjemahan Ganguli): racun Kalakuta muncul selama pengadukan, dan Siwa menelannya atas permintaan Brahman demi keselamatan ciptaan.
summary.en: Mahabharata (Ganguli translation): the Kalakuta poison arose during the churning, and Siva swallowed it at Brahman's request for the safety of creation.

summary.id: Kamus Monier-Williams: śiva berarti "mujur, menguntungkan, pemurah, ramah, baik hati, bersahabat".
summary.en: Monier-Williams dictionary: śiva means "auspicious, propitious, gracious, benign, kind, benevolent, friendly".

summary.id: Sharma: akar kata śarv- berarti "melukai" atau "membunuh", sehingga nama itu berarti "yang dapat membunuh kekuatan kegelapan".
summary.en: Sharma: the root śarv- means "to injure" or "to kill", so the name connotes "one who can kill the forces of darkness".

Tidak dicari karena fokus pengayaan pada kekuatan, ranah, dan perbuatan sang dewa; belum ada klaim bersumber tentang penggambaran modern.

short_description.id: Siwa, juga disebut Mahadewa, adalah salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu, Yang Mahatinggi dalam tradisi Saiwa, dan anggota Trimurti yang berperan sebagai pelebur dan pelindung.
short_description.en: Shiva, also called Mahadeva, is one of the principal deities of Hinduism, the Supreme Being in Shaivism, and a member of the Trimurti who acts as destroyer and protector.

long_description.id: Siwa, yang namanya berarti "mujur" atau "menguntungkan", juga dikenal sebagai Mahadewa dan Sankara, adalah salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu. Dalam tradisi Saiwa ia Yang Mahatinggi, Tuhan yang mencipta, memelihara, dan mengubah alam semesta. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia anggota Trimurti bersama Brahma dan Wisnu, berperan sebagai Pelindung, dan sebagai penguasa Waktu ia pelebur sekaligus pencipta segala sesuatu.
long_description.en: Shiva, whose name means "auspicious" or "propitious", is also called Mahadeva and Sankara and ranks among the chief gods of Hinduism. In Shaivism he is the highest being, the Lord who creates, protects and transforms the universe. According to the World History Encyclopedia he belongs to the Trimurti with Brahma and Vishnu, serves as the Protector, and as lord of Time is both destroyer and creator of all things.

long_description.id: Siwa memiliki banyak aspek, yang welas asih maupun yang menakutkan. Dalam aspek welas asihnya ia digambarkan sebagai yogi mahatahu yang hidup bertapa di Kailasa sekaligus kepala keluarga bersama istrinya, Parwati, dan kedua anaknya, Ganesha dan Kartikeya; dalam aspek garangnya ia sering digambarkan membinasakan raksasa. Menurut World History Encyclopedia ia pertapa agung yang memusatkan diri pada meditasi, tetapi juga memiliki sisi gelap sebagai pemimpin roh jahat dan hantu serta penguasa pencuri, penjahat, dan pengemis. Ia dikenal pula sebagai Adiyogi, yogi pertama, pelindung yoga, meditasi, dan seni.
long_description.en: Shiva shows both gentle and terrifying sides. In his gentle forms he appears as an all-knowing ascetic yogi dwelling on Kailasa, and also as a family man with his consort Parvati and their sons Ganesha and Kartikeya; in his wrathful forms he is frequently portrayed destroying demons. According to the World History Encyclopedia he is the great ascetic who concentrates on meditation, yet he also has a darker side as leader of evil spirits and ghosts and master of thieves, villains and beggars. He is also honoured as Adiyogi, the first yogi, patron of yoga, meditation and the arts.

long_description.id: Ciri ikonografinya antara lain raja ular Vasuki di lehernya, bulan sabit, Sungai Gangga yang mengalir dari rambut gimbalnya, mata ketiga di dahinya, trisula sebagai senjatanya, dan kendang damaru; ia biasanya dipuja dalam wujud lingga, lambang kesuburan atau energi ilahi yang terdapat di kuil-kuilnya. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Asia ia biasanya mewakili Nataraja yang membawakan tarian kosmis Tandava dalam lingkaran api, dan kadang membawa busur perak Pinaka serta menunggang banteng putih. Siwa dipuja luas oleh umat Hindu di India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, dan Indonesia, terutama di Jawa dan Bali.
long_description.en: Among his emblems are the serpent king Vasuki around his neck, a crescent moon, the holy Ganga flowing from his matted hair, a third eye on his forehead, the trident as his weapon and the damaru drum; he is usually worshipped in the aniconic form of the lingam, a symbol of fertility or divine energy found in his temples. According to the World History Encyclopedia, in Asian art he usually represents Nataraja, performing the Tandava cosmic dance within a circle of fire, and is sometimes shown with the silver bow Pinaka and riding a white bull. Hindus honour Shiva across India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Indonesia, notably in Java and Bali.

long_description.id: Kisah-kisahnya memperlihatkan kekuatannya. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Siwa menciptakan Virabhadra dan Rudrakali dari rambutnya, yang kemudian memenggal Daksha, menangkap Gangga dalam sanggulnya agar jatuhnya sungai itu tidak menghancurkan peradaban, dan menyambar sapi-sapi Surabhi dengan api dari mata ketiganya sebelum para dewa menenangkannya dengan banteng Nandi. Dalam Mahabharata, ia menelan racun yang muncul selama pengadukan, dan sejak itu disebut Nilakantha, serta mengambil rupa seorang Kirata dan menurut ringkasan epos itu menganugerahkan senjata Pasupata kepada Arjuna.
long_description.en: His stories show his power. According to the World History Encyclopedia, Shiva created Virabhadra and Rudrakali from his hair, who then beheaded Daksha, caught the Ganga in his topknot so that her fall would not destroy civilisation, and struck Surabhi's cows with fire from his third eye before the gods calmed him with the bull Nandi. In the Mahabharata he swallows the poison that appeared during the churning and is called Nilakantha from then on, and he takes the form of a Kirata and, according to a summary passage of the epic, grants the Pasupata weapon to Arjuna.
