claims.quote: is one of the principal deities of Hinduism. He is the Supreme Being in Shaivism, one of the major traditions within Hinduism.

statement.id: Siwa adalah salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu dan Yang Mahatinggi dalam tradisi Saiwa.
statement.en: Shiva is one of the principal deities of Hinduism and the Supreme Being in Shaivism.

claims.quote: In the Shaivite tradition, Shiva is the Supreme Lord who creates, protects and transforms the universe.

statement.id: Dalam tradisi Saiwa, Siwa adalah Tuhan Yang Mahatinggi yang mencipta, memelihara, dan mengubah alam semesta.
statement.en: In the Shaiva tradition Shiva is the Supreme Lord who creates, protects and transforms the universe.

claims.quote: Shiva has many aspects, benevolent as well as fearsome. In benevolent aspects, he is depicted as an omniscient yogi who lives an ascetic life on Kailasa as well as a householder with his wife Parvati and his two children, Ganesha and Kartikeya. In his fierce aspects, he is often depicted slaying demons.

statement.id: Siwa memiliki aspek welas asih dan menakutkan: ia digambarkan sebagai yogi mahatahu yang bertapa di Kailasa dan kepala keluarga bersama Parwati serta anak-anaknya, Ganesha dan Kartikeya, dan dalam aspek garangnya membinasakan raksasa.
statement.en: Shiva has benevolent and fearsome aspects: an omniscient ascetic yogi on Kailasa and a householder with Parvati and their children Ganesha and Kartikeya, and in fierce aspects a slayer of demons.

claims.quote: Shiva is also known as Adiyogi (the first yogi), regarded as the patron god of yoga, meditation and the arts.

statement.id: Siwa juga dikenal sebagai Adiyogi (yogi pertama), dewa pelindung yoga, meditasi, dan seni.
statement.en: Shiva is also known as Adiyogi (the first yogi), patron god of yoga, meditation and the arts.

claims.quote: The iconographical attributes of Shiva are the serpent king Vasuki around his neck, the adorning crescent moon, the holy river Ganga flowing from his matted hair, the third eye on his forehead (the eye that turns everything in front of it into ashes when opened), the trishula or trident as his weapon, and the damaru. He is usually worshiped in the aniconic form of lingam.

statement.id: Ciri ikonografi Siwa antara lain raja ular Vasuki di lehernya, bulan sabit, Sungai Gangga yang mengalir dari rambut gimbalnya, mata ketiga di dahinya, trisula, dan damaru; ia biasanya dipuja dalam wujud lingga.
statement.en: Shiva's attributes include the serpent king Vasuki round his neck, the crescent moon, the Ganga flowing from his matted hair, the third eye, the trident and the damaru; he is usually worshipped as the lingam.

claims.quote: Shiva is a pan-Hindu deity, revered widely by Hindus in India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Indonesia (especially in Java and Bali).

statement.id: Siwa adalah dewa seluruh umat Hindu yang dipuja luas di India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, dan Indonesia (terutama Jawa dan Bali).
statement.en: Shiva is a pan-Hindu deity revered widely in India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Indonesia (especially Java and Bali).

claims.quote: Though associated with Vedic deity Rudra, Shiva may have non-Vedic roots

statement.id: Meski dikaitkan dengan dewa Weda Rudra, Siwa mungkin berakar dari luar tradisi Weda.
statement.en: Though associated with the Vedic deity Rudra, Shiva may have non-Vedic roots.

claims.quote: In Hinduism, the universe is thought to regenerate in cycles (every 2,160,000,000 years). Shiva destroys the universe at the end of each cycle which then allows for a new Creation.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam agama Hindu alam semesta beregenerasi dalam siklus, dan Siwa meleburnya pada akhir setiap siklus sehingga penciptaan baru dapat terjadi.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in Hinduism the universe regenerates in cycles, and Shiva destroys it at the end of each cycle, allowing a new creation.

claims.quote: The poison burned his throat and left a permanent blue scar, hence one of his many titles became Nilakantha or Blue Throat.

statement.id: Racun yang diminum Siwa membakar tenggorokannya dan meninggalkan bekas biru permanen, sehingga ia bergelar Nilakantha, Si Leher Biru.
statement.en: The poison Shiva drank burned his throat and left a permanent blue scar, so he became Nilakantha, Blue Throat.

claims.quote: According to the Monier-Williams Sanskrit dictionary, the word "śiva" (Devanagari: शिव ... means "auspicious, propitious, gracious, benign, kind, benevolent, friendly"

statement.id: Menurut kamus Sanskerta Monier-Williams, kata "śiva" (Devanagari: शिव) berarti "mujur, menguntungkan, pemurah, ramah, baik hati, bersahabat".
statement.en: According to the Monier-Williams Sanskrit dictionary, the word "śiva" (Devanagari: शिव) means "auspicious, propitious, gracious, benign, kind, benevolent, friendly".

claims.quote: Sharma presents another etymology with the Sanskrit root śarv-, which means "to injure" or "to kill", interpreting the name to connote "one who can kill the forces of darkness".

statement.id: Sharma mengajukan etimologi lain dari akar kata Sanskerta śarv-, yang berarti "melukai" atau "membunuh", dan menafsirkan nama itu sebagai "yang dapat membunuh kekuatan kegelapan".
statement.en: Sharma presents another etymology from the Sanskrit root śarv-, meaning "to injure" or "to kill", interpreting the name as "one who can kill the forces of darkness".

claims.quote: Shiva (Siva) is one of the most important gods in Hinduism and a member of the holy trinity (trimurti) with Brahma and Vishnu. Shiva is a complex character who may represent goodness and benevolence, and he serves as the Protector.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Siwa (Siva) adalah salah satu dewa terpenting dalam agama Hindu dan anggota tritunggal suci (trimurti) bersama Brahma dan Wisnu; ia tokoh yang kompleks, dapat melambangkan kebaikan dan kemurahan hati, dan berperan sebagai Pelindung.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Shiva (Siva) is one of the most important gods in Hinduism and a member of the holy trinity (trimurti) with Brahma and Vishnu; a complex character who may represent goodness and benevolence, he serves as the Protector.

claims.quote: Shiva is also associated with Time, and in this capacity, he is both the destroyer and creator of all things.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Siwa juga dikaitkan dengan Waktu, dan dalam kapasitas itu ia pelebur sekaligus pencipta segala sesuatu.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Shiva is also associated with Time, and in that capacity he is both the destroyer and the creator of all things.

claims.quote: Shiva is also the great ascetic, abstaining from all forms of indulgence and pleasure, concentrating rather on meditation as a means to find perfect happiness. He also has a darker side as the leader of evil spirits, ghosts and as the master of thieves, villains and beggars.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Siwa adalah pertapa agung yang menjauhi segala kenikmatan dan memusatkan diri pada meditasi; ia juga memiliki sisi gelap sebagai pemimpin roh jahat dan hantu serta penguasa pencuri, penjahat, dan pengemis.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Shiva is the great ascetic who abstains from all indulgence and pleasure and concentrates on meditation; he also has a darker side as leader of evil spirits and ghosts and master of thieves, villains and beggars.

claims.quote: Shiva is the most important Hindu god for the Shaivism sect, the patron of Yogis and Brahmins, and also the protector of the Vedas, the sacred texts.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Siwa adalah dewa terpenting bagi sekte Saiwa, pelindung para yogi dan brahmana, serta pelindung Weda, kitab-kitab suci.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Shiva is the most important god for the Shaivism sect, the patron of yogis and Brahmins, and the protector of the Vedas, the sacred texts.

claims.quote: Daksha did not approve of Sati's marriage to Shiva and even went further and held a special sacrificial ceremony to all the gods except Shiva. Outraged at this slight, Sati threw herself on the sacrificial fire.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Daksha tidak menyetujui pernikahan putrinya Sati dengan Siwa dan mengadakan upacara kurban untuk semua dewa kecuali Siwa; tersinggung, Sati menceburkan diri ke api kurban itu.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Daksha disapproved of Sati's marriage to Shiva and held a sacrificial ceremony for all the gods except Shiva; outraged at the slight, Sati threw herself on the sacrificial fire.

claims.quote: Shiva reacted to this tragedy by creating two demons (Virabhadra and Rudrakali) from his hair who wreaked havoc on the ceremony and beheaded Daksha. The other gods appealed to Shiva to end the violence and, complying, he brought Daksha back to life but with the head of a ram (or goat).

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Siwa menciptakan dua iblis (Virabhadra dan Rudrakali) dari rambutnya yang mengacaukan upacara dan memenggal Daksha; atas permohonan para dewa, Siwa menghentikan kekerasan itu dan menghidupkan kembali Daksha dengan kepala domba (atau kambing).
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Shiva created two demons (Virabhadra and Rudrakali) from his hair, who wreaked havoc on the ceremony and beheaded Daksha; at the gods' appeal he ended the violence and revived Daksha with the head of a ram (or goat).

claims.quote: Realising his error, Shiva then sent for a new head with which to make the boy whole again but the nearest at hand was of an elephant. And so Ganesha, the elephant-headed god, was born.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, setelah menyadari kekeliruannya Siwa meminta kepala baru untuk memulihkan anak itu, dan kepala terdekat adalah kepala gajah, sehingga lahirlah Ganesha, dewa berkepala gajah.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, realising his error, Shiva sent for a new head to make the boy whole again, and the nearest was an elephant's, so Ganesha, the elephant-headed god, was born.

claims.quote: To cushion Ganga's fall to the earth, and prevent such a great river destroying civilisation, Shiva caught her in his hair topknot

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, untuk meredam jatuhnya Gangga ke bumi dan mencegah sungai sebesar itu menghancurkan peradaban, Siwa menangkapnya dalam sanggul rambutnya.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, to cushion Ganga's fall to earth and stop so great a river from destroying civilisation, Shiva caught her in his hair topknot.

claims.quote: Angry at this disturbance to his meditation, the god struck the cows with fire from his third eye.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam kisah tentang sapi Surabhi, Siwa yang terganggu meditasinya menyambar sapi-sapi itu dengan api dari mata ketiganya.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in the story of Surabhi's cows, Shiva, angry at the disturbance to his meditation, struck the cows with fire from his third eye.

claims.quote: Still angry, the other gods sought to calm Shiva down by offering him a magnificent bull - Nandi, the son of Surabhi and Kasyapa - which Shiva accepted and rode.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, para dewa menenangkan Siwa dengan mempersembahkan seekor banteng agung, Nandi, putra Surabhi dan Kasyapa, yang diterima dan ditunggangi Siwa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, the gods calmed Shiva by offering him a magnificent bull, Nandi, the son of Surabhi and Kasyapa, which Shiva accepted and rode.

claims.quote: Shiva is closely associated with the Linga (or Lingham) - a phallus or symbol of fertility or divine energy found in temples to the god.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Siwa lekat dengan Linga (Lingam), lambang kesuburan atau energi ilahi yang terdapat di kuil-kuil sang dewa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Shiva is closely associated with the Linga (Lingham), a symbol of fertility or divine energy found in temples to the god.

claims.quote: he usually represents Nataraja and performs the Tandava cosmic dance within a circle of fire which represents the never-ending cycle of time.
claims.locator: How is Shiva Represented in Art?

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Asia, Siwa biasanya mewakili Nataraja yang membawakan tarian kosmis Tandava dalam lingkaran api yang melambangkan siklus waktu tanpa akhir.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in Asian art Shiva usually represents Nataraja, performing the Tandava cosmic dance within a circle of fire that stands for the never-ending cycle of time.

claims.quote: Sometimes he also rides his white bull, carries a silver bow (Pinaka), holds an antelope, and wears a tiger or elephant skin, all symbolic of his famed prowess as a hunter.
claims.locator: How is Shiva Represented in Art?

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Siwa kadang digambarkan menunggang banteng putihnya, membawa busur perak (Pinaka), memegang kijang, dan mengenakan kulit harimau atau gajah, semuanya lambang keahliannya sebagai pemburu.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Shiva is sometimes shown riding his white bull, carrying a silver bow (Pinaka), holding an antelope and wearing a tiger or elephant skin, all symbolic of his famed prowess as a hunter.

claims.quote: But with the churning still going on, the poison Kalakuta appeared at last ... And then Siva, being solicited by Brahman, swallowed that poison for the safety of the creation. The divine Maheswara held it in his throat, and it is said that from that time he is called Nilakantha (blue-throated).

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata (terjemahan Ganguli), atas permintaan Brahman, Siwa menelan racun yang muncul selama pengadukan demi keselamatan ciptaan; Maheswara menahannya di tenggorokan, dan sejak itu ia disebut Nilakantha (berleher biru).
statement.en: In the Mahabharata (Ganguli translation), at Brahman's request Siva swallowed the poison for the safety of creation; the divine Maheswara held it in his throat and from that time is called Nilakantha (blue-throated).

claims.quote: the illustrious Hara—assuming the form of a Kirata resplendent as a golden tree, and with a huge and stalwart form like a second Meru ... the handsome god of gods was accompanied by Uma in the guise of a Kirata woman ... Sankara in the guise of a Kirata suddenly bade him stop

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Hara mengambil rupa seorang Kirata bersosok besar dan kekar seperti Meru kedua, berkilau bagai pohon emas, ditemani Uma dalam rupa perempuan Kirata; Sankara juga disebut tampil dalam rupa Kirata.
statement.en: In the Mahabharata, Hara takes the form of a Kirata, resplendent as a golden tree, with a huge, stalwart form like a second Meru, accompanied by Uma in the guise of a Kirata woman; Sankara is also said to appear in the guise of a Kirata.

claims.quote: I will give to thee that favourite weapon of mine called the Pasuputa ... this weapon should not be hurled without adequate cause; for if hurled at any foe of little might it may destroy the whole universe.

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata, sang dewa menyatakan akan memberikan senjata kesayangannya yang disebut Pasuputa, dan memperingatkan bahwa senjata itu tidak boleh dilepaskan tanpa alasan memadai karena bila dilepaskan kepada musuh yang lemah pun ia dapat menghancurkan seluruh alam semesta.
statement.en: In the Mahabharata, the god says he will give his favourite weapon, called the Pasuputa, and warns that it must not be hurled without adequate cause since, hurled even at a weak foe, it may destroy the whole universe.

claims.quote: O god of gods, O Mahadeva, O thou of blue throat, O thou of matted locks ... Thou art Siva in the form of Vishnu, and Vishnu in the form of Siva. Thou destroyedest of old the great sacrifice of Daksha.

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Arjuna menyapa sang dewa sebagai dewa para dewa, Mahadewa, yang berleher biru dan berambut gimbal, dan berkata bahwa ia adalah Siwa dalam wujud Wisnu dan Wisnu dalam wujud Siwa, yang dahulu menghancurkan kurban agung Daksha.
statement.en: In the Mahabharata, Arjuna addresses the god as god of gods, Mahadeva, of blue throat and matted locks, and says he is Siva in the form of Vishnu and Vishnu in the form of Siva, who of old destroyed the great sacrifice of Daksha.

claims.quote: that wielder of the Pinaka-that one who had his abode on the mountains (of Kailasa)—accompanied by Uma

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Mahadewa disebut pemegang Pinaka yang tinggal di pegunungan (Kailasa) bersama Uma.
statement.en: In the Mahabharata, Mahadeva is described as the wielder of the Pinaka who had his abode on the mountains (of Kailasa), accompanied by Uma.

claims.quote: Sati was eventually reincarnated as Parvati in her next life and she re-married Shiva.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Sati akhirnya terlahir kembali sebagai Parwati pada kehidupan berikutnya dan menikah lagi dengan Siwa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Sati was eventually reincarnated as Parvati in her next life and re-married Shiva.

claims.quote: self-sacrifice is emphasised when Vasuki, the king of Serpents, threatened to vomit snake venom across the seas. Shiva, assuming the form of a giant tortoise or turtle, collected the venom in his palm and drank it.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ketika Vasuki, raja ular, mengancam memuntahkan bisa ke lautan, Siwa dalam wujud kura-kura raksasa menampung bisa itu di telapak tangannya dan meminumnya.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, when Vasuki, king of the serpents, threatened to vomit snake venom across the seas, Shiva, assuming the form of a giant tortoise or turtle, collected the venom in his palm and drank it.

claims.quote: And Hara, beholding the wonder of Arjuna and seeing that his body had been emaciated with ascetic austerities, spake unto him ... I will as I have been pleased with thee, grant thee an irresistible weapon. Soon shall thou be able to wield that weapon of mine.

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Hara, melihat keajaiban sikap Arjuna dan tubuhnya yang kurus karena pertapaan, menyatakan senang dan akan menganugerahkan senjata tak tertahankan yang tak lama lagi dapat digunakan Arjuna.
statement.en: In the Mahabharata, Hara, beholding the wonder of Arjuna whose body was emaciated by ascetic austerities, says he is pleased and will grant him an irresistible weapon of his that Arjuna will soon be able to wield.

claims.quote: Arjuna, having, in combat, pleased the god of gods, Tryambaka (the three-eyed) in the disguise of a hunter, obtained the great weapon Pasupata

statement.id: Dalam ringkasan kisah pada Mahabharata, Arjuna, setelah menyenangkan dewa para dewa Tryambaka (si mata tiga) yang menyamar sebagai pemburu dalam pertempuran, memperoleh senjata agung Pasupata.
statement.en: In a summary passage of the Mahabharata, Arjuna, having pleased in combat the god of gods Tryambaka (the three-eyed) in the disguise of a hunter, obtained the great weapon Pasupata.

A narrow directed tongue of fire emerges clearly from the THIRD EYE, source-supported third-eye fire (shiva-c05,c20), distinct from the gently flowing Ganga (c05,c19). Keep face readable and beautiful, serene and awe-inspiring, no victims. Dramatic firelight and natural cool mountain dawn, rich brushwork, dignified authentic iconography. Blue throat c09,c25; mountain context c03,c29; four-arm arrangement is editorial traditional iconographic choice informed by sculpture reference, not asserted textual anatomy. Avoid cosmic generic ribbons, extra heads/limbs, weapons beyond trident, modern film/game/anime/comic designs, nakedness, gore, text, logos, labels, border or watermark.

short_description.id: Zhu Bajie adalah tokoh novel klasik Tiongkok Journey to the West: monster humanoid setengah manusia setengah babi, bekas marsekal langit yang dibuang ke bumi, lalu menjadi murid kedua Tang Sanzang dengan garu bergigi sembilan sebagai senjatanya.
short_description.en: Zhu Bajie is a character of the classic Chinese novel Journey to the West: a half-human, half-pig humanoid monster, a former heavenly marshal cast down to earth, who becomes a disciple of Tang Sanzang with a nine-toothed rake as his weapon.

long_description.id: Zhu Bajie adalah tokoh sastra dari novel Journey to the West, yang terbit pada abad ke-16 pada masa dinasti Ming dan dikaitkan dengan Wu Cheng'en. Ia salah satu dari tiga murid Tang Sanzang, bersama Sun Wukong dan Sha Heshang, dan digambarkan sebagai monster humanoid yang sebagian manusia dan sebagian babi.
long_description.en: Zhu Bajie is a literary character from Journey to the West, a novel that appeared in the 16th century under the Ming dynasty and is credited to Wu Cheng'en. He is one of Tang Sanzang's three disciples, with Sun Wukong and Sha Heshang, and is portrayed as a humanoid monster who is part human and part pig.

long_description.id: Menurut teks novel, ia dahulu Marsekal Tianpeng dari Sungai Langit. Karena mabuk dan menggoda Chang'e, ia dihukum Kaisar Giok dan dibuang ke bumi, lalu salah masuk ke rahim babi betina. Di gunung Fuling ia tinggal di gua Yunzhan dan hidup dengan memakan manusia, sampai Guanyin menahbiskannya dengan nama Zhu Wuneng dan menyuruhnya menunggu pengambil sutra.
long_description.en: According to the novel text he was once Marshal Tianpeng of the Heavenly River. For flirting with Chang'e while drunk he was punished by the Jade Emperor and cast down to earth, where he entered a sow's womb. On Fuling mountain he lived in the Yunzhan cave and survived by eating people, until Guanyin ordained him with the name Zhu Wuneng and told him to wait for the scripture seeker.

long_description.id: Di desa keluarga Gao, ia menjadi menantu yang awalnya berupa pria gemuk berkulit gelap lalu berubah menjadi sosok berwajah babi, sebelum Sun Wukong menaklukkannya. Tang Sanzang lalu menambahkan nama Bajie, "delapan pantangan", dan ia bergabung dalam perjalanan itu dengan garu bergigi sembilan di tangan.
long_description.en: In the Gao family's village he lived as a son-in-law who first appeared as a dark, stout man and then changed into a pig-faced creature, until Sun Wukong subdued him. Tang Sanzang then added the name Bajie, "eight restraints", and he joined the journey with a nine-toothed rake in hand.

long_description.id: Novel dan ulasan menggambarkannya serakah makan, malas, dan mudah tergoda perempuan, tetapi juga rendah hati terhadap Sun Wukong, lembut hati hingga sering membujuk Sun Wukong melepaskan iblis, dan mahir bertarung di air. Di akhir novel ia tidak menjadi buddha melainkan Pembersih Altar, karena masih terikat keinginan rendahnya.
long_description.en: The novel and its commentary portray him as greedy for food, lazy and easily tempted by women, yet respectful toward Sun Wukong, soft-hearted enough to urge Sun Wukong to release demons, and skilled at fighting in water. At the end of the novel he does not become a buddha but the Altar Cleanser, because he remains attached to his base desires.

cultural_context.id: Dalam pengantar terjemahannya tahun 1913, Timothy Richard menafsirkan si Babi sebagai lambang naluri yang tak terkendali; ini tafsiran penerjemah. Wikipedia mencatat bahwa gelar Marshal Tianpeng berasal dari pemujaan bintang Tao kuno, dan bahwa kini di Taiwan serta bagian lain Asia Timur ia dipandang sebagai dewa pelindung pemijat, pramuria, dan pekerja seks.
cultural_context.en: In the introduction to his 1913 translation Timothy Richard interprets the Pig as personating irrepressible instincts; this is the translator's interpretation. Wikipedia records that the title Marshal Tianpeng comes from ancient Taoist star worship, and that today some in Taiwan and elsewhere in East Asia regard him as a patron deity of masseuses, hostesses and prostitutes.

literal_meaning.id: Zhu berarti "babi" dan Bajie berarti "delapan sila" atau "delapan pantangan"; nama Zhu Wuneng berarti "babi yang sadar akan kemampuan".
literal_meaning.en: Zhu means "swine" and Bajie means "eight precepts" or "eight restraints"; the name Zhu Wuneng means "pig who is aware of ability".

description.en: Old Gao says his son-in-law can stir wind, bring clouds and mist, and make stones and sand fly.

description.en: He neglects the group's responsibilities and looks for excuses to delay the pilgrimage.

claims.quote: is a Chinese novel published in the 16th century during the Ming dynasty and attributed to Wu Cheng'en.

statement.en: Journey to the West (Xiyouji) is a Chinese novel published in the 16th century during the Ming dynasty and attributed to Wu Cheng'en.

claims.quote: He was supposed to be reborn as a human but ended up in the womb of a sow due to an error on the Reincarnation Wheel, which turned him into a half-man, half-pig humanoid monster.

statement.id: Ia seharusnya terlahir kembali sebagai manusia tetapi berakhir di rahim babi betina akibat kesalahan pada Roda Reinkarnasi, sehingga menjadi monster humanoid setengah manusia setengah babi.
statement.en: He was supposed to be reborn as a human but ended up in the womb of a sow because of an error on the Reincarnation Wheel, which turned him into a half-man, half-pig humanoid monster.

claims.quote: He is also capable of 36 transformations and can travel on clouds, but not as fast as Sun Wukong.

statement.id: Ia juga mampu melakukan 36 perubahan wujud dan dapat bepergian dengan awan, tetapi tidak secepat Sun Wukong.
statement.en: He is also capable of 36 transformations and can travel on clouds, but not as fast as Sun Wukong.

claims.quote: His weapon of choice is the jiuchidingpa (九齿钉耙; 九齒釘耙; jiǔchǐdīngpá; "nine-tooth iron rake").

statement.id: Senjata pilihannya adalah jiuchidingpa (九齒釘耙), "garu besi bergigi sembilan".
statement.en: His weapon of choice is the jiuchidingpa (九齒釘耙), the "nine-tooth iron rake".

claims.quote: three other disciples who agree to help him in order to atone for their sins: Zhu Bajie, Sha Wujing and White Dragon Horse.

statement.id: Wukong diberi tugas menjadi murid pertama Tang Sanzang dan menyediakan tiga murid lain yang bersedia membantu demi menebus dosa mereka: Zhu Bajie, Sha Wujing, dan White Dragon Horse.
statement.en: Wukong becomes Tang Sanzang's first disciple and provides three other disciples who agree to help in order to atone for their sins: Zhu Bajie, Sha Wujing and White Dragon Horse.

claims.quote: made his spirituality the lowest in the group, with even the White Dragon Horse achieving more than him, and he remained on Earth and was granted the title "Cleaner of the Altars,"

statement.id: Nafsu terhadap perempuan, kemalasan ekstrem, dan keserakahan membuat kerohaniannya terendah dalam rombongan, bahkan White Dragon Horse mencapai lebih darinya; ia tetap di bumi dan dianugerahi gelar "Cleaner of the Altars".
statement.en: His lust for women, extreme laziness and greediness made his spirituality the lowest in the group, with even the White Dragon Horse achieving more than him; he remained on Earth and was granted the title "Cleaner of the Altars".

claims.quote: Once an immortal who was the Marshal of the Heavenly Canopy commanding 100,000 naval soldiers of the Milky Way

statement.id: Dahulu seorang abadi yang menjadi Marshal of the Heavenly Canopy, memimpin 100.000 prajurit laut Bima Sakti.
statement.en: Once an immortal who was the Marshal of the Heavenly Canopy, commanding 100,000 naval soldiers of the Milky Way.

claims.quote: Zhu Bajie, also named Zhu Wuneng, is one of the three disciples of Tang Sanzang, along with Sun Wukong and Sha Heshang, and a major character of the 16th-century novel Journey to the West.

statement.id: Zhu Bajie, juga bernama Zhu Wuneng, adalah salah satu dari tiga murid Tang Sanzang bersama Sun Wukong dan Sha Heshang, serta tokoh utama novel abad ke-16 Journey to the West.
statement.en: Zhu Bajie, also named Zhu Wuneng, is one of the three disciples of Tang Sanzang, along with Sun Wukong and Sha Heshang, and a major character of the 16th-century novel Journey to the West.

claims.quote: Zhu means "swine", and Bajie means "eight precepts". Before being recruited by the bodhisattva Guanyin, Zhu Bajie was known as Zhu Gāngliè (豬剛巤), literally "Strong-Maned Pig".

statement.id: Zhu berarti "babi" dan Bajie berarti "delapan sila". Sebelum direkrut bodhisatwa Guanyin, Zhu Bajie dikenal sebagai Zhu Gāngliè (豬剛巤), secara harfiah "Babi Berbulu Kuduk Kuat".
statement.en: Zhu means "swine" and Bajie means "eight precepts". Before being recruited by the bodhisattva Guanyin, Zhu Bajie was known as Zhu Gāngliè (豬剛巤), literally "Strong-Maned Pig".

claims.quote: He is portrayed as a fearsome humanoid monster, part human and part pig, who often causes trouble for himself and his companions through laziness, gluttony, and lust.

statement.id: Ia digambarkan sebagai monster humanoid menakutkan, sebagian manusia dan sebagian babi, yang sering menimbulkan masalah bagi dirinya dan rekan-rekannya karena kemalasan, kerakusan, dan nafsu.
statement.en: He is portrayed as a fearsome humanoid monster, part human and part pig, who often causes trouble for himself and his companions through laziness, gluttony and lust.

claims.quote: His Buddhist name "Zhu Wuneng", given by Bodhisattva Guanyin, means "pig (reincarnated) who is aware of ability" or "pig who rises to power"

statement.id: Nama Buddhisnya "Zhu Wuneng", diberikan oleh Bodhisatwa Guanyin, berarti "babi (reinkarnasi) yang sadar akan kemampuan" atau "babi yang naik ke kekuasaan".
statement.en: His Buddhist name "Zhu Wuneng", given by Bodhisattva Guanyin, means "pig (reincarnated) who is aware of ability" or "pig who rises to power".

claims.quote: Tang Sanzang gave him the nickname Bājiè, meaning "eight restraints" or "eight commandments", to remind him of Buddhist discipline.

statement.id: Tang Sanzang memberinya julukan Bājiè, berarti "delapan pantangan" atau "delapan perintah", untuk mengingatkannya pada disiplin Buddhis.
statement.en: Tang Sanzang gave him the nickname Bājiè, meaning "eight restraints" or "eight commandments", to remind him of Buddhist discipline.

claims.quote: In the original Chinese novel, he is often called dāizi (呆子), meaning "idiot".

statement.id: Dalam novel Tiongkok aslinya, ia sering disebut dāizi (呆子), yang berarti "si bodoh".
statement.en: In the original Chinese novel he is often called dāizi (呆子), meaning "idiot".

claims.quote: Bodhisattvas and other heavenly beings usually refer to him as Tiānpéng (天蓬), his former title when he was a heavenly marshal known as Marshal Tianpeng

statement.id: Bodhisatwa dan makhluk surgawi lain biasanya menyebutnya Tiānpéng (天蓬), gelarnya dahulu ketika menjadi marsekal langit bernama Marshal Tianpeng.
statement.en: Bodhisattvas and other heavenly beings usually refer to him as Tiānpéng (天蓬), his former title when he was a heavenly marshal known as Marshal Tianpeng.

claims.quote: Formerly a heavenly marshal and commander of 80,000 celestial sailors, Zhu Bajie is skilled at underwater combat, where he is portrayed as surpassing Sun Wukong.

statement.id: Dahulu marsekal langit dan komandan 80.000 pelaut surgawi, Zhu Bajie mahir bertarung di bawah air, tempat ia digambarkan melampaui Sun Wukong.
statement.en: Formerly a heavenly marshal and commander of 80,000 celestial sailors, Zhu Bajie is skilled at underwater combat, where he is portrayed as surpassing Sun Wukong.

claims.quote: After his drunken attempt to seduce her, she reported him to the Jade Emperor, leading to his banishment to Earth.

statement.id: Setelah ia mabuk dan mencoba merayu Chang'e, sang dewi melaporkannya kepada Kaisar Giok, sehingga ia dibuang ke bumi.
statement.en: After his drunken attempt to seduce Chang'e, she reported him to the Jade Emperor, leading to his banishment to Earth.

claims.quote: By mishap, he fell into a pig well and was reborn as a man-eating pig-monster known as Zhū Gāngliè

statement.id: Karena kecelakaan, ia jatuh ke sumur babi dan terlahir kembali sebagai monster babi pemakan manusia bernama Zhū Gāngliè.
statement.en: By mishap he fell into a pig well and was reborn as a man-eating pig-monster known as Zhū Gāngliè.

claims.quote: He is instead rewarded for his part in the pilgrimage's success with a job as "Cleanser of the Altars" ... and with all the leftovers he can eat.

statement.id: Sebagai ganjaran atas perannya dalam keberhasilan ziarah, ia diberi tugas sebagai "Cleanser of the Altars" (淨壇使者) dan semua sisa makanan yang bisa ia makan.
statement.en: He is instead rewarded for his part in the pilgrimage's success with a job as "Cleanser of the Altars" (淨壇使者) and with all the leftovers he can eat.

claims.quote: At the end of the novel, most of Bajie's fellow pilgrims achieve enlightenment and become arhats, but he does not; although much improved, he remains too attached to his base desires.

statement.id: Di akhir novel, sebagian besar rekan Bajie mencapai pencerahan dan menjadi arhat, tetapi ia tidak; walau sudah jauh membaik, ia masih terlalu terikat pada keinginan rendahnya.
statement.en: At the end of the novel most of Bajie's fellow pilgrims achieve enlightenment and become arhats, but he does not; although much improved, he remains too attached to his base desires.

claims.quote: After finishing his own slice, he finds the watermelon so delicious that he makes excuses to eat each remaining piece until the whole watermelon is gone. He has a large appetite, which is evident in many parts of the story.

statement.id: Setelah menghabiskan bagiannya, ia menganggap semangka itu begitu lezat sehingga mencari alasan untuk memakan tiap potongan yang tersisa hingga habis; nafsu makannya besar dan tampak di banyak bagian cerita.
statement.en: After finishing his own slice he finds the watermelon so delicious that he makes excuses to eat each remaining piece until it is all gone; his large appetite is evident in many parts of the story.

claims.quote: Zhu Bajie is given to laziness. He often neglects the group's troubles and responsibilities, looking for excuses to delay the pilgrimage.

statement.id: Zhu Bajie cenderung malas; ia sering mengabaikan masalah dan tanggung jawab rombongan dan mencari alasan untuk menunda ziarah.
statement.en: Zhu Bajie is given to laziness; he often neglects the group's troubles and responsibilities, looking for excuses to delay the pilgrimage.

claims.quote: After his reincarnation, he is often portrayed as openly lustful when he encounters women. His lust often gets the group into trouble and sometimes leads to disaster.

statement.id: Setelah reinkarnasi, ia sering digambarkan terang-terangan berahi saat bertemu perempuan; nafsunya sering menjerumuskan rombongan ke dalam masalah dan kadang bencana.
statement.en: After his reincarnation he is often portrayed as openly lustful when he meets women; his lust often gets the group into trouble and sometimes leads to disaster.

claims.quote: Although Sun Wukong can identify demons, Zhu Bajie often persuades him to release them rather than capture or kill them; his kindness often causes trouble and leads to disaster.

statement.id: Meski Sun Wukong dapat mengenali iblis, Zhu Bajie sering membujuknya melepaskan mereka alih-alih menangkap atau membunuhnya; kebaikan hatinya sering menimbulkan masalah dan bencana.
statement.en: Although Sun Wukong can identify demons, Zhu Bajie often persuades him to release them rather than capture or kill them; his kindness often causes trouble and leads to disaster.

claims.quote: Zhu Bajie respectfully calls Sun Wukong "brother", even though the two often clash and Sun frequently mocks him.

statement.id: Zhu Bajie dengan hormat memanggil Sun Wukong "kakak", meski keduanya sering bentrok dan Sun sering mengejeknya.
statement.en: Zhu Bajie respectfully calls Sun Wukong "brother", even though the two often clash and Sun frequently mocks him.

claims.quote: The character's name and pilgrimage origins may derive from Zhu Shixing, a real monk who lived during the late Han dynasty.

statement.id: Nama dan asal-usul ziarah tokoh ini mungkin berasal dari Zhu Shixing, biksu nyata yang hidup pada akhir dinasti Han.
statement.en: The character's name and pilgrimage origins may derive from Zhu Shixing, a real monk who lived during the late Han dynasty.

claims.quote: Zhu Bajie first appeared as a pig demon in theatrical plays of the Yuan and early Ming dynasties, including works by Yang Jingxian. In these early versions, the character introduces himself as the "Chariot General" and serves Marici, the Bodhisattva of Light.
claims.locator: Origins and development: Early theatrical appearances

statement.id: Zhu Bajie pertama kali muncul sebagai iblis babi dalam drama panggung dinasti Yuan dan awal Ming, termasuk karya Yang Jingxian; dalam versi awal itu ia memperkenalkan diri sebagai "Chariot General" dan melayani Marici, Bodhisatwa Cahaya.
statement.en: Zhu Bajie first appeared as a pig demon in theatrical plays of the Yuan and early Ming dynasties, including works by Yang Jingxian; in these early versions he introduces himself as the "Chariot General" and serves Marici, the Bodhisattva of Light.

claims.quote: Zhu Bajie's heavenly title, Marshal Tianpeng, comes from ancient Taoist star worship.
claims.locator: Origins and development: Evolution of Marshal Tianpeng

statement.id: Gelar surgawi Zhu Bajie, Marshal Tianpeng, berasal dari pemujaan bintang Tao kuno.
statement.en: Zhu Bajie's heavenly title, Marshal Tianpeng, comes from ancient Taoist star worship.

claims.quote: In modern times, Zhu Bajie is seen as a patron deity of masseuses, hostesses, and prostitutes in Taiwan and other parts of East Asia.

statement.id: Pada masa modern, Zhu Bajie dipandang sebagai dewa pelindung pemijat, pramuria, dan pekerja seks di Taiwan dan bagian lain Asia Timur.
statement.en: In modern times Zhu Bajie is seen as a patron deity of masseuses, hostesses and prostitutes in Taiwan and other parts of East Asia.

claims.quote: The Pig, who personates irrepressible instincts ... But he has no sense, is too fond of ease, good feeding and pleasure

statement.id: Dalam pengantar terjemahannya tahun 1913, Timothy Richard menulis bahwa si Babi melambangkan naluri yang tak terkendali, dan bahwa ia tak punya akal sehat serta terlalu gemar bersantai, makan enak, dan kesenangan.
statement.en: In the introduction to his 1913 translation Timothy Richard writes that the Pig personates irrepressible instincts, and that he has no sense and is too fond of ease, good feeding and pleasure.

claims.quote: But getting drunk, I made love to some of the fairies, and was expelled to Fu Ling Shan, but by some mistake in transmigration

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan Richard (1913) si iblis Chu bercerita bahwa ia mabuk, merayu beberapa peri, lalu diusir ke Fu Ling Shan akibat kesalahan dalam perpindahan jiwa.
statement.en: In Richard's 1913 translation the demon Chu says that, getting drunk, he made love to some of the fairies and was expelled to Fu Ling Shan through some mistake in transmigration.

claims.quote: But I will also give you a new name Pa Kiel (eight commandments).

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan Richard (1913), Sang Guru memberi si iblis nama baru Pa Kiel (delapan perintah).
statement.en: In Richard's 1913 translation the Master gives the demon a new name, Pa Kiel (eight commandments).

claims.quote: 我本是天河裡天蓬元帥。只因帶酒戲弄嫦娥，玉帝把我打了二千鎚，貶下塵凡。一靈真性，徑來奪舍投胎，不期錯了道路，投在個母豬胎裡，變得這般模樣。

statement.id: Dalam bab 8, si monster mengaku dahulu Marsekal Tianpeng dari Sungai Langit; karena mabuk dan menggoda Chang'e ia dihukum Kaisar Giok dengan dua ribu pukulan palu, dibuang ke dunia, dan salah masuk ke rahim babi betina sehingga berwujud demikian.
statement.en: In chapter 8 the creature says he was once Marshal Tianpeng of the Heavenly River; for flirting with Chang'e while drunk the Jade Emperor had him struck two thousand blows with a hammer and cast down to the mortal world, where he took the wrong road and entered a sow's womb, taking this form.

claims.quote: 是我咬殺母豬，打死群彘，在此處占了山場，吃人度日。不期撞著菩薩，萬望拔救拔救。

statement.id: Ia mengaku menggigit mati babi betina, membunuh kawanan babi, merebut wilayah gunung itu, dan hidup dengan memakan manusia, lalu memohon pertolongan Guanyin.
statement.en: He says he bit the sow to death, killed the herd of pigs, took over the mountain ground and lived by eating people, and then begs the bodhisattva for rescue.

claims.quote: 叫做福陵山。山中有一洞，叫做雲棧洞。洞裡原有個卵二姐，他見我有些武藝，招我做了家長，又喚做倒蹅門。

statement.id: Ia menyebut gunung itu Fuling (福陵山), dengan sebuah gua bernama Yunzhan (雲棧洞) di dalamnya; di gua itu dahulu ada Luan Erjie (卵二姐) yang, melihat ia punya kepandaian bela diri, mengangkatnya sebagai kepala keluarga.
statement.en: He names the mountain Fuling (福陵山), with a cave called Yunzhan (雲棧洞) in it; in that cave there had been a Luan Erjie (卵二姐) who, seeing he had some martial skill, took him on as head of the household.

claims.quote: 菩薩才與他摩頂受戒，指身為姓，就姓了豬；替他起了法名，就叫做豬悟能。遂此領命歸真，持齋把素，斷絕了五葷三厭，專候那取經人。

statement.id: Guanyin menahbiskannya, memberinya marga "豬" (babi) dari tubuhnya dan nama dharma "豬悟能"; ia lalu berpuasa, menjauhi lima sayuran berbau dan tiga pantangan, menunggu orang yang akan mengambil sutra.
statement.en: The bodhisattva ordains him, gives him the surname "豬" (pig) from his body and the dharma name "豬悟能"; he then keeps a vegetarian fast, giving up the five pungent foods and three abstentions, to wait for the scripture seeker.

claims.quote: 初來時是一條黑胖漢，後來就變做一個長嘴大耳朵的獃子，腦後又有一溜鬃毛，身體粗糙怕人，頭臉就像個豬的模樣。食腸卻又甚大：一頓要吃三五斗米飯，早間點心也得百十個燒餅才夠。

statement.id: Dalam bab 18, Tuan Gao menggambarkan menantunya: mula-mula pria gemuk berkulit gelap, lalu berubah menjadi si dungu bermoncong panjang, bertelinga besar, berbulu kuduk di belakang kepala, dan berkepala seperti babi, yang sekali makan menghabiskan tiga hingga lima dou nasi.
statement.en: In chapter 18 old Gao describes his son-in-law: at first a dark, stout man, then a dull fellow with a long snout and big ears, a mane behind his head and a pig-like head and face, who eats three to five dou of rice at one meal.

claims.quote: 他如今又會弄風，雲來霧去，走石飛砂，諕得我一家並左鄰右舍，俱不得安生。

statement.id: Tuan Gao menyebut kini ia dapat mengendalikan angin, mendatangkan awan dan kabut, serta menerbangkan batu dan pasir, sehingga keluarga dan tetangga tidak tenang.
statement.en: Old Gao says he can now stir up wind, bring clouds and mist, and make stones and sand fly, so that the family and neighbours cannot live in peace.

claims.quote: 正行處，忽見一座高山，那怪把紅光結聚，現了本相，撞入洞內，取出一柄九齒釘鈀來戰。

statement.id: Dalam bab 19, si monster memusatkan cahaya merah, menampakkan wujud aslinya, menerobos masuk gua, dan membawa keluar sebuah garu bergigi sembilan (九齒釘鈀) untuk bertarung.
statement.en: In chapter 19 the creature gathers red light, shows his true form, rushes into his cave and brings out a nine-toothed rake (九齒釘鈀) to fight.

claims.quote: 三藏道：「不可，不可。你既是不吃五葷三厭，我再與你起個別名，喚為八戒。」那獃子歡歡喜喜道：「謹遵師命。」因此又叫做豬八戒。

statement.id: Tang Sanzang berkata bahwa karena ia menjauhi lima sayuran berbau dan tiga pantangan, ia diberi nama lain "八戒"; sejak itu ia juga disebut 豬八戒.
statement.en: Tang Sanzang says that since he keeps away from the five pungent foods and three abstentions he will be given another name, "八戒" (Bajie); hence he is also called 豬八戒.

claims.quote: 他本是天蓬元帥臨凡，只因錯投了胎，嘴臉像一個野豬模樣，其實性靈尚存。他說以相為姓，喚名豬剛鬣。

statement.id: Sun Wukong melaporkan bahwa monster itu aslinya Marsekal Tianpeng yang turun ke dunia, salah menjelma sehingga wajahnya seperti babi hutan namun akal batinnya tetap ada; ia mengaku bermarga dari rupanya dan bernama 豬剛鬣.
statement.en: Sun Wukong reports that the creature is really Marshal Tianpeng come down to the mortal world, who took the wrong birth and has a wild boar's face while his inner nature remains; he says he takes his surname from his looks and is named 豬剛鬣.

claims.quote: 甚虧了悟能與他水面上大戰三次，只是不能取勝，被他攔阻，不能渡河。

statement.id: Sun Wukong melapor kepada Guanyin bahwa Wuneng (Zhu Bajie) sudah bertarung tiga kali melawan monster sungai di permukaan air tanpa menang, sehingga rombongan terhalang menyeberang.
statement.en: Sun Wukong reports to Guanyin that Wuneng (Zhu Bajie) fought the river monster three times on the water without winning, so the party was blocked from crossing.

claims.quote: 那八戒聞得這般富貴，這般美色，他卻心癢難撓；坐在那椅子上，一似針戳屁股，左扭右扭的，忍耐不住。

statement.id: Dalam bab 23, mendengar kekayaan dan kecantikan itu, Bajie tak tahan; ia duduk gelisah seperti ditusuk jarum.
statement.en: In chapter 23, hearing of such wealth and beauty, Bajie cannot restrain himself and squirms in his chair as if pricked by a needle.

claims.quote: 豬悟能，汝本天河水神天蓬元帥，為汝蟠桃會上酗酒戲了仙娥，貶汝下界投胎，身如畜類。幸汝記愛人身，在福陵山雲棧洞造孽，喜歸大教，入我沙門，保聖僧在路，卻又有頑心，色情未泯。因汝挑擔有功，加陞汝職正果，做淨壇使者。

statement.id: Di akhir novel, Buddha berkata bahwa Zhu Wuneng dahulu dewa air Sungai Langit, Marsekal Tianpeng, dibuang karena mabuk dan menggoda dewi; karena jasanya memikul beban, ia dinaikkan menjadi Pembersih Altar (淨壇使者).
statement.en: At the end of the novel the Buddha says Zhu Wuneng was once the water god of the Heavenly River, Marshal Tianpeng, cast down for drunken misconduct with an immortal maiden; for his merit in carrying the baggage he is raised to the rank of Altar Cleanser (淨壇使者).

claims.quote: 八戒口中嚷道：「他們都成佛，如何把我做個淨壇使者？」如來道：「因汝口壯身慵，食腸寬大。

statement.id: Bajie protes mengapa ia hanya menjadi Pembersih Altar sementara yang lain menjadi buddha; Buddha menjawab bahwa ia bermulut besar, bertubuh malas, dan berperut lebar.
statement.en: Bajie protests that he is made only an Altar Cleanser while the others become buddhas; the Buddha answers that he has a big mouth, a lazy body and a wide appetite.

text.id: Menurut satu kajian, asalnya dapat ditelusuri ke tokoh dalam epos Sanskerta abad-abad pertama SM; dalam sastra, tokoh novel zaman Dinasti Ming.
text.en: According to one study, his origins can be traced to a figure of the Sanskrit epics of the first centuries BCE; in literature, a character in novels of the Ming dynasty.

short_description.id: Nezha adalah dewa pelindung dalam agama rakyat Tiongkok, Taoisme, dan Buddhisme, yang bergelar Marsekal Altar Tengah, yang juga tampil sebagai tokoh dalam novel Fengshen Yanyi dan Perjalanan ke Barat.
short_description.en: Nezha is a protection deity in Chinese folk religion, Taoism, and Buddhism, with the title Marshal of the Central Altar, who also appears as a character in the novels Fengshen Yanyi and Journey to the West.

long_description.id: Nezha adalah dewa pelindung dalam Taoisme, Buddhisme, Konfusianisme, dan agama rakyat Tiongkok. Nama Taoisnya yang resmi adalah Marsekal Altar Tengah, dan setelah menjadi dewa ia diberi gelar Pangeran Ketiga Teratai. Dalam pemujaan rakyat ia juga disebut Pangeran Ketiga. Menurut Meir Shahar, ia telah dimuliakan selama lebih dari seribu tahun.
long_description.en: Across Chinese folk religion, Taoism, Buddhism, and Confucianism, Nezha is a protective deity. The Taoist tradition officially names him Marshal of the Central Altar, and once he became a deity he received the title Third Lotus Prince. In popular worship he is also called the Third Prince. According to Meir Shahar, he has been celebrated for over a millennium.

long_description.id: Menurut Meir Shahar, Nezha bermula sebagai makhluk mitologis bernama Nalakūbara dalam epos Sanskerta, dan nama Nezha berasal dari Nalakuvara, yang digambarkan sebagai jenderal yaksa heroik dalam Mahamayuri. Kajian yang sama menyebut ia telah dipuja oleh biksu Buddha, pendeta Dao, dan perantara roh. Novel Perjalanan ke Barat memberi penjelasan lain tentang nama itu: Nezha lahir dengan aksara 'Ne' di telapak tangan kiri dan 'zha' di telapak tangan kanan.
long_description.en: According to Meir Shahar, Nezha began as a mythological being named Nalakūbara in the Sanskrit epics, and the name Nezha derives from Nalakuvara, portrayed as a heroic yaksha general in the Mahamayuri. The same study says he has been venerated by Buddhist monks, Daoist priests, and spirit mediums. The novel Journey to the West gives a different explanation of the name: Nezha was born with the character 'Ne' on his left palm and 'zha' on his right palm.

long_description.id: Dalam pemujaan, Nezha dianggap dewa pelindung banyak pengemudi profesional karena ia terbang cepat dengan roda angin-api, dan juga dewa pelindung anak-anak dan bakti anak. Orang tua mempersembahkan sesaji kepadanya agar anak mereka tumbuh kuat, sehat, dan berbakti. Shahar menafsirkan bahwa dalam kisahnya, etika Konfusian menuntut dorongan oedipal menyamar sebagai bakti anak.
long_description.en: In worship, Nezha is regarded as the tutelary god of many professional drivers because he flies swiftly on his wind-fire wheels, and also as the patron god of children and filial piety. Parents make offerings to him so that their children will grow up strong, healthy, and dutiful. Shahar interprets his story as one in which Confucian ethics require the oedipal drive to masquerade as filial piety.

long_description.id: Dalam novel Fengshen Yanyi dari zaman Dinasti Ming, Nezha adalah putra Li Jing yang lahir dari bola daging setelah dikandung lebih dari tiga tahun, dan merupakan penjelmaan Lingzhu Zi. Saat mandi di Sungai Jiuwan ia membunuh yaksa Li Gen dan putra Raja Naga, Ao Bing, lalu mengembalikan daging dan tulangnya kepada orang tuanya. Rohnya pergi ke Gunung Qianyuan; ia dipuja di sebuah kuil di Gunung Cuiping hingga Li Jing menghancurkannya, lalu Taiyi Zhenren membangkitkannya dalam tubuh teratai. Ia lalu menyerang Li Jing untuk membalas dendam hingga seorang Daois mengurungnya dengan pagoda, dan Li Jing menjadi Raja Langit Pembawa Pagoda.
long_description.en: In the novel Fengshen Yanyi of the Ming dynasty, Nezha is Li Jing's son, born from a ball of flesh after more than three years' gestation, and an incarnation of Lingzhu Zi. While bathing in the Jiuwan River he kills the yaksha Li Gen and the Dragon King's son Ao Bing, then returns his flesh and bones to his parents. His spirit goes to Mount Qianyuan; he is worshiped at a shrine on Mount Cuiping until Li Jing destroys it, and Taiyi Zhenren then raises him in a lotus body. He then attacks Li Jing in revenge until a Daoist traps him in a pagoda, and Li Jing becomes the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King.

long_description.id: Dalam novel Perjalanan ke Barat dari zaman Dinasti Ming, Nezha tampil sebagai Pangeran Ketiga yang bersama ayahnya, Raja Langit Li Jing, diangkat untuk menaklukkan Sun Wukong. Ia berubah menjadi bertiga kepala berenam lengan dan memegang enam senjata. Kisah asalnya diceritakan berbeda: Buddha, bukan Taiyi Zhenren, yang menghidupkannya kembali, dan pagoda diberikan Rulai kepada sang ayah. Penggambaran dalam novel ini adalah tokoh sastra, terpisah dari praktik pemujaan rakyat.
long_description.en: In the novel Journey to the West of the Ming dynasty, Nezha appears as the Third Prince who, with his father the Heavenly King Li Jing, is appointed to subdue Sun Wukong. He transforms into a three-headed, six-armed figure holding six weapons. His origin story is told differently: the Buddha, not Taiyi Zhenren, revives him, and the pagoda is given to the father by the Tathagata. This novel portrayal is a literary characterization, separate from the practice of folk worship.

cultural_context.id: Dalam pemujaan, Nezha dianggap pelindung pengemudi profesional serta anak-anak dan bakti anak; orang tua mempersembahkan sesaji agar anak mereka tumbuh kuat, sehat, dan berbakti. Shahar menyebut kisahnya mengungkap ketegangan tersembunyi dalam sistem keluarga Tiongkok.
cultural_context.en: In worship, Nezha is regarded as protector of professional drivers and of children and filial piety; parents make offerings so that their children grow up strong, healthy, and dutiful. Shahar says his story uncovers hidden tensions in the Chinese family system.

etymology.original_form: 哪吒 (Nézhā), dari 那吒 (Nazha) dan Nalakuvara

literal_meaning.id: Menurut Meir Shahar, nama ini berasal dari Nalakuvara; penambahan 'radikal mulut' (口) pada Na (那) menghasilkan bentuk sekarang. Novel Perjalanan ke Barat memberi penjelasan lain dari aksara di telapak tangan.
literal_meaning.en: According to Meir Shahar the name comes from Nalakuvara; adding the 'mouth radical' (口) to Na (那) gives the present form. The novel Journey to the West gives a different explanation from characters on the palms.

who.id: Dewa pelindung Tiongkok yang dikenal dengan gelar Marsekal Altar Tengah dan Pangeran Ketiga.
who.en: A Chinese protection deity known by the titles Marshal of the Central Altar and Third Prince.

origin.id: Menurut satu kajian, ia berawal dari Nalakūbara dalam epos Sanskerta di India; dalam novel Fengshen Yanyi ia lahir di Chentang Pass.
origin.en: According to one study he began as Nalakūbara of the Sanskrit epics in India; in the novel Fengshen Yanyi he is born at Chentang Pass.

role.id: Dewa pelindung yang dipuja sebagai pelindung pengemudi serta anak-anak dan bakti anak.
role.en: A protection deity worshiped as protector of drivers and of children and filial piety.

famous_for.id: Paling dikenal lewat kisah dalam novel Fengshen Yanyi: membunuh putra Raja Naga, mengembalikan daging dan tulangnya kepada orang tuanya, lalu dibangkitkan dalam tubuh teratai.
famous_for.en: Best known for the story in the novel Fengshen Yanyi: killing the Dragon King's son, returning his flesh and bones to his parents, and being raised in a lotus body.

did_you_know.id: Menurut Wikipedia, alur bahwa Ao Guang menuntut anak-anak sebagai korban dan mengancam membanjiri Chentang Pass hanya ditemukan dalam film 1979 Nezha Conquers the Dragon King, bukan dalam novel Fengshen Yanyi.
did_you_know.en: According to Wikipedia, the plot in which Ao Guang demands children as sacrifices and threatens to flood Chentang Pass is found only in the 1979 film Nezha Conquers the Dragon King, not in the novel Fengshen Yanyi.

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam cerita rakyat tradisional Nezha terbang cepat dengan roda angin-api; dalam Fengshen Yanyi ia berdiri di atas dua roda itu.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, in traditional folklore Nezha flies swiftly on his wind-fire wheels; in Fengshen Yanyi he stands on the two wheels.

name.en: The treasures Qiankun Quan and Huntian Ling

description.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, ia lahir dengan gelang emas dan kain merah yang disebut Qiankun Quan dan Huntian Ling; gelang itu dipakai membunuh Li Gen dan Ao Bing.
description.en: In Fengshen Yanyi he is born with a golden bracelet and a red silk called the Qiankun Quan and Huntian Ling; the bracelet is used to kill Li Gen and Ao Bing.

description.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, Nezha berubah menjadi bertiga kepala berenam lengan dengan enam senjata.
description.en: In Journey to the West, Nezha transforms into a three-headed, six-armed figure with six weapons.

description.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Taiyi Zhenren membentuk tubuh baru dari kelopak dan tangkai teratai; dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, Buddha menghidupkannya kembali.
description.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Taiyi Zhenren forms a new body from lotus petals and stalks; in Journey to the West the Buddha revives him.

description.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, ia menaklukkan sembilan puluh enam gua siluman dengan kekuatan gaibnya.
description.en: In Journey to the West he subdues ninety-six caves of demons with his divine power.

description.id: Lahir dari bola daging sebagai penjelmaan Lingzhu Zi, dibangkitkan Taiyi Zhenren dalam tubuh teratai, dan memakai roda angin-api serta tombak berujung api.
description.en: Born from a ball of flesh as an incarnation of Lingzhu Zi, raised by Taiyi Zhenren in a lotus body, and using wind-fire wheels and a fire-tipped spear.

description.id: Dihidupkan kembali oleh Buddha, lalu ayahnya menerima pagoda dari Rulai; dalam pertarungan ia berubah menjadi bertiga kepala berenam lengan.
description.en: Revived by the Buddha, after which his father receives a pagoda from the Tathagata; in battle he transforms into a three-headed, six-armed figure.

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, sebelum menjelma ke dunia fana ia dilukiskan sebagai dewa agung dengan tiga kepala, sembilan mata, dan delapan tangan.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, before his reincarnation he is described as a great immortal with three heads, nine eyes, and eight arms.

title.id: Kelahiran di Chentang Pass (novel Fengshen Yanyi)
title.en: Birth at Chentang Pass (novel Fengshen Yanyi)

role.id: Anak yang lahir dari bola daging.
role.en: The child born from a ball of flesh.

summary.id: Nyonya Yin mengandung lebih dari tiga tahun; Li Jing menebas bola daging yang lahir dan keluarlah seorang anak laki-laki, yang kemudian dinamai Nezha oleh Taiyi Zhenren.
summary.en: Lady Yin carries the child for more than three years; Li Jing slashes the ball of flesh that is born and a boy jumps out, who is then named Nezha by Taiyi Zhenren.

title.id: Mandi di Sungai Jiuwan dan putra Raja Naga
title.en: The bath in the Jiuwan River and the Dragon King's son

role.id: Pembunuh Li Gen dan Ao Bing.
role.en: Killer of Li Gen and Ao Bing.

summary.id: Pusaka Nezha mengguncang istana kristal; yaksa Li Gen dan Ao Bing, putra Raja Naga, terbunuh olehnya, dan Ao Guang datang ke Chentang Pass untuk menuntut.
summary.en: Nezha's treasure shakes the crystal palace; he kills the yaksha Li Gen and Ao Bing, the Dragon King's son, and Ao Guang comes to Chentang Pass to complain.

role.id: Anak yang mengorbankan dirinya agar orang tuanya tidak menanggung akibat.
role.en: The child who gives up his life so his parents bear no consequences.

summary.id: Nezha mengaku sebagai Lingzhu Zi, memotong lengannya dan membelah perutnya sendiri; rohnya melayang ke Gunung Qianyuan.
summary.en: Nezha declares himself Lingzhu Zi, cuts off an arm and slits open his own belly; his spirit drifts to Mount Qianyuan.

title.id: Kuil Gunung Cuiping dan tubuh teratai
title.en: The Mount Cuiping shrine and the lotus body

summary.id: Taiyi Zhenren menyuruh Nezha meminta sebuah istana persinggahan lewat mimpi ibunya; penduduk berdatangan berdoa hingga Li Jing menghancurkan arcanya dan membakar kuil; Taiyi Zhenren lalu membentuk tubuh baru dari teratai.
summary.en: Taiyi Zhenren tells Nezha to ask for a shrine-palace through his mother's dream; residents come to pray until Li Jing smashes the statue and burns the temple; Taiyi Zhenren then forms a new body from lotus.

title.id: Pertarungan dengan Li Jing dan pagoda
title.en: The fight with Li Jing and the pagoda

role.en: The son who attacks his father.

summary.id: Nezha dengan roda angin-api dan tombak berujung api menyerang Li Jing, hingga seorang Daois mengurungnya dengan pagoda; syair penutup menyebut kekuatan Randeng.
summary.en: Nezha, on wind-fire wheels with a fire-tipped spear, attacks Li Jing until a Daoist traps him with a pagoda; the closing verse credits Randeng's power.

title.id: Nezha melawan Sun Wukong (novel Perjalanan ke Barat)
title.en: Nezha against Sun Wukong (novel Journey to the West)

role.id: Panglima langit yang menaklukkan Sun Wukong.
role.en: Heavenly commander sent to subdue Sun Wukong.

summary.id: Nezha dan ayahnya diangkat oleh Kaisar Giok; ia berubah menjadi bertiga kepala berenam lengan dan bertarung dengan Sun Wukong.
summary.en: Nezha and his father are appointed by the Jade Emperor; he transforms into a three-headed, six-armed figure and fights Sun Wukong.

description.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, tempat Nezha lahir.
description.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, where Nezha is born.

description.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, kediaman Taiyi Zhenren dan asal pusaka Nezha.
description.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the abode of Taiyi Zhenren and the source of Nezha's treasures.

description.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, sungai di muara Laut Timur tempat Nezha mandi.
description.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the river at the mouth of the East Sea where Nezha bathes.

description.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, lokasi kuil (istana persinggahan) Nezha yang ramai dikunjungi peziarah.
description.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the site of Nezha's busy shrine-palace.

description.id: Menurut Shahar, petualangan seksual Nalakūbara, asal Nezha, dirayakan dalam epos Sanskerta sejak abad-abad pertama SM.
description.en: According to Shahar, the sexual misadventures of Nalakūbara, Nezha's origin, were celebrated in the Sanskrit epics as early as the first centuries BCE.

title.en: Description in the Sanjiao Soushen Daquan

description.id: Teks zaman Yuan ini melukiskan Nezha sebagai dewa agung dengan tiga kepala, sembilan mata, dan delapan tangan sebelum menjelma ke dunia fana.
description.en: This Yuan-dynasty text describes Nezha as a great immortal with three heads, nine eyes, and eight arms before his reincarnation.

title.en: Composition of the novel Fengshen Yanyi

description.id: Menurut Wikisource, novel yang memuat kisah Nezha ini kira-kira rampung ditulis pada masa Longqing dan Wanli.
description.en: According to Wikisource, the novel containing the Nezha story was roughly completed in the Longqing and Wanli periods.

note.id: Ayah Nezha dalam novel; kemudian Raja Langit Pembawa Pagoda.
note.en: Nezha's father in the novels; later the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King.

note.id: Daois yang menamai dan menjadi guru Nezha dalam Fengshen Yanyi serta membangkitkannya dalam tubuh teratai.
note.en: The Daoist who names Nezha and acts as his master in Fengshen Yanyi, and raises him in a lotus body.

note.id: Kakak sulung Nezha, murid Wenshu Guangfa Tianzun.
note.en: Nezha's eldest brother, a disciple of Wenshu Guangfa Tianzun.

note.id: Kakak kedua Nezha, murid Puxian Zhenren.
note.en: Nezha's second brother, a disciple of Puxian Zhenren.

note.id: Putra ketiga Raja Naga Laut Timur yang dibunuh Nezha dalam Fengshen Yanyi.
note.en: Third son of the East Sea Dragon King, killed by Nezha in Fengshen Yanyi.

note.id: Raja Naga yang datang menuntut atas kematian putranya dalam Fengshen Yanyi.
note.en: The Dragon King who comes to demand redress for his son's death in Fengshen Yanyi.

note.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, Nezha melawan Sun Wukong dan kemudian keduanya berteman.
note.en: In Journey to the West, Nezha fights Sun Wukong and they later become friends.

note.id: Menurut Shahar, Nezha bermula sebagai Nalakūbara dari epos Sanskerta.
note.en: According to Shahar, Nezha began as Nalakūbara of the Sanskrit epics.

description.id: Film animasi panjang yang meningkatkan popularitas Nezha, diputar di Festival Film Cannes 1980.
description.en: An animated feature that increased Nezha's popularity, screened at the 1980 Cannes Film Festival.

description.id: Film animasi panjang yang memecahkan banyak rekor pendapatan.
description.en: An animated feature that set numerous box-office records.

description.id: Sekuel Ne Zha yang mencetak rekor pendapatan lebih jauh.
description.en: The sequel to Ne Zha, which set further box-office records.

traditional.id: Dalam novel Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha membunuh Li Gen dan Ao Bing saat mandi di Sungai Jiuwan dan pusakanya mengguncang istana naga.
traditional.en: In the novel Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha kills Li Gen and Ao Bing while bathing in the Jiuwan River, and his treasure shakes the dragon palace.

modern.id: Dalam budaya populer, pembunuhan itu sering dipandang sebagai akibat Ao Guang menuntut anak-anak sebagai korban; menurut Wikipedia alur ini hanya ada dalam film 1979, bukan novel.
modern.en: In popular culture the killings are often seen as a result of Ao Guang demanding children as sacrifices; according to Wikipedia this plot is found only in the 1979 film, not the novel.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa satu tokoh dapat memiliki asal-usul yang dijelaskan secara berbeda oleh kajian akademik dan oleh novel klasik?
learning_questions.en: Why can one figure have origins explained differently by academic study and by classic novels?

learning_questions.id: Apa yang berubah ketika kisah Nezha diceritakan ulang dalam film modern dibandingkan dengan teks novel?
learning_questions.en: What changes when Nezha's story is retold in modern films compared with the novel texts?

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana pemujaan Nezha mencerminkan harapan orang tua terhadap anak-anak mereka?
learning_questions.en: How does the worship of Nezha reflect parents' hopes for their children?
