sources.title: Oedipal God: The Chinese Nezha and His Indian Origins (book page)
sources.author: Meir Shahar

claims.quote: Nezha (哪吒, Nézhā) or sometimes Nezha the Crown Prince (哪吒太子, Nézhā Tàizǐ), or Natha, is a protection deity in Taoism, Buddhism, Confucianism, and Chinese folk religion.

statement.id: Nezha (哪吒), kadang disebut Nezha Sang Putra Mahkota (哪吒太子) atau Natha, adalah dewa pelindung dalam Taoisme, Buddhisme, Konfusianisme, dan agama rakyat Tiongkok.
statement.en: Nezha (哪吒), sometimes called Nezha the Crown Prince (哪吒太子) or Natha, is a protection deity in Taoism, Buddhism, Confucianism, and Chinese folk religion.

claims.quote: His official Taoist name is "Marshal of the Central Altar" (中壇元帥). He was then given the title "Third Lotus Prince" (蓮花三太子) after he became a deity.

statement.id: Nama resmi Taoisnya adalah 'Marsekal Altar Tengah' (中壇元帥). Setelah menjadi dewa, ia diberi gelar 'Pangeran Ketiga Teratai' (蓮花三太子).
statement.en: His official Taoist name is 'Marshal of the Central Altar' (中壇元帥). After he became a deity he was given the title 'Third Lotus Prince' (蓮花三太子).

claims.quote: Nezha is worshipped in Chinese folk religion and is called "Marshal of the Central Altar" (三坛大会元帅), or the "Third Prince" (三太子).

statement.id: Nezha dipuja dalam agama rakyat Tiongkok dan disebut 'Marsekal Altar Tengah' (三坛大会元帅) atau 'Pangeran Ketiga' (三太子).
statement.en: Nezha is worshipped in Chinese folk religion and is called 'Marshal of the Central Altar' (三坛大会元帅) or the 'Third Prince' (三太子).

claims.quote: As in traditional folklore, Nezha flies around swiftly on his wind fire wheels, so he is also regarded as the tutelary god of many professional drivers, like trucks, taxis, or sightseeing bus drivers.

statement.id: Seperti dalam cerita rakyat tradisional, Nezha terbang cepat dengan roda angin-api (風火輪), sehingga ia juga dianggap dewa pelindung banyak pengemudi profesional, seperti sopir truk, taksi, atau bus wisata.
statement.en: As in traditional folklore, Nezha flies around swiftly on his wind fire wheels, so he is also regarded as the tutelary god of many professional drivers, such as truck, taxi, or sightseeing-bus drivers.

claims.quote: Nezha is also often regarded as the patron god of children and filial piety. Parents would make an offering to Nezha with the hope that their children would grow up strong, healthy, and be dutiful and respectful.

statement.id: Nezha juga sering dianggap dewa pelindung anak-anak dan bakti anak. Orang tua mempersembahkan sesaji kepada Nezha dengan harapan anak mereka tumbuh kuat, sehat, berbakti, dan hormat.
statement.en: Nezha is also often regarded as the patron god of children and filial piety. Parents would make an offering to Nezha hoping their children would grow up strong, healthy, dutiful, and respectful.

claims.quote: Finally, the book offers a detailed history of the legend and the cult reaching back over two thousand years to its origins in India, where Nezha began as a mythological being named Nalakūbara, whose sexual misadventures were celebrated in the Sanskrit epics as early as the first centuries BCE.

statement.id: Menurut deskripsi buku Meir Shahar, legenda dan kultus Nezha dapat ditelusuri lebih dari dua ribu tahun ke asalnya di India, tempat Nezha bermula sebagai makhluk mitologis bernama Nalakūbara, yang petualangan seksualnya dirayakan dalam epos Sanskerta sejak abad-abad pertama SM.
statement.en: According to the description of Meir Shahar's book, the legend and cult of Nezha reach back over two thousand years to their origins in India, where Nezha began as a mythological being named Nalakūbara, whose sexual misadventures were celebrated in the Sanskrit epics as early as the first centuries BCE.

claims.quote: Crossing the boundaries between China’s diverse religious traditions, it tracks the rebellious infant in the many ways he has been venerated by Buddhist monks, Daoist priests, and possessed spirit mediums

statement.id: Menurut deskripsi buku Shahar, Nezha sang bayi pemberontak dipuja dengan berbagai cara oleh biksu Buddha, pendeta Dao, dan perantara roh yang kerasukan.
statement.en: According to the description of Shahar's book, the rebellious infant Nezha has been venerated in many ways by Buddhist monks, Daoist priests, and possessed spirit mediums.

claims.quote: Celebrated for over a millennium, Nezha is among the most formidable and enigmatic of all Chinese gods.

statement.id: Menurut deskripsi buku Shahar, Nezha telah dimuliakan selama lebih dari seribu tahun dan termasuk dewa Tiongkok yang paling tangguh dan penuh teka-teki.
statement.en: According to the description of Shahar's book, Nezha has been celebrated for over a millennium and is among the most formidable and enigmatic of all Chinese gods.

claims.quote: Shahar argues that, despite a disastrous father-son relationship, Confucian ethics require that the oedipal drive masquerade as filial piety in Nezha’s story, dictating that the child-god kill himself before trying to avenge himself upon his father.

statement.id: Shahar berpendapat bahwa, meski hubungan ayah-anak itu buruk, etika Konfusian menuntut dorongan oedipal menyamar sebagai bakti anak dalam kisah Nezha, sehingga sang dewa kecil bunuh diri sebelum mencoba membalas dendam kepada ayahnya.
statement.en: Shahar argues that, despite a disastrous father-son relationship, Confucian ethics require the oedipal drive to masquerade as filial piety in Nezha's story, dictating that the child-god kill himself before trying to avenge himself on his father.

claims.quote: According to Meir Shahar, the name Nezha comes from Nalakuvara, depicted as a heroic yaksha general in the Mahamayuri.

statement.id: Menurut Meir Shahar, nama Nezha berasal dari Nalakuvara, yang digambarkan sebagai jenderal yaksa heroik dalam Mahamayuri.
statement.en: According to Meir Shahar, the name Nezha comes from Nalakuvara, depicted as a heroic yaksha general in the Mahamayuri.

claims.quote: The original variant 那羅鳩婆羅 changed to 捺羅俱跋羅, 那吒矩韈囉 and finally 那吒 (Nazha). The simple addition of the "mouth radical" (口) to Na (那) changes the name to the current form Nezha (哪吒).

statement.id: Bentuk asli 那羅鳩婆羅 berubah menjadi 捺羅俱跋羅, 那吒矩韈囉, dan akhirnya 那吒 (Nazha). Penambahan 'radikal mulut' (口) pada Na (那) mengubah nama menjadi bentuk sekarang, Nezha (哪吒).
statement.en: The original variant 那羅鳩婆羅 changed to 捺羅俱跋羅, 那吒矩韈囉, and finally 那吒 (Nazha). Adding the 'mouth radical' (口) to Na (那) gives the current form Nezha (哪吒).

claims.quote: 原來天王生此子時，他左手掌上有個「哪」字，右手掌上有個「吒」字，故名哪吒。

statement.id: Dalam novel Perjalanan ke Barat, ketika sang Raja Langit melahirkan putra ini, di telapak tangan kirinya ada aksara 'Ne' (哪) dan di telapak tangan kanannya aksara 'zha' (吒), sehingga ia dinamai Nezha.
statement.en: In the novel Journey to the West, when the Heavenly King had this son, the character 'Ne' (哪) was on his left palm and 'zha' (吒) on his right palm, hence the name Nezha.

claims.quote: 殷夫人後又懷孕在身，已及三年零六個月，倘不生產。李靖時常心下憂疑，一日，指夫人之腹，言曰：「孕懷三載有餘，尚不降生，非妖即怪。」

statement.id: Dalam novel Fengshen Yanyi, Nyonya Yin mengandung selama tiga tahun enam bulan tanpa melahirkan, dan Li Jing cemas serta berkata bahwa kehamilan sepanjang itu pasti pertanda siluman atau makhluk aneh.
statement.en: In the novel Fengshen Yanyi, Lady Yin was pregnant for three years and six months without giving birth, and Li Jing, worried, said that a pregnancy so long must mean a demon or a monster.

claims.quote: 有一肉毬，滴溜溜圓轉如輪。李靖大驚，望肉毬上一劍砍去，劃然有聲。分開肉毬，跳出一個小孩兒來，滿地紅光，面如傅粉，右手套一金鐲，肚腹上圍著一塊紅綾，金光射目。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing menebas sebuah bola daging yang berputar seperti roda; bola itu terbelah dan keluarlah seorang anak laki-laki dengan cahaya merah, bermuka putih, bergelang emas di tangan kanan, dan berselempang kain merah di perutnya.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing slashes a ball of flesh that turns like a wheel; it splits open and a small boy jumps out amid red light, with a face white as powder, a golden bracelet on his right hand, and a red silk cloth around his belly.

claims.quote: 這位神聖下世，出在陳塘關，乃姜子牙先行官是也；靈珠子化身。金鐲是「乾坤圈」，紅綾名曰「混天綾。」此物乃是乾元山鎮金光洞之寶。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, narator menyatakan bahwa dewa ini lahir di Chentang Pass sebagai penjelmaan Lingzhu Zi dan pembuka jalan bagi Jiang Ziya; gelang emasnya bernama Qiankun Quan (乾坤圈) dan kain merahnya Huntian Ling (混天綾), pusaka Gua Jinguang di Gunung Qianyuan.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the narrator states that this divine being was born at Chentang Pass as an incarnation of Lingzhu Zi and as Jiang Ziya's vanguard; the golden bracelet is the Qiankun Quan (乾坤圈) and the red silk the Huntian Ling (混天綾), treasures of Jinguang Cave on Mount Qianyuan.

claims.quote: 李靖答曰：「不才有三子；長曰金吒，拜五龍山雲霄洞文殊廣法天尊為師；次曰木吒，拜九宮山白鶴洞普賢真人為師。老師既要此子為門下，但憑起一名諱，便拜道長為師。」道人曰：「此子第三，取名叫做『哪吒』。」

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing menyebut ketiga putranya: Jinzha (murid Wenshu Guangfa Tianzun) dan Muzha (murid Puxian Zhenren); sang Daois lalu menamai putra ketiga 'Nezha'.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing names his three sons: Jinzha (a disciple of Wenshu Guangfa Tianzun) and Muzha (a disciple of Puxian Zhenren); the Daoist then names the third son 'Nezha'.

claims.quote: 貧道乃乾元山金光洞太乙真人是也。聞得將軍生了公子，特來賀喜。借令公子一看，不知尊意如何？

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, sang Daois memperkenalkan diri sebagai Taiyi Zhenren dari Gua Jinguang di Gunung Qianyuan, yang datang memberi selamat atas kelahiran putra Li Jing.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the Daoist introduces himself as Taiyi Zhenren of Jinguang Cave on Mount Qianyuan, who has come to congratulate Li Jing on the birth of his son.

claims.quote: 不知這河是九灣河，是東海口上。哪吒將此寶放在水中，把水俱映紅了。擺一擺，江河晃動，搖一搖，乾坤動撼。那哪吒洗澡，不覺那水晶宮已愰的亂響。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha mandi di Sungai Jiuwan di muara Laut Timur dengan mencelupkan pusakanya; air menjadi merah, sungai bergoyang, dan istana kristal ikut berguncang.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha bathes in the Jiuwan River at the mouth of the East Sea and dips his treasure in the water; the water turns red, the river shakes, and the crystal palace rattles.

claims.quote: 把右手套的乾坤圈望空中一舉。此寶原係崑崙山玉虛宮所賜太乙真人鎮金光洞之物，夜叉那裏經得起，那寶打將下來，正落在夜叉頭上，只打的腦漿迸流，即死於岸上。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha mengangkat Qiankun Quan ke udara dan benda itu menimpa kepala yaksa pengintai Li Gen hingga ia tewas di tepi sungai.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha raises the Qiankun Quan into the air and it strikes the head of the patrolling yaksha Li Gen, who dies on the bank.

claims.quote: 提起乾坤圈，照頂門一下，把三太子的元身打出，是一條龍，在地上挺直。哪吒曰：「打出這小龍的本像來了。也罷，把他的筋抽去，做一條龍筋絛與俺父親束甲。」

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha memukul putra ketiga Raja Naga dengan Qiankun Quan hingga wujud aslinya, seekor naga, tampak; ia lalu mencabut urat sang naga untuk dijadikan ikat pinggang bagi ayahnya.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha strikes the Dragon King's third son with the Qiankun Quan until his true form, a dragon, appears; he then pulls out its sinew to make a belt for his father.

claims.quote: 敖光大怒，恨不能即與其子報仇，隨化一秀士，逕往陳塘關來。至於帥府，對門官曰：「你與我傳報，有故人敖光拜訪。」

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Ao Guang murka dan, setelah menjelma menjadi seorang terpelajar, pergi ke Chentang Pass dan mengumumkan dirinya sebagai kenalan lama yang berkunjung.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Ao Guang, furious, transforms into a scholar, goes to Chentang Pass, and announces himself as an old acquaintance come to visit.

claims.quote: 『一人行事一人當』，我打死敖丙、李艮，我當償命，豈有子連累父母之理！」乃對敖光曰：「我一身非輕，乃靈珠子是也。奉玉虛符命，應運下世。我今日剖腹、剜腸、剔骨肉，還於父母，不累雙親。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha menyatakan bahwa ia yang membunuh Ao Bing dan Li Gen sehingga ia sendiri yang harus menanggung akibatnya, mengaku sebagai Lingzhu Zi, dan berkata akan mengembalikan daging dan tulangnya kepada orang tuanya agar mereka tidak terbebani.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha declares that he killed Ao Bing and Li Gen and must pay for it himself, says he is Lingzhu Zi, and says he will return his flesh and bones to his parents so that they are not burdened.

claims.quote: 哪吒便右手提劍，先去一臂膊，後自剖其腹，剜腸剔骨，散了七魂三魄，一命歸泉。四龍王據哪吒之言回旨。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha dengan pedang di tangan kanan memotong sebelah lengannya lalu membelah perutnya sendiri; ia mati dan para Raja Naga melaporkan sesuai ucapannya.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha, sword in his right hand, cuts off an arm and then slits open his own belly; he dies, and the Dragon Kings report according to his words.

claims.quote: 哪吒魂無所依，魄無所倚──他原是寶貝化現，借了精血，故有魂魄。哪吒飄飄蕩蕩，隨風而至，逕到乾元山來。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, roh Nezha tak punya tempat bersandar; ia berasal dari penjelmaan pusaka yang meminjam darah dan sari tubuh sehingga memiliki roh, dan ia melayang tertiup angin sampai ke Gunung Qianyuan.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha's spirit has nothing to rest on; he was the manifestation of a treasure that borrowed essence and blood and so has a spirit, and he drifts on the wind to Mount Qianyuan.

claims.quote: 真人吩咐哪吒：「此處非汝安身之所。你回到陳塘關，托一夢與你母親，離關四十里，有一翠屏山，山上有一空地，令你母親造一座哪吒行宮，你受香煙三載，又可立於人間，輔佐真主。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Taiyi Zhenren menyuruh Nezha menemui ibunya dalam mimpi dan meminta dibangunkan sebuah istana persinggahan (行宮) di Gunung Cuiping, empat puluh li dari pass itu; setelah menerima dupa selama tiga tahun ia dapat kembali ke dunia manusia untuk membantu sang penguasa sejati.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Taiyi Zhenren tells Nezha to appear in his mother's dream and ask for a shrine-palace (行宮) on Mount Cuiping, forty li from the pass; after receiving incense for three years he can return to the human world to assist the true ruler.

claims.quote: 哪吒在翠屏山顯聖，四方遠近居民，俱來進香，紛紛如蟻，日盛一日，往往不斷。祈福禳災，無不感應。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha menampakkan kesaktian di Gunung Cuiping; penduduk dari dekat dan jauh berdatangan membawa dupa, makin ramai dari hari ke hari, dan doa memohon berkah atau penangkal bencana selalu terkabul.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha manifests his power at Mount Cuiping; residents from near and far come with incense in growing numbers day by day, and prayers for blessings or the warding off of disaster are always answered.

claims.quote: 罵罷，提六陳鞭，一鞭把哪吒金身打的粉碎。李靖怒發，復一腳蹬倒鬼判。傳令：「放火，燒了廟宇。」

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing menghancurkan arca emas Nezha dengan cambuk, menendang roboh arca hakim hantu, dan memerintahkan agar kuil dibakar.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing smashes Nezha's golden statue with a whip, kicks over the ghost-judge statues, and orders the temple burned.

claims.quote: 真人將花勒下瓣兒，鋪成三才，又將荷葉梗兒折成三百骨節，三個荷葉，按上、中、下，按天、地、人。真人將一粒金丹放於居中

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Taiyi Zhenren menata kelopak teratai dan tangkai daun teratai menjadi tubuh dengan tiga ratus ruas tulang, lalu menaruh sebutir pil emas di tengahnya.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Taiyi Zhenren arranges lotus petals and lotus-leaf stalks into a body with three hundred joints of bone, then places a grain of golden elixir at its center.

claims.quote: 外面有三公子，腳踏風火二輪，手提火尖鎗，口稱老爺姓諱，不知何故，請老爺定奪。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, para pengawal melaporkan bahwa putra ketiga berdiri di atas dua roda angin-api dan memegang tombak berujung api.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the guards report that the third son stands on two wind-fire wheels and holds a fire-tipped spear.

claims.quote: 只見祥雲繚繞，紫霧盤旋，一物往下落來，把哪吒罩在玲瓏塔裏。道人雙手在塔上一拍，塔裏火發，把哪吒燒的大叫：「饒命！」

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, seorang Daois menurunkan sebuah pagoda yang mengurung Nezha, lalu menepuknya hingga api berkobar di dalam dan Nezha berteriak minta ampun.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, a Daoist drops a pagoda that traps Nezha and claps it so that fire breaks out inside and Nezha cries for mercy.

claims.quote: 道人原是太乙真人請到此間磨哪吒之性，以認父子之情。後來父子四人，肉身成聖，托塔天王乃李靖也。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Daois itu ternyata diundang Taiyi Zhenren untuk menjinakkan watak Nezha agar mengakui ikatan ayah-anak; kemudian keempat ayah dan putra itu menjadi suci dengan tubuh jasmani, dan Li Jing menjadi Raja Langit Pembawa Pagoda.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the Daoist turns out to have been invited by Taiyi Zhenren to temper Nezha's nature so that he acknowledges the father-son bond; later the father and three sons become sages in the flesh, and Li Jing is the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King.

claims.quote: 黃金造就玲瓏塔，萬道毫光透九重。不是燃燈施法力，難教父子復相從。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, syair penutup bab menyebut bahwa tanpa kekuatan gaib Randeng, ayah dan anak itu sulit rukun kembali berkat pagoda emas.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the closing verse of the chapter says that without Randeng's spiritual power the father and son could hardly have been reunited by the golden pagoda.

claims.quote: 割肉還母，剔骨還父，還了父精母血。一點靈魂，徑到西方極樂世界告佛。佛正與眾菩薩講經，只聞得幢幡寶蓋有人叫道：「救命！」佛慧眼一看，知是哪吒之魂，即將碧藕為骨，荷葉為衣，念動起死回生真言，哪吒遂得了性命。

statement.id: Dalam novel Perjalanan ke Barat, Nezha mengembalikan daging kepada ibu dan tulang kepada ayah, rohnya pergi memohon kepada Buddha di Surga Barat, dan Buddha menghidupkannya kembali dengan akar teratai sebagai tulang dan daun teratai sebagai pakaian.
statement.en: In the novel Journey to the West, Nezha returns his flesh to his mother and his bones to his father, his spirit goes to plead with the Buddha in the Western Paradise, and the Buddha revives him with lotus root for bones and lotus leaf for clothing.

claims.quote: 如來以和為尚，賜他一座玲瓏剔透舍利子如意黃金寶塔。那塔上層層有佛，豔豔光明。喚哪吒以佛為父，解釋了冤仇。所以稱為托塔李天王者，此也。

statement.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, Rulai (Buddha) memberi sang ayah sebuah pagoda emas yang berlapis-lapis Buddha dan menyuruh Nezha menganggap Buddha sebagai ayah sehingga dendam selesai; inilah asal gelar Li Tianwang Pembawa Pagoda.
statement.en: In Journey to the West, the Tathagata gives the father a golden pagoda with Buddhas on every level and tells Nezha to take the Buddha as his father, ending the grudge; this is why Li Tianwang is called the Pagoda-Bearer.

claims.quote: 運用神力，法降九十六洞妖魔，神通廣大。後來要殺天王，報那剔骨之仇。

statement.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, setelah hidup kembali Nezha memakai kekuatan gaibnya untuk menaklukkan sembilan puluh enam gua siluman, dan kemudian hendak membunuh sang Raja Langit untuk membalas dendam atas tulangnya yang dikupas.
statement.en: In Journey to the West, after being revived Nezha uses his divine power to subdue ninety-six caves of demons, and later wants to kill the Heavenly King to avenge having stripped his own bones.

claims.quote: 班部中閃上托塔李天王與哪吒三太子，越班奏上道：「萬歲，微臣不才，請旨降此妖怪。」玉帝大喜，即封托塔天王李靖為降魔大元帥，哪吒三太子為三壇海會大神，即刻興師下界。

statement.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, Raja Langit Li Jing dan Pangeran Ketiga Nezha mengajukan diri menaklukkan 'siluman' Sun Wukong; Kaisar Giok mengangkat Li Jing sebagai Marsekal Penakluk Iblis dan Nezha sebagai Dewa Agung Haihui Tiga Altar.
statement.en: In Journey to the West, the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King Li Jing and Third Prince Nezha volunteer to subdue the 'monster' Sun Wukong; the Jade Emperor appoints Li Jing Great Marshal Subduer of Demons and Nezha Great Deity of the Three Altars' Sea Assembly.

claims.quote: 那哪吒奮怒，大喝一聲，叫：「變！」即變做三頭六臂，惡狠狠，手持著六般兵器，乃是斬妖劍、砍妖刀、縛妖索、降妖杵、繡毬兒、火輪兒，丫丫叉叉，撲面來打。

statement.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, Nezha berteriak 'Berubah!' dan menjadi bertiga kepala berenam lengan, memegang enam senjata: pedang pembasmi siluman, golok pemotong siluman, tali pengikat siluman, pentungan penakluk siluman, bola bersulam, dan roda api.
statement.en: In Journey to the West, Nezha shouts 'Change!' and becomes three-headed and six-armed, holding six weapons: a demon-slaying sword, a demon-cutting blade, a demon-binding rope, a demon-subduing pestle, an embroidered ball, and a fire wheel.

claims.quote: In the Yuan dynasty Sanjiao Soushen Daquan (Complete Collection of Deities of the Three Religions), prior to his reincarnation into the mortal realm, Nezha was a great immortal under the Jade Emperor, who wears a golden wheel around his head, has three heads, nine eyes, and eight arms, and can blow azure clouds out of his mouth.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam Sanjiao Soushen Daquan (Kumpulan Lengkap Dewa Tiga Ajaran) zaman Yuan, sebelum menjelma ke dunia fana Nezha adalah dewa agung di bawah Kaisar Giok yang mengenakan roda emas di kepala, bertiga kepala, bermata sembilan, bertangan delapan, dan dapat mengembuskan awan biru dari mulutnya.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, in the Yuan-dynasty Sanjiao Soushen Daquan (Complete Collection of Deities of the Three Religions), before his reincarnation into the mortal realm Nezha was a great immortal under the Jade Emperor who wears a golden wheel around his head, has three heads, nine eyes, and eight arms, and can blow azure clouds out of his mouth.

claims.quote: In popular culture, Nezha's killing of Li Gen and Ao Bing is often seen as a result of Ao Guang demanding young boys and girls from Chentang Pass as sacrifices.

statement.id: Dalam budaya populer, pembunuhan Li Gen dan Ao Bing oleh Nezha sering dipandang sebagai akibat Ao Guang menuntut anak laki-laki dan perempuan dari Chentang Pass sebagai korban persembahan.
statement.en: In popular culture, Nezha's killing of Li Gen and Ao Bing is often seen as a result of Ao Guang demanding young boys and girls from Chentang Pass as sacrifices.

claims.quote: The above plot is only found in the 1979 Shanghai Animation Film Studio movie, Nezha Conquers the Dragon King, and not in the Fengshen Yanyi novel or Qing dynasty opera adaptations.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, alur yang dijelaskan sebelumnya (tuntutan korban dan ancaman banjir) hanya ditemukan dalam film Shanghai Animation Film Studio tahun 1979, Nezha Conquers the Dragon King, dan tidak ada dalam novel Fengshen Yanyi maupun adaptasi opera zaman Qing.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, the plot described just before (the demand for sacrifices and the flood threat) is found only in the 1979 Shanghai Animation Film Studio movie Nezha Conquers the Dragon King, and not in the Fengshen Yanyi novel or Qing-dynasty opera adaptations.

claims.quote: The character increased in popularity in 1979 with the animated feature film Nezha Conquers the Dragon King, which was screened at the 1980 Cannes Film Festival and is considered one of the great classic works of Chinese animation.

statement.id: Popularitas tokoh ini meningkat pada 1979 dengan film animasi panjang Nezha Conquers the Dragon King, yang diputar di Festival Film Cannes 1980 dan dianggap salah satu karya klasik besar animasi Tiongkok.
statement.en: The character increased in popularity in 1979 with the animated feature film Nezha Conquers the Dragon King, which was screened at the 1980 Cannes Film Festival and is considered one of the great classic works of Chinese animation.

claims.quote: On 26 July 2019, another animated feature film, Ne Zha, was more successful, setting numerous all-time records for box-office grosses, including third-highest-grossing of all films in China and highest-grossing animated film from outside the United States.

statement.id: Pada 26 Juli 2019, film animasi panjang lain, Ne Zha, lebih sukses dan memecahkan banyak rekor pendapatan sepanjang masa, termasuk film berpendapatan tertinggi ketiga di Tiongkok dan film animasi berpendapatan tertinggi dari luar Amerika Serikat.
statement.en: On 26 July 2019, another animated feature film, Ne Zha, was more successful, setting numerous all-time box-office records, including third-highest-grossing of all films in China and highest-grossing animated film from outside the United States.

claims.quote: A sequel, Ne Zha 2 (2025), set further box office records, becoming the highest-grossing film in China, and the highest grossing non-English language film of all time, and the highest grossing animated movie of all time.

statement.id: Sekuelnya, Ne Zha 2 (2025), mencetak rekor pendapatan lebih jauh, menjadi film berpendapatan tertinggi di Tiongkok, film berbahasa non-Inggris berpendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa, dan film animasi berpendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa.
statement.en: A sequel, Ne Zha 2 (2025), set further box-office records, becoming the highest-grossing film in China, the highest-grossing non-English-language film of all time, and the highest-grossing animated movie of all time.

claims.quote: He fought the Monkey King, Sun Wukong, when the latter rebelled against the Jade Emperor. They later became friends.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam Perjalanan ke Barat Nezha bertarung melawan Raja Kera Sun Wukong ketika yang terakhir memberontak melawan Kaisar Giok; keduanya kemudian menjadi teman.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, in Journey to the West Nezha fought the Monkey King Sun Wukong when the latter rebelled against the Jade Emperor; they later became friends.

claims.quote: 《封神演義》，一般俗稱《封神榜》，又名《商周列國全傳》、《武王伐紂外史》、《封神傳》。是一部中國神魔小說，作者是明朝的陳仲琳（或許仲琳）

statement.id: Menurut pengantar Wikisource, Fengshen Yanyi (封神演義), yang biasa disebut Fengshen Bang, adalah novel dewa-iblis Tiongkok; pengarangnya disebut Chen Zhonglin (atau Xu Zhonglin) dari Dinasti Ming.
statement.en: According to the Wikisource introduction, Fengshen Yanyi (封神演義), commonly called Fengshen Bang, is a Chinese novel of gods and demons whose author is given as Chen Zhonglin (or Xu Zhonglin) of the Ming dynasty.

claims.quote: 約成書於隆慶、萬曆年間。全書共一百回，以姜子牙輔佐周室（周文王、周武王）討伐商紂的歷史為背景

statement.id: Menurut pengantar Wikisource, Fengshen Yanyi kira-kira rampung ditulis pada masa Longqing dan Wanli; novel ini terdiri dari seratus bab dengan latar Jiang Ziya membantu wangsa Zhou (Raja Wen dan Raja Wu) menyerang Zhou raja Shang.
statement.en: According to the Wikisource introduction, Fengshen Yanyi was roughly completed in the Longqing and Wanli periods; it has one hundred chapters and is set against Jiang Ziya helping the house of Zhou (King Wen and King Wu) attack the Shang tyrant.

claims.quote: 《西遊記》是中國明代長篇神話小說，古代白話寫成。全書20卷100回。

statement.id: Menurut pengantar Wikisource, Xiyouji (Perjalanan ke Barat) adalah novel mitologi panjang dari zaman Dinasti Ming, ditulis dalam bahasa lisan klasik dengan 100 bab.
statement.en: According to the Wikisource introduction, Xiyouji (Journey to the West) is a long Chinese mythological novel of the Ming dynasty, written in classical vernacular, in 100 chapters.

claims.quote: 哪吒曰：「李靖！我骨肉已交還與你，我與你無干礙，你為何往翠屏山鞭打我的金身，火燒我的行宮？今日拿你，報一鞭之恨！」把鎗愰一愰，劈腦刺來。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha yang sudah hidup kembali menegur Li Jing karena mencambuk arca emasnya dan membakar istana persinggahannya di Gunung Cuiping, lalu menusukkan tombaknya ke arah kepala Li Jing untuk membalas dendam atas satu cambukan itu.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the revived Nezha rebukes Li Jing for whipping his golden statue and burning his shrine-palace on Mount Cuiping, then thrusts his spear at Li Jing's head to avenge that one lash.

claims.quote: In this theoretically informed study Meir Shahar recounts Nezha’s riveting tale—which culminates in suicide and attempted patricide—and uncovers hidden tensions in the Chinese family system.

statement.id: Menurut deskripsi buku, Meir Shahar menceritakan kisah Nezha yang memikat, yang berpuncak pada bunuh diri dan percobaan membunuh ayah, serta mengungkap ketegangan tersembunyi dalam sistem keluarga Tiongkok.
statement.en: According to the book description, Meir Shahar recounts Nezha's riveting tale, which culminates in suicide and attempted patricide, and uncovers hidden tensions in the Chinese family system.

summary.id: Menurut Meir Shahar, nama itu berasal dari Nalakuvara, jenderal yaksa dalam Mahamayuri.
summary.en: According to Meir Shahar, the name comes from Nalakuvara, a yaksha general in the Mahamayuri.

summary.id: Dalam novel Perjalanan ke Barat, ia dinamai dari aksara 'Ne' dan 'zha' di telapak tangannya.
summary.en: In the novel Journey to the West, he is named after the characters 'Ne' and 'zha' on his palms.

did_you_know.en: In the stories, Vishnu pulled out two hairs, one white and one black, and the black hair became Krishna in Devaki's eighth conception.

description.id: Krishna mengangkat Bukit Govardhan untuk melindungi kaumnya dari hujan dahsyat; Wisnu Purana menyebut ia menahannya dengan satu tangan seolah bermain.

description.id: Ia memikat para gopi dengan permainan serulingnya yang ilahi.
description.en: He enchanted the gopis with his divine flute playing.

description.id: Ia membunuh atau menghajar musuh seperti Putana, Kaliya, dan Kamsa; Wisnu Purana menyebut ia menindih Kansa hingga tewas dan bertekad membunuh Kāliya.
description.en: He killed or thrashed enemies such as Putana, Kaliya and Kamsa; the Vishnu Purana says he crushed Kansa to death and resolved to slay Kāliya.

description.id: Dalam Bhagavad Gita ia memperlihatkan kepada Arjuna semua rupa-Nya yang tak terhingga lalu kembali ke wujud Krishna yang dikenal Arjuna.
description.en: In the Bhagavad Gita he shows Arjuna all his infinite semblances and then returns to the form of Krishna that Arjuna knew.

description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Krishna tewas secara tak sengaja oleh panah pemburu yang mengenai tumitnya.
description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna was accidentally killed by a hunter's arrow striking his heel.

role.id: Anak kedelapan yang disembunyikan dari Kamsa
role.en: The eighth child hidden from Kamsa

summary.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Krishna lahir di Mathura dari Devaki dan Wasudewa tetapi dibesarkan Nanda dan Yashoda di Gokul untuk menghindari pamannya, Raja Kamsa yang zalim. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu mencabut dua helai rambut dan rambut hitam ditanamkan ke rahim Devaki; Kamsa yang diperingatkan tentang anak kedelapan telah membunuh tujuh anak sebelumnya, dan Wasudewa menyembunyikan Krishna di Vrindavana. Wisnu Purana menyebut suara dari langit yang memperingatkan Kansa.
summary.en: According to Wikipedia, Krishna was born in Mathura to Devaki and Vasudeva but raised by Nanda and Yashoda in Gokul to escape his uncle, the tyrant king Kamsa. According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu pulled two hairs and the black one was planted in Devaki's womb; Kamsa, warned about the eighth child, had killed seven children before, and Vasudeva hid Krishna in Vrindavana. The Vishnu Purana tells of the voice from the sky that warned Kansa.

summary.id: Krishna mengangkat Bukit Govardhan untuk melindungi kaumnya dari hujan dahsyat. Menurut World History Encyclopedia banjir itu dikirim Indra, dan menurut Wisnu Purana ia menahan gunung dengan satu tangan selama tujuh hari tujuh malam sementara awan Indra menurunkan hujan.
summary.en: Krishna lifted Govardhan Hill to shelter his community from devastating rains. According to the World History Encyclopedia the deluge was sent by Indra, and according to the Vishnu Purana he held the mountain with one hand for seven days and nights while Indra's clouds poured rain.

role.en: Rescuer of Vraja from the poisonous serpent

summary.id: Wisnu Purana menceritakan Krishna melihat kolam berisi ular Kāliya yang mendidih oleh api bisa, lalu bertekad membunuhnya agar penduduk Vraja bebas dari rasa takut; World History Encyclopedia menyebut Kaliya di antara musuh yang ia kalahkan.
summary.en: The Vishnu Purana tells how Krishna saw the pool of the serpent Kāliya boiling with the fires of poison and resolved to slay it so that Vraja's people would be free of fear; the World History Encyclopedia lists Kaliya among the enemies he defeated.

summary.id: Krishna mengalahkan tiran Kamsa dan kemudian menjadi raja Mathura; dalam Wisnu Purana ia menarik rambut Kansa, menjatuhkannya ke tanah, dan menimpanya hingga Kansa tewas.
summary.en: Krishna dealt with the tyrant Kamsa and afterwards became king of Mathura; in the Vishnu Purana he seizes Kansa by the hair, throws him to the ground and falls upon him until Kansa dies.

summary.id: Krishna menjadi kusir kereta Arjuna dalam perang di Kurukshetra antara Pandawa dan Kaurawa, dan pada malam sebelum perang itu ia melantunkan Bhagavad Gita. Dalam Gita ia menyatakan dirinya Roh dalam hati setiap makhluk dan, menurut World History Encyclopedia, bahwa seluruh alam semesta diciptakan olehnya; ia memperlihatkan kepada Arjuna semua rupa-Nya.
summary.en: Krishna was Arjuna's charioteer in the war at Kurukshetra between the Pandavas and the Kauravas, and on the eve of the battle he recounted the Bhagavad Gita. In the Gita he declares himself the Spirit in every creature's heart, and, according to the World History Encyclopedia, that the whole universe was created by him; he shows Arjuna all his semblances.

title.en: The theft of the Parijata tree

role.en: Thief of the tree from Indra

summary.id: Krishna mencuri pohon suci Parijata dari Indra dan mengalahkannya, menanamnya di Dvaraka, tetapi setelah ia wafat pohon itu dikembalikan kepada Indra.
summary.en: Krishna stole the sacred Parijata tree from Indra, defeating him, and planted it at Dvaraka, but on his death it was returned to Indra.

summary.en: Krishna built the fortress city of Dvaraka in Gujarat; a hunter's arrow struck his heel and killed him, and seven days later Dvaraka sank beneath the sea.

short_description.id: Kresna, juga disebut Govinda, Madhava, dan Gopala, adalah dewa utama agama Hindu yang dipuja sebagai awatara kedelapan Wisnu sekaligus Tuhan Yang Mahatinggi, tokoh sentral Mahabharata dan penyampai Bhagavad Gita.
short_description.en: Krishna, known too as Govinda, Madhava and Gopala, is a leading Hindu god honoured both as Vishnu's eighth avatar and as the supreme deity, a central figure of the Mahabharata and teacher of the Bhagavad Gita.

long_description.id: Kresna, juga dikenal sebagai Govinda, Madhava, Gopala, dan banyak nama lain, adalah dewa utama agama Hindu. Ia dipuja sebagai awatara kedelapan Wisnu dan sebagai Tuhan Yang Mahatinggi, dan dihormati karena kasih, welas asih, perlindungan, dan kelembutannya. Hari kelahirannya dirayakan setiap tahun pada Krishna Janmashtami, yang jatuh pada akhir Agustus atau awal September.
long_description.en: Krishna, called also Govinda, Madhava, Gopala and by many other names, is one of the great gods of Hinduism. Devotees honour him both as Vishnu's eighth avatar and as the highest god in his own right, cherishing him for his love, mercy, protection and gentleness. His birth is celebrated each year at Krishna Janmashtami, in late August or early September.

long_description.id: Kresna sering digambarkan berkulit gelap sesuai arti namanya, hitam atau gelap. Menurut Wikipedia, ia tokoh sentral dalam Mahabharata, Bhagavata Purana, Brahma Vaivarta Purana, dan Bhagavad Gita, yang menggambarkannya sebagai negarawan ilahi, guru, penyelamat dharma, kusir kereta, dan kadang penggembala sapi. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, perannya ganda: ia penghukum perbuatan manusia sekaligus pembawa pencerahan.
long_description.en: Artists often give Krishna dark skin, matching his name, which means black or dark. According to Wikipedia he figures centrally in texts including Mahabharata, Bhagavata Purana, Brahma Vaivarta Purana and Bhagavad Gita, which present him as divine statesman, teacher, savior of dharma, charioteer and at times a cowherd. According to the World History Encyclopedia his role is twofold: he punishes human deeds yet also brings enlightenment.

long_description.id: Ia lahir di Mathura dari Dewaki dan Wasudewa, tetapi dibesarkan Nanda dan Yashoda di Gokul untuk menghindari pamannya, Raja Kamsa yang zalim. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu mencabut dua helai rambut dan rambut hitam ditanamkan ke rahim Devaki; Kamsa, yang telah diperingatkan tentang anak kedelapan, membunuh tujuh anak lebih dahulu, dan Wasudewa menyembunyikan Krishna di Vrindavana tempat ia tumbuh sebagai penggembala yang memikat para gopi.
long_description.en: He was born in Mathura to Devaki and Vasudeva, but raised by Nanda and Yashoda in Gokul to escape his uncle, the tyrant king Kamsa. According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu pulled two hairs and the black one was planted in Devaki's womb; Kamsa, warned about the eighth child, killed seven children first, and Vasudeva hid Krishna in Vrindavana, where he grew up as a cowherd who stirred the hearts of the gopis.

long_description.id: Kisah hidupnya memuat banyak keajaiban: ia memikat para gopi dengan seruling ilahinya dan mengangkat Bukit Govardhan untuk melindungi kaumnya dari hujan dahsyat. Wisnu Purana menyebut ia menahan gunung itu dengan satu tangan, bertekad membunuh ular Kāliya, dan menindih Kansa hingga tewas. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia juga mengalahkan Putana, Kaliya, dan Pancajana, dan mencuri pohon Parijata dari Indra.
long_description.en: Wonders run through his story: his flute charmed the gopis, and he raised Govardhan Hill as a shelter for his people against torrential rain. The Vishnu Purana says he held the mountain with one hand, resolved to slay the serpent Kāliya and crushed Kansa to death. According to the World History Encyclopedia he also overcame Putana, Kaliya and Pancajana and stole the Parijata tree from Indra.

long_description.id: Kemudian ia mendirikan kota Dvaraka dan menjadi kusir kereta Arjuna dalam perang Kurukshetra. Menurut World History Encyclopedia ia melantunkan Bhagavad Gita pada malam sebelum perang; dalam Gita ia menyatakan seluruh alam semesta diciptakan olehnya, dan dalam terjemahan Arnold Krishna berkata ia adalah Roh dalam hati setiap makhluk, memperlihatkan semua rupa-Nya kepada Arjuna, lalu kembali ke rupa Krishna yang dikenalnya. Ia tewas oleh panah pemburu yang mengenai tumitnya, dan tujuh hari kemudian Dvaraka tenggelam.
long_description.en: He went on to found the city of Dvaraka and drive Arjuna's chariot in the Kurukshetra War. According to the World History Encyclopedia he recounted the Bhagavad Gita on the eve of the battle; in the Gita he states that the whole universe was created by him, and in Arnold's translation Krishna says he is the Spirit in every creature's heart, shows Arjuna all his semblances and then returns to the Krishna form Arjuna knew. He was killed by a hunter's arrow striking his heel, and seven days later Dvaraka was submerged.

long_description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, kini banyak penganut memuja Krishna sebagai dewa Hindu tertinggi dan ia terutama dihormati di Bengal dan Udupi, dengan hari kelahirannya dirayakan pada Krishna Janmashtami. Dalam seni Hindu ia biasanya berkulit gelap, berjubah kuning, berbulu merak di rambut, dan memainkan seruling; dalam seni Khmer pengangkatan Gunung Govardhana menjadi adegan yang paling populer, antara lain di Angkor Wat. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia mungkin pahlawan paling populer dalam mitologi Hindu.
long_description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, many believers today worship Krishna as the supreme Hindu god and he is especially revered in Bengal and Udupi, with his birthday celebrated at Krishna Janmashtami. In Hindu art he typically has dark skin, a yellow robe, a peacock feather in his hair and a flute; in Khmer art the lifting of Mount Govardhana is the most popular scene, at sites such as Angkor Wat. The World History Encyclopedia calls him perhaps the most popular of all the heroes of Hindu mythology.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Krishna adalah tokoh sentral dalam Mahabharata, Bhagavata Purana, Brahma Vaivarta Purana, dan Bhagavad Gita, dan teks-teks itu menggambarkannya sebagai negarawan ilahi, guru, penyelamat dharma, kusir kereta, dan kadang penggembala sapi.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, Krishna is a central figure in the Mahabharata, the Bhagavata Purana, the Brahma Vaivarta Purana and the Bhagavad Gita, and these texts describe him as a divine statesman, teacher, savior of dharma, charioteer and sometimes a cowherd.

claims.quote: Krishna's adventures appear in the Mahabharata, Bhagavad Gita, Harivamsa, and the sacred texts known as the Puranas where he is described as the Supreme Being and creator of the universe.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, petualangan Krishna muncul dalam Mahabharata, Bhagavad Gita, Harivamsa, dan Purana, yang menyebutnya Yang Mahatinggi dan pencipta alam semesta.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna's adventures appear in the Mahabharata, Bhagavad Gita, Harivamsa and the Puranas, where he is described as the Supreme Being and creator of the universe.

claims.quote: One day Vishnu, the great Hindu god pulled two hairs from his own head, one white and one black. The black hair was planted into the womb of Devaki, a princess of the city of Mathura

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu mencabut dua helai rambut, putih dan hitam; rambut hitam ditanamkan ke rahim Devaki, putri kota Mathura, dan lahirlah Krishna.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu pulled two hairs from his head, one white and one black; the black hair was planted into the womb of Devaki, a princess of the city of Mathura, and Krishna was born.

claims.quote: Unfortunately for Krishna his mother's brother, Kamsa, had been warned that Devaki's eighth child would kill him, and so Kamsa determined to murder the eighth child, a crime he had already carried out seven times before Krishna was born.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Kamsa, saudara laki-laki ibu Krishna, diperingatkan bahwa anak kedelapan Devaki akan membunuhnya, sehingga ia membunuh tujuh anak sebelum Krishna lahir.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Kamsa, his mother's brother, had been warned that Devaki's eighth child would kill him and had killed seven children before Krishna was born.

claims.quote: Fortunately, Vasudeva took the precaution of hiding Krishna in the remote village of Vrindavana where the boy was brought up as a simple cowherd (in this guise he can be referred to as Govinda).

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wasudewa menyembunyikan Krishna di desa terpencil Vrindavana, tempat ia dibesarkan sebagai penggembala sederhana yang dapat disebut Govinda.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vasudeva hid Krishna in the remote village of Vrindavana, where he was brought up as a simple cowherd who can be called Govinda.

claims.quote: There he spent an idyllic childhood and stirred the hearts of many gopis or herd-women with his dark good looks, playful charm, and mastery of music and dance.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Krishna menghabiskan masa kecil yang indah dan memikat banyak gopi dengan ketampanannya yang gelap, pesonanya yang jenaka, serta keahliannya bermusik dan menari.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna spent an idyllic childhood and stirred the hearts of many gopis with his dark good looks, playful charm and mastery of music and dance.

claims.quote: Krishna's dual role is as the punisher of human deeds but also as a bringer of enlightenment.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, peran ganda Krishna adalah sebagai penghukum perbuatan manusia sekaligus pembawa pencerahan.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna's dual role is as the punisher of human deeds but also as a bringer of enlightenment.

claims.quote: Krishna's foster parents at Vrindavana were Nanda and Yashoda, his sister is Subhadra, and his brother Balarama. Krishna's favourite consort was the cowherd woman Radha

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, orang tua asuh Krishna di Vrindavana adalah Nanda dan Yashoda, saudarinya Subhadra, saudaranya Balarama, dan selir kesayangannya Radha, perempuan penggembala.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna's foster parents at Vrindavana were Nanda and Yashoda, his sister is Subhadra, his brother Balarama, and his favourite consort the cowherd woman Radha.

claims.quote: Queen Rukmini, an earthly form of the goddess Lakshmi, is considered Krishna's second most favoured wife after Radha. With Rukmini, Krishna had a son, Pradyumna, and a daughter, Carumati.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Ratu Rukmini, wujud duniawi dewi Lakshmi, dianggap istri kesayangan kedua Krishna setelah Radha, dan dari Rukmini Krishna memiliki putra Pradyumna serta putri Carumati.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Queen Rukmini, an earthly form of the goddess Lakshmi, is considered Krishna's second most favoured wife after Radha, and with Rukmini Krishna had a son, Pradyumna, and a daughter, Carumati.

claims.quote: Notable amongst these are his various killings and thrashings of prominent enemies such as the ogress Putana, the giant bull danava, the giant snake Kaliya, and the king of the Hayas (horses). Also swiftly dealt with was the scheming tyrant Kamsa – after whose beheading Krishna established himself as king of Mathura.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Krishna membunuh dan menghajar musuh-musuh terkemuka seperti raksasi Putana, banteng danava raksasa, ular raksasa Kaliya, dan raja Haya (kuda), serta mengalahkan tiran Kamsa, setelah itu ia menjadi raja Mathura.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna killed and thrashed prominent enemies such as the ogress Putana, the giant bull danava, the giant snake Kaliya and the king of the Hayas (horses), and dealt with the tyrant Kamsa, after whose beheading he became king of Mathura.

claims.quote: the sea-demon Pancajana who looked like a conch shell and who lost his magic shell to Krishna which the hero carried thereafter and used as a trumpet.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, iblis laut Pancajana yang menyerupai kerang kehilangan kerang saktinya kepada Krishna, yang sejak itu membawanya dan memakainya sebagai trompet.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, the sea-demon Pancajana, who looked like a conch shell, lost his magic shell to Krishna, who carried it thereafter and used it as a trumpet.

claims.quote: Krishna also found time to lift the mountain Govardhana to foil a terrible deluge sent by Indra, to conquer Saubha, the floating city of the Titans (daityas), got the better of the sea-god Varuna, and even managed to steal the divine discus possessed by the fire-god Agni.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Krishna mengangkat Gunung Govardhana untuk menggagalkan banjir dahsyat kiriman Indra, menaklukkan Saubha kota terapung para Titan, mengungguli dewa laut Varuna, dan mencuri cakram ilahi milik dewa api Agni.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna lifted Mount Govardhana to foil a terrible deluge sent by Indra, conquered Saubha, the floating city of the Titans, got the better of the sea-god Varuna and stole the divine discus of the fire-god Agni.

claims.quote: Krishna acted as the warrior-prince Arjuna's charioteer in the Great War, the Battle of Kurukshetra, between the Pandavas (whom Krishna supported) and the Kauravas. It was on the eve of this battle that Krishna recounted the sacred song of the Bhagavad Gita to Arjuna.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Krishna menjadi kusir kereta pangeran-pejuang Arjuna dalam Perang Besar di Kurukshetra antara Pandawa (yang ia dukung) dan Kaurawa, dan pada malam sebelum perang itu ia melantunkan Bhagavad Gita kepada Arjuna.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna acted as the warrior-prince Arjuna's charioteer in the Great War at Kurukshetra between the Pandavas (whom he supported) and the Kauravas, and on the eve of the battle he recounted the Bhagavad Gita to Arjuna.

claims.quote: It is in the Bhagavad Gita that Krishna also states that 'All this universe has been created by me; all things exist in me'. Arjuna, in the same work, tells us that Krishna is 'divine, prior to the gods, unborn, omnipresent'.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam Bhagavad Gita Krishna menyatakan bahwa seluruh alam semesta diciptakan olehnya dan segala sesuatu ada di dalam dirinya, dan Arjuna menyebutnya ilahi, mendahului para dewa, tak dilahirkan, dan mahahadir.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in the Bhagavad Gita Krishna states that the whole universe was created by him and all things exist in him, and Arjuna calls him divine, prior to the gods, unborn and omnipresent.

claims.quote: In other adventures Krishna built the great fortress city of Dvaraka in Gujarat, known as the 'City of Gates'. Seven days after Krishna was accidentally killed by a hunter's arrow striking his heel, Dvaraka was submerged beneath the ocean.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Krishna membangun kota benteng Dvaraka di Gujarat, dijuluki Kota Gerbang; tujuh hari setelah ia tewas secara tak sengaja oleh panah pemburu yang mengenai tumitnya, Dvaraka tenggelam di bawah laut.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna built the fortress city of Dvaraka in Gujarat, known as the 'City of Gates'; seven days after he was accidentally killed by a hunter's arrow striking his heel, Dvaraka was submerged beneath the ocean.

claims.quote: Krishna had also stolen the sacred Parijata tree from Indra, defeating the god in the process. Krishna planted the tree at Dvaraka, but upon his death it was returned to Indra.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Krishna mencuri pohon suci Parijata dari Indra dan mengalahkannya, menanamnya di Dvaraka, tetapi setelah ia wafat pohon itu dikembalikan kepada Indra.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna stole the sacred Parijata tree from Indra, defeating the god, and planted it at Dvaraka, but on his death it was returned to Indra.

claims.quote: The worship of Krishna may have started as early as the 5th century BCE. Today he is worshipped as the supreme Hindu god by many believers, and he is especially revered in Bengal and Udupi in southern India.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, pemujaan Krishna mungkin bermula sedini abad ke-5 SM; kini ia dipuja banyak orang sebagai dewa Hindu tertinggi dan terutama dihormati di Bengal dan Udupi di India selatan.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, the worship of Krishna may have started as early as the 5th century BCE; today many believers worship him as the supreme Hindu god and he is especially revered in Bengal and Udupi in southern India.

claims.quote: Krishna is typically portrayed in Hindu art with a dark skin (usually blue-black), and he may carry the cakra discus Vajranabha and the club Kaumodaki – both given to him by Agni. He typically wears a yellow robe, has a peacock feather in his long black hair, and commonly plays a flute.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Hindu Krishna biasanya digambarkan berkulit gelap (biasanya biru-hitam), dapat membawa cakram Vajranabha dan gada Kaumodaki pemberian Agni, berjubah kuning, berbulu merak di rambutnya, dan umumnya memainkan seruling.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna is typically portrayed in Hindu art with dark skin (usually blue-black), may carry the discus Vajranabha and the club Kaumodaki given by Agni, wears a yellow robe, has a peacock feather in his hair and commonly plays a flute.

claims.quote: In Khmer art the most popular scene of Krishna's adventures is the lifting of Mt. Govardhana, and the god is frequently represented in the architectural sculpture at such famous sites as Angkor Wat.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Khmer adegan petualangan Krishna yang paling populer adalah pengangkatan Gunung Govardhana, yang sering terpahat pada arsitektur di situs terkenal seperti Angkor Wat.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in Khmer art the most popular scene of Krishna's adventures is the lifting of Mt. Govardhana, frequently represented in architectural sculpture at famous sites such as Angkor Wat.

claims.quote: Its simple plot consists of a dialogue held by Prince Arjuna, the brother of King Yudhisthira, with Krishna, the Supreme Deity, wearing the disguise of a charioteer.

statement.id: Dalam pengantar terjemahan Edwin Arnold, alur Bhagavad Gita berupa dialog Pangeran Arjuna dengan Krishna, Dewa Tertinggi yang menyamar sebagai kusir kereta.
statement.en: In the preface to Edwin Arnold's translation, the plot of the Bhagavad Gita is a dialogue between Prince Arjuna and Krishna, the Supreme Deity, wearing the disguise of a charioteer.

claims.quote: I am the Spirit seated deep in every creature's heart; From Me they come; by Me they live; at My word they depart!

statement.id: Dalam Bhagavad Gita (terjemahan Arnold), Krishna berkata bahwa ia adalah Roh yang bersemayam dalam hati setiap makhluk; dari-Nya mereka datang, oleh-Nya mereka hidup, dan atas titah-Nya mereka pergi.
statement.en: In the Bhagavad Gita (Arnold translation), Krishna says he is the Spirit seated deep in every creature's heart; from him they come, by him they live, and at his word they depart.

claims.quote: Vishnu of the Adityas I am, those Lords of Light ... of Rudras Sankara

statement.id: Dalam Bhagavad Gita (terjemahan Arnold), Krishna berkata bahwa di antara para Aditya ia adalah Wisnu dan di antara para Rudra ia adalah Sankara.
statement.en: In the Bhagavad Gita (Arnold translation), Krishna says that among the Adityas he is Vishnu and among the Rudras he is Sankara.

claims.quote: I show thee all my semblances, infinite, rich, divine, My changeful hues, my countless forms.

statement.id: Dalam Bhagavad Gita (terjemahan Arnold), Krishna memperlihatkan kepada Arjuna semua rupa-Nya yang tak terhingga, kaya, dan ilahi, dengan warna-warna yang berubah dan wujud yang tak terhitung.
statement.en: In the Bhagavad Gita (Arnold translation), Krishna shows Arjuna all his semblances, infinite, rich and divine, with changeful hues and countless forms.

claims.quote: Once more I am thy Krishna, the form thou knew'st of old!

statement.id: Dalam Bhagavad Gita (terjemahan Arnold), setelah menampakkan wujud-Nya yang menakjubkan, Krishna berkata kepada Arjuna bahwa ia kembali menjadi Krishna dengan rupa yang dikenalnya dahulu.
statement.en: In the Bhagavad Gita (Arnold translation), after showing his awesome form, Krishna tells Arjuna that he is once more the Krishna of the form he knew of old.

claims.quote: Having thus made up his mind, Krishna immediately upheld the mountain Govardhana with one hand as if in sport ... For seven days and nights did the vast clouds, despatched by Indra, pour down showers upon the Gokula of Nanda, to destroy the dwellers, but they were protected by the height of the mountain.

statement.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, Krishna mengangkat Gunung Govardhana dengan satu tangan seolah bermain, dan selama tujuh hari tujuh malam awan kiriman Indra menurunkan hujan atas Gokula milik Nanda tetapi para penghuninya terlindung oleh ketinggian gunung itu.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, Krishna upheld Mount Govardhana with one hand as if in sport, and for seven days and nights the clouds sent by Indra poured showers on the Gokula of Nanda, but its dwellers were protected by the height of the mountain.

claims.quote: There he saw the pool with the dreadful serpent Kāliya, boiling with the fires of poison ... I must slay this serpent, so that the inhabitants of Vraja may live here happily freed from fear.

statement.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, Krishna melihat kolam berisi ular dahsyat Kāliya yang mendidih oleh api bisa, dan berniat membunuhnya agar penduduk Vraja hidup bahagia tanpa rasa takut.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, Krishna sees the pool with the dreadful serpent Kāliya boiling with the fires of poison and resolves to slay it so that the inhabitants of Vraja may live happily freed from fear.

claims.quote: laid hold of him by the hair of his head, and struck his tiara to the ground: then casting him down upon the earth, Govinda threw himself upon him. Crushed by the weight of the upholder of the universe, the son of Ugrasena, Kansa the king, gave up the ghost.

statement.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, Krishna menarik rambut Kansa, menjatuhkan mahkotanya, lalu menjatuhkan Kansa ke tanah dan menimpanya, sehingga Kansa, putra Ugrasena, tewas tertindih beban sang penopang alam semesta.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, Krishna seizes Kansa by the hair, strikes his tiara to the ground and throws him down and falls upon him, so that Kansa, the son of Ugrasena, gives up the ghost, crushed by the weight of the upholder of the universe.

claims.quote: A voice was heard in the sky, loud and deep as thunder, which addressing Kansa, said—"O foolish, the eighth child of this damsel, whom thou art carrying in the car, along with her husband, shall destroy thy life".

statement.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, sebuah suara dari langit berkata kepada Kansa bahwa anak kedelapan Devaki akan mengakhiri hidupnya.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, a voice from the sky tells Kansa that the eighth child of Devaki shall destroy his life.

claims.quote: the supreme deity plucked off two hairs, one white and one black and said to the celestials ... This, my black hair, shall be impersonated in the eighth conception of the goddess-like Devaki, the wife of Vasudeva and shall destroy Kansa

statement.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, Sang Dewa Tertinggi mencabut dua helai rambut, putih dan hitam, dan menyatakan bahwa rambut hitamnya akan menjelma dalam kandungan kedelapan Devaki, istri Wasudewa, dan akan membinasakan Kansa.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, the supreme deity plucks off two hairs, one white and one black, and declares that his black hair shall be impersonated in the eighth conception of Devaki, the wife of Vasudeva, and shall destroy Kansa.

cultural_context.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, kini banyak penganut memuja Krishna sebagai dewa Hindu tertinggi, terutama di Bengal dan Udupi; Wikipedia mencatat kelahirannya dirayakan umat Hindu setiap tahun pada Krishna Janmashtami, dan dalam seni Khmer pengangkatan Gunung Govardhana menjadi adegan petualangannya yang paling populer.
cultural_context.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, many believers today worship Krishna as the supreme Hindu god, especially in Bengal and Udupi; Wikipedia records that Hindus celebrate his birthday each year at Krishna Janmashtami, and in Khmer art the lifting of Mount Govardhana is the most popular scene of his adventures.

literal_meaning.id: hitam, gelap
literal_meaning.en: black, dark

who.id: Dewa Hindu, awatara kedelapan Wisnu.
who.en: A Hindu god, the eighth avatar of Vishnu.

origin.id: Agama Hindu; lahir di Mathura menurut kisahnya.
origin.en: Hinduism; born in Mathura in the stories.

role.id: Awatara Wisnu dan Dewa Tertinggi yang menjadi kusir kereta Arjuna serta penyampai Bhagavad Gita.
role.en: Avatar of Vishnu and Supreme Deity who served as Arjuna's charioteer and teacher of the Bhagavad Gita.

famous_for.id: Serulingnya, mengangkat Bukit Govardhan, mengalahkan Kamsa, dan menyampaikan Bhagavad Gita.
famous_for.en: His flute, lifting Govardhan Hill, defeating Kamsa and delivering the Bhagavad Gita.

did_you_know.id: Menurut kisahnya, Wisnu mencabut dua helai rambut, putih dan hitam, dan rambut hitam itulah yang menjelma sebagai Krishna dalam kandungan kedelapan Devaki.
did_you_know.en: In the stories, Vishnu pulled out two hairs, one white and one black, and the black hair became Krishna in Devaki's eighth conception.

description.id: Krishna mengangkat Bukit Govardhan untuk melindungi kaumnya dari hujan dahsyat; Wisnu Purana menyebut ia menahannya dengan satu tangan seolah bermain.
description.en: Krishna lifted Govardhan Hill to protect his community from devastating rains; the Vishnu Purana says he held it with one hand as if in sport.

description.id: Ia memikat para gopi dengan permainan serulingnya yang ilahi.
description.en: He enchanted the gopis with his divine flute playing.

description.id: Ia membunuh atau menghajar musuh seperti Putana, Kaliya, dan Kamsa; Wisnu Purana menyebut ia menindih Kansa hingga tewas dan bertekad membunuh Kāliya.
description.en: He killed or thrashed enemies such as Putana, Kaliya and Kamsa; the Vishnu Purana says he crushed Kansa to death and resolved to slay Kāliya.

description.id: Dalam Bhagavad Gita ia memperlihatkan kepada Arjuna semua rupa-Nya yang tak terhingga lalu kembali ke wujud Krishna yang dikenal Arjuna.
description.en: In the Bhagavad Gita he shows Arjuna all his infinite semblances and then returns to the form of Krishna that Arjuna knew.

description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Krishna tewas secara tak sengaja oleh panah pemburu yang mengenai tumitnya.
description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna was accidentally killed by a hunter's arrow striking his heel.

role.id: Anak kedelapan yang disembunyikan dari Kamsa
role.en: The eighth child hidden from Kamsa

summary.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Krishna lahir di Mathura dari Devaki dan Wasudewa tetapi dibesarkan Nanda dan Yashoda di Gokul untuk menghindari pamannya, Raja Kamsa yang zalim. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu mencabut dua helai rambut dan rambut hitam ditanamkan ke rahim Devaki; Kamsa yang diperingatkan tentang anak kedelapan telah membunuh tujuh anak sebelumnya, dan Wasudewa menyembunyikan Krishna di Vrindavana. Wisnu Purana menyebut suara dari langit yang memperingatkan Kansa.
summary.en: According to Wikipedia, Krishna was born in Mathura to Devaki and Vasudeva but raised by Nanda and Yashoda in Gokul to escape his uncle, the tyrant king Kamsa. According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu pulled two hairs and the black one was planted in Devaki's womb; Kamsa, warned about the eighth child, had killed seven children before, and Vasudeva hid Krishna in Vrindavana. The Vishnu Purana tells of the voice from the sky that warned Kansa.

summary.id: Krishna mengangkat Bukit Govardhan untuk melindungi kaumnya dari hujan dahsyat. Menurut World History Encyclopedia banjir itu dikirim Indra, dan menurut Wisnu Purana ia menahan gunung dengan satu tangan selama tujuh hari tujuh malam sementara awan Indra menurunkan hujan.
summary.en: Krishna lifted Govardhan Hill to shelter his community from devastating rains. According to the World History Encyclopedia the deluge was sent by Indra, and according to the Vishnu Purana he held the mountain with one hand for seven days and nights while Indra's clouds poured rain.

role.en: Rescuer of Vraja from the poisonous serpent

summary.id: Wisnu Purana menceritakan Krishna melihat kolam berisi ular Kāliya yang mendidih oleh api bisa, lalu bertekad membunuhnya agar penduduk Vraja bebas dari rasa takut; World History Encyclopedia menyebut Kaliya di antara musuh yang ia kalahkan.
summary.en: The Vishnu Purana tells how Krishna saw the pool of the serpent Kāliya boiling with the fires of poison and resolved to slay it so that Vraja's people would be free of fear; the World History Encyclopedia lists Kaliya among the enemies he defeated.

summary.id: Krishna mengalahkan tiran Kamsa dan kemudian menjadi raja Mathura; dalam Wisnu Purana ia menarik rambut Kansa, menjatuhkannya ke tanah, dan menimpanya hingga Kansa tewas.
summary.en: Krishna dealt with the tyrant Kamsa and afterwards became king of Mathura; in the Vishnu Purana he seizes Kansa by the hair, throws him to the ground and falls upon him until Kansa dies.

summary.id: Krishna menjadi kusir kereta Arjuna dalam perang di Kurukshetra antara Pandawa dan Kaurawa, dan pada malam sebelum perang itu ia melantunkan Bhagavad Gita. Dalam Gita ia menyatakan dirinya Roh dalam hati setiap makhluk dan, menurut World History Encyclopedia, bahwa seluruh alam semesta diciptakan olehnya; ia memperlihatkan kepada Arjuna semua rupa-Nya.
summary.en: Krishna was Arjuna's charioteer in the war at Kurukshetra between the Pandavas and the Kauravas, and on the eve of the battle he recounted the Bhagavad Gita. In the Gita he declares himself the Spirit in every creature's heart, and, according to the World History Encyclopedia, that the whole universe was created by him; he shows Arjuna all his semblances.

summary.id: Krishna mencuri pohon suci Parijata dari Indra dan mengalahkannya, menanamnya di Dvaraka, tetapi setelah ia wafat pohon itu dikembalikan kepada Indra.
summary.en: Krishna stole the sacred Parijata tree from Indra, defeating him, and planted it at Dvaraka, but on his death it was returned to Indra.

summary.en: Krishna built the fortress city of Dvaraka in Gujarat; a hunter's arrow struck his heel and killed him, and seven days later Dvaraka sank beneath the sea.

short_description.id: Kresna, juga disebut Govinda, Madhava, dan Gopala, adalah dewa utama agama Hindu yang dipuja sebagai awatara kedelapan Wisnu sekaligus Tuhan Yang Mahatinggi, tokoh sentral Mahabharata dan penyampai Bhagavad Gita.
short_description.en: Krishna, known too as Govinda, Madhava and Gopala, is a leading Hindu god honoured both as Vishnu's eighth avatar and as the supreme deity, a central figure of the Mahabharata and teacher of the Bhagavad Gita.

long_description.id: Kresna, juga dikenal sebagai Govinda, Madhava, Gopala, dan banyak nama lain, adalah dewa utama agama Hindu. Ia dipuja sebagai awatara kedelapan Wisnu dan sebagai Tuhan Yang Mahatinggi, dan dihormati karena kasih, welas asih, perlindungan, dan kelembutannya. Hari kelahirannya dirayakan setiap tahun pada Krishna Janmashtami, yang jatuh pada akhir Agustus atau awal September.
long_description.en: Krishna, called also Govinda, Madhava, Gopala and by many other names, is one of the great gods of Hinduism. Devotees honour him both as Vishnu's eighth avatar and as the highest god in his own right, cherishing him for his love, mercy, protection and gentleness. His birth is celebrated each year at Krishna Janmashtami, in late August or early September.

long_description.id: Kresna sering digambarkan berkulit gelap sesuai arti namanya, hitam atau gelap. Menurut Wikipedia, ia tokoh sentral dalam Mahabharata, Bhagavata Purana, Brahma Vaivarta Purana, dan Bhagavad Gita, yang menggambarkannya sebagai negarawan ilahi, guru, penyelamat dharma, kusir kereta, dan kadang penggembala sapi. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, perannya ganda: ia penghukum perbuatan manusia sekaligus pembawa pencerahan.
long_description.en: Artists often give Krishna dark skin, matching his name, which means black or dark. According to Wikipedia he figures centrally in texts including Mahabharata, Bhagavata Purana, Brahma Vaivarta Purana and Bhagavad Gita, which present him as divine statesman, teacher, savior of dharma, charioteer and at times a cowherd. According to the World History Encyclopedia his role is twofold: he punishes human deeds yet also brings enlightenment.

long_description.id: Ia lahir di Mathura dari Dewaki dan Wasudewa, tetapi dibesarkan Nanda dan Yashoda di Gokul untuk menghindari pamannya, Raja Kamsa yang zalim. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu mencabut dua helai rambut dan rambut hitam ditanamkan ke rahim Devaki; Kamsa, yang telah diperingatkan tentang anak kedelapan, membunuh tujuh anak lebih dahulu, dan Wasudewa menyembunyikan Krishna di Vrindavana tempat ia tumbuh sebagai penggembala yang memikat para gopi.
long_description.en: He was born in Mathura to Devaki and Vasudeva, but raised by Nanda and Yashoda in Gokul to escape his uncle, the tyrant king Kamsa. According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu pulled two hairs and the black one was planted in Devaki's womb; Kamsa, warned about the eighth child, killed seven children first, and Vasudeva hid Krishna in Vrindavana, where he grew up as a cowherd who stirred the hearts of the gopis.

long_description.id: Kisah hidupnya memuat banyak keajaiban: ia memikat para gopi dengan seruling ilahinya dan mengangkat Bukit Govardhan untuk melindungi kaumnya dari hujan dahsyat. Wisnu Purana menyebut ia menahan gunung itu dengan satu tangan, bertekad membunuh ular Kāliya, dan menindih Kansa hingga tewas. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia juga mengalahkan Putana, Kaliya, dan Pancajana, dan mencuri pohon Parijata dari Indra.
long_description.en: Wonders run through his story: his flute charmed the gopis, and he raised Govardhan Hill as a shelter for his people against torrential rain. The Vishnu Purana says he held the mountain with one hand, resolved to slay the serpent Kāliya and crushed Kansa to death. According to the World History Encyclopedia he also overcame Putana, Kaliya and Pancajana and stole the Parijata tree from Indra.

long_description.id: Kemudian ia mendirikan kota Dvaraka dan menjadi kusir kereta Arjuna dalam perang Kurukshetra. Menurut World History Encyclopedia ia melantunkan Bhagavad Gita pada malam sebelum perang; dalam Gita ia menyatakan seluruh alam semesta diciptakan olehnya, dan dalam terjemahan Arnold Krishna berkata ia adalah Roh dalam hati setiap makhluk, memperlihatkan semua rupa-Nya kepada Arjuna, lalu kembali ke rupa Krishna yang dikenalnya. Ia tewas oleh panah pemburu yang mengenai tumitnya, dan tujuh hari kemudian Dvaraka tenggelam.
long_description.en: He went on to found the city of Dvaraka and drive Arjuna's chariot in the Kurukshetra War. According to the World History Encyclopedia he recounted the Bhagavad Gita on the eve of the battle; in the Gita he states that the whole universe was created by him, and in Arnold's translation Krishna says he is the Spirit in every creature's heart, shows Arjuna all his semblances and then returns to the Krishna form Arjuna knew. He was killed by a hunter's arrow striking his heel, and seven days later Dvaraka was submerged.

long_description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, kini banyak penganut memuja Krishna sebagai dewa Hindu tertinggi dan ia terutama dihormati di Bengal dan Udupi, dengan hari kelahirannya dirayakan pada Krishna Janmashtami. Dalam seni Hindu ia biasanya berkulit gelap, berjubah kuning, berbulu merak di rambut, dan memainkan seruling; dalam seni Khmer pengangkatan Gunung Govardhana menjadi adegan yang paling populer, antara lain di Angkor Wat. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia mungkin pahlawan paling populer dalam mitologi Hindu.
long_description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, many believers today worship Krishna as the supreme Hindu god and he is especially revered in Bengal and Udupi, with his birthday celebrated at Krishna Janmashtami. In Hindu art he typically has dark skin, a yellow robe, a peacock feather in his hair and a flute; in Khmer art the lifting of Mount Govardhana is the most popular scene, at sites such as Angkor Wat. The World History Encyclopedia calls him perhaps the most popular of all the heroes of Hindu mythology.

claims.quote: also known as Govinda, Madhava, Gopala, and other names and titles is a major deity in Hinduism. He is worshipped as the eighth avatar of Vishnu and as the Supreme God in his own right. He is widely revered for his divine qualities of love, compassion, protection, and tenderness.

statement.id: Kresna (कृष्ण), juga Govinda, Madhava, Gopala, dan nama lain, adalah dewa utama agama Hindu yang dipuja sebagai awatara kedelapan Wisnu dan sebagai Tuhan Yang Mahatinggi, dihormati karena kasih, welas asih, perlindungan, dan kelembutannya.
statement.en: Krishna (कृष्ण), also Govinda, Madhava, Gopala and other names, is a major Hindu deity worshipped as the eighth avatar of Vishnu and as Supreme God in his own right, revered for love, compassion, protection and tenderness.

claims.quote: Krishna's birthday is celebrated every year by Hindus on Krishna Janmashtami, according to the lunisolar Hindu calendar, which falls in late August or early September of the Gregorian calendar.

statement.id: Hari kelahiran Kresna dirayakan umat Hindu setiap tahun pada Krishna Janmashtami, akhir Agustus atau awal September.
statement.en: Krishna's birthday is celebrated by Hindus every year on Krishna Janmashtami, in late August or early September.
