claims.quote: is a Chinese novel published in the 16th century during the Ming dynasty and attributed to Wu Cheng'en.

statement.id: Journey to the West (Xiyouji) adalah novel Tiongkok yang terbit pada abad ke-16 pada masa dinasti Ming dan dikaitkan dengan Wu Cheng'en.
statement.en: Journey to the West (Xiyouji) is a Chinese novel published in the 16th century during the Ming dynasty and attributed to Wu Cheng'en.

claims.quote: The beginning part of the story deals with the earlier exploits of Sun Wukong, a monkey born on Flower Fruit Mountain from a stone egg that forms from an ancient rock created by the coupling of Heaven and Earth, who learns the art of the Tao, 72 polymorphic transformations, combat, and secrets of immortality

statement.id: Bagian awal novel menceritakan petualangan awal Sun Wukong, seekor kera yang lahir di Gunung Bunga dan Buah (Flower Fruit Mountain) dari telur batu, yang mempelajari Tao, 72 transformasi, ilmu tempur, dan rahasia keabadian.
statement.en: The opening part of the novel deals with the early exploits of Sun Wukong, a monkey born on Flower Fruit Mountain from a stone egg, who learns the Tao, 72 transformations, combat, and the secrets of immortality.

claims.quote: also known as the Monkey King, is a literary and religious figure best known as one of the main characters in the 16th-century Chinese novel Journey to the West.

statement.id: Sun Wukong, juga dikenal sebagai Raja Kera (Monkey King), adalah tokoh sastra dan keagamaan yang paling dikenal sebagai salah satu tokoh utama novel Tiongkok abad ke-16 Journey to the West.
statement.en: Sun Wukong, also known as the Monkey King, is a literary and religious figure best known as one of the main characters of the 16th-century Chinese novel Journey to the West.

claims.quote: In the novel, Sun Wukong is an intelligent monkey (likely a rhesus macaque or a golden snub-nosed monkey) born from a stone who acquires supernatural powers through Taoist practices and consuming heavenly victuals.

statement.id: Dalam novel, Sun Wukong adalah kera cerdas (kemungkinan rhesus makaka atau monyet hidung pesek emas) yang lahir dari batu dan memperoleh kekuatan gaib lewat latihan Tao serta makanan surgawi.
statement.en: In the novel Sun Wukong is an intelligent monkey (likely a rhesus macaque or a golden snub-nosed monkey) born from a stone who gains supernatural powers through Taoist practice and heavenly food.

claims.quote: After rebelling against heaven, he is imprisoned under a mountain by the Buddha. Five hundred years later, he accompanies the monk Tang Sanzang riding on the White Dragon Horse and two other disciples, Zhu Bajie and Sha Heshang, on a journey to obtain Buddhist sutras in the West or Western Paradise, where Buddha and his followers dwell.

statement.id: Setelah memberontak melawan surga, ia dipenjara di bawah gunung oleh Buddha. Lima ratus tahun kemudian ia menemani biksu Tang Sanzang, yang menunggang White Dragon Horse, bersama dua murid lain, Zhu Bajie dan Sha Heshang, mengambil sutra Buddha di Barat.
statement.en: After rebelling against heaven he is imprisoned under a mountain by the Buddha. Five hundred years later he accompanies the monk Tang Sanzang, who rides the White Dragon Horse, with two other disciples, Zhu Bajie and Sha Heshang, to obtain Buddhist sutras in the West.

claims.quote: Sun Wukong possesses many abilities. He has supernatural strength and is able to support the weight of two heavy mountains on his shoulders

statement.id: Sun Wukong memiliki banyak kemampuan, antara lain kekuatan supernatural; ia mampu memikul beban dua gunung berat di bahunya.
statement.en: Sun Wukong has many abilities, including supernatural strength; he can support the weight of two heavy mountains on his shoulders.

claims.quote: Sun Wukong acquires the 72 Earthly Transformations, which allow him to access 72 unique powers, including the ability to transform into animals and objects.

statement.id: Sun Wukong memperoleh 72 Transformasi Duniawi, yang memberinya 72 kekuatan unik, termasuk kemampuan berubah menjadi hewan dan benda.
statement.en: Sun Wukong acquires the 72 Earthly Transformations, which give him 72 unique powers, including the ability to transform into animals and objects.

claims.quote: The ability, oft portrayed as Wukong riding a nimbus-like cloud, requires a magic hand sign, an oral spell, a fist clench, and a body shake. Wukong's master Puti Zushi taught this ability to the monkey to give him a style of flying that complements his penchant for jumping.

statement.id: Kemampuan salto awan sering digambarkan sebagai Wukong menunggang awan; guru Puti Zushi mengajarkannya agar Wukong memiliki cara terbang yang cocok dengan kegemarannya melompat.
statement.en: The cloud somersault is often portrayed as Wukong riding a cloud; his master Puti Zushi taught it to give him a style of flying suited to his love of jumping.

claims.quote: Sun Wukong is said to have gained immortality through nine different means and instances, which together made him one of the most immortal and invincible beings in all of creation.

statement.id: Sun Wukong dikatakan memperoleh keabadian lewat sembilan cara dan peristiwa berbeda, yang menjadikannya salah satu makhluk paling abadi dan kebal di seluruh ciptaan.
statement.en: Sun Wukong is said to have gained immortality through nine different means and instances, making him one of the most immortal and invincible beings in all of creation.

claims.quote: a magical circlet which, once the Monkey King is tricked into putting it on, can never be removed. When Tang Sanzang chants a certain sutra, the band will tighten and cause an unbearable headache.

statement.id: Guanyin memberi Tang Sanzang sebuah lingkaran gaib dari Buddha yang tidak dapat dilepas setelah Raja Kera dibujuk memakainya; saat Tang Sanzang melafalkan sutra tertentu, lingkaran itu mengetat dan menimbulkan sakit kepala tak tertahankan.
statement.en: Guanyin gives Tang Sanzang a magical circlet from the Buddha that can never be removed once the Monkey King is tricked into wearing it; when Tang Sanzang chants a certain sutra the band tightens and causes an unbearable headache.

claims.quote: The surname Sūn was given as an in-joke about the monkey, as monkeys are also called húsūn (猢猻), and can mean either a literal or a figurative monkey (or a macaque).

statement.id: Marga Sūn diberikan sebagai lelucon tentang kera, karena kera juga disebut húsūn (猢猻), kata yang dapat berarti kera secara harfiah maupun kiasan.
statement.en: The surname Sūn was given as an in-joke about the monkey, since monkeys are also called húsūn (猢猻), a word that can mean a monkey literally or figuratively.

claims.quote: The given name, Wùkōng, means "awakened to emptiness", sometimes translated as "aware of vacuity".

statement.id: Nama pemberian Wùkōng berarti "tersadar akan kekosongan", kadang diterjemahkan "sadar akan kehampaan".
statement.en: The given name Wùkōng means "awakened to emptiness", sometimes translated as "aware of vacuity".

claims.quote: Son Gokū in Japanese, Sonogong in Korean ... Tôn Ngộ Không in Vietnamese, Sung Ghokong or Sung Gokhong in Javanese, Sun Ngokong in Thai, Wu Khone in Burmese, and Sun Gokong in Malay.

statement.id: Nama Sun Wukong dilafalkan Son Gokū dalam bahasa Jepang, Tôn Ngộ Không dalam bahasa Vietnam, Sung Ghokong atau Sung Gokhong dalam bahasa Jawa, dan Sun Gokong dalam bahasa Melayu, di antara bahasa lain.
statement.en: Sun Wukong is pronounced Son Gokū in Japanese, Tôn Ngộ Không in Vietnamese, Sung Ghokong or Sung Gokhong in Javanese and Sun Gokong in Malay, among other languages.

claims.quote: The earliest known literary prototype of Sun Wukong appears in the Song dynasty (960–1279) storyteller's prompt-book Poetic Tale of Tripitaka of the Great Tang Fetching Scriptures (大唐三藏取經詩話). In this 17-chapter text, the character is known as the "Monkey Pilgrim" (猴行者, Hou Xingzhe).

statement.id: Prototipe sastra tertua yang diketahui dari Sun Wukong muncul dalam buku pegangan juru cerita dinasti Song (960–1279), Poetic Tale of Tripitaka of the Great Tang Fetching Scriptures, teks 17 bab yang menyebutnya "Monkey Pilgrim" (猴行者, Hou Xingzhe).
statement.en: The earliest known literary prototype of Sun Wukong appears in a Song dynasty (960–1279) storyteller's prompt-book, Poetic Tale of Tripitaka of the Great Tang Fetching Scriptures, a 17-chapter text that calls him the "Monkey Pilgrim" (猴行者, Hou Xingzhe).

claims.quote: Unlike the Ming dynasty classic where the monkey is freed from under a mountain, the Monkey Pilgrim voluntarily approaches Xuanzang

statement.id: Berbeda dari novel dinasti Ming yang menceritakan kera dibebaskan dari bawah gunung, Monkey Pilgrim mendekati Xuanzang atas kehendaknya sendiri.
statement.en: Unlike the Ming dynasty classic, in which the monkey is freed from under a mountain, the Monkey Pilgrim approaches Xuanzang of his own accord.

claims.quote: Throughout the text, the Monkey Pilgrim serves as Xuanzang's sole magical protector, as the characters of Zhu Bajie (Pigsy) and Sha Wujing (Sandy) had not yet been fully developed as fellow disciples.

statement.id: Dalam teks itu, Monkey Pilgrim menjadi satu-satunya pelindung gaib Xuanzang, karena tokoh Zhu Bajie (Pigsy) dan Sha Wujing (Sandy) belum dikembangkan sepenuhnya sebagai sesama murid.
statement.en: In that text the Monkey Pilgrim is Xuanzang's sole magical protector, since the characters of Zhu Bajie (Pigsy) and Sha Wujing (Sandy) had not yet been fully developed as fellow disciples.

claims.quote: Hu Shih first suggested that Wu Cheng'en may have been influenced by the Hindu deity Hanuman from the Ramayana in his depictions of the Monkey King.

statement.id: Hu Shih pertama kali mengusulkan bahwa Wu Cheng'en mungkin dipengaruhi dewa Hindu Hanuman dari Ramayana dalam penggambarannya tentang Raja Kera.
statement.en: Hu Shih first suggested that Wu Cheng'en may have been influenced by the Hindu deity Hanuman of the Ramayana in his depictions of the Monkey King.

claims.quote: Instead, Lu Xun suggested the 9th-century Chinese deity Wuzhiqi, who appears as a sibling of Sun Wukong in older Yuan dynasty stories, as the inspiration.

statement.id: Sebaliknya, Lu Xun mengusulkan dewa Tiongkok abad ke-9 Wuzhiqi, yang muncul sebagai saudara Sun Wukong dalam kisah dinasti Yuan yang lebih tua, sebagai sumber inspirasinya.
statement.en: Instead, Lu Xun suggested the 9th-century Chinese deity Wuzhiqi, who appears as a sibling of Sun Wukong in older Yuan dynasty stories, as the inspiration.

claims.quote: According to Li, the Monkey King in the final novel combines two separate folklore traditions that merged during the Yuan dynasty (1271–1368).

statement.id: Menurut Li Tianfei, Raja Kera dalam novel akhir menggabungkan dua tradisi cerita rakyat terpisah yang bersatu pada masa dinasti Yuan (1271–1368).
statement.en: According to Li Tianfei, the Monkey King of the final novel combines two separate folklore traditions that merged during the Yuan dynasty (1271–1368).

claims.quote: In parts of southern China, including Sichuan, Fujian, and Guangdong, local folklore featured powerful ape spirits that were worshipped and given titles such as "Great Sage Equal to Heaven" (齐天大圣).

statement.id: Di beberapa bagian Tiongkok selatan, termasuk Sichuan, Fujian, dan Guangdong, cerita rakyat setempat memuat roh kera perkasa yang dipuja dan diberi gelar seperti "Great Sage Equal to Heaven" (齐天大圣).
statement.en: In parts of southern China, including Sichuan, Fujian and Guangdong, local folklore featured powerful ape spirits that were worshipped and given titles such as "Great Sage Equal to Heaven" (齐天大圣).

claims.quote: He forms a brotherhood called the Seven Sages (七聖) with the Bull Demon King (牛魔王), the Saurian Demon King (蛟魔王), the Roc Demon King (鵬魔王), the Lion Spirit King (獅狔王), the Macaque Spirit King (獼猴王), and the snub-nosed monkey Spirit King (禺狨王).

statement.id: Ia membentuk persaudaraan bernama Tujuh Resi (Seven Sages, 七聖) dengan Bull Demon King (牛魔王) serta raja-raja siluman lain, antara lain Raja Roc dan Raja Singa.
statement.en: He forms a brotherhood called the Seven Sages (七聖) with the Bull Demon King (牛魔王) and other spirit kings, among them the Roc Demon King and the Lion Spirit King.

claims.quote: Guanyin suggests the Jade Emperor's nephew Erlang Shen fight Wukong. Wukong and Erlang are evenly matched and eventually, both turn into terrifying figures, which scares Wukong's monkey army away.

statement.id: Guanyin menyarankan Erlang Shen, keponakan Kaisar Giok, melawan Wukong; Wukong dan Erlang sama kuat; keduanya akhirnya berubah menjadi sosok menakutkan yang membuat pasukan kera Wukong lari ketakutan.
statement.en: Guanyin suggests the Jade Emperor's nephew Erlang Shen fight Wukong; Wukong and Erlang are evenly matched and eventually both turn into terrifying figures, which scares Wukong's monkey army away.

claims.quote: Sun Wukong defeats the Army of Heaven's 100,000 celestial warriors, the 28 constellations and the Four Heavenly Kings, under the command of Devaraja Li and his third son, Princes Nezha, despite the Heavenly weapons used against him.

statement.id: Sun Wukong mengalahkan 100.000 prajurit langit Army of Heaven, 28 rasi bintang, dan Empat Raja Surgawi di bawah komando Devaraja Li dan putra ketiganya, Nezha.
statement.en: Sun Wukong defeats the Army of Heaven's 100,000 celestial warriors, the 28 constellations and the Four Heavenly Kings, under the command of Devaraja Li and his third son Nezha.

claims.quote: His fellow spiritual primates are the Six-Eared Macaque (六耳獼猴), who is one of his antagonists in the main storyline

statement.id: Sesama primata rohani Wukong antara lain Six-Eared Macaque (六耳獼猴), yang menjadi salah satu lawannya dalam alur utama.
statement.en: Wukong's fellow spiritual primates include the Six-Eared Macaque (六耳獼猴), who is one of his antagonists in the main storyline.

claims.quote: The brief satirical novel Xiyoubu (西遊補; "Supplement to the Journey to the West"), c. 1640, follows Sun Wukong as he is trapped in a magical dream world created by the Qing Fish Demon, the embodiment of desire

statement.id: Novel satir pendek Xiyoubu (sekitar 1640) mengisahkan Sun Wukong terjebak di dunia mimpi gaib ciptaan Qing Fish Demon, perwujudan keinginan.
statement.en: The brief satirical novel Xiyoubu (c. 1640) follows Sun Wukong trapped in a magical dream world created by the Qing Fish Demon, the embodiment of desire.

claims.quote: A Chinese Odyssey is a fantasy comedy film made in Hong Kong 1995.

statement.id: A Chinese Odyssey adalah film komedi fantasi yang dibuat di Hong Kong pada 1995.
statement.en: A Chinese Odyssey is a fantasy comedy film made in Hong Kong in 1995.

claims.quote: Martial Arts Superstar Donnie Yen plays Sun Wukong in the 2014 movie The Monkey King

statement.id: Donnie Yen memerankan Sun Wukong dalam film The Monkey King tahun 2014.
statement.en: Donnie Yen plays Sun Wukong in the 2014 movie The Monkey King.

claims.quote: The character of Son Goku in Dragon Ball is based on Sun Wukong, as attested by his monkey tail, staff, flying cloud, and name

statement.id: Tokoh Son Goku dalam Dragon Ball didasarkan pada Sun Wukong, terlihat dari ekor kera, tongkat, awan terbang, dan namanya.
statement.en: The character Son Goku in Dragon Ball is based on Sun Wukong, as shown by his monkey tail, staff, flying cloud and name.

claims.quote: The character of Monkey in the 1978 Japanese television series Monkey is based on Sun Wukong.

statement.id: Tokoh Monkey dalam serial televisi Jepang Monkey tahun 1978 didasarkan pada Sun Wukong.
statement.en: The character Monkey in the 1978 Japanese television series Monkey is based on Sun Wukong.

claims.quote: Sun Wu Kung. A monkey who personates the irrepressible human mind, the discoverer, the inventive genius, full of resource

statement.id: Dalam pengantar terjemahannya tahun 1913, Timothy Richard menulis bahwa Sun Wu Kung adalah kera yang melambangkan pikiran manusia yang tak terkendali, sang penemu, jenius pencipta yang penuh akal.
statement.en: In the introduction to his 1913 translation, Timothy Richard writes that Sun Wu Kung is a monkey who personates the irrepressible human mind, the discoverer, the inventive genius, full of resource.

claims.quote: On a certain day it split open and produced a stone egg, round like a big ball. After exposure to the air, this was transformed into a stone monkey with the five senses of the body complete, and able to creep and run.

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan Richard (1913), suatu hari batu hidup itu terbelah dan menghasilkan telur batu bundar; setelah terkena udara, telur itu menjadi kera batu dengan kelima indra lengkap dan mampu merayap serta berlari.
statement.en: In Richard's 1913 translation, one day the living stone split open and produced a round stone egg; after exposure to the air it became a stone monkey with the five senses complete, able to creep and run.

claims.quote: the Master orders some very difficult work to be done, and the Monkey hesitates, the spikes enter into his head and give great pain.

statement.id: Richard menjelaskan bahwa topi berduri yang dipakai Kera menusuk kepalanya dan menimbulkan sakit hebat bila Sang Guru memerintahkan pekerjaan sulit dan Kera ragu.
statement.en: Richard explains that the hat of spikes worn by the Monkey pricks his head and gives great pain when the Master orders some very difficult work and the Monkey hesitates.

claims.quote: 內育仙胞，一日迸裂，產一石卵，似圓毬樣大。因見風，化作一個石猴，五官俱備，四肢皆全。

statement.id: Dalam teks asli novel (bab 1), sebuah batu yang mengandung "kantong gaib" pecah pada suatu hari dan melahirkan telur batu sebesar bola; terkena angin, telur itu menjadi kera batu dengan panca indra dan keempat anggota badan lengkap.
statement.en: In the original text (chapter 1), a stone holding an immortal "womb" split open one day and produced a stone egg the size of a ball; touched by the wind it became a stone monkey with all five senses and four limbs complete.

claims.quote: 眾猴聽說，即拱伏無違，一個個序齒排班，朝上禮拜，都稱「千歲大王」。自此，石猿高登王位，將「石」字兒隱了，遂稱「美猴王」。

statement.id: Para kera memberi hormat dan menyebutnya "千歲大王"; kera batu itu pun naik takhta, menanggalkan kata "batu" dari namanya, dan disebut Raja Kera Tampan (美猴王).
statement.en: The monkeys bow and hail him as "千歲大王"; the stone ape then ascends the throne, drops the word "stone" from his name, and is called the Handsome Monkey King (美猴王).

claims.quote: 美猴王領一群猿猴、獼猴、馬猴等，分派了君臣佐使。朝遊花果山，暮宿水簾洞

statement.id: Raja Kera Tampan memimpin sekelompok kera dan monyet; mereka berkelana di Gunung Bunga dan Buah (花果山) pada siang hari dan bermalam di Gua Tirai Air (水簾洞) pada malam hari.
statement.en: The Handsome Monkey King led a troop of apes and monkeys; by day they roamed Flower Fruit Mountain (花果山) and by night they lodged in the Water Curtain Cave (水簾洞).

claims.quote: 我明日就辭汝等下山，雲遊海角，遠涉天涯，務必訪此三者，學一個不老長生，常躲過閻君之難。

statement.id: Raja Kera memutuskan turun gunung, mengembara jauh untuk mencari tiga golongan makhluk yang luput dari kematian, agar belajar hidup abadi dan menghindari bencana dari Raja Yama.
statement.en: The Monkey King resolves to leave the mountain and wander far to find the three kinds of beings who escape death, so as to learn ageless long life and avoid the hardship of King Yama.

claims.quote: 祖師道：「乃廣、大、智、慧、真、如、性、海、穎、悟、圓、覺十二字。排到你，正當『悟』字。與你起個法名叫做『孫悟空』，好麼？」猴王笑道：「好！好！好！自今就叫做孫悟空也。」

statement.id: Sang guru (祖師) berkata bahwa urutan dua belas aksara nama perguruannya jatuh pada aksara "悟" bagi si kera, lalu memberinya nama dharma "孫悟空"; si kera menerimanya dengan gembira.
statement.en: The patriarch (祖師) says that in his school's sequence of twelve characters the monkey's turn falls on the character "悟", and gives him the dharma name "孫悟空", which the monkey gladly accepts.

claims.quote: 你身軀雖是鄙陋，卻像個食松果的猢猻。我與你就身上取個姓氏，意思教你姓『猢』。猢字去了個獸傍，乃是個古月。古者，老也；月者，陰也。老陰不能化育，教你姓『猻』倒好。猻字去了獸傍，乃是個子系。子者，兒男也；系者。嬰細也，正合嬰兒之本論。教你姓『孫』罷。

statement.id: Sang guru menilai tubuh si kera buruk tetapi mirip kera pemakan buah pinus, lalu memberinya marga "孫" setelah membahas aksara 猢 dan 猻.
statement.en: The patriarch says the monkey's body is unlovely yet like a pine-nut-eating macaque (猢猻), and after discussing the characters 猢 and 猻 gives him the surname "孫".

claims.quote: 這猴王也是他一竅通時百竅通，當時習了口訣，自修自煉，將七十二般變化都學成了。

statement.id: Dalam bab 2, si Raja Kera menguasai satu hal lalu seratus hal lain menyusul; ia mempelajari rumus lisan, berlatih sendiri, dan menguasai tujuh puluh dua perubahan wujud.
statement.en: In chapter 2 the Monkey King, once one opening is clear, finds a hundred open; he learns the oral formula, practises on his own, and masters the seventy-two transformations.

claims.quote: 這朵雲，捻著訣，念動真言，攢緊了拳，將身一抖，跳將起來，一觔斗就有十萬八千里路哩。

statement.id: Sang guru mengajarkan awan salto: dengan rumus tangan, mantra, kepalan, dan guncangan tubuh, sekali salto menempuh seratus delapan ribu li.
statement.en: The patriarch teaches the somersault cloud: with a hand sign, a spell, a clenched fist and a shake of the body, one somersault covers 108,000 li.

claims.quote: 悟空十分歡喜，拿出海藏看時，原來兩頭是兩個金箍，中間乃一段烏鐵。緊挨箍有鐫成的一行字，喚做：「如意金箍棒，重一萬三千五百斤。

statement.id: Dalam bab 3, senjata yang dipilih Wukong berujung dua gelang emas dengan batang besi hitam di tengah, bertuliskan "如意金箍棒" (tongkat gelang emas sesuka hati) seberat 13.500 kati.
statement.en: In chapter 3 the weapon Wukong takes has two gold bands at its ends and a length of black iron between them, inscribed "如意金箍棒" (Ruyi Jingu Bang), weighing 13,500 jin.

claims.quote: 玉帝傳旨道：「就除他做個弼馬溫罷。」眾臣叫謝恩，他也只朝上唱個大喏。玉帝又差木德星官送他去御馬監到任。

statement.id: Kaisar Giok menetapkan Wukong sebagai "弼馬溫" (pengurus kuda) dan mengirimnya ke istal kerajaan untuk menjabat.
statement.en: The Jade Emperor decrees that Wukong be made a "弼馬溫" (keeper of the horses) and sends him to the imperial stables to take up the post.

claims.quote: 就做個齊天大聖，有何不可？」猴王聞說，歡喜不勝，連道幾個「好！好！好！」教四健將：「就替我快置個旌旗，旗上寫『齊天大聖』四大字，立竿張掛。自此以後，只稱我為齊天大聖，不許再稱大王。

statement.id: Setelah menolak jabatan pengurus kuda, Wukong menyiapkan panji bertuliskan "齊天大聖" dan memerintahkan agar ia hanya disebut Sang Resi Setara Langit, bukan raja.
statement.en: After the horse-keeper post, a banner reading "齊天大聖" (Great Sage Equal to Heaven) is set up and Wukong orders that he be called by that title and no longer "king".

claims.quote: 朕見你身閑無事，與你件執事：你且權管那蟠桃園，早晚好生在意。

statement.id: Kaisar Giok menugaskan Wukong mengurus Kebun Persik Panjang Umur (蟠桃園) sementara waktu.
statement.en: The Jade Emperor assigns Wukong to take charge of the Peach Garden (蟠桃園) for the time being.

claims.quote: 佛祖道：「我與你打個賭賽：你若有本事，一觔斗打出我這右手掌中，算你贏

statement.id: Buddha menantang Wukong bertaruh: bila Wukong mampu sekali salto keluar dari telapak tangan kanannya, ia dianggap menang.
statement.en: The Buddha proposes a wager: if Wukong can somersault out of his right palm in a single leap, Wukong wins.

claims.quote: 被佛祖翻掌一撲，把這猴王推出西天門外，將五指化作金、木、水、火、土五座聯山，喚名「五行山」

statement.id: Buddha membalik telapak tangannya, mendorong Raja Kera keluar dari gerbang barat surga, dan mengubah lima jarinya menjadi lima gunung berantai bernama Gunung Lima Unsur (五行山).
statement.en: The Buddha turns his palm, pushes the Monkey King out of the West Heaven Gate, and turns his five fingers into five linked mountains called the Five Elements Mountain (五行山).

claims.quote: 孫悟空，汝因大鬧天宮，吾以甚深法力，壓在五行山下，幸天災滿足，歸於釋教；且喜汝隱惡揚善，在途中煉魔降怪有功，全終全始，加陞大職正果，汝為鬥戰勝佛。

statement.id: Di akhir novel, Buddha menyebut Sun Wukong pernah mengacau istana langit dan ditindih di bawah Gunung Lima Unsur; karena jasanya menaklukkan iblis di sepanjang jalan, ia dianugerahi gelar Buddha Pemenang Pertempuran (鬥戰勝佛).
statement.en: At the end of the novel the Buddha recalls that Sun Wukong made havoc in the heavenly palace and was pressed under the Five Elements Mountain, and for his merit in subduing demons along the way names him the Buddha Victorious in Fighting (鬥戰勝佛).

summary.id: Hu Shih mengusulkan pengaruh Hanuman dari Ramayana.
summary.en: Hu Shih suggested the influence of Hanuman of the Ramayana.

summary.id: Lu Xun mengusulkan dewa Wuzhiqi sebagai sumber inspirasi.
summary.en: Lu Xun suggested the deity Wuzhiqi as the inspiration.

summary.id: Li Tianfei berpendapat tokoh ini gabungan dua tradisi cerita rakyat yang menyatu pada masa Yuan.
summary.en: Li Tianfei argues the character combines two folklore traditions that merged in the Yuan dynasty.

text.id: Arca Wisnu di Thailand berasal dari abad ke-4 hingga ke-9; kuil Wisnu besar tertua di India berasal dari masa Kekaisaran Gupta.
text.en: Vishnu statues in Thailand date from the 4th to 9th century; the earliest grand Vishnu temples in India date from the Gupta Empire period.

cultural_context.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu adalah dewa terpenting Waisnawa, sekte Hindu terbesar, dan dipandang sebagai pelindung manusia yang menjaga tatanan (dharma).
cultural_context.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is the foremost god of Vaishnavism, which it describes as the largest Hindu sect, and is seen as the guardian of humanity who protects the order of things (dharma).

literal_meaning.id: meliputi segala; menurut Medhātith, yang adalah segalanya dan berada di dalam segalanya
literal_meaning.en: all pervasive; according to Medhātith, one who is everything and inside everything

who.id: Dewa pemelihara dalam agama Hindu.
who.en: The preserver god of Hinduism.

origin.id: Agama Hindu, terutama tradisi Waisnawa.
origin.en: Hinduism, especially Vaishnavism.

role.id: Sang Pemelihara dalam Trimurti dan pelindung dharma yang turun sebagai awatara.
role.en: The Preserver within the Trimurti and protector of dharma who descends as avatars.

famous_for.id: Sepuluh awatara, termasuk Rama dan Kresna, serta kisahnya sebagai Kurma, Varaha, Matsya, Vamana, dan Nara-Simha.
famous_for.en: His ten avatars, including Rama and Krishna, and his stories as Kurma, Varaha, Matsya, Vamana and Nara-Simha.

did_you_know.id: Wisnu juga disebut Trivikrama, 'yang bertiga langkah', karena dalam wujud Vamana ia melintasi langit, Bumi, dan Dunia Bawah dengan tiga langkah.
did_you_know.en: Vishnu is also called Trivikrama, 'of the three steps', because as Vamana he crossed the sky, the Earth and the Underworld in three steps.

description.id: Turun ke dunia dalam berbagai wujud awatara, berupa manusia, hewan, atau campuran keduanya, untuk memulihkan tatanan kosmis dan melawan raksasa.
description.en: Descends in various avatar forms, as people, animals or a mix of both, to restore cosmic order and fight demons.

description.id: Wisnu bersenjatakan cakram Sudarsanacakra dan sering memegang kerang dan gada; Wisnu Purana menggambarkannya dengan kerang, cakram, dan gada.
description.en: Vishnu is armed with the Sudarsanacakra discus and often holds a conch and a mace; the Vishnu Purana shows him with the shell, the discus and the mace.

name.id: Memberi kesempatan hidup abadi kepada para dewa
name.en: Giving the gods the chance of immortality

description.id: Dengan menjelma Maya, Wisnu mengambil nektar dari para raksasa dan memberikannya kepada para dewa.
description.en: By taking the form of Maya, Vishnu recovered the nectar from the demons and gave it to the gods.

title.en: The churning of the ocean of milk

role.en: Supporter of the mountain and giver of nectar

summary.id: Para dewa dan raksasa mengaduk samudra dengan Gunung Mandara dan ular Vasuki sebagai tali, tetapi tidak sanggup menahan gunung itu, sehingga Wisnu menopangnya sebagai kura-kura Kurma. Ia kemudian menjelma Maya untuk mengambil nektar dari para raksasa dan memberikannya kepada para dewa. Wisnu Purana juga menyebut Hari sendiri, sebagai kura-kura di Lautan Susu, menjadi penopang tongkat pengaduk.
summary.en: The gods and demons churned the ocean with Mount Mandara and the serpent Vasuki as a rope but could not handle the mountain, so Vishnu held it up as the tortoise Kurma. He then became Maya to take the nectar from the demons and give it to the gods. The Vishnu Purana likewise says that Hari himself, as a tortoise in the Milky sea, became the support of the churning-stick.

role.id: Babi hutan raksasa yang menyelamatkan Bumi
role.en: The gigantic boar who rescues the Earth

summary.id: Sebagai babi hutan raksasa Varaha, Wisnu bertarung seribu tahun melawan raksasa Daitya setelah Hiranyaksha membawa Bumi ke dasar laut, lalu mengangkat Bumi dengan taringnya.
summary.en: As the gigantic boar Varaha, Vishnu fought the giant Daitya for a thousand years after Hiranyaksha took the Earth to the bottom of the sea, then raised the Earth on his tusk.

summary.id: Wisnu muncul sebagai ikan kecil Matsya yang melompat ke tangan Manu, lalu tampil sebagai ikan raksasa bersisik emas dan bertanduk satu yang membawa kapal bagi Manu.
summary.en: Vishnu appears as the small fish Matsya who jumps into Manu's hand, and later as the gigantic fish with golden scales and a single horn carrying a ship for Manu.

role.id: Brahmana kerdil yang merebut alam semesta
role.en: The dwarf Brahman who claims the universe

summary.id: Dalam wujud Vamana, brahmana kerdil, Wisnu menghadapi Bali; dengan tiga langkah ia melintasi langit, Bumi, dan Dunia Bawah, sehingga tak ada yang tersisa bagi para raksasa.
summary.en: As Vamana, a dwarf Brahman, Vishnu confronted Bali; in three steps he crossed the sky, the Earth and the Underworld, leaving nothing for the giants.

role.en: The man-lion who answers a challenge

summary.id: Ketika Raja Asura Hiranya-Kasipu menyerukan agar ia disembah sebagai dewa dan menantang Wisnu menampakkan diri, Wisnu muncul sebagai manusia-singa Nara-Simha.
summary.en: When Hiranya-Kasipu, King of the Asuras, demanded worship as a god and challenged Vishnu to show himself, Vishnu appeared as the man-lion Nara-Simha.

short_description.id: Wisnu, juga disebut Narayana dan Hari, adalah salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu, Yang Mahatinggi dalam tradisi Waisnawa, dan Sang Pemelihara dalam Trimurti yang turun ke dunia sebagai awatara.
short_description.en: Vishnu, also called Narayana and Hari, is one of the principal deities of Hinduism, the Supreme Being in Vaishnavism and the Preserver within the Trimurti, who descends to the world as avatars.

long_description.id: Wisnu, yang namanya berarti Yang Meliputi Segala, juga dikenal sebagai Narayana dan Hari, adalah salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu. Ia Yang Mahatinggi dalam tradisi Waisnawa, salah satu tradisi besar agama Hindu masa kini, dan dewa pemeliharaan. Dalam Trimurti, yang juga mencakup Brahma dan Siwa, Wisnu dikenal sebagai Sang Pemelihara, dan Lakshmi adalah pasangannya.
long_description.en: Vishnu, whose name means the All-Pervasive, is also called Narayana and Hari and ranks among the chief gods of Hinduism. Vaishnavism, one of the great Hindu traditions today, reveres him as the highest being and god of preservation. In the Trimurti, with Brahma and Shiva, he is the Preserver, and Lakshmi is his partner.

long_description.id: Dalam aspek welas asihnya, Wisnu digambarkan sebagai makhluk mahatahu yang berbaring di atas lilitan ular Sesha di samudra susu purba, Kshira Sagara, bersama pasangannya, Lakshmi. Setiap kali dunia terancam kejahatan dan kekacauan, Wisnu turun dalam wujud awatara untuk memulihkan tatanan kosmis dan melindungi dharma. Dashavatara adalah sepuluh awatara utamanya, dan dari kesepuluhnya Rama dan Kresna paling banyak dipuja.
long_description.en: In his benevolent aspects Vishnu is depicted as an omniscient being lying on the coils of the serpent Shesha in the primeval ocean of milk, Kshira Sagara, with his consort Lakshmi. Whenever the world is threatened by evil and chaos, Vishnu descends as an avatar to restore cosmic order and protect dharma. The Dashavatara are his ten primary avatars, of whom Rama and Krishna are the most worshipped.

long_description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu memiliki sepuluh awatara, berupa manusia, hewan, atau campuran keduanya. Dalam wujud Kurma ia menopang gunung saat samudra diaduk, lalu menjelma Maya yang jelita untuk membuat para raksasa melepaskan nektar kepada para dewa. Sebagai Varaha ia mengangkat Bumi dari dasar laut setelah bertarung seribu tahun, sebagai Matsya ia membawa kapal bagi Manu, sebagai Vamana ia melintasi langit, Bumi, dan Dunia Bawah dengan tiga langkah, dan sebagai manusia-singa Nara-Simha ia menjawab tantangan Hiranya-Kasipu. Wisnu Purana menambahkan bahwa Hari sendiri, sebagai kura-kura di Lautan Susu, menopang tongkat pengaduk.
long_description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu has ten avatars, as people, animals or a mix of both. As Kurma he held up the mountain while the ocean was churned and then became the beautiful Maya so that the demons would give up the nectar to the gods. As Varaha he raised the Earth from the sea bottom after a thousand-year fight, as Matsya he carried a ship for Manu, as Vamana he crossed the world in three steps, and as the man-lion Nara-Simha he answered Hiranya-Kasipu's challenge. The Vishnu Purana adds that Hari himself, as a tortoise in the Milky sea, supported the churning-stick.

long_description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu paling sering digambarkan berwarna biru, kadang menunggang Garuda, dan bersenjatakan cakram Sudarsanacakra; di keempat tangannya ia sering memegang kerang, gada atau pedang, dan teratai. Ia dianggap tinggal di kota Vaikuntha di Gunung Meru, dan dikaitkan dengan matahari lewat nama Surya Narayana. Wisnu Purana menggambarkannya duduk di atas Garuda dengan kerang, cakram, dan gada, serta menyebut Janārddana sebagai pencipta, pemelihara, dan pelebur alam semesta.
long_description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is most often depicted coloured blue, sometimes rides Garuda and bears the Sudarsanacakra discus; in his four hands he often holds a conch, a mace or sword, and a lotus. He is considered to dwell in the city of Vaikuntha on Mt. Meru and is linked with the sun through the name Surya Narayana. The Vishnu Purana shows him seated on Garuda with the shell, discus and mace, and calls Janārddana the creator, preserver and destroyer of the universe.

long_description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu adalah dewa terpenting Waisnawa, sekte Hindu terbesar, dan ia memiliki tiga istri: Lakshmi, Sarasvati, dan Ganga, dua yang terakhir akhirnya ia kirim kepada Brahma dan Siwa. Menurut Wikipedia, arca Wisnu berlengan empat dari abad ke-4 hingga ke-9 ditemukan di Thailand dan mirip dengan arca di India kuno, dan sebagian kuil Wisnu besar tertua di India berasal dari masa Kekaisaran Gupta.
long_description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is the foremost god of Vaishnavism, which it describes as the largest Hindu sect, and has three wives, Lakshmi, Sarasvati and Ganga, the latter two eventually sent to Brahma and Shiva. According to Wikipedia, statues of four-armed Vishnu from the 4th to 9th century have been found in Thailand and mirror those of ancient India, and some of the earliest surviving grand Vishnu temples in India date from the Gupta Empire period.

claims.quote: also known as Narayana and Hari, is one of the principal deities of Hinduism. He is the Supreme Being within Vaishnavism, one of the major traditions within contemporary Hinduism, and the god of preservation (sattva).

statement.id: Wisnu, juga dikenal sebagai Narayana dan Hari, adalah salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu, Yang Mahatinggi dalam tradisi Waisnawa, dan dewa pemeliharaan.
statement.en: Vishnu, also known as Narayana and Hari, is one of the principal deities of Hinduism, the Supreme Being in Vaishnavism, and the god of preservation.

claims.quote: Vishnu is known as The Preserver within the Trimurti, the triple deity of supreme divinity that includes Brahma and Shiva.

statement.id: Dalam Trimurti, tiga dewa dengan keilahian tertinggi yang mencakup Brahma dan Siwa, Wisnu dikenal sebagai Sang Pemelihara.
statement.en: Within the Trimurti, the triple deity of supreme divinity that includes Brahma and Shiva, Vishnu is known as the Preserver.

claims.quote: In benevolent aspects, he is depicted as an omniscient being sleeping on the coils of the serpent Shesha (who represents time) floating in the primeval ocean of milk called Kshira Sagara with his consort, Lakshmi.

statement.id: Dalam aspek welas asihnya Wisnu digambarkan berbaring di atas lilitan ular Sesha di samudra susu purba Kshira Sagara bersama Lakshmi.
statement.en: In benevolent aspects Vishnu is shown lying on the coils of the serpent Shesha in the primeval ocean of milk, Kshira Sagara, with Lakshmi.

claims.quote: Whenever the world is threatened with evil, chaos, and destructive forces, Vishnu descends in the form of an avatar (incarnation) to restore the cosmic order and protect dharma. The Dashavatara are the ten primary avatars of Vishnu. Of these ten, Rama and Krishna are the most worshipped

statement.id: Setiap kali dunia terancam kejahatan dan kekacauan, Wisnu turun sebagai awatara untuk memulihkan tatanan kosmis dan melindungi dharma; Dashavatara adalah sepuluh awatara utamanya, dan Rama serta Kresna paling banyak dipuja.
statement.en: Whenever the world is threatened by evil and chaos, Vishnu descends as an avatar to restore cosmic order and protect dharma; the Dashavatara are his ten primary avatars, Rama and Krishna the most worshipped.

claims.quote: Vishnu (also spelled Viṣṇu, Sanskrit: विष्णु) means 'all pervasive'

statement.id: Nama Wisnu (विष्णु, juga ditulis Viṣṇu) berarti 'meliputi segala'.
statement.en: The name Vishnu (Sanskrit: विष्णु, also spelled Viṣṇu) means 'all pervasive'.

claims.quote: Vishnu is the Preserver and guardian of men, he protects the order of things (dharma), and he appears on earth in various incarnations (avatars) to fight demons and to maintain cosmic harmony.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu adalah pemelihara dan pelindung manusia yang menjaga dharma dan muncul di bumi dalam berbagai awatara untuk melawan raksasa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is the Preserver and guardian of humanity who protects dharma and appears on earth in various avatars to fight demons.

claims.quote: To mix the ocean they decided to use the holy Mt. Mandara with the giant serpent Vasuki (or Ananta) as a turning rope; one end to be pulled by Demons and the other by the gods. However, neither group could handle such a weight and they called for Vishnu to hold it. This he did in the form of Kurma, the giant tortoise, supporting the mountain on his shell.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, untuk mengaduk samudra para dewa dan raksasa memakai Gunung Mandara dengan ular raksasa Vasuki (atau Ananta) sebagai tali, tetapi tidak sanggup menahan bebannya sehingga memanggil Wisnu, yang menopang gunung itu di punggungnya dalam wujud Kurma, kura-kura raksasa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, to churn the ocean the gods and demons used Mount Mandara with the giant serpent Vasuki (or Ananta) as a rope, but could not handle its weight and called on Vishnu, who held the mountain on his shell in the form of Kurma, the giant tortoise.

claims.quote: according to Medhātith (c. 1000 CE), 'one who is everything and inside everything'

statement.id: Menurut Medhātith (sekitar 1000 M), Wisnu berarti 'yang adalah segalanya dan berada di dalam segalanya'.
statement.en: According to Medhātith (c. 1000 CE), Vishnu means 'one who is everything and inside everything'.

claims.quote: In Thailand, for example, statues of four-armed Vishnu have been found in provinces near Malaysia and dated to be from the 4th to 9th-century, and this mirror those found in ancient India.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, di Thailand ditemukan patung Wisnu berlengan empat di provinsi dekat Malaysia yang berasal dari abad ke-4 hingga ke-9, dan patung itu mirip dengan yang ditemukan di India kuno.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, statues of four-armed Vishnu found in Thai provinces near Malaysia date from the 4th to 9th century and mirror those found in ancient India.

claims.quote: Some of the earliest surviving grand Vishnu temples in India have been dated to the Gupta Empire period.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, sebagian kuil Wisnu besar tertua yang masih bertahan di India berasal dari masa Kekaisaran Gupta.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, some of the earliest surviving grand Vishnu temples in India have been dated to the Gupta Empire period.

claims.quote: Vishnu is the most important god of Vaishnavism, the largest Hindu sect. Indeed, to illustrate Vishnu's superior status, Brahma is, in some accounts, considered to have been born from a lotus flower which grew from Vishnu's naval.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu adalah dewa terpenting Waisnawa, sekte Hindu terbesar; sebagai tanda kedudukannya yang unggul, dalam beberapa kisah Brahma dianggap lahir dari bunga teratai yang tumbuh dari pusar Wisnu.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is the most important god of Vaishnavism, the largest Hindu sect; to illustrate his superior status, in some accounts Brahma is born from a lotus flower that grew from Vishnu's navel.

claims.quote: Vishnu was married to Lakshmi (the goddess of good fortune), Sarawati (the goddess of wisdom) and Ganga (the goddess who is the personification of the River Ganges). However, unable to live with the quarrels between his three wives, Vishnu eventually sent Ganga to Shiva and Sarawati to Brahma.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu menikah dengan Lakshmi (dewi keberuntungan), Sarasvati (dewi kebijaksanaan), dan Ganga (personifikasi Sungai Gangga), tetapi karena pertengkaran istri-istrinya ia mengirim Ganga kepada Siwa dan Sarasvati kepada Brahma.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu was married to Lakshmi (goddess of good fortune), Sarawati (goddess of wisdom) and Ganga (personification of the River Ganges), but unable to bear their quarrels he sent Ganga to Shiva and Sarawati to Brahma.

claims.quote: He is considered to live in the city of Vaikuntha on Mt. Meru, where everything is made of shining gold and fabulous jewels and where there are lakes resplendent with lotus flowers.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu dianggap tinggal di kota Vaikuntha di Gunung Meru, tempat segalanya terbuat dari emas berkilau dan permata, dengan danau-danau yang dipenuhi teratai.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is considered to live in the city of Vaikuntha on Mt. Meru, where everything is made of shining gold and jewels and lakes are resplendent with lotus flowers.

claims.quote: Vishnu has ten avatars or worldly appearances, which are people, animals or a mix of both.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu memiliki sepuluh awatara atau penampakan duniawi, berupa manusia, hewan, atau campuran keduanya.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu has ten avatars or worldly appearances, which are people, animals or a mix of both.

claims.quote: As Varaha, the gigantic boar, he defeated the giant Daitya after Hiranyaksha had mischievously taken the Earth (Bhumi-devi) to the bottom of the sea. The incredible fight between the two lasted for a thousand years but Vishnu prevailed and finally raised the Earth from the watery depths, carrying it on his tusk.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, sebagai Varaha, babi hutan raksasa, Wisnu mengalahkan raksasa Daitya setelah Hiranyaksha membawa Bumi (Bhumi-devi) ke dasar laut; setelah pertarungan seribu tahun, Wisnu menang dan mengangkat Bumi dari kedalaman dengan taringnya.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, as Varaha, the gigantic boar, Vishnu defeated the giant Daitya after Hiranyaksha took the Earth (Bhumi-devi) to the bottom of the sea; after a fight lasting a thousand years Vishnu prevailed and raised the Earth from the depths on his tusk.

claims.quote: Fortunately, Vishnu interceded in the form of the beautiful Maya (the personification of Illusion) and, suitably distracted, the Demons relinquished the nectar which Vishnu graciously gave to the gods, allowing them the possibility of immortality.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu menjelma Maya yang jelita (personifikasi Ilusi) hingga para raksasa terpedaya dan melepaskan nektar, yang lalu ia berikan kepada para dewa sehingga mereka berpeluang hidup abadi.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu took the form of the beautiful Maya (the personification of Illusion), so that the distracted Demons relinquished the nectar, which he gave to the gods, allowing them the possibility of immortality.

claims.quote: Vishnu appears as another avatar in the form of the fish Matsya. Manu, the sage and son of Vivsavat-Sun, was washing in a river one day when a small fish suddenly jumped into his hand. ... Vishnu then reappeared on the scene as the gigantic fish, this time with golden scales and a single horn, and carrying the promised ship for Manu.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu muncul sebagai awatara ikan Matsya yang melompat ke tangan Manu; kelak ia tampil sebagai ikan raksasa bersisik emas dan bertanduk satu yang membawa kapal bagi Manu.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu appears as the avatar of the fish Matsya, who jumped into the hand of Manu; later he reappears as the gigantic fish with golden scales and a single horn carrying the promised ship for Manu.

claims.quote: Vishnu was persuaded by the gods to interrupt his meditations and confront the giant warrior Bali, which he did in the form of a dwarf Brahman (or priest) called Vamana. ... with his first step he cleared the sky, with the second the Earth and, with his final step, the Underworld, thus leaving nothing for the poor giants.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu menghadapi pahlawan raksasa Bali dalam wujud brahmana kerdil bernama Vamana; dengan langkah pertama ia melintasi langit, dengan yang kedua Bumi, dan dengan yang terakhir Dunia Bawah, sehingga tak ada yang tersisa bagi para raksasa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu confronted the giant warrior Bali as a dwarf Brahman called Vamana; with his first step he cleared the sky, with the second the Earth and with the last the Underworld, leaving nothing for the giants.

statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu appeared as the man-lion Nara-Simha when Hiranya-Kasipu, King of the Asuras, called on people to worship him as a god and challenged Vishnu to show himself if he were really omnipresent.

claims.quote: Whatever is generated by any living being, O twice-born one—the agent is considered as a portion of Hari. And whatever destroys any living being, moveable or immoveable, is considered as the destroying portion of Janārddana as Rudra. In this wise Janārddana is the creator, preserver and destroyer of the universe.

statement.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, apa pun yang dilahirkan makhluk hidup dianggap bagian Hari, dan apa pun yang membinasakan makhluk dianggap bagian Janārddana sebagai Rudra; dengan demikian Janārddana adalah pencipta, pemelihara, dan pelebur alam semesta.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, whatever is generated by a living being is considered a portion of Hari, and whatever destroys a living being the destroying portion of Janārddana as Rudra; in this way Janārddana is the creator, preserver and destroyer of the universe.

He then became Maya to take the nectar from the demons and give it to the gods. short_description.id: Wisnu, juga disebut Narayana dan Hari, adalah salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu, Yang Mahatinggi dalam tradisi Waisnawa, dan Sang Pemelihara dalam Trimurti yang turun ke dunia sebagai awatara.
short_description.en: Vishnu, also called Narayana and Hari, is one of the principal deities of Hinduism, the Supreme Being in Vaishnavism and the Preserver within the Trimurti, who descends to the world as avatars.

long_description.id: Wisnu, yang namanya berarti Yang Meliputi Segala, juga dikenal sebagai Narayana dan Hari, adalah salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu. Ia Yang Mahatinggi dalam tradisi Waisnawa, salah satu tradisi besar agama Hindu masa kini, dan dewa pemeliharaan. Dalam Trimurti, yang juga mencakup Brahma dan Siwa, Wisnu dikenal sebagai Sang Pemelihara, dan Lakshmi adalah pasangannya.
long_description.en: Vishnu, whose name means the All-Pervasive, is also called Narayana and Hari and ranks among the chief gods of Hinduism. Vaishnavism, one of the great Hindu traditions today, reveres him as the highest being and god of preservation. In the Trimurti, with Brahma and Shiva, he is the Preserver, and Lakshmi is his partner.

long_description.id: Dalam aspek welas asihnya, Wisnu digambarkan sebagai makhluk mahatahu yang berbaring di atas lilitan ular Sesha di samudra susu purba, Kshira Sagara, bersama pasangannya, Lakshmi. Setiap kali dunia terancam kejahatan dan kekacauan, Wisnu turun dalam wujud awatara untuk memulihkan tatanan kosmis dan melindungi dharma. Dashavatara adalah sepuluh awatara utamanya, dan dari kesepuluhnya Rama dan Kresna paling banyak dipuja.
long_description.en: In his benevolent aspects Vishnu is depicted as an omniscient being lying on the coils of the serpent Shesha in the primeval ocean of milk, Kshira Sagara, with his consort Lakshmi. Whenever the world is threatened by evil and chaos, Vishnu descends as an avatar to restore cosmic order and protect dharma. The Dashavatara are his ten primary avatars, of whom Rama and Krishna are the most worshipped.

long_description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu memiliki sepuluh awatara, berupa manusia, hewan, atau campuran keduanya. Dalam wujud Kurma ia menopang gunung saat samudra diaduk, lalu menjelma Maya yang jelita untuk membuat para raksasa melepaskan nektar kepada para dewa. Sebagai Varaha ia mengangkat Bumi dari dasar laut setelah bertarung seribu tahun, sebagai Matsya ia membawa kapal bagi Manu, sebagai Vamana ia melintasi langit, Bumi, dan Dunia Bawah dengan tiga langkah, dan sebagai manusia-singa Nara-Simha ia menjawab tantangan Hiranya-Kasipu. Wisnu Purana menambahkan bahwa Hari sendiri, sebagai kura-kura di Lautan Susu, menopang tongkat pengaduk.
long_description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu has ten avatars, as people, animals or a mix of both. As Kurma he held up the mountain while the ocean was churned and then became the beautiful Maya so that the demons would give up the nectar to the gods. As Varaha he raised the Earth from the sea bottom after a thousand-year fight, as Matsya he carried a ship for Manu, as Vamana he crossed the world in three steps, and as the man-lion Nara-Simha he answered Hiranya-Kasipu's challenge. The Vishnu Purana adds that Hari himself, as a tortoise in the Milky sea, supported the churning-stick.

long_description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu paling sering digambarkan berwarna biru, kadang menunggang Garuda, dan bersenjatakan cakram Sudarsanacakra; di keempat tangannya ia sering memegang kerang, gada atau pedang, dan teratai. Ia dianggap tinggal di kota Vaikuntha di Gunung Meru, dan dikaitkan dengan matahari lewat nama Surya Narayana. Wisnu Purana menggambarkannya duduk di atas Garuda dengan kerang, cakram, dan gada, serta menyebut Janārddana sebagai pencipta, pemelihara, dan pelebur alam semesta.
long_description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is most often depicted coloured blue, sometimes rides Garuda and bears the Sudarsanacakra discus; in his four hands he often holds a conch, a mace or sword, and a lotus. He is considered to dwell in the city of Vaikuntha on Mt. Meru and is linked with the sun through the name Surya Narayana. The Vishnu Purana shows him seated on Garuda with the shell, discus and mace, and calls Janārddana the creator, preserver and destroyer of the universe.

long_description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu adalah dewa terpenting Waisnawa, sekte Hindu terbesar, dan ia memiliki tiga istri: Lakshmi, Sarasvati, dan Ganga, dua yang terakhir akhirnya ia kirim kepada Brahma dan Siwa. Menurut Wikipedia, arca Wisnu berlengan empat dari abad ke-4 hingga ke-9 ditemukan di Thailand dan mirip dengan arca di India kuno, dan sebagian kuil Wisnu besar tertua di India berasal dari masa Kekaisaran Gupta.
long_description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is the foremost god of Vaishnavism, which it describes as the largest Hindu sect, and has three wives, Lakshmi, Sarasvati and Ganga, the latter two eventually sent to Brahma and Shiva. According to Wikipedia, statues of four-armed Vishnu from the 4th to 9th century have been found in Thailand and mirror those of ancient India, and some of the earliest surviving grand Vishnu temples in India date from the Gupta Empire period.

claims.quote: In benevolent aspects, he is depicted as an omniscient being sleeping on the coils of the serpent Shesha (who represents time) floating in the primeval ocean of milk called Kshira Sagara with his consort, Lakshmi.

statement.id: Dalam aspek welas asihnya Wisnu digambarkan berbaring di atas lilitan ular Sesha di samudra susu purba Kshira Sagara bersama Lakshmi.
statement.en: In benevolent aspects Vishnu is shown lying on the coils of the serpent Shesha in the primeval ocean of milk, Kshira Sagara, with Lakshmi.

claims.quote: Whenever the world is threatened with evil, chaos, and destructive forces, Vishnu descends in the form of an avatar (incarnation) to restore the cosmic order and protect dharma. The Dashavatara are the ten primary avatars of Vishnu. Of these ten, Rama and Krishna are the most worshipped

statement.id: Setiap kali dunia terancam kejahatan dan kekacauan, Wisnu turun sebagai awatara untuk memulihkan tatanan kosmis dan melindungi dharma; Dashavatara adalah sepuluh awatara utamanya, dan Rama serta Kresna paling banyak dipuja.
statement.en: Whenever the world is threatened by evil and chaos, Vishnu descends as an avatar to restore cosmic order and protect dharma; the Dashavatara are his ten primary avatars, Rama and Krishna the most worshipped.

claims.quote: Vishnu (also spelled Viṣṇu, Sanskrit: विष्णु) means 'all pervasive'

statement.id: Nama Wisnu (विष्णु, juga ditulis Viṣṇu) berarti 'meliputi segala'.
statement.en: The name Vishnu (Sanskrit: विष्णु, also spelled Viṣṇu) means 'all pervasive'.

claims.quote: Vishnu is the Preserver and guardian of men, he protects the order of things (dharma), and he appears on earth in various incarnations (avatars) to fight demons and to maintain cosmic harmony.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu adalah pemelihara dan pelindung manusia yang menjaga dharma dan muncul di bumi dalam berbagai awatara untuk melawan raksasa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is the Preserver and guardian of humanity who protects dharma and appears on earth in various avatars to fight demons.

claims.quote: To mix the ocean they decided to use the holy Mt. Mandara with the giant serpent Vasuki (or Ananta) as a turning rope; one end to be pulled by Demons and the other by the gods. However, neither group could handle such a weight and they called for Vishnu to hold it. This he did in the form of Kurma, the giant tortoise, supporting the mountain on his shell.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, untuk mengaduk samudra para dewa dan raksasa memakai Gunung Mandara dengan ular raksasa Vasuki (atau Ananta) sebagai tali, tetapi tidak sanggup menahan bebannya sehingga memanggil Wisnu, yang menopang gunung itu di punggungnya dalam wujud Kurma, kura-kura raksasa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, to churn the ocean the gods and demons used Mount Mandara with the giant serpent Vasuki (or Ananta) as a rope, but could not handle its weight and called on Vishnu, who held the mountain on his shell in the form of Kurma, the giant tortoise.

claims.quote: according to Medhātith (c. 1000 CE), 'one who is everything and inside everything'

statement.id: Menurut Medhātith (sekitar 1000 M), Wisnu berarti 'yang adalah segalanya dan berada di dalam segalanya'.
statement.en: According to Medhātith (c. 1000 CE), Vishnu means 'one who is everything and inside everything'.

claims.quote: In Thailand, for example, statues of four-armed Vishnu have been found in provinces near Malaysia and dated to be from the 4th to 9th-century, and this mirror those found in ancient India.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, di Thailand ditemukan patung Wisnu berlengan empat di provinsi dekat Malaysia yang berasal dari abad ke-4 hingga ke-9, dan patung itu mirip dengan yang ditemukan di India kuno.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, statues of four-armed Vishnu found in Thai provinces near Malaysia date from the 4th to 9th century and mirror those found in ancient India.

claims.quote: Some of the earliest surviving grand Vishnu temples in India have been dated to the Gupta Empire period.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, sebagian kuil Wisnu besar tertua yang masih bertahan di India berasal dari masa Kekaisaran Gupta.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, some of the earliest surviving grand Vishnu temples in India have been dated to the Gupta Empire period.

claims.quote: Vishnu is the most important god of Vaishnavism, the largest Hindu sect. Indeed, to illustrate Vishnu's superior status, Brahma is, in some accounts, considered to have been born from a lotus flower which grew from Vishnu's naval.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu adalah dewa terpenting Waisnawa, sekte Hindu terbesar; sebagai tanda kedudukannya yang unggul, dalam beberapa kisah Brahma dianggap lahir dari bunga teratai yang tumbuh dari pusar Wisnu.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is the most important god of Vaishnavism, the largest Hindu sect; to illustrate his superior status, in some accounts Brahma is born from a lotus flower that grew from Vishnu's navel.

claims.quote: Vishnu was married to Lakshmi (the goddess of good fortune), Sarawati (the goddess of wisdom) and Ganga (the goddess who is the personification of the River Ganges). However, unable to live with the quarrels between his three wives, Vishnu eventually sent Ganga to Shiva and Sarawati to Brahma.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu menikah dengan Lakshmi (dewi keberuntungan), Sarasvati (dewi kebijaksanaan), dan Ganga (personifikasi Sungai Gangga), tetapi karena pertengkaran istri-istrinya ia mengirim Ganga kepada Siwa dan Sarasvati kepada Brahma.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu was married to Lakshmi (goddess of good fortune), Sarawati (goddess of wisdom) and Ganga (personification of the River Ganges), but unable to bear their quarrels he sent Ganga to Shiva and Sarawati to Brahma.

claims.quote: He is considered to live in the city of Vaikuntha on Mt. Meru, where everything is made of shining gold and fabulous jewels and where there are lakes resplendent with lotus flowers.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu dianggap tinggal di kota Vaikuntha di Gunung Meru, tempat segalanya terbuat dari emas berkilau dan permata, dengan danau-danau yang dipenuhi teratai.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is considered to live in the city of Vaikuntha on Mt. Meru, where everything is made of shining gold and jewels and lakes are resplendent with lotus flowers.

claims.quote: Vishnu has ten avatars or worldly appearances, which are people, animals or a mix of both.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu memiliki sepuluh awatara atau penampakan duniawi, berupa manusia, hewan, atau campuran keduanya.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu has ten avatars or worldly appearances, which are people, animals or a mix of both.

claims.quote: As Varaha, the gigantic boar, he defeated the giant Daitya after Hiranyaksha had mischievously taken the Earth (Bhumi-devi) to the bottom of the sea. The incredible fight between the two lasted for a thousand years but Vishnu prevailed and finally raised the Earth from the watery depths, carrying it on his tusk.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, sebagai Varaha, babi hutan raksasa, Wisnu mengalahkan raksasa Daitya setelah Hiranyaksha membawa Bumi (Bhumi-devi) ke dasar laut; setelah pertarungan seribu tahun, Wisnu menang dan mengangkat Bumi dari kedalaman dengan taringnya.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, as Varaha, the gigantic boar, Vishnu defeated the giant Daitya after Hiranyaksha took the Earth (Bhumi-devi) to the bottom of the sea; after a fight lasting a thousand years Vishnu prevailed and raised the Earth from the depths on his tusk.

claims.quote: Fortunately, Vishnu interceded in the form of the beautiful Maya (the personification of Illusion) and, suitably distracted, the Demons relinquished the nectar which Vishnu graciously gave to the gods, allowing them the possibility of immortality.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu menjelma Maya yang jelita (personifikasi Ilusi) hingga para raksasa terpedaya dan melepaskan nektar, yang lalu ia berikan kepada para dewa sehingga mereka berpeluang hidup abadi.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu took the form of the beautiful Maya (the personification of Illusion), so that the distracted Demons relinquished the nectar, which he gave to the gods, allowing them the possibility of immortality.

claims.quote: Vishnu appears as another avatar in the form of the fish Matsya. Manu, the sage and son of Vivsavat-Sun, was washing in a river one day when a small fish suddenly jumped into his hand. ... Vishnu then reappeared on the scene as the gigantic fish, this time with golden scales and a single horn, and carrying the promised ship for Manu.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu muncul sebagai awatara ikan Matsya yang melompat ke tangan Manu; kelak ia tampil sebagai ikan raksasa bersisik emas dan bertanduk satu yang membawa kapal bagi Manu.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu appears as the avatar of the fish Matsya, who jumped into the hand of Manu; later he reappears as the gigantic fish with golden scales and a single horn carrying the promised ship for Manu.

claims.quote: Vishnu was persuaded by the gods to interrupt his meditations and confront the giant warrior Bali, which he did in the form of a dwarf Brahman (or priest) called Vamana. ... with his first step he cleared the sky, with the second the Earth and, with his final step, the Underworld, thus leaving nothing for the poor giants.
claims.locator: The Legend of the Three Steps

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu menghadapi pahlawan raksasa Bali dalam wujud brahmana kerdil bernama Vamana; dengan langkah pertama ia melintasi langit, dengan yang kedua Bumi, dan dengan yang terakhir Dunia Bawah, sehingga tak ada yang tersisa bagi para raksasa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu confronted the giant warrior Bali as a dwarf Brahman called Vamana; with his first step he cleared the sky, with the second the Earth and with the last the Underworld, leaving nothing for the giants.

claims.quote: For this reason, Vishnu is often also called Trivikrama, meaning 'of the three steps'.
claims.locator: The Legend of the Three Steps

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu sering pula disebut Trivikrama, yang berarti 'yang bertiga langkah'.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is often also called Trivikrama, meaning 'of the three steps'.

claims.quote: Vishnu appeared as the man-lion Nara-Simha when Hiranya-Kasipu (King of the Asuras or Demons) not only impiously called for people to worship him as a god but also foolishly challenged Vishnu to show himself there and then if the god really were omnipresent.
claims.locator: The Legend of the Three Steps

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu tampil sebagai manusia-singa Nara-Simha ketika Hiranya-Kasipu, Raja Asura, menyerukan agar orang menyembahnya sebagai dewa dan menantang Wisnu menunjukkan diri jika benar mahahadir.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu appeared as the man-lion Nara-Simha when Hiranya-Kasipu, King of the Asuras, called on people to worship him as a god and challenged Vishnu to show himself if he were really omnipresent.

claims.quote: he is most often depicted coloured blue and sometimes rides Garuda, a gigantic half-man, half-bird creature which devours snakes.
claims.locator: How is Vishnu Representated in Art?

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Hindu Wisnu paling sering digambarkan berwarna biru dan kadang menunggang Garuda, makhluk raksasa setengah manusia setengah burung yang memangsa ular.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in Hindu art Vishnu is most often depicted coloured blue and sometimes rides Garuda, a gigantic half-man, half-bird creature that devours snakes.

claims.quote: His weapon is the Sudarsanacakra or discus (chakra), perhaps representative of his association with the sun but also, with its thousand spokes, symbolic of the wheel of time. He often holds various other objects in his (usually) four hands such as a conch shell trumpet which sounds the Creation, a mace (gada) or a sword which represents strength, and a lotus
claims.locator: How is Vishnu Representated in Art?

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, senjata Wisnu adalah cakram Sudarsanacakra, mungkin lambang kaitannya dengan matahari dan roda waktu; di keempat tangannya ia sering memegang kerang sangkakala penanda Penciptaan, gada atau pedang lambang kekuatan, dan teratai.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu's weapon is the Sudarsanacakra discus, perhaps representing his link with the sun and the wheel of time; in his usually four hands he often holds a conch shell trumpet that sounds the Creation, a mace or sword representing strength, and a lotus.

claims.quote: Certainly, Vishnu was associated with the sun, as one of his other names suggests - Surya Narayana.
claims.locator: The Legend of the Three Steps

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu dikaitkan dengan matahari, seperti ditunjukkan salah satu namanya yang lain, Surya Narayana.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu was associated with the sun, as one of his other names, Surya Narayana, suggests.

claims.quote: Whatever is generated by any living being, O twice-born one—the agent is considered as a portion of Hari. And whatever destroys any living being, moveable or immoveable, is considered as the destroying portion of Janārddana as Rudra. In this wise Janārddana is the creator, preserver and destroyer of the universe.

statement.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, apa pun yang dilahirkan makhluk hidup dianggap bagian Hari, dan apa pun yang membinasakan makhluk dianggap bagian Janārddana sebagai Rudra; dengan demikian Janārddana adalah pencipta, pemelihara, dan pelebur alam semesta.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, whatever is generated by a living being is considered a portion of Hari, and whatever destroys a living being the destroying portion of Janārddana as Rudra; in this way Janārddana is the creator, preserver and destroyer of the universe.

claims.quote: And, O mighty ascetic, remaining in the midst of the Milky sea in the shape of a tortoise, the revered Hari himself became the support of the churning-stick.
claims.locator: Vishnu Purana, Book I (Churning of the Milky sea)

statement.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, Hari sendiri, dalam wujud kura-kura di tengah Lautan Susu, menjadi penopang tongkat pengaduk.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, the revered Hari himself, in the shape of a tortoise in the midst of the Milky sea, became the support of the churning-stick.

claims.quote: Having thus recited the prayer the celestials beheld Hari the supreme lord of all, seated on Garuda, armed with the shell, the discus, and the mace.
claims.locator: Vishnu Purana, Book III (prayer of the celestials)

statement.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, para dewa melihat Hari, penguasa tertinggi segalanya, duduk di atas Garuda dengan kerang, cakram, dan gada.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, the celestials behold Hari, the supreme lord of all, seated on Garuda, armed with the shell, the discus and the mace.

presentation_revision_history.prompt: Edit only the crown of this Vishnu image: REMOVE the PEACOCK FEATHER completely and replace that tiny crown-top area with plain gold jewelwork or unobstructed background. Preserve exactly the same four arms, discus, conch, mace, lotus, blue skin, gold Vaikuntha, solar radiance, clothing, framing, painterly style and every other detail. The source supports four attributes vishnu-c22, blue skin c21, Vaikuntha c13 and solar association c23, but does not support a peacock feather for this Vishnu. No words or watermark.
presentation_revision_history.depicted_variant: Four-armed blue Vishnu bearing discus, conch, mace and lotus in Vaikuntha, with solar-domain radiance.

visual_requirements.description: VISHNU, respectful majestic Hindu Preserver, living blue-skinned deity exactly FOUR ARMS and one head. Each separate hand holds one clearly distinct object: Sudarsana discus, conch shell, heavy mace and lotus (c21,c22). Stands protectively on a lotus platform overlooking the magnificent shining gold and jewel city Vaikuntha with lotus lakes on Mount Meru (c13). Crown and modest traditional opaque robes; benevolent commanding gaze. Spectacular warm SOLAR RADIANCE emphasizes his documented solar association Surya Narayana (c23), source-supported illumination rather than invented attack or sci-fi beams. Low-angle monumental form above tiny distant gold palaces, readable hands, all four attributes visible, rich brushwork.

presentation_revision_history.aura: Four-armed blue Vishnu bearing discus, conch, mace and lotus in Vaikuntha, with solar-domain radiance.

visual_review.notes: Four arms with conch, disk, mace and lotus; no peacock feather. Blue skin, golden radiant cosmic scale, living figure.

root_visual_review.notes: Four-armed blue Vishnu holding discus, conch, mace and lotus in radiant Vaikuntha; iconography correct, respectful and majestic.

presentation_revision.rationale: Big names (major gods, archangels, demon princes, primordial monsters, famous literary beings) must look imposing and powerful: an epic, awe-inspiring or terrifying presence that matches their standing in the tradition.

cultural_context.id: Menurut theoi.com, di orakel kuno Dodona para imam Zeus terilhami desir daun ek, dan di Olimpiade para pemenang dimahkotai karangan daun zaitun dari hutan suci sang dewa.
cultural_context.en: According to theoi.com, at the ancient oracle of Dodona the priests of Zeus drew inspiration from the sound of oak foliage, while Olympic victors wore wreaths of olive taken from the god's sacred grove.

literal_meaning.id: dewa langit siang
literal_meaning.en: god of the daytime sky

who.id: Raja para dewa Yunani.
who.en: King of the Greek gods.

origin.id: Agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno.
origin.en: Ancient Greek religion and mythology.

role.id: Raja para dewa dan penguasa langit, cuaca, hukum, dan ketertiban.
role.en: King of the gods and ruler of sky, weather, law and order.

famous_for.id: Petirnya, kemenangannya atas para Titan, Giant, dan Typhoeus, serta banyak petualangan cintanya.
famous_for.en: His thunderbolt, his victories over the Titans, Giants and Typhoeus, and his many love affairs.

did_you_know.id: Di Olimpiade kuno, para pemenang dimahkotai karangan daun zaitun yang dipetik dari hutan suci Zeus.
did_you_know.en: In the ancient Olympic Games, winners wore wreaths of olive taken from the sacred grove of Zeus.

description.id: Menurut theoi.com ia dewa langit dan cuaca, dan menurut World History Encyclopedia ia mengendalikan cuaca.
description.en: According to theoi.com he is god of sky and weather, and according to the World History Encyclopedia he controlled the weather.

description.id: Para Kyklopes mempersenjatai Zeus dengan petir, yang ia genggam seperti lembing; dengan petir mematikannya ia menjatuhkan raja para Giant.
description.en: The Kyklopes armed Zeus with lightning-bolts, which he wields like a javelin; with his deadly lightning-bolts he laid low the king of the Giants.

description.id: Merayu perempuan fana dan Hera dalam berbagai rupa, seperti angsa, banteng, hujan emas, dan burung kukuk.
description.en: Seduced mortal women and Hera in various guises, such as a swan, a bull, a shower of gold and a cuckoo-bird.

description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Zeus memberi tanda dan pertanda.
description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Zeus offered signs and omens.

description.id: Dalam pertarungan dengan Typhoeus, Zeus dikalahkan dan otot-otot kakinya dirobek hingga tak berdaya, sampai Pan mencuri kembali kekuatannya.
description.en: In combat with Typhoeus, Zeus was defeated and the sinews torn from his limbs, leaving him helpless until Pan stole back his strength.

summary.id: Rhea menyelamatkan Zeus dari Kronos dengan memberinya batu berbalut kain; Zeus dibesarkan di Gunung Dikte, Kreta, lalu memaksa Kronos memuntahkan saudara-saudaranya.
summary.en: Rhea saved Zeus from Cronus by handing him a swaddled stone; Zeus grew up on Mount Dikte, Crete, then forced Cronus to disgorge his siblings.

summary.id: Setelah dewasa Zeus merekrut Metis untuk membuat Kronos memuntahkan saudara-saudaranya, membebaskan para raksasa dari Tartaros, dan dengan petir dari para Kyklopes serta lemparan batu para Hekatonkheires mengalahkan Kronos dan sekutunya, yang dibuang ke penjara di bawah bumi. Sesudahnya ia dan saudara-saudaranya mengundi kekuasaan: Zeus mendapat langit, Poseidon laut, dan Haides dunia bawah.
summary.en: On coming of age Zeus recruited Metis to make Kronos disgorge his siblings, freed the giants from Tartaros and, with lightning from the Kyklopes and boulders from the Hekatonkheires, defeated Kronos and his allies, who were banished to a prison beneath the earth. Afterwards he and his brothers cast lots to share the universe among them, and he received the sky, Poseidon the ocean and Haides the world below.

role.en: Father who swallowed the child's mother

summary.id: Zeus menelan Metis yang sedang hamil setelah ramalan menyatakan putranya akan menggantikannya; Athena lahir di perutnya dan keluar langsung dari kepalanya.
summary.en: Zeus swallowed the pregnant Metis after an oracle said her son would replace him; Athena was born in his belly and birthed directly from his head.

summary.id: Prometheus memberi manusia api yang dicuri dari para dewa; Zeus menghukum dengan memerintahkan penciptaan Pandora, yang dikirim ke bumi membawa bejana penuh malapetaka.
summary.en: Prometheus gave mankind fire stolen from the gods; Zeus punished this by ordering the creation of Pandora, sent to earth with a vessel full of troubles.

summary.id: Zeus memutuskan menghapus manusia yang bejat dengan banjir besar; hanya Deukalion dan Pyrrha yang diselamatkan dan mengisi kembali dunia dengan batu yang menjelma manusia.
summary.en: Zeus decided to wipe out wicked mankind with a great deluge; only Deukalion and Pyrrha were spared, repopulating the world with stones that turned into men.

summary.id: Atas dorongan Gaia para Giant mengepung benteng Olimpos, tetapi Zeus menjatuhkan raja mereka dan banyak lainnya dengan petirnya.
summary.en: At Gaia's urging the Giants besieged the fortress of Olympos, but Zeus laid low their king and many others with his lightning-bolts.

role.en: God who loses and then wins

summary.id: Typhoeus menyerang Olimpos dan mengalahkan Zeus dengan merobek otot-otot kakinya. Pan mencuri kembali kekuatan Zeus, yang kemudian menang dan mengurung Typhoeus di bawah Gunung Etna.
summary.en: Typhoeus attacked Olympos and defeated Zeus by tearing the sinews from his limbs. Pan stole back Zeus's strength, and Zeus then won and bound Typhoeus beneath Mount Etna.

summary.id: Zeus menghukum Tantalos, Lykaon, Ixion, dan Salmoneus karena kedurhakaan dan kejahatan mereka terhadap para dewa.
summary.en: Zeus punished Tantalos, Lykaon, Ixion and Salmoneus for their impiety and crimes against the gods.

description.id: Tempat Zeus memerintah sebagai raja para dewa.
description.en: Where Zeus rules as king of the gods.

description.id: Tempat Zeus dibesarkan secara rahasia.
description.en: Where Zeus was raised in secret.

description.id: Tempat Zeus mengurung Typhoeus setelah mengalahkannya.
description.en: Where Zeus bound Typhoeus after defeating him.

description.id: Orakel kuno tempat para imam Zeus terilhami desir daun ek.
description.en: The ancient oracle where the priests of Zeus were inspired by the rustling of oak-leaves.

note.id: Saudari sekaligus istri Zeus; menurut theoi.com ia dirayu dalam rupa burung kukuk.
note.en: Zeus's sister and wife; according to theoi.com he seduced her in the guise of a cuckoo-bird.

note.id: Ayah Zeus, yang menelan anak-anaknya begitu lahir.
note.en: Zeus's father, who devoured his children as they were born.

note.id: Ibu Zeus.
note.en: Zeus's mother.

note.id: Saudara Zeus yang memperoleh kekuasaan atas laut.
note.en: Zeus's brother, who won rule of the sea.

note.id: Saudara Zeus yang memperoleh kekuasaan atas dunia bawah (Haides).
note.en: Zeus's brother, who won rule of the underworld (Haides).

note.id: Putri Zeus dan Metis, lahir dari kepala Zeus.
note.en: Daughter of Zeus and Metis, birthed from Zeus's head.

note.id: Dewi yang direkrut Zeus lalu ditelannya.
note.en: The goddess Zeus recruited and then swallowed.

note.id: Putra fana kesayangan Zeus, yang diterima di Olimpos sebagai dewa.
note.en: Zeus's favorite mortal son, welcomed to Olympos as a god.

note.id: Putra Zeus yang juga menjadi juru bicara pribadinya.
note.en: A son of Zeus who also served as his personal herald.

note.id: Zeus menghukum Prometheus karena mencuri api bagi manusia.
note.en: Zeus punished Prometheus for giving stolen fire to mankind.

note.id: Raksasa yang menyerang Olimpos dan mengalahkan Zeus sementara.
note.en: The giant who attacked Olympos and temporarily defeated Zeus.

note.id: Para Giant yang mengepung Olimpos atas dorongan Gaia.
note.en: The Giants who besieged Olympos at Gaia's urging.

note.id: Dewa Roma kuno yang disamakan dengan Zeus.
note.en: The god of ancient Rome identified with Zeus.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa banyak bangsa kuno menjadikan dewa langit sebagai raja para dewa?
learning_questions.en: Why did many ancient peoples make a sky god the king of the gods?

learning_questions.id: Mengapa dalam mitos Zeus bisa dikalahkan sementara oleh Typhoeus meski ia raja para dewa?
learning_questions.en: Why, in myth, can Zeus be temporarily defeated by Typhoeus even though he is king of the gods?

shows.en: The marble so-called Zeus of Otricoli, a Roman copy after a 4th-century Greek original.

summary.id: Wikipedia: dalam kebanyakan tradisi Hera biasanya dikatakan melahirkan Ares, Eileithyia, Hebe, dan Hefaistos.
summary.en: Wikipedia: in most traditions Hera is usually said to have borne Ares, Eileithyia, Hebe and Hephaestus.

summary.en: theoi.com: Zeus and Hera had three children, namely Ares, Hebe and Eileithyia.
