short_description.id: Zeus adalah dewa tertinggi dalam jajaran dewa Yunani, dewa langit dan guntur yang memerintah sebagai raja para dewa di Gunung Olimpus dan menggenggam petir sebagai senjatanya.
short_description.en: Zeus is the supreme deity of the Greek pantheon, a sky and thunder god who rules as king of the gods on Mount Olympus and wields the lightning bolt as his weapon.

long_description.id: Zeus adalah dewa tertinggi dalam jajaran dewa Yunani, dewa langit dan guntur dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno yang memerintah sebagai raja para dewa di Gunung Olimpus. Menurut theoi.com, ia dewa langit, cuaca, hukum dan ketertiban, takdir, serta kekuasaan raja, digambarkan sebagai laki-laki dewasa berwibawa berjanggut gelap, dengan atribut petir, tongkat kerajaan, dan elang. Di Roma kuno, Zeus disamakan dengan Jupiter.
long_description.en: Zeus stands at the head of the Greek pantheon: god of the sky and of thunder in ancient Greek religion and myth, reigning over the gods from Mount Olympus. Theoi.com describes him as lord of sky, weather, law and order, destiny and kingship, shown as a dignified bearded man in his prime holding a thunderbolt and sceptre, with an eagle. In ancient Rome he was equated with Jupiter.

long_description.id: Zeus adalah putra Titan Kronos dan Rheia. Kronos menelan setiap anaknya begitu lahir, tetapi Rhea menyelamatkan Zeus dengan memberi Kronos sebuah batu berbalut kain. Menurut theoi.com, Zeus dibesarkan diam-diam di Gunung Dikte di Kreta dan diasuh para nimfa dengan susu kambing Amaltheia. Setelah dewasa ia merekrut dewi Metis, yang menyuguhkan ramuan ajaib kepada Kronos sehingga Kronos memuntahkan para dewa muda yang telah ditelannya.
long_description.en: Zeus is the child of the Titans Kronos and Rheia. Kronos swallowed each child at birth, but Rhea saved Zeus by giving Kronos a stone wrapped in swaddling cloth. According to theoi.com, Zeus was raised in secret on Mount Dikte in Crete, nursed by nymphs on the milk of the goat Amaltheia. On coming of age he recruited the goddess Metis, who served Kronos a magical draught that made him disgorge the young gods he had devoured.

long_description.id: Kekuasaannya diperoleh melalui perang. Menurut theoi.com, Zeus membebaskan para raksasa dari Tartaros, dipersenjatai petir oleh para Kyklopes, dan dibantu para Hekatonkheires mengalahkan Kronos dan para Titan. Zeus dan saudara-saudaranya lalu mengundi kekuasaan atas kosmos: Zeus mendapat langit, Poseidon laut, dan Haides dunia bawah. Ia kemudian menjatuhkan raja para Giant dengan petirnya, dan sempat dikalahkan Typhoeus sebelum Pan mencuri kembali kekuatannya sehingga Zeus menang dan mengurung raksasa itu di bawah Gunung Etna.
long_description.en: His rule was won through war. According to theoi.com, Zeus freed the giants from Tartaros, was armed with lightning-bolts by the Kyklopes and, aided by the Hekatonkheires, defeated Kronos and the Titans. Zeus and his brothers then cast lots to share out the universe, and Zeus received the sky, Poseidon the ocean and Haides the world below. He later laid low the king of the Giants with his lightning, and was for a time defeated by Typhoeus until Pan stole back his strength, so that Zeus won and bound the monster beneath Mount Etna.

long_description.id: Dalam kebanyakan tradisi, Zeus menikah dengan Hera, saudarinya, yang menurut theoi.com ia rayu dalam rupa burung kukuk. Ia juga terkenal karena banyak petualangan cintanya, yang melahirkan banyak keturunan ilahi dan pahlawan, termasuk Apollo, Artemis, Hermes, Persephone, Dionysus, Perseus, dan Herakles; menurut theoi.com ia merayu banyak perempuan fana dalam berbagai samaran, seperti angsa untuk Leda dan banteng untuk Europa. Athena lahir dari Metis, yang ditelan Zeus setelah ramalan menyatakan putranya akan menggantikannya, dan keluar dari kepala Zeus.
long_description.en: In most traditions Zeus is married to Hera, his sister, whom according to theoi.com he seduced in the guise of a cuckoo-bird. He was also infamous for his many love affairs, which produced numerous divine and heroic offspring, including Apollo, Artemis, Hermes, Persephone, Dionysus, Perseus and Heracles; according to theoi.com he seduced many mortal women in various disguises, such as a swan for Leda and a bull for Europa. Athena was born of Metis, whom Zeus swallowed after an oracle said her son would replace him, and emerged from Zeus's head.

long_description.id: Menurut theoi.com, atribut Zeus yang paling khas adalah petir yang ia genggam seperti lembing, disertai tongkat kerajaan, takhta, elang, Nike mini, dan aigis. Hewan sucinya adalah elang dan banteng, dan tanaman sucinya adalah pohon ek holm dan zaitun; di orakel Dodona para imamnya terilhami desir daun ek, dan di Olimpiade para pemenang dimahkotai daun zaitun dari hutan sucinya. Takhtanya dijaga Kratos, Zelos, Nike, dan Bia, dan Hermes menjadi juru bicara pribadinya.
long_description.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus's most distinctive attribute was the lightning bolt he wielded like a javelin, together with a royal sceptre, a throne, an eagle, a miniature Nike and the aigis. His sacred animals were the eagle and the bull, and his sacred plants the holm oak and the olive; at the Dodona oracle his priests drew inspiration from the sound of oak foliage, while victors at the Olympic Games wore wreaths of olive from the god's sacred grove. His throne was guarded by Kratos, Zelos, Nike and Bia, and Hermes served as his personal herald.

long_description.id: Zeus juga menegakkan keadilan dan hukuman. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia raja kedua belas dewa Olimpus; ia mengendalikan cuaca, memberi tanda dan pertanda, dan menegakkan keadilan serta ketertiban dari Gunung Olimpus. Menurut theoi.com, ia menghukum Prometheus yang memberi manusia api curian dengan mengirim Pandora ke bumi, memutuskan menghapus manusia yang bejat dengan banjir besar sambil menyelamatkan Deukalion dan Pyrrha, dan menghukum Tantalos, Lykaon, Ixion, dan Salmoneus.
long_description.en: Zeus was also an enforcer of justice and punishment. According to the World History Encyclopedia, he was king of the twelve Olympian gods; he controlled the weather, offered signs and omens, and dispensed justice and order from Mount Olympus. According to theoi.com he punished Prometheus, who gave mankind stolen fire, by sending Pandora to earth, decided to wipe wicked mankind out with a great deluge while sparing Deukalion and Pyrrha, and punished Tantalos, Lykaon, Ixion and Salmoneus.

claims.quote: His throne was guarded by four winged spirits, two male and two female, named Kratos (Strength), Zelos (Rivalry), Nike (Victory) and Bia (Force).

statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' throne was guarded by four winged spirits, two male and two female, named Kratos (Strength), Zelos (Rivalry), Nike (Victory) and Bia (Force).

statement.en: According to theoi.com, Hermes was Zeus' personal herald, acting as diplomat, envoy and general agent of the god's will.

summary.id: Setelah dewasa Zeus merekrut Metis untuk membuat Kronos memuntahkan saudara-saudaranya, membebaskan para raksasa dari Tartaros, dan dengan petir dari para Kyklopes serta lemparan batu para Hekatonkheires mengalahkan Kronos dan sekutunya, yang dibuang ke penjara di bawah bumi. Sesudahnya ia dan saudara-saudaranya mengundi kekuasaan: Zeus mendapat langit, Poseidon laut, dan Haides dunia bawah.
summary.en: On coming of age Zeus recruited Metis to make Kronos disgorge his siblings, freed the giants from Tartaros and, with lightning from the Kyklopes and boulders from the Hekatonkheires, defeated Kronos and his allies, who were banished to a prison beneath the earth. short_description.id: Zeus adalah dewa tertinggi dalam jajaran dewa Yunani, dewa langit dan guntur yang memerintah sebagai raja para dewa di Gunung Olimpus dan menggenggam petir sebagai senjatanya.
short_description.en: Zeus is the supreme deity of the Greek pantheon, a sky and thunder god who rules as king of the gods on Mount Olympus and wields the lightning bolt as his weapon.

long_description.id: Zeus adalah dewa tertinggi dalam jajaran dewa Yunani, dewa langit dan guntur dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno yang memerintah sebagai raja para dewa di Gunung Olimpus. Menurut theoi.com, ia dewa langit, cuaca, hukum dan ketertiban, takdir, serta kekuasaan raja, digambarkan sebagai laki-laki dewasa berwibawa berjanggut gelap, dengan atribut petir, tongkat kerajaan, dan elang. Di Roma kuno, Zeus disamakan dengan Jupiter.
long_description.en: Zeus stands at the head of the Greek pantheon: god of the sky and of thunder in ancient Greek religion and myth, reigning over the gods from Mount Olympus. Theoi.com describes him as lord of sky, weather, law and order, destiny and kingship, shown as a dignified bearded man in his prime holding a thunderbolt and sceptre, with an eagle. In ancient Rome he was equated with Jupiter.

long_description.id: Zeus adalah putra Titan Kronos dan Rheia. Kronos menelan setiap anaknya begitu lahir, tetapi Rhea menyelamatkan Zeus dengan memberi Kronos sebuah batu berbalut kain. Menurut theoi.com, Zeus dibesarkan diam-diam di Gunung Dikte di Kreta dan diasuh para nimfa dengan susu kambing Amaltheia. Setelah dewasa ia merekrut dewi Metis, yang menyuguhkan ramuan ajaib kepada Kronos sehingga Kronos memuntahkan para dewa muda yang telah ditelannya.
long_description.en: Zeus is the child of the Titans Kronos and Rheia. Kronos swallowed each child at birth, but Rhea saved Zeus by giving Kronos a stone wrapped in swaddling cloth. According to theoi.com, Zeus was raised in secret on Mount Dikte in Crete, nursed by nymphs on the milk of the goat Amaltheia. On coming of age he recruited the goddess Metis, who served Kronos a magical draught that made him disgorge the young gods he had devoured.

long_description.id: Kekuasaannya diperoleh melalui perang. Menurut theoi.com, Zeus membebaskan para raksasa dari Tartaros, dipersenjatai petir oleh para Kyklopes, dan dibantu para Hekatonkheires mengalahkan Kronos dan para Titan. Zeus dan saudara-saudaranya lalu mengundi kekuasaan atas kosmos: Zeus mendapat langit, Poseidon laut, dan Haides dunia bawah. Ia kemudian menjatuhkan raja para Giant dengan petirnya, dan sempat dikalahkan Typhoeus sebelum Pan mencuri kembali kekuatannya sehingga Zeus menang dan mengurung raksasa itu di bawah Gunung Etna.
long_description.en: His rule was won through war. According to theoi.com, Zeus freed the giants from Tartaros, was armed with lightning-bolts by the Kyklopes and, aided by the Hekatonkheires, defeated Kronos and the Titans. Zeus and his brothers then cast lots to share out the universe, and Zeus received the sky, Poseidon the ocean and Haides the world below. He later laid low the king of the Giants with his lightning, and was for a time defeated by Typhoeus until Pan stole back his strength, so that Zeus won and bound the monster beneath Mount Etna.

long_description.id: Dalam kebanyakan tradisi, Zeus menikah dengan Hera, saudarinya, yang menurut theoi.com ia rayu dalam rupa burung kukuk. Ia juga terkenal karena banyak petualangan cintanya, yang melahirkan banyak keturunan ilahi dan pahlawan, termasuk Apollo, Artemis, Hermes, Persephone, Dionysus, Perseus, dan Herakles; menurut theoi.com ia merayu banyak perempuan fana dalam berbagai samaran, seperti angsa untuk Leda dan banteng untuk Europa. Athena lahir dari Metis, yang ditelan Zeus setelah ramalan menyatakan putranya akan menggantikannya, dan keluar dari kepala Zeus.
long_description.en: In most traditions Zeus is married to Hera, his sister, whom according to theoi.com he seduced in the guise of a cuckoo-bird. He was also infamous for his many love affairs, which produced numerous divine and heroic offspring, including Apollo, Artemis, Hermes, Persephone, Dionysus, Perseus and Heracles; according to theoi.com he seduced many mortal women in various disguises, such as a swan for Leda and a bull for Europa. Athena was born of Metis, whom Zeus swallowed after an oracle said her son would replace him, and emerged from Zeus's head.

long_description.id: Menurut theoi.com, atribut Zeus yang paling khas adalah petir yang ia genggam seperti lembing, disertai tongkat kerajaan, takhta, elang, Nike mini, dan aigis. Hewan sucinya adalah elang dan banteng, dan tanaman sucinya adalah pohon ek holm dan zaitun; di orakel Dodona para imamnya terilhami desir daun ek, dan di Olimpiade para pemenang dimahkotai daun zaitun dari hutan sucinya. Takhtanya dijaga Kratos, Zelos, Nike, dan Bia, dan Hermes menjadi juru bicara pribadinya.
long_description.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus's most distinctive attribute was the lightning bolt he wielded like a javelin, together with a royal sceptre, a throne, an eagle, a miniature Nike and the aigis. His sacred animals were the eagle and the bull, and his sacred plants the holm oak and the olive; at the Dodona oracle his priests drew inspiration from the sound of oak foliage, while victors at the Olympic Games wore wreaths of olive from the god's sacred grove. His throne was guarded by Kratos, Zelos, Nike and Bia, and Hermes served as his personal herald.

long_description.id: Zeus juga menegakkan keadilan dan hukuman. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia raja kedua belas dewa Olimpus; ia mengendalikan cuaca, memberi tanda dan pertanda, dan menegakkan keadilan serta ketertiban dari Gunung Olimpus. Menurut theoi.com, ia menghukum Prometheus yang memberi manusia api curian dengan mengirim Pandora ke bumi, memutuskan menghapus manusia yang bejat dengan banjir besar sambil menyelamatkan Deukalion dan Pyrrha, dan menghukum Tantalos, Lykaon, Ixion, dan Salmoneus.
long_description.en: Zeus was also an enforcer of justice and punishment. According to the World History Encyclopedia, he was king of the twelve Olympian gods; he controlled the weather, offered signs and omens, and dispensed justice and order from Mount Olympus. According to theoi.com he punished Prometheus, who gave mankind stolen fire, by sending Pandora to earth, decided to wipe wicked mankind out with a great deluge while sparing Deukalion and Pyrrha, and punished Tantalos, Lykaon, Ixion and Salmoneus.

claims.quote: The early generations of man descended into wickedness and corruption and Zeus decided to wipe them from the face of the earth with a great deluge. One virtuous couple, Deukalion and Pyrrha, were spared and afterwards allowed to repopulate the world with the casting of stones which transformed into men.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus memutuskan menghapus generasi awal manusia yang bejat dengan banjir besar; pasangan saleh Deukalion dan Pyrrha diselamatkan dan memulihkan dunia dengan melempar batu yang menjelma manusia.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus decided to wipe the wicked early generations of man from the earth with a great deluge; the virtuous couple Deukalion and Pyrrha were spared and repopulated the world with cast stones that turned into men.

claims.quote: The earth-goddess Gaia (Gaea), angered by the imprisonment of the Titanes, urged the Giants to rise up against the gods of Olympos. They laid siege to the heavenly fortress but Zeus laid low their king and many others with his deadly lightning-bolts.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Gaia yang murka atas pemenjaraan para Titan mendorong para Giant memberontak melawan dewa-dewa Olimpos; mereka mengepung benteng surgawi, tetapi Zeus menjatuhkan raja mereka dan banyak lainnya dengan petirnya yang mematikan.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Gaia, angered by the imprisonment of the Titanes, urged the Giants to rise against the gods of Olympos; they besieged the heavenly fortress but Zeus laid low their king and many others with his deadly lightning-bolts.

claims.quote: Gaia produced one more giant, Typhoeus, the most monstrous of his kind and set him upon Olympos. The rest of the gods fled in horror and Zeus himself was defeated in combat with the monster tearing the sinews from his limbs rendering him helpless. Pan later stole back the god's strength and, restored, Zeus defeated the giant in a rematch and bound him beneath Mount Etna.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Gaia melahirkan Typhoeus, raksasa paling mengerikan, yang menyerang Olimpos; para dewa melarikan diri dan Zeus sendiri dikalahkan, otot-otot kakinya dirobek hingga tak berdaya. Pan kemudian mencuri kembali kekuatannya, dan Zeus memenangkan pertarungan ulang serta mengurung Typhoeus di bawah Gunung Etna.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Gaia produced Typhoeus, the most monstrous of the giants, and set him upon Olympos; the gods fled and Zeus himself was defeated, the sinews torn from his limbs. Pan later stole back the god's strength, and Zeus defeated the giant in a rematch and bound him beneath Mount Etna.

claims.quote: Zeus punished the worst villians of myth for their impiety and crimes against the gods including Tantalos who stole ambrosia from heaven, Lykaon (Lycaon) who served human flesh to the gods, Ixion who attempted to rape Zeus' wife the goddess Hera, and Salmoneus who tried to imitate Zeus and steal the worship that was due the gods.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus menghukum para penjahat terburuk dalam mitos karena kedurhakaan mereka, di antaranya Tantalos yang mencuri ambrosia, Lykaon yang menghidangkan daging manusia kepada para dewa, Ixion yang mencoba memperkosa Hera, dan Salmoneus yang menirukan Zeus.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus punished the worst villains of myth for impiety, including Tantalos who stole ambrosia, Lykaon who served human flesh to the gods, Ixion who attempted to rape Hera, and Salmoneus who tried to imitate Zeus.

claims.quote: Zeus' most distinctive attribute was his stylized lightning bolt which he wielded in his hand like a javelin. His other attributes included a royal sceptre, a throne, an eagle, a miniature Nike (winged goddess of victory), and the aigis (a goat-skin arm-guard).

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, atribut Zeus yang paling khas adalah petirnya yang digenggam seperti lembing; atribut lainnya mencakup tongkat kerajaan, takhta, elang, Nike mini, dan aigis (pelindung lengan dari kulit kambing).
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' most distinctive attribute was his lightning bolt wielded like a javelin; others included a royal sceptre, a throne, an eagle, a miniature Nike and the aigis (a goat-skin arm-guard).

claims.quote: Zeus' sacred animals were the eagle and the bull. In myth he abducted the youth Ganymede in the shape of an eagle and the maiden Europa in the guise of a bull.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, hewan suci Zeus adalah elang dan banteng; dalam mitos ia menculik pemuda Ganymede dalam rupa elang dan gadis Europa dalam rupa banteng.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' sacred animals were the eagle and the bull; in myth he abducted the youth Ganymede as an eagle and the maiden Europa as a bull.

claims.quote: His sacred plants were the evergreen holm oak and the olive tree. At the ancient oracle of Dodona Zeus' priests were inspired by the rustling of oak-leaves, and at the Olympic Games victors were crowned with a wreath of olive-leaves picked from the god's sacred grove.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, tanaman suci Zeus adalah pohon ek holm dan zaitun; di orakel kuno Dodona para imam terilhami desir daun ek, dan di Olimpiade para pemenang dimahkotai karangan daun zaitun dari hutan suci sang dewa.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' sacred plants were the holm oak and the olive tree; at the ancient oracle of Dodona his priests were inspired by the rustling of oak-leaves, and at the Olympic Games victors were crowned with olive-leaves from the god's sacred grove.

claims.quote: His throne was guarded by four winged spirits, two male and two female, named Kratos (Strength), Zelos (Rivalry), Nike (Victory) and Bia (Force).

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, takhta Zeus dijaga empat roh bersayap, dua laki-laki dan dua perempuan, bernama Kratos (Kekuatan), Zelos (Persaingan), Nike (Kemenangan), dan Bia (Paksaan).
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' throne was guarded by four winged spirits, two male and two female, named Kratos (Strength), Zelos (Rivalry), Nike (Victory) and Bia (Force).

claims.quote: The god Hermes was Zeus' personal herald who acted as diplomat, envoy and general agent of the god's will.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Hermes adalah juru bicara pribadi Zeus yang bertugas sebagai diplomat, utusan, dan agen umum kehendak sang dewa.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Hermes was Zeus' personal herald, acting as diplomat, envoy and general agent of the god's will.

claims.quote: The god's favorite mortal son was Herakles (Heracles) whom he supported throughout his trials and eventually welcomed to Olympos as a god.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, putra fana kesayangan Zeus adalah Herakles, yang ia dukung sepanjang cobaannya dan akhirnya diterima di Olimpos sebagai dewa.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' favorite mortal son was Herakles, whom he supported throughout his trials and eventually welcomed to Olympos as a god.

claims.quote: Zeus was a son of the Titans Kronos (Cronus) and Rheia and a grandson of Ouranos (the Sky) and Gaia (the Earth). He was a brother of the gods Poseidon, Haides, Hera, Demeter and Hestia.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus adalah putra Titan Kronos dan Rheia serta cucu Ouranos (Langit) dan Gaia (Bumi), dan saudara Poseidon, Haides, Hera, Demeter, dan Hestia.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus was a son of the Titans Kronos and Rheia, a grandson of Ouranos (the Sky) and Gaia (the Earth), and a brother of Poseidon, Haides, Hera, Demeter and Hestia.

claims.quote: Zeus married his sister, the sky-goddess Hera, and they had three children - Ares, Hebe and Eileithyia.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus menikahi saudarinya, dewi langit Hera, dan mereka memiliki tiga anak: Ares, Hebe, dan Eileithyia.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus married his sister, the sky-goddess Hera, and they had three children: Ares, Hebe and Eileithyia.

text.id: Dikenal dalam agama Yunani kuno; orakel Delphi sudah ramai dikunjungi pada abad ke-8 SM.
text.en: Known in ancient Greek religion; the Delphic oracle was already well visited in the 8th century BCE.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology di theoi.com, Apollo beserta pemujaan, festival, dan orakelnya lebih besar pengaruhnya atas orang Yunani daripada dewa lain mana pun. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia sangat dicintai kemungkinan besar karena kaitannya dengan musik, puisi, penyucian, penyembuhan, dan pengobatan.
cultural_context.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, Apollo and his worship, festivals and oracles had more influence on the Greeks than any other god. According to the World History Encyclopedia he was much loved most likely because of his links with music, poetry, purification, healing and medicine.

literal_meaning.id: Asal katanya tidak jelas; orang Yunani paling sering mengaitkannya dengan kata kerja apollymi, "menghancurkan".
literal_meaning.en: Its origin is unclear; the Greeks most often linked it with the verb apollymi, "to destroy".

who.id: Dewa Olimpus yang fungsinya mencakup cahaya, penyembuhan, nubuat, musik, puisi, dan panahan.
who.en: An Olympian god whose functions include light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry and archery.

origin.id: Agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno; menurut World History Encyclopedia ia lahir di Pulau Delos.
origin.en: Ancient Greek religion and mythology; according to the World History Encyclopedia he was born on the island of Delos.

role.id: Dewa pelindung Delphi, dewa orakel Delphi dan penyucian ritual.
role.en: Patron god of Delphi, god of the Delphic oracle and of ritual purification.

famous_for.id: Membunuh ular Python di Delphi, memimpin musik dan nubuat, serta menjadi penolong sekaligus pembawa wabah.
famous_for.en: Slaying the serpent Python at Delphi, presiding over music and prophecy, and being both helper and bringer of plague.

did_you_know.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Apollo konon langsung berubah dari bayi menjadi pria dewasa pada kecapan pertama ambrosia.
did_you_know.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Apollo was said to have changed at once from babe to man at his first taste of ambrosia.

description.id: Sebagai dewa orakel Delphi, nubuat Apollo sering dimintai petunjuk dalam berbagai urusan.
description.en: As god of the Delphic oracle, Apollo's prophecies were often consulted for guidance in various matters.

description.id: Pengobatan dan penyembuhan dikaitkan dengan Apollo, secara langsung atau lewat putranya Asclepius; ia membebaskan manusia dari wabah.
description.en: Medicine and healing are associated with Apollo, directly or through his son Asclepius; he delivered people from epidemics.

description.id: Dengan panahnya Apollo dapat mendatangkan penyakit dan wabah; kematian mendadak dipercaya akibat panahnya.
description.en: With his arrows Apollo could bring ill health and plague; sudden deaths were believed to be the effect of his arrows.

description.id: Sebagai dewa mousike, Apollo membawahi segala musik, lagu, tari, dan puisi, dan ia penemu musik dawai.
description.en: As god of mousike Apollo presides over all music, song, dance and poetry, and invented string music.

summary.id: Apollo, putra Zeus dan Leto serta saudara kembar Artemis, lahir di Pulau Delos. Pada kecapan pertama ambrosia ia konon langsung menjadi pria dewasa, lalu diberi busur buatan Hephaestus.
summary.en: Apollo, son of Zeus and Leto and twin of Artemis, was born on the island of Delos. At his first taste of ambrosia he was said to become a man at once, and was then given a bow made by Hephaestus.

title.id: Membunuh Python dan mendirikan orakel Delphi
title.en: Slaying Python and founding the Delphic oracle

role.en: Slayer of the serpent and master of the oracle

summary.id: Menurut legenda, Apollo mendirikan orakel di tempat ia membunuh ular Python dan Pythian Games dimulai untuk memperingatinya. Sumber klasik berbeda soal pemilik orakel sebelumnya: Apollodorus menyebut Themis, Hyginus menyebut Python sendiri.
summary.en: According to legend Apollo created the oracle where he killed the serpent Python, and the Pythian games began in its memory. Classical sources differ on who held the oracle earlier: Apollodorus names Themis, Hyginus names Python himself.

title.en: The lyre and the cattle of Hermes

summary.id: Hermes semasa bayi mencuri kawanan sapi suci Apollo. Ia boleh menyimpan sapi-sapi itu setelah menyerahkan kepada Apollo lira yang diciptakannya dari cangkang kura-kura.
summary.en: As a baby Hermes stole Apollo's sacred cattle. He was allowed to keep them after giving Apollo the lyre he had invented from a tortoiseshell.

role.id: Pelindung bangsa Troya dan pembawa wabah
role.en: Protector of the Trojans and bringer of plague

summary.id: Dalam Iliad Apollo berpihak kepada bangsa Troya, menyelamatkan Hector, Aeneas, dan Glaukos, membawa wabah kepada bangsa Achaea, dan menuntun panah Paris ke tumit Achilles.
summary.en: In the Iliad Apollo sides with the Trojans, saves Hector, Aeneas and Glaukos, brings plague on the Achaeans, and guides Paris' arrow to the heel of Achilles.

title.id: Asclepius, para Kiklops, dan pengabdian kepada Admetus
title.en: Asclepius, the Cyclopes and service to Admetus

summary.id: Zeus membunuh Asclepius karena menghidupkan kembali seorang manusia fana. Apollo membalas dengan membunuh para Kiklops, dan sebagai hukuman harus mengabdi setahun kepada Admetus dari Therae sebagai penggembala domba.
summary.en: Zeus killed Asclepius for bringing a mortal back to life. Apollo took revenge by killing the Cyclopes and, as punishment, had to serve Admetus of Therae for a year as a shepherd.

summary.id: Bersama Artemis, Apollo menewaskan putra-putra Niobe yang menyombongkan kesuburannya. Ia juga mengalahkan satir Marsyas dalam adu musik dan menguliti sang satir hidup-hidup.
summary.en: With Artemis, Apollo slew the sons of Niobe, who boasted of her fertility. He also beat the satyr Marsyas in a music contest and had him flayed alive.

description.en: According to theoi.com, worship of Apollo at Rome is first heard of in 430 BC, when a temple was raised to avert a plague.

topic.en: Apollo's relation to Helios and the sun

summary.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, the later poets, mythographers and philosophers almost universally saw Apollo as identical with Helios.

summary.en: According to Apollodorus the oracle first belonged to Themis and was guarded by the dragon Python; Apollo took it after slaying the monster.

summary.id: Menurut tradisi Yunani, Apollo membantu para pemukim Kreta atau Arkadia mendirikan kota Troya.
summary.en: According to Greek tradition, Apollo helped Cretan or Arcadian colonists found the city of Troy.

summary.id: Teks paku Het menyebut dewa Asia Kecil bernama Appaliunas atau Apalunas yang berkaitan dengan kota Wilusa, sehingga pengaruh budaya mungkin berasal dari arah sebaliknya.
summary.en: Hittite cuneiform texts mention an Asia Minor god called Appaliunas or Apalunas in connection with the city of Wilusa, so cultural influence may have run in the reverse direction.

short_description.id: Apollo adalah salah satu dewa Olimpus dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno, dengan fungsi cahaya, penyembuhan, nubuat, musik, puisi, dan panahan; putra Zeus dan Leto serta saudara kembar Artemis.
short_description.en: Apollo is one of the Olympian gods of ancient Greek religion and myth, with functions including light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry and archery; son of Zeus and Leto and twin of Artemis.

long_description.id: Apollo adalah salah satu dewa Olimpus dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno, dengan fungsi yang mencakup cahaya, penyembuhan, nubuat, musik, puisi, dan panahan. Ia putra Zeus dan Leto serta saudara kembar Artemis, dan menurut World History Encyclopedia ia lahir di Pulau Delos. Menurut theoi.com, ia digambarkan sebagai pemuda tampan tanpa janggut berambut panjang. Busurnya, menurut World History Encyclopedia, dibuat oleh Hephaestus.
long_description.en: Apollo is a god of the Olympian circle in ancient Greek religion and mythology. Light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry and archery all fall within his domains. Zeus and Leto are his parents and Artemis is his twin; the World History Encyclopedia places his birth on the island of Delos. Theoi.com says he was pictured as a handsome youth, beardless and long-haired. The same encyclopedia says his bow was made by Hephaestus.

long_description.id: Sebagai dewa pelindung Delphi (Apollo Pythios), Apollo adalah dewa orakel Delphi dan dewa penyucian ritual, dan nubuatnya sering dimintai petunjuk. Menurut legenda yang dicatat World History Encyclopedia, ia mendirikan orakel itu di tempat ia membunuh ular Python, dan Pythian Games dimulai untuk memperingati kematian makhluk itu. Sumber klasik berbeda soal pemilik orakel sebelumnya: menurut Apollodorus orakel itu milik Themis, sedangkan menurut Hyginus milik Python sendiri.
long_description.en: Apollo, patron god of Delphi (Apollo Pythios), is the god of the Delphic oracle and of ritual purification, and people often sought guidance from his oracles. A legend recorded by the World History Encyclopedia says he founded the oracle on the spot where he killed the serpent Python, and that the Pythian games began in memory of that creature. Classical sources disagree about who held the oracle before him: Apollodorus names Themis, while Hyginus says Python held it himself.

long_description.id: Apollo umumnya dipandang sebagai dewa penolong yang menolak kejahatan, bergelar Alexicacus. Ia membebaskan manusia dari wabah, tetapi juga dapat mendatangkan penyakit dan wabah dengan panahnya; menurut theoi.com, kematian mendadak dipercaya akibat panah Apollo. Dalam Iliad, menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia berpihak kepada bangsa Troya dan membawa wabah kepada bangsa Achaea. Sisi gelapnya juga tampak pada kisah Niobe dan satir Marsyas.
long_description.en: Apollo was generally regarded as a helper who turns evil away, bearing the title Alexicacus. He rescued people from epidemics, yet his arrows could also bring sickness and plague; theoi.com notes that sudden deaths were believed to come from his arrows. In the Iliad, says the World History Encyclopedia, he takes the Trojan side and sends plague upon the Achaeans. His darker side also shows in the stories of Niobe and the satyr Marsyas.

long_description.id: Sebagai dewa mousike, Apollo membawahi segala musik, lagu, tari, dan puisi; ia penemu musik dawai dan sering menjadi pendamping para Muse. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia memperoleh liranya dari Hermes. Anaknya yang paling terkenal antara lain Orpheus dan Asclepius; Zeus membunuh Asclepius karena menghidupkan kembali seorang manusia fana, dan Apollo membalas dengan membunuh para Kiklops.
long_description.en: As god of mousike, Apollo presides over every kind of music, song, dance and poetry; he invented string music and often keeps company with the Muses. The World History Encyclopedia says he obtained his lyre from Hermes. Among his best-known children are Orpheus and Asclepius; Zeus killed Asclepius for reviving a mortal, and Apollo took revenge by killing the Cyclopes.

long_description.id: Dalam seni Yunani kuno Apollo paling sering tampil sebagai pemuda rupawan tanpa janggut dan dikenali dari kithara atau lira, trivet perunggu, rusa, serta busur dan tempat anak panah. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, benda yang dikaitkan dengannya mencakup busur perak dan kithara dari cangkang kura-kura; sumber lain menambahkan pedang, plektrum, dan trivet persembahan sebagai lambang nubuatnya. Ia juga mengawasi upacara inisiasi para pemuda yang memasuki masyarakat warga dan menjadi prajurit.
long_description.en: In ancient Greek art Apollo most often appears as a handsome beardless youth, recognised by a kithara or lyre, a bronze tripod, a deer, and a bow and quiver. The World History Encyclopedia lists a silver bow and a kithara made from a tortoise shell among his associated objects; a second source adds the sword, the plectrum and the sacrificial tripod as an emblem of his prophetic power. He also oversaw the initiation rites of young men entering the full civic community and becoming warriors.

long_description.id: Dalam konteks sastra, Apollo melambangkan keselarasan, keteraturan, dan nalar, yang dikontraskan dengan Dionysus. Ia sering dikaitkan dengan matahari dan Helios, tetapi sumber berbeda soal sejak kapan kaitan itu ada. Menurut tradisi Yunani ia membantu para pemukim mendirikan kota Troya, tetapi kisah ini mungkin mencerminkan pengaruh dari arah sebaliknya, karena teks Het menyebut dewa Asia Kecil bernama Appaliunas atau Apalunas.
long_description.en: In literary contexts Apollo stands for harmony, order and reason, set against Dionysus. He is often linked with the sun and Helios, though sources differ on how early that link dates. Greek tradition says he helped colonists found the city of Troy, but this may reflect influence running the other way, since Hittite texts mention an Asia Minor god called Appaliunas or Apalunas.

claims.quote: Apollo is one of the Olympian deities in ancient Greek religion and mythology. His numerous functions include light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry, and archery. He is the son of Zeus and Leto, and the twin brother of Artemis, goddess of the hunt.

statement.id: Apollo adalah salah satu dewa Olimpus dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno, dengan fungsi cahaya, penyembuhan, nubuat, musik, puisi, dan panahan; putra Zeus dan Leto, saudara kembar Artemis.
statement.en: Apollo is an Olympian god of ancient Greek religion and myth whose functions include light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry and archery; son of Zeus and Leto, twin of Artemis.

claims.quote: As the patron deity of Delphi (Apollo Pythios), Apollo is an oracular god—the prophetic deity of the Delphic Oracle and the deity of ritual purification. His oracles were often consulted for guidance in various matters.

statement.id: Sebagai dewa pelindung Delphi, Apollo adalah dewa orakel Delphi dan dewa penyucian ritual, dan nubuatnya sering dimintai petunjuk.
statement.en: As patron of Delphi, Apollo is the god of the Delphic oracle and of ritual purification, and his oracles were often consulted.

claims.quote: He was in general seen as the god who affords help and wards off evil, and is referred to as Alexicacus, the "averter of evil". Medicine and healing are associated with Apollo, whether through the god himself or mediated through his son Asclepius. Apollo delivered people from epidemics, yet he is also a god who could bring ill health and deadly plague with his arrows.

statement.id: Apollo dipandang sebagai dewa penolong dan penolak kejahatan (Alexicacus), dikaitkan dengan pengobatan secara langsung atau melalui putranya Asclepius; ia membebaskan manusia dari wabah tetapi juga dapat mendatangkan penyakit dengan panahnya.
statement.en: Apollo was seen as a helper and averter of evil (Alexicacus), linked with medicine directly or via his son Asclepius; he delivered people from epidemics but could also bring disease with his arrows.

claims.quote: As the god of mousike, Apollo presides over all music, songs, dance, and poetry. He is the inventor of string-music and the frequent companion of the Muses

statement.id: Sebagai dewa mousike, Apollo membawahi segala musik, lagu, tari, dan puisi; ia penemu musik dawai dan sering menjadi pendamping para Muse.
statement.en: As god of mousike Apollo presides over all music, song, dance and poetry; he is the inventor of string music and a frequent companion of the Muses.

claims.quote: APOLLON (Apollo) was the Olympian god of prophecy and oracles, music, song and poetry, archery, healing, plague and disease, and the protection of the young. He was depicted as a handsome, beardless youth with long hair

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Apollon (Apollo) adalah dewa Olimpus nubuat dan orakel, musik, lagu dan puisi, panahan, penyembuhan, wabah dan penyakit, serta perlindungan anak muda; ia digambarkan sebagai pemuda tampan tanpa janggut berambut panjang.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Apollon (Apollo) was the Olympian god of prophecy and oracles, music, song and poetry, archery, healing, plague and disease, and the protection of the young, depicted as a handsome, beardless youth with long hair.

claims.quote: Apollo was perhaps the most loved of all the gods. He was worshipped at Delphi and Delos, amongst the most famous of all Greek religious sanctuaries.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Apollo mungkin dewa yang paling dicintai, dan dipuja di Delphi dan Delos, dua tempat suci agama Yunani yang paling terkenal.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Apollo was perhaps the most loved of the gods, worshipped at Delphi and Delos, among the most famous of Greek religious sanctuaries.

claims.quote: The slaying of the serpent Python which guarded the oracular shrine of Delphoi (Delphi).

statement.id: Salah satu mitos paling terkenal Apollo menurut theoi.com adalah pembunuhan ular Python yang menjaga tempat suci orakel di Delphi.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, one of the most famous myths of Apollo is the slaying of the serpent Python, which guarded the oracular shrine of Delphi.

claims.quote: Son of Zeus and Leto, and the twin brother of Artemis, Apollo was born on the island of Delos

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Apollo, putra Zeus dan Leto serta saudara kembar Artemis, lahir di Pulau Delos.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Apollo, son of Zeus and Leto and twin brother of Artemis, was born on the island of Delos.

claims.quote: At his first taste of ambrosia, he was said to have immediately transformed from babe to man. Apollo was then given his bow, made by the master craftsman of Mount Olympus, Hephaestus.

statement.id: Pada kecapan pertama ambrosia, Apollo konon langsung berubah dari bayi menjadi pria dewasa; ia lalu diberi busur buatan Hephaestus, pengrajin ulung Gunung Olimpus.
statement.en: At his first taste of ambrosia Apollo was said to have changed at once from babe to man; he was then given his bow, made by Hephaestus, master craftsman of Mount Olympus.

claims.quote: Apollo acquired his lyre from his mischievous half-brother Hermes, the messenger god. While still a baby, Hermes had stolen Apollo's sacred herd of cattle, cleverly reversing their hooves to make it difficult to follow their tracks.

statement.id: Apollo memperoleh liranya dari saudara tirinya, Hermes sang dewa pembawa pesan, yang semasa bayi mencuri kawanan sapi suci Apollo dan membalik tapak kuku sapi-sapi itu agar jejaknya sulit diikuti.
statement.en: Apollo acquired his lyre from his half-brother Hermes, the messenger god, who as a baby had stolen Apollo's sacred cattle and reversed their hooves to make the tracks hard to follow.

claims.quote: Hermes was permitted to keep his ill-gotten gains but only after he gave Apollo his lyre which he had invented using a tortoiseshell.

statement.id: Hermes boleh menyimpan hasil curiannya, tetapi hanya setelah menyerahkan kepada Apollo lira yang ia ciptakan dari cangkang kura-kura.
statement.en: Hermes was allowed to keep his ill-gotten gains, but only after giving Apollo the lyre he had invented using a tortoiseshell.

claims.quote: perhaps the most famous are Orpheus (who inherited his father's musical skills and became a virtuoso with the lyre or kithara), Asclepius (to whom he gave his knowledge of healing and medicine)

statement.id: Di antara anak-anak Apollo yang paling terkenal adalah Orpheus, yang mewarisi keahlian musik ayahnya pada lira atau kithara, dan Asclepius, yang diberinya pengetahuan tentang penyembuhan dan pengobatan.
statement.en: Among Apollo's most famous children are Orpheus, who inherited his father's musical skills on the lyre or kithara, and Asclepius, to whom he gave his knowledge of healing and medicine.

claims.quote: Apollo is a significant protagonist in Homer's account of the Trojan War in the Iliad. On the side of the Trojans, he gives particular assistance to the Trojan heroes Hector, Aeneas, and Glaukos, saving their lives on more than one occasion with his divine intervention.

statement.id: Apollo adalah tokoh penting dalam kisah Perang Troya karya Homer, Iliad; ia berpihak kepada bangsa Troya dan beberapa kali menyelamatkan nyawa para pahlawan Troya Hector, Aeneas, dan Glaukos dengan campur tangan ilahinya.
statement.en: Apollo is a significant protagonist in Homer's account of the Trojan War in the Iliad; on the Trojan side, he repeatedly saved the lives of the Trojan heroes Hector, Aeneas and Glaukos by divine intervention.

claims.quote: He brought plague to the Achaeans, led the entire Trojan army (holding Zeus' fearsome aegis) in an attack which destroyed the defensive walls of the Greek camps, and was also responsible for guiding Paris' arrow to the heel of Achilles, killing the seemingly invincible Greek hero.

statement.id: Apollo membawa wabah kepada bangsa Achaea, memimpin seluruh pasukan Troya menghancurkan tembok pertahanan kamp Yunani, dan menuntun panah Paris ke tumit Achilles sehingga pahlawan Yunani yang tampak kebal itu tewas.
statement.en: Apollo brought plague to the Achaeans, led the entire Trojan army in an attack that destroyed the defensive walls of the Greek camps, and guided Paris' arrow to the heel of Achilles, killing the seemingly invincible Greek hero.

claims.quote: The pair did have a serious falling out when Zeus killed Asclepius after he had used his marvellous medicinal skills to bring a mortal back to life. In revenge, Apollo then killed the Cyclopes, the one-eyed giants who made Zeus' thunderbolts.

statement.id: Apollo dan Zeus sempat bertikai hebat ketika Zeus membunuh Asclepius karena menghidupkan kembali seorang manusia fana dengan keahlian pengobatannya; sebagai balasan Apollo membunuh para Kiklops, raksasa bermata satu pembuat petir Zeus.
statement.en: Apollo and Zeus had a serious falling out when Zeus killed Asclepius for using his medicinal skills to bring a mortal back to life; in revenge Apollo killed the Cyclopes, the one-eyed giants who made Zeus' thunderbolts.

claims.quote: As punishment, Apollo was obliged to spend a year in the humble service of Admetus of Therae, tending the king's sheep.

statement.id: Sebagai hukuman, Apollo harus mengabdi selama setahun kepada Admetus dari Therae dengan menggembalakan domba raja itu.
statement.en: As punishment, Apollo had to spend a year in the humble service of Admetus of Therae, tending the king's sheep.

claims.quote: Apollo's darker side as the bringer of plague and divine retribution is seen most famously when he is, with his sister Artemis, the remorseless slayer of Niobe's six (or in some accounts seven) sons as punishment for her boasting that her childbearing capacity was greater than Leto's.

statement.id: Sisi gelap Apollo sebagai pembawa wabah dan pembalasan ilahi tampak paling terkenal ketika ia bersama saudarinya Artemis menewaskan enam (atau dalam sebagian riwayat tujuh) putra Niobe sebagai hukuman atas kesombongannya bahwa ia lebih subur daripada Leto.
statement.en: Apollo's darker side as bringer of plague and divine retribution is seen most famously when, with his sister Artemis, he slew Niobe's six (or in some accounts seven) sons as punishment for her boast that she was more fertile than Leto.

claims.quote: Another hapless victim of Apollo's wrath was the satyr Marsyas who unwisely claimed he was musically more gifted than the god. The pair had a competition and the Muses ruled that Apollo was indeed the better musician.

statement.id: Korban lain amarah Apollo adalah satir Marsyas yang dengan gegabah mengaku lebih berbakat dalam musik daripada sang dewa; keduanya bertanding dan para Muse memutuskan Apollo musisi yang lebih baik.
statement.en: Another victim of Apollo's wrath was the satyr Marsyas, who unwisely claimed to be more musically gifted than the god; the two competed and the Muses ruled that Apollo was the better musician.

claims.quote: Apollo then had the mortal flayed alive for his presumption and nailed his skin to a pine tree.

statement.id: Apollo kemudian menguliti Marsyas hidup-hidup karena kelancangannya dan memaku kulitnya pada sebatang pohon pinus.
statement.en: Apollo then had Marsyas flayed alive for his presumption and nailed his skin to a pine tree.

claims.quote: According to legend, Apollo, wishing to reveal to humanity the intentions of his father Zeus, created the oracle on the site where he had killed the serpent (or dragon) Python. The Panhellenic Pythian games were begun at the site in order to commemorate the death of this divine creature.
claims.locator: Which Sites Were Sacred to Apollo?

statement.id: Menurut legenda, Apollo yang hendak menyingkapkan kehendak ayahnya, Zeus, kepada manusia mendirikan orakel di tempat ia membunuh ular (atau naga) Python; Pythian Games dimulai di tempat itu untuk memperingati kematian makhluk ilahi tersebut.
statement.en: According to legend, Apollo, wishing to reveal his father Zeus's intentions to humanity, created the oracle on the site where he had killed the serpent (or dragon) Python; the Pythian games were begun there to commemorate the death of this divine creature.

claims.quote: The oracle of Delphi was already well-visited in the 8th century BCE - despite being difficult to get to and open only in summer
claims.locator: Which Sites Were Sacred to Apollo?

statement.id: Orakel Delphi sudah ramai dikunjungi pada abad ke-8 SM, meskipun sulit dijangkau dan hanya buka pada musim panas.
statement.en: The oracle of Delphi was already well visited in the 8th century BCE, despite being hard to reach and open only in summer.

claims.quote: a silver bow - symbolic of his prowess as an archer. a kithara (or lyre) - made from the shell of a tortoise, this was symbolic of Apollo's ability in music and his leadership of the chorus of the nine Muses.

statement.id: Benda yang dikaitkan dengan Apollo antara lain busur perak, lambang kehebatannya memanah, dan kithara (lira) dari cangkang kura-kura, lambang kemampuan musiknya dan kepemimpinannya atas paduan suara sembilan Muse.
statement.en: Objects associated with Apollo include a silver bow, symbolic of his prowess as an archer, and a kithara (or lyre) made from a tortoise shell, symbolic of his musical ability and his leadership of the chorus of the nine Muses.

claims.quote: Apollo oversaw the initiation rites performed by young males (ephebes) as they entered the full civic community and became warriors.

statement.id: Apollo mengawasi upacara inisiasi para pemuda (efebe) saat mereka memasuki masyarakat warga sepenuhnya dan menjadi prajurit.
statement.en: Apollo oversaw the initiation rites of young males (ephebes) as they entered the full civic community and became warriors.

claims.quote: The god is frequently associated with the sun (as Phoebus Apollo) and the sun god Helios, but modern scholars mostly agree that the link between Apollo and Helios does not go further back than the 5th century BCE.

statement.id: Sang dewa sering dikaitkan dengan matahari (sebagai Phoebus Apollo) dan dewa matahari Helios, tetapi para ahli modern umumnya sepakat bahwa kaitan Apollo dengan Helios tidak lebih tua daripada abad ke-5 SM.
statement.en: The god is often associated with the sun (as Phoebus Apollo) and the sun god Helios, but modern scholars mostly agree the link between Apollo and Helios goes back no further than the 5th century BCE.

claims.quote: the view which was almost universal among the later poets, mythographers, and philesophers, and according to which Apollo was identical with Helios, or the Sun
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology di theoi.com, pandangan yang hampir universal di kalangan penyair, penulis mitologi, dan filsuf kemudian adalah bahwa Apollo identik dengan Helios, sang Matahari.
statement.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, the view almost universal among later poets, mythographers and philosophers was that Apollo was identical with Helios, the Sun.

claims.quote: According to Apollodorus, the oracle had previously been in the possession of Themis, and the dragon Python guarded the mysterious chasm, and Apollo, after having slain the monster, took possession of the oracle.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Apollodorus, orakel itu sebelumnya dimiliki Themis dan naga Python menjaga celah misteriusnya; setelah membunuh monster itu, Apollo mengambil alih orakel tersebut.
statement.en: According to Apollodorus, the oracle had earlier belonged to Themis and the dragon Python guarded the mysterious chasm; after slaying the monster, Apollo took possession of the oracle.

claims.quote: According to Hyginus, Python himself possessed the oracle
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Hyginus, Python sendirilah yang memiliki orakel itu.
statement.en: According to Hyginus, Python himself possessed the oracle.

claims.quote: All sudden deaths of men, whether they were regarded as a punishment or a reward, were believed to be the effect of the arrows of Apollo; and with the same arrows he sent the plague into the camp of the Greeks.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Semua kematian mendadak, baik dianggap hukuman maupun ganjaran, dipercaya akibat panah Apollo, dan dengan panah yang sama ia mengirim wabah ke kemah orang Yunani.
statement.en: All sudden deaths, whether regarded as punishment or reward, were believed to result from Apollo's arrows, and with the same arrows he sent the plague into the Greek camp.

claims.quote: Apollo and his worship, his festivals and oracles, had more influence upon the Greeks than any other god
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, Apollo beserta pemujaan, festival, dan orakelnya lebih besar pengaruhnya atas orang Yunani daripada dewa lain mana pun.
statement.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, Apollo and his worship, festivals and oracles had more influence upon the Greeks than any other god.

claims.quote: But the first time that we hear of the worship of Apollo at Rome is in the year B. C. 430, when, for the purpose of averting a plague, a temple was raised to him
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Pemujaan Apollo di Roma pertama kali terdengar pada tahun 430 SM, ketika sebuah kuil didirikan untuk menolak wabah.
statement.en: The worship of Apollo at Rome is first heard of in the year 430 BC, when a temple was raised to him to avert a plague.

claims.quote: The etymology of the name is unclear. The spelling Ἀπόλλων ... Thus, the Greeks most often associated Apollo's name with the Greek verb ἀπόλλυμι (apollymi), "to destroy".

statement.id: Asal kata nama Apollo (Ἀπόλλων) tidak jelas; orang Yunani paling sering mengaitkan nama itu dengan kata kerja apollymi, "menghancurkan".
statement.en: The etymology of the name Apollo (Ἀπόλλων) is unclear; the Greeks most often associated it with the verb apollymi, "to destroy".

claims.quote: According to Greek tradition, he helped Cretan or Arcadian colonists found the city of Troy. However, this story may reflect a cultural influence which had the reverse direction: Hittite cuneiform texts mention an Asia Minor god called Appaliunas or Apalunas in connection with the city of Wilusa

statement.id: Menurut tradisi Yunani, Apollo membantu para pemukim Kreta atau Arkadia mendirikan kota Troya; namun kisah ini mungkin mencerminkan pengaruh budaya dari arah sebaliknya, karena teks paku Het menyebut dewa Asia Kecil bernama Appaliunas atau Apalunas yang berkaitan dengan kota Wilusa.
statement.en: According to Greek tradition he helped Cretan or Arcadian colonists found the city of Troy, but this may reflect cultural influence in the reverse direction, since Hittite cuneiform texts mention an Asia Minor god called Appaliunas or Apalunas in connection with the city of Wilusa.

claims.quote: Apollo's most common attributes were the bow and arrow. Other attributes of his included the kithara (an advanced version of the common lyre), the plectrum and the sword. Another common emblem was the sacrificial tripod, representing his prophetic powers.

statement.id: Atribut Apollo yang paling umum adalah busur dan anak panah; atribut lainnya mencakup kithara, plektrum, dan pedang, dan lambang umum lain adalah trivet persembahan yang melambangkan kekuatan nubuatnya.
statement.en: Apollo's most common attributes were the bow and arrow; others included the kithara, the plectrum and the sword, and another common emblem was the sacrificial tripod, representing his prophetic powers.

claims.quote: In literary contexts, Apollo represents harmony, order, and reason—characteristics contrasted with those of Dionysus, god of wine, who represents ecstasy and disorder.

statement.id: Dalam konteks sastra, Apollo melambangkan keselarasan, keteraturan, dan nalar, yang dikontraskan dengan Dionysus, dewa anggur, yang melambangkan kegairahan dan kekacauan.
statement.en: In literary contexts Apollo represents harmony, order and reason, contrasted with Dionysus, god of wine, who represents ecstasy and disorder.

claims.quote: the god's instruction of the Muses formed the subject of Igor Stravinsky's Apollon musagète (1927–1928)

statement.id: Pengajaran sang dewa kepada para Muse menjadi pokok karya Igor Stravinsky, Apollon musagète (1927–1928).
statement.en: The god's instruction of the Muses formed the subject of Igor Stravinsky's Apollon musagète (1927–1928).

claims.quote: In spaceflight, the 1960s and 1970s NASA program for orbiting and landing astronauts on the Moon was named after Apollo, by NASA manager Abe Silverstein

statement.id: Program NASA tahun 1960-an dan 1970-an untuk mengorbitkan dan mendaratkan astronaut di Bulan dinamai menurut Apollo oleh manajer NASA Abe Silverstein.
statement.en: The 1960s and 1970s NASA program for orbiting and landing astronauts on the Moon was named after Apollo by NASA manager Abe Silverstein.

claims.quote: Apollo appears frequently in all media of ancient Greek art, most often as a beautiful, beardless youth. He is easily identified with either a kithara or a lyre, a bronze tripod (signifying his oracle at Delphi), a deer (which he often fights over with Hercules), and a bow and quiver.
claims.locator: How is Apollo Represented in Art?

statement.id: Apollo sering muncul dalam semua media seni Yunani kuno, paling sering sebagai pemuda rupawan tanpa janggut, dan mudah dikenali dari kithara atau lira, trivet perunggu (penanda orakelnya di Delphi), rusa, serta busur dan tempat anak panah.
statement.en: Apollo appears often in all media of ancient Greek art, most often as a beautiful beardless youth, and is easily identified by a kithara or lyre, a bronze tripod (signifying his oracle at Delphi), a deer, and a bow and quiver.

claims.quote: Apollo was a much-loved god, and this was most likely due to his association with many positive aspects of the human condition such as music, poetry, purification, healing, and medicine.

statement.id: Apollo adalah dewa yang sangat dicintai, kemungkinan besar karena kaitannya dengan banyak segi positif kehidupan manusia seperti musik, puisi, penyucian, penyembuhan, dan pengobatan.
statement.en: Apollo was a much-loved god, most likely because of his association with many positive aspects of the human condition such as music, poetry, purification, healing and medicine.

text.en: Known in ancient Greek religion; the Delphic oracle was already well visited in the 8th century BCE.

literal_meaning.id: Asal katanya tidak jelas; orang Yunani paling sering mengaitkannya dengan kata kerja apollymi, "menghancurkan".
literal_meaning.en: Its origin is unclear; the Greeks most often linked it with the verb apollymi, "to destroy".

who.id: Dewa Olimpus yang fungsinya mencakup cahaya, penyembuhan, nubuat, musik, puisi, dan panahan.
who.en: An Olympian god whose functions include light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry and archery.

origin.id: Agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno; menurut World History Encyclopedia ia lahir di Pulau Delos.
origin.en: Ancient Greek religion and mythology; according to the World History Encyclopedia he was born on the island of Delos.

role.id: Dewa pelindung Delphi, dewa orakel Delphi dan penyucian ritual.
role.en: Patron god of Delphi, god of the Delphic oracle and of ritual purification.

famous_for.id: Membunuh ular Python di Delphi, memimpin musik dan nubuat, serta menjadi penolong sekaligus pembawa wabah.
famous_for.en: Slaying the serpent Python at Delphi, presiding over music and prophecy, and being both helper and bringer of plague.

did_you_know.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Apollo konon langsung berubah dari bayi menjadi pria dewasa pada kecapan pertama ambrosia.
did_you_know.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Apollo was said to have changed at once from babe to man at his first taste of ambrosia.

description.id: Sebagai dewa orakel Delphi, nubuat Apollo sering dimintai petunjuk dalam berbagai urusan.
description.en: As god of the Delphic oracle, Apollo's prophecies were often consulted for guidance in various matters.

description.id: Pengobatan dan penyembuhan dikaitkan dengan Apollo, secara langsung atau lewat putranya Asclepius; ia membebaskan manusia dari wabah.
description.en: Medicine and healing are associated with Apollo, directly or through his son Asclepius; he delivered people from epidemics.

description.id: Dengan panahnya Apollo dapat mendatangkan penyakit dan wabah; kematian mendadak dipercaya akibat panahnya.
description.en: With his arrows Apollo could bring ill health and plague; sudden deaths were believed to be the effect of his arrows.

description.id: Sebagai dewa mousike, Apollo membawahi segala musik, lagu, tari, dan puisi, dan ia penemu musik dawai.
description.en: As god of mousike Apollo presides over all music, song, dance and poetry, and invented string music.

summary.id: Apollo, putra Zeus dan Leto serta saudara kembar Artemis, lahir di Pulau Delos. Pada kecapan pertama ambrosia ia konon langsung menjadi pria dewasa, lalu diberi busur buatan Hephaestus.
summary.en: Apollo, son of Zeus and Leto and twin of Artemis, was born on the island of Delos. At his first taste of ambrosia he was said to become a man at once, and was then given a bow made by Hephaestus.

title.id: Membunuh Python dan mendirikan orakel Delphi
title.en: Slaying Python and founding the Delphic oracle

role.en: Slayer of the serpent and master of the oracle

summary.id: Menurut legenda, Apollo mendirikan orakel di tempat ia membunuh ular Python dan Pythian Games dimulai untuk memperingatinya. Sumber klasik berbeda soal pemilik orakel sebelumnya: Apollodorus menyebut Themis, Hyginus menyebut Python sendiri.
summary.en: According to legend Apollo created the oracle where he killed the serpent Python, and the Pythian games began in its memory. Classical sources differ on who held the oracle earlier: Apollodorus names Themis, Hyginus names Python himself.

title.en: The lyre and the cattle of Hermes

summary.id: Hermes semasa bayi mencuri kawanan sapi suci Apollo. Ia boleh menyimpan sapi-sapi itu setelah menyerahkan kepada Apollo lira yang diciptakannya dari cangkang kura-kura.
summary.en: As a baby Hermes stole Apollo's sacred cattle. He was allowed to keep them after giving Apollo the lyre he had invented from a tortoiseshell.

role.id: Pelindung bangsa Troya dan pembawa wabah
role.en: Protector of the Trojans and bringer of plague

summary.id: Dalam Iliad Apollo berpihak kepada bangsa Troya, menyelamatkan Hector, Aeneas, dan Glaukos, membawa wabah kepada bangsa Achaea, dan menuntun panah Paris ke tumit Achilles.
summary.en: In the Iliad Apollo sides with the Trojans, saves Hector, Aeneas and Glaukos, brings plague on the Achaeans, and guides Paris' arrow to the heel of Achilles.

title.id: Asclepius, para Kiklops, dan pengabdian kepada Admetus
title.en: Asclepius, the Cyclopes and service to Admetus

summary.id: Zeus membunuh Asclepius karena menghidupkan kembali seorang manusia fana. Apollo membalas dengan membunuh para Kiklops, dan sebagai hukuman harus mengabdi setahun kepada Admetus dari Therae sebagai penggembala domba.
summary.en: Zeus killed Asclepius for bringing a mortal back to life. Apollo took revenge by killing the Cyclopes and, as punishment, had to serve Admetus of Therae for a year as a shepherd.

summary.id: Bersama Artemis, Apollo menewaskan putra-putra Niobe yang menyombongkan kesuburannya. Ia juga mengalahkan satir Marsyas dalam adu musik dan menguliti sang satir hidup-hidup.
summary.en: With Artemis, Apollo slew the sons of Niobe, who boasted of her fertility. He also beat the satyr Marsyas in a music contest and had him flayed alive.

description.id: Tempat orakel Apollo; Apollo dipuja di sini sebagai dewa pelindung, dan orakelnya sudah ramai dikunjungi pada abad ke-8 SM.
description.en: Seat of Apollo's oracle; Apollo was worshipped here as patron god, and the oracle was already well visited in the 8th century BCE.

description.id: Pulau kelahiran Apollo dan salah satu tempat suci Yunani yang paling terkenal.
description.en: The island where Apollo was born and one of the most famous Greek sanctuaries.

description.id: Orakel Delphi sudah ramai dikunjungi pada abad ke-8 SM.
description.en: The oracle of Delphi was already well visited in the 8th century BCE.

title.en: First temple of Apollo at Rome

description.id: Menurut theoi.com, pemujaan Apollo di Roma pertama kali terdengar pada tahun 430 SM, ketika sebuah kuil didirikan untuk menolak wabah.
description.en: According to theoi.com, worship of Apollo at Rome is first heard of in 430 BC, when a temple was raised to avert a plague.

note.en: Apollo's son associated with medicine; killed by Zeus for bringing a mortal back to life.

note.en: The sun god often associated with Apollo; sources differ on how early the two were linked.

description.id: Program NASA tahun 1960-an dan 1970-an untuk mengorbitkan dan mendaratkan astronaut di Bulan dinamai menurut Apollo oleh manajer NASA Abe Silverstein.
description.en: The 1960s and 1970s NASA program to orbit and land astronauts on the Moon was named after Apollo by NASA manager Abe Silverstein.

learning_questions.en: Why might one god be both healer and bringer of plague?

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana perbedaan keterangan dari para penulis klasik tentang pemilik orakel Delphi memengaruhi cara kita membaca mitos?
learning_questions.en: How do the classical authors' differing accounts of who held the Delphic oracle affect the way we read myth?

topic.id: Hubungan Apollo dengan Helios dan matahari
topic.en: Apollo's relation to Helios and the sun

summary.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, para ahli modern umumnya sepakat bahwa kaitan Apollo dengan Helios tidak lebih tua daripada abad ke-5 SM.
summary.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, modern scholars mostly agree that the link between Apollo and Helios goes back no further than the 5th century BCE.

summary.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology di theoi.com, penyair, penulis mitologi, dan filsuf kemudian hampir semuanya memandang Apollo identik dengan Helios.
summary.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, the later poets, mythographers and philosophers almost universally saw Apollo as identical with Helios.

topic.id: Siapa pemilik orakel Delphi sebelum Apollo
topic.en: Who held the Delphic oracle before Apollo

summary.id: Menurut Apollodorus, orakel itu semula milik Themis dan dijaga naga Python; Apollo mengambilnya setelah membunuh monster itu.
summary.en: According to Apollodorus the oracle first belonged to Themis and was guarded by the dragon Python; Apollo took it after slaying the monster.

summary.id: Menurut Hyginus, Python sendirilah yang memiliki orakel itu.
summary.en: According to Hyginus, Python himself possessed the oracle.

topic.en: Origin of Apollo's cult at Troy

summary.id: Menurut tradisi Yunani, Apollo membantu para pemukim Kreta atau Arkadia mendirikan kota Troya.
summary.en: According to Greek tradition, Apollo helped Cretan or Arcadian colonists found the city of Troy.

summary.id: Teks paku Het menyebut dewa Asia Kecil bernama Appaliunas atau Apalunas yang berkaitan dengan kota Wilusa, sehingga pengaruh budaya mungkin berasal dari arah sebaliknya.
summary.en: Hittite cuneiform texts mention an Asia Minor god called Appaliunas or Apalunas in connection with the city of Wilusa, so cultural influence may have run in the reverse direction.
