short_description.id: Apollo adalah salah satu dewa Olimpus dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno, dengan fungsi cahaya, penyembuhan, nubuat, musik, puisi, dan panahan; putra Zeus dan Leto serta saudara kembar Artemis.
short_description.en: Apollo is one of the Olympian gods of ancient Greek religion and myth, with functions including light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry and archery; son of Zeus and Leto and twin of Artemis.

long_description.id: Apollo adalah salah satu dewa Olimpus dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno, dengan fungsi yang mencakup cahaya, penyembuhan, nubuat, musik, puisi, dan panahan. Ia putra Zeus dan Leto serta saudara kembar Artemis, dan menurut World History Encyclopedia ia lahir di Pulau Delos. Menurut theoi.com, ia digambarkan sebagai pemuda tampan tanpa janggut berambut panjang. Busurnya, menurut World History Encyclopedia, dibuat oleh Hephaestus.
long_description.en: Apollo is a god of the Olympian circle in ancient Greek religion and mythology. Light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry and archery all fall within his domains. Zeus and Leto are his parents and Artemis is his twin; the World History Encyclopedia places his birth on the island of Delos. Theoi.com says he was pictured as a handsome youth, beardless and long-haired. The same encyclopedia says his bow was made by Hephaestus.

long_description.id: Sebagai dewa pelindung Delphi (Apollo Pythios), Apollo adalah dewa orakel Delphi dan dewa penyucian ritual, dan nubuatnya sering dimintai petunjuk. Menurut legenda yang dicatat World History Encyclopedia, ia mendirikan orakel itu di tempat ia membunuh ular Python, dan Pythian Games dimulai untuk memperingati kematian makhluk itu. Sumber klasik berbeda soal pemilik orakel sebelumnya: menurut Apollodorus orakel itu milik Themis, sedangkan menurut Hyginus milik Python sendiri.
long_description.en: Apollo, patron god of Delphi (Apollo Pythios), is the god of the Delphic oracle and of ritual purification, and people often sought guidance from his oracles. A legend recorded by the World History Encyclopedia says he founded the oracle on the spot where he killed the serpent Python, and that the Pythian games began in memory of that creature. Classical sources disagree about who held the oracle before him: Apollodorus names Themis, while Hyginus says Python held it himself.

long_description.id: Apollo umumnya dipandang sebagai dewa penolong yang menolak kejahatan, bergelar Alexicacus. Ia membebaskan manusia dari wabah, tetapi juga dapat mendatangkan penyakit dan wabah dengan panahnya; menurut theoi.com, kematian mendadak dipercaya akibat panah Apollo. Dalam Iliad, menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia berpihak kepada bangsa Troya dan membawa wabah kepada bangsa Achaea. Sisi gelapnya juga tampak pada kisah Niobe dan satir Marsyas.
long_description.en: Apollo was generally regarded as a helper who turns evil away, bearing the title Alexicacus. He rescued people from epidemics, yet his arrows could also bring sickness and plague; theoi.com notes that sudden deaths were believed to come from his arrows. In the Iliad, says the World History Encyclopedia, he takes the Trojan side and sends plague upon the Achaeans. His darker side also shows in the stories of Niobe and the satyr Marsyas.

long_description.id: Sebagai dewa mousike, Apollo membawahi segala musik, lagu, tari, dan puisi; ia penemu musik dawai dan sering menjadi pendamping para Muse. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia memperoleh liranya dari Hermes. Anaknya yang paling terkenal antara lain Orpheus dan Asclepius; Zeus membunuh Asclepius karena menghidupkan kembali seorang manusia fana, dan Apollo membalas dengan membunuh para Kiklops.
long_description.en: As god of mousike, Apollo presides over every kind of music, song, dance and poetry; he invented string music and often keeps company with the Muses. The World History Encyclopedia says he obtained his lyre from Hermes. Among his best-known children are Orpheus and Asclepius; Zeus killed Asclepius for reviving a mortal, and Apollo took revenge by killing the Cyclopes.

long_description.id: Dalam seni Yunani kuno Apollo paling sering tampil sebagai pemuda rupawan tanpa janggut dan dikenali dari kithara atau lira, trivet perunggu, rusa, serta busur dan tempat anak panah. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, benda yang dikaitkan dengannya mencakup busur perak dan kithara dari cangkang kura-kura; sumber lain menambahkan pedang, plektrum, dan trivet persembahan sebagai lambang nubuatnya. Ia juga mengawasi upacara inisiasi para pemuda yang memasuki masyarakat warga dan menjadi prajurit.
long_description.en: In ancient Greek art Apollo most often appears as a handsome beardless youth, recognised by a kithara or lyre, a bronze tripod, a deer, and a bow and quiver. The World History Encyclopedia lists a silver bow and a kithara made from a tortoise shell among his associated objects; a second source adds the sword, the plectrum and the sacrificial tripod as an emblem of his prophetic power. He also oversaw the initiation rites of young men entering the full civic community and becoming warriors.

long_description.id: Dalam konteks sastra, Apollo melambangkan keselarasan, keteraturan, dan nalar, yang dikontraskan dengan Dionysus. Ia sering dikaitkan dengan matahari dan Helios, tetapi sumber berbeda soal sejak kapan kaitan itu ada. Menurut tradisi Yunani ia membantu para pemukim mendirikan kota Troya, tetapi kisah ini mungkin mencerminkan pengaruh dari arah sebaliknya, karena teks Het menyebut dewa Asia Kecil bernama Appaliunas atau Apalunas.
long_description.en: In literary contexts Apollo stands for harmony, order and reason, set against Dionysus. He is often linked with the sun and Helios, though sources differ on how early that link dates. Greek tradition says he helped colonists found the city of Troy, but this may reflect influence running the other way, since Hittite texts mention an Asia Minor god called Appaliunas or Apalunas.

claims.quote: Apollo is one of the Olympian deities in ancient Greek religion and mythology. His numerous functions include light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry, and archery. He is the son of Zeus and Leto, and the twin brother of Artemis, goddess of the hunt.

statement.id: Apollo adalah salah satu dewa Olimpus dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno, dengan fungsi cahaya, penyembuhan, nubuat, musik, puisi, dan panahan; putra Zeus dan Leto, saudara kembar Artemis.
statement.en: Apollo is an Olympian god of ancient Greek religion and myth whose functions include light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry and archery; son of Zeus and Leto, twin of Artemis.

claims.quote: As the patron deity of Delphi (Apollo Pythios), Apollo is an oracular god—the prophetic deity of the Delphic Oracle and the deity of ritual purification. His oracles were often consulted for guidance in various matters.

statement.id: Sebagai dewa pelindung Delphi, Apollo adalah dewa orakel Delphi dan dewa penyucian ritual, dan nubuatnya sering dimintai petunjuk.
statement.en: As patron of Delphi, Apollo is the god of the Delphic oracle and of ritual purification, and his oracles were often consulted.

claims.quote: He was in general seen as the god who affords help and wards off evil, and is referred to as Alexicacus, the "averter of evil". Medicine and healing are associated with Apollo, whether through the god himself or mediated through his son Asclepius. Apollo delivered people from epidemics, yet he is also a god who could bring ill health and deadly plague with his arrows.

statement.id: Apollo dipandang sebagai dewa penolong dan penolak kejahatan (Alexicacus), dikaitkan dengan pengobatan secara langsung atau melalui putranya Asclepius; ia membebaskan manusia dari wabah tetapi juga dapat mendatangkan penyakit dengan panahnya.
statement.en: Apollo was seen as a helper and averter of evil (Alexicacus), linked with medicine directly or via his son Asclepius; he delivered people from epidemics but could also bring disease with his arrows.

claims.quote: As the god of mousike, Apollo presides over all music, songs, dance, and poetry. He is the inventor of string-music and the frequent companion of the Muses

statement.id: Sebagai dewa mousike, Apollo membawahi segala musik, lagu, tari, dan puisi; ia penemu musik dawai dan sering menjadi pendamping para Muse.
statement.en: As god of mousike Apollo presides over all music, song, dance and poetry; he is the inventor of string music and a frequent companion of the Muses.

claims.quote: APOLLON (Apollo) was the Olympian god of prophecy and oracles, music, song and poetry, archery, healing, plague and disease, and the protection of the young. He was depicted as a handsome, beardless youth with long hair

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Apollon (Apollo) adalah dewa Olimpus nubuat dan orakel, musik, lagu dan puisi, panahan, penyembuhan, wabah dan penyakit, serta perlindungan anak muda; ia digambarkan sebagai pemuda tampan tanpa janggut berambut panjang.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Apollon (Apollo) was the Olympian god of prophecy and oracles, music, song and poetry, archery, healing, plague and disease, and the protection of the young, depicted as a handsome, beardless youth with long hair.

claims.quote: Apollo was perhaps the most loved of all the gods. He was worshipped at Delphi and Delos, amongst the most famous of all Greek religious sanctuaries.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Apollo mungkin dewa yang paling dicintai, dan dipuja di Delphi dan Delos, dua tempat suci agama Yunani yang paling terkenal.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Apollo was perhaps the most loved of the gods, worshipped at Delphi and Delos, among the most famous of Greek religious sanctuaries.

claims.quote: The slaying of the serpent Python which guarded the oracular shrine of Delphoi (Delphi).

statement.id: Salah satu mitos paling terkenal Apollo menurut theoi.com adalah pembunuhan ular Python yang menjaga tempat suci orakel di Delphi.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, one of the most famous myths of Apollo is the slaying of the serpent Python, which guarded the oracular shrine of Delphi.

claims.quote: Son of Zeus and Leto, and the twin brother of Artemis, Apollo was born on the island of Delos

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Apollo, putra Zeus dan Leto serta saudara kembar Artemis, lahir di Pulau Delos.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Apollo, son of Zeus and Leto and twin brother of Artemis, was born on the island of Delos.

claims.quote: At his first taste of ambrosia, he was said to have immediately transformed from babe to man. Apollo was then given his bow, made by the master craftsman of Mount Olympus, Hephaestus.

statement.id: Pada kecapan pertama ambrosia, Apollo konon langsung berubah dari bayi menjadi pria dewasa; ia lalu diberi busur buatan Hephaestus, pengrajin ulung Gunung Olimpus.
statement.en: At his first taste of ambrosia Apollo was said to have changed at once from babe to man; he was then given his bow, made by Hephaestus, master craftsman of Mount Olympus.

claims.quote: Apollo acquired his lyre from his mischievous half-brother Hermes, the messenger god. While still a baby, Hermes had stolen Apollo's sacred herd of cattle, cleverly reversing their hooves to make it difficult to follow their tracks.

statement.id: Apollo memperoleh liranya dari saudara tirinya, Hermes sang dewa pembawa pesan, yang semasa bayi mencuri kawanan sapi suci Apollo dan membalik tapak kuku sapi-sapi itu agar jejaknya sulit diikuti.
statement.en: Apollo acquired his lyre from his half-brother Hermes, the messenger god, who as a baby had stolen Apollo's sacred cattle and reversed their hooves to make the tracks hard to follow.

claims.quote: Hermes was permitted to keep his ill-gotten gains but only after he gave Apollo his lyre which he had invented using a tortoiseshell.

statement.id: Hermes boleh menyimpan hasil curiannya, tetapi hanya setelah menyerahkan kepada Apollo lira yang ia ciptakan dari cangkang kura-kura.
statement.en: Hermes was allowed to keep his ill-gotten gains, but only after giving Apollo the lyre he had invented using a tortoiseshell.

claims.quote: perhaps the most famous are Orpheus (who inherited his father's musical skills and became a virtuoso with the lyre or kithara), Asclepius (to whom he gave his knowledge of healing and medicine)

statement.id: Di antara anak-anak Apollo yang paling terkenal adalah Orpheus, yang mewarisi keahlian musik ayahnya pada lira atau kithara, dan Asclepius, yang diberinya pengetahuan tentang penyembuhan dan pengobatan.
statement.en: Among Apollo's most famous children are Orpheus, who inherited his father's musical skills on the lyre or kithara, and Asclepius, to whom he gave his knowledge of healing and medicine.

claims.quote: Apollo is a significant protagonist in Homer's account of the Trojan War in the Iliad. On the side of the Trojans, he gives particular assistance to the Trojan heroes Hector, Aeneas, and Glaukos, saving their lives on more than one occasion with his divine intervention.

statement.id: Apollo adalah tokoh penting dalam kisah Perang Troya karya Homer, Iliad; ia berpihak kepada bangsa Troya dan beberapa kali menyelamatkan nyawa para pahlawan Troya Hector, Aeneas, dan Glaukos dengan campur tangan ilahinya.
statement.en: Apollo is a significant protagonist in Homer's account of the Trojan War in the Iliad; on the Trojan side, he repeatedly saved the lives of the Trojan heroes Hector, Aeneas and Glaukos by divine intervention.

claims.quote: He brought plague to the Achaeans, led the entire Trojan army (holding Zeus' fearsome aegis) in an attack which destroyed the defensive walls of the Greek camps, and was also responsible for guiding Paris' arrow to the heel of Achilles, killing the seemingly invincible Greek hero.

statement.id: Apollo membawa wabah kepada bangsa Achaea, memimpin seluruh pasukan Troya menghancurkan tembok pertahanan kamp Yunani, dan menuntun panah Paris ke tumit Achilles sehingga pahlawan Yunani yang tampak kebal itu tewas.
statement.en: Apollo brought plague to the Achaeans, led the entire Trojan army in an attack that destroyed the defensive walls of the Greek camps, and guided Paris' arrow to the heel of Achilles, killing the seemingly invincible Greek hero.

claims.quote: The pair did have a serious falling out when Zeus killed Asclepius after he had used his marvellous medicinal skills to bring a mortal back to life. In revenge, Apollo then killed the Cyclopes, the one-eyed giants who made Zeus' thunderbolts.

statement.id: Apollo dan Zeus sempat bertikai hebat ketika Zeus membunuh Asclepius karena menghidupkan kembali seorang manusia fana dengan keahlian pengobatannya; sebagai balasan Apollo membunuh para Kiklops, raksasa bermata satu pembuat petir Zeus.
statement.en: Apollo and Zeus had a serious falling out when Zeus killed Asclepius for using his medicinal skills to bring a mortal back to life; in revenge Apollo killed the Cyclopes, the one-eyed giants who made Zeus' thunderbolts.

claims.quote: As punishment, Apollo was obliged to spend a year in the humble service of Admetus of Therae, tending the king's sheep.

statement.id: Sebagai hukuman, Apollo harus mengabdi selama setahun kepada Admetus dari Therae dengan menggembalakan domba raja itu.
statement.en: As punishment, Apollo had to spend a year in the humble service of Admetus of Therae, tending the king's sheep.

claims.quote: Apollo's darker side as the bringer of plague and divine retribution is seen most famously when he is, with his sister Artemis, the remorseless slayer of Niobe's six (or in some accounts seven) sons as punishment for her boasting that her childbearing capacity was greater than Leto's.

statement.id: Sisi gelap Apollo sebagai pembawa wabah dan pembalasan ilahi tampak paling terkenal ketika ia bersama saudarinya Artemis menewaskan enam (atau dalam sebagian riwayat tujuh) putra Niobe sebagai hukuman atas kesombongannya bahwa ia lebih subur daripada Leto.
statement.en: Apollo's darker side as bringer of plague and divine retribution is seen most famously when, with his sister Artemis, he slew Niobe's six (or in some accounts seven) sons as punishment for her boast that she was more fertile than Leto.

claims.quote: Another hapless victim of Apollo's wrath was the satyr Marsyas who unwisely claimed he was musically more gifted than the god. The pair had a competition and the Muses ruled that Apollo was indeed the better musician.

statement.id: Korban lain amarah Apollo adalah satir Marsyas yang dengan gegabah mengaku lebih berbakat dalam musik daripada sang dewa; keduanya bertanding dan para Muse memutuskan Apollo musisi yang lebih baik.
statement.en: Another victim of Apollo's wrath was the satyr Marsyas, who unwisely claimed to be more musically gifted than the god; the two competed and the Muses ruled that Apollo was the better musician.

claims.quote: Apollo then had the mortal flayed alive for his presumption and nailed his skin to a pine tree.

statement.id: Apollo kemudian menguliti Marsyas hidup-hidup karena kelancangannya dan memaku kulitnya pada sebatang pohon pinus.
statement.en: Apollo then had Marsyas flayed alive for his presumption and nailed his skin to a pine tree.

claims.quote: According to legend, Apollo, wishing to reveal to humanity the intentions of his father Zeus, created the oracle on the site where he had killed the serpent (or dragon) Python. The Panhellenic Pythian games were begun at the site in order to commemorate the death of this divine creature.
claims.locator: Which Sites Were Sacred to Apollo?

statement.id: Menurut legenda, Apollo yang hendak menyingkapkan kehendak ayahnya, Zeus, kepada manusia mendirikan orakel di tempat ia membunuh ular (atau naga) Python; Pythian Games dimulai di tempat itu untuk memperingati kematian makhluk ilahi tersebut.
statement.en: According to legend, Apollo, wishing to reveal his father Zeus's intentions to humanity, created the oracle on the site where he had killed the serpent (or dragon) Python; the Pythian games were begun there to commemorate the death of this divine creature.

claims.quote: The oracle of Delphi was already well-visited in the 8th century BCE - despite being difficult to get to and open only in summer
claims.locator: Which Sites Were Sacred to Apollo?

statement.id: Orakel Delphi sudah ramai dikunjungi pada abad ke-8 SM, meskipun sulit dijangkau dan hanya buka pada musim panas.
statement.en: The oracle of Delphi was already well visited in the 8th century BCE, despite being hard to reach and open only in summer.

claims.quote: a silver bow - symbolic of his prowess as an archer. a kithara (or lyre) - made from the shell of a tortoise, this was symbolic of Apollo's ability in music and his leadership of the chorus of the nine Muses.

statement.id: Benda yang dikaitkan dengan Apollo antara lain busur perak, lambang kehebatannya memanah, dan kithara (lira) dari cangkang kura-kura, lambang kemampuan musiknya dan kepemimpinannya atas paduan suara sembilan Muse.
statement.en: Objects associated with Apollo include a silver bow, symbolic of his prowess as an archer, and a kithara (or lyre) made from a tortoise shell, symbolic of his musical ability and his leadership of the chorus of the nine Muses.

claims.quote: Apollo oversaw the initiation rites performed by young males (ephebes) as they entered the full civic community and became warriors.

statement.id: Apollo mengawasi upacara inisiasi para pemuda (efebe) saat mereka memasuki masyarakat warga sepenuhnya dan menjadi prajurit.
statement.en: Apollo oversaw the initiation rites of young males (ephebes) as they entered the full civic community and became warriors.

claims.quote: The god is frequently associated with the sun (as Phoebus Apollo) and the sun god Helios, but modern scholars mostly agree that the link between Apollo and Helios does not go further back than the 5th century BCE.

statement.id: Sang dewa sering dikaitkan dengan matahari (sebagai Phoebus Apollo) dan dewa matahari Helios, tetapi para ahli modern umumnya sepakat bahwa kaitan Apollo dengan Helios tidak lebih tua daripada abad ke-5 SM.
statement.en: The god is often associated with the sun (as Phoebus Apollo) and the sun god Helios, but modern scholars mostly agree the link between Apollo and Helios goes back no further than the 5th century BCE.

claims.quote: the view which was almost universal among the later poets, mythographers, and philesophers, and according to which Apollo was identical with Helios, or the Sun
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology di theoi.com, pandangan yang hampir universal di kalangan penyair, penulis mitologi, dan filsuf kemudian adalah bahwa Apollo identik dengan Helios, sang Matahari.
statement.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, the view almost universal among later poets, mythographers and philosophers was that Apollo was identical with Helios, the Sun.

claims.quote: According to Apollodorus, the oracle had previously been in the possession of Themis, and the dragon Python guarded the mysterious chasm, and Apollo, after having slain the monster, took possession of the oracle.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Apollodorus, orakel itu sebelumnya dimiliki Themis dan naga Python menjaga celah misteriusnya; setelah membunuh monster itu, Apollo mengambil alih orakel tersebut.
statement.en: According to Apollodorus, the oracle had earlier belonged to Themis and the dragon Python guarded the mysterious chasm; after slaying the monster, Apollo took possession of the oracle.

claims.quote: According to Hyginus, Python himself possessed the oracle
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Hyginus, Python sendirilah yang memiliki orakel itu.
statement.en: According to Hyginus, Python himself possessed the oracle.

claims.quote: All sudden deaths of men, whether they were regarded as a punishment or a reward, were believed to be the effect of the arrows of Apollo; and with the same arrows he sent the plague into the camp of the Greeks.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Semua kematian mendadak, baik dianggap hukuman maupun ganjaran, dipercaya akibat panah Apollo, dan dengan panah yang sama ia mengirim wabah ke kemah orang Yunani.
statement.en: All sudden deaths, whether regarded as punishment or reward, were believed to result from Apollo's arrows, and with the same arrows he sent the plague into the Greek camp.

claims.quote: Apollo and his worship, his festivals and oracles, had more influence upon the Greeks than any other god
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, Apollo beserta pemujaan, festival, dan orakelnya lebih besar pengaruhnya atas orang Yunani daripada dewa lain mana pun.
statement.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, Apollo and his worship, festivals and oracles had more influence upon the Greeks than any other god.

claims.quote: But the first time that we hear of the worship of Apollo at Rome is in the year B. C. 430, when, for the purpose of averting a plague, a temple was raised to him
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Pemujaan Apollo di Roma pertama kali terdengar pada tahun 430 SM, ketika sebuah kuil didirikan untuk menolak wabah.
statement.en: The worship of Apollo at Rome is first heard of in the year 430 BC, when a temple was raised to him to avert a plague.

claims.quote: The etymology of the name is unclear. The spelling Ἀπόλλων ... Thus, the Greeks most often associated Apollo's name with the Greek verb ἀπόλλυμι (apollymi), "to destroy".

statement.id: Asal kata nama Apollo (Ἀπόλλων) tidak jelas; orang Yunani paling sering mengaitkan nama itu dengan kata kerja apollymi, "menghancurkan".
statement.en: The etymology of the name Apollo (Ἀπόλλων) is unclear; the Greeks most often associated it with the verb apollymi, "to destroy".

claims.quote: According to Greek tradition, he helped Cretan or Arcadian colonists found the city of Troy. However, this story may reflect a cultural influence which had the reverse direction: Hittite cuneiform texts mention an Asia Minor god called Appaliunas or Apalunas in connection with the city of Wilusa

statement.id: Menurut tradisi Yunani, Apollo membantu para pemukim Kreta atau Arkadia mendirikan kota Troya; namun kisah ini mungkin mencerminkan pengaruh budaya dari arah sebaliknya, karena teks paku Het menyebut dewa Asia Kecil bernama Appaliunas atau Apalunas yang berkaitan dengan kota Wilusa.
statement.en: According to Greek tradition he helped Cretan or Arcadian colonists found the city of Troy, but this may reflect cultural influence in the reverse direction, since Hittite cuneiform texts mention an Asia Minor god called Appaliunas or Apalunas in connection with the city of Wilusa.

claims.quote: Apollo's most common attributes were the bow and arrow. Other attributes of his included the kithara (an advanced version of the common lyre), the plectrum and the sword. Another common emblem was the sacrificial tripod, representing his prophetic powers.

statement.id: Atribut Apollo yang paling umum adalah busur dan anak panah; atribut lainnya mencakup kithara, plektrum, dan pedang, dan lambang umum lain adalah trivet persembahan yang melambangkan kekuatan nubuatnya.
statement.en: Apollo's most common attributes were the bow and arrow; others included the kithara, the plectrum and the sword, and another common emblem was the sacrificial tripod, representing his prophetic powers.

claims.quote: In literary contexts, Apollo represents harmony, order, and reason—characteristics contrasted with those of Dionysus, god of wine, who represents ecstasy and disorder.

statement.id: Dalam konteks sastra, Apollo melambangkan keselarasan, keteraturan, dan nalar, yang dikontraskan dengan Dionysus, dewa anggur, yang melambangkan kegairahan dan kekacauan.
statement.en: In literary contexts Apollo represents harmony, order and reason, contrasted with Dionysus, god of wine, who represents ecstasy and disorder.

claims.quote: the god's instruction of the Muses formed the subject of Igor Stravinsky's Apollon musagète (1927–1928)

statement.id: Pengajaran sang dewa kepada para Muse menjadi pokok karya Igor Stravinsky, Apollon musagète (1927–1928).
statement.en: The god's instruction of the Muses formed the subject of Igor Stravinsky's Apollon musagète (1927–1928).

claims.quote: In spaceflight, the 1960s and 1970s NASA program for orbiting and landing astronauts on the Moon was named after Apollo, by NASA manager Abe Silverstein

statement.id: Program NASA tahun 1960-an dan 1970-an untuk mengorbitkan dan mendaratkan astronaut di Bulan dinamai menurut Apollo oleh manajer NASA Abe Silverstein.
statement.en: The 1960s and 1970s NASA program for orbiting and landing astronauts on the Moon was named after Apollo by NASA manager Abe Silverstein.

claims.quote: Apollo appears frequently in all media of ancient Greek art, most often as a beautiful, beardless youth. He is easily identified with either a kithara or a lyre, a bronze tripod (signifying his oracle at Delphi), a deer (which he often fights over with Hercules), and a bow and quiver.
claims.locator: How is Apollo Represented in Art?

statement.id: Apollo sering muncul dalam semua media seni Yunani kuno, paling sering sebagai pemuda rupawan tanpa janggut, dan mudah dikenali dari kithara atau lira, trivet perunggu (penanda orakelnya di Delphi), rusa, serta busur dan tempat anak panah.
statement.en: Apollo appears often in all media of ancient Greek art, most often as a beautiful beardless youth, and is easily identified by a kithara or lyre, a bronze tripod (signifying his oracle at Delphi), a deer, and a bow and quiver.

claims.quote: Apollo was a much-loved god, and this was most likely due to his association with many positive aspects of the human condition such as music, poetry, purification, healing, and medicine.

statement.id: Apollo adalah dewa yang sangat dicintai, kemungkinan besar karena kaitannya dengan banyak segi positif kehidupan manusia seperti musik, puisi, penyucian, penyembuhan, dan pengobatan.
statement.en: Apollo was a much-loved god, most likely because of his association with many positive aspects of the human condition such as music, poetry, purification, healing and medicine.

text.id: Dipuja sejak zaman Han menurut satu kajian; pemujaannya menyebar ke seluruh Tiongkok pada masa Dinasti Song Utara; tokoh novel zaman Dinasti Ming.
text.en: Worshiped from the Han period according to one study; his cult spread across China under the Northern Song; also a character in novels of the Ming dynasty.

short_description.id: Erlang Shen adalah dewa agama rakyat Tiongkok dan Daoisme yang dikaitkan dengan pengendalian banjir, keadilan, dan penaklukan iblis, digambarkan bermata ketiga dan ditemani anjing pemburu.
short_description.en: Erlang Shen is a god of Chinese folk religion and Daoism associated with flood control, justice, and demon subdual, depicted with a third eye and a hunting dog.

long_description.id: Erlang Shen, sering disebut Erlang saja, adalah dewa dalam agama rakyat Tiongkok dan Daoisme yang dikaitkan dengan air (pengendalian banjir), keadilan, keprajuritan, perburuan, dan penaklukan iblis. Ia biasa digambarkan sebagai pemuda dengan mata ketiga yang melihat kebenaran di tengah dahinya, bersenjata tombak bermata tiga, dan ditemani anjing pemburu setianya, Xiaotian Quan. Julukannya antara lain Chuanzhu ('Penguasa Sichuan') dan Guankou Erlang.
long_description.en: Erlang Shen, often just called Erlang, is a deity of Chinese folk religion and Daoism linked to water (flood control), justice, martial prowess, hunting, and subduing demons. Images usually show a young man whose forehead bears a third eye that sees the truth, who carries a three-pronged spear, and who is followed by his faithful hunting dog Xiaotian Quan. Among his epithets are Chuanzhu ('Lord of Sichuan') and Guankou Erlang.

long_description.id: Asal-usulnya rumit. Yang paling lazim, ia dipercaya sebagai pendewaan Li Erlang, putra kedua Li Bing, insinyur hidrolik zaman Dinasti Qin. Ia bermula sebagai dewa lokal Guankou di Sichuan, dan pada masa Dinasti Song Utara pemujaannya menyebar ke seluruh Tiongkok. Satu kajian yang dirangkum Jim R. McClanahan menyebut bahwa pada zaman Han ia sudah dipuja sebagai dewa pemburu dan penakluk hantu gunung oleh kelompok etnis Qiang, dan pada 965 Dinasti Song mengadopsi kultusnya setelah menaklukkan kerajaan Shu Kemudian.
long_description.en: His origin is complex. The most common belief is that he is the deified Li Erlang, second son of Li Bing, an engineer of hydraulic works in the Qin dynasty. He started out as a local god of Guankou in Sichuan, and during the Northern Song his cult spread across China. A study summarized by Jim R. McClanahan holds that already in the Han period the Qiang ethnic group worshiped him as a hunting god who quelled mountain ghosts, and that in 965 the Song dynasty adopted his cult after conquering the Later Shu kingdom.

long_description.id: Legenda Erlang menjadi tema seni lukis yang disebut 'Searching the Mountains' (mencari iblis di pegunungan). Menurut Cleveland Museum of Art, tema ini dikaitkan dengan Erlang yang mengakhiri banjir dahsyat dengan mengalahkan naga ganas dan makhluk jahat lain di Gunung Guankou, Sichuan. Dalam adegan penting, sang naga raksasa dirantai oleh prajurit-iblis di bawah komando Erlang, yang tampil berjubah pejabat sipil.
long_description.en: Erlang's legend inspired a painting theme called 'Searching the Mountains.' The Cleveland Museum of Art links the theme to Erlang, who put an end to destructive floods by overcoming a fierce dragon and other evil beings on Mount Guankou in Sichuan. In a key scene, demon-soldiers under Erlang's command chain a giant dragon, and he wears the civil robes of a court official.

long_description.id: Dalam sastra, Erlang muncul di dua novel zaman Dinasti Ming sebagai keponakan Kaisar Giok: Fengshen Yanyi, yang kira-kira rampung ditulis pada masa Longqing dan Wanli, dan Perjalanan ke Barat (Xiyouji). Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat ia dipanggil untuk menangkap Sun Wukong: ia menyebut dirinya Raja Zhaohui Lingxian, berubah menjadi sosok raksasa dalam duel, dan anjingnya menggigit betis Sun Wukong; sebuah syair menggambarkannya memegang tombak bermata tiga berbilah dua. Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, ia bernama Yang Jian, murid Yuding Zhenren. Penggambaran dalam novel ini adalah tokoh sastra dan tidak sama dengan keyakinan agama rakyat tentang Erlang.
long_description.en: In literature, Erlang appears as the Jade Emperor's nephew in two novels of the Ming dynasty: Fengshen Yanyi, roughly completed in the Longqing and Wanli periods, and Journey to the West (Xiyouji). In Journey to the West he is summoned to capture Sun Wukong: he calls himself Prince Zhaohui Lingxian, transforms into a giant in the duel, and his hound bites Sun Wukong's calf; a verse describes him holding a three-pointed, double-edged spear. In Fengshen Yanyi he is named Yang Jian, a disciple of Yuding Zhenren. These novel portrayals are literary characterizations and are not the same as folk-religious belief about Erlang.

cultural_context.id: Dalam agama rakyat dan Daoisme, Erlang dikaitkan dengan air (pengendalian banjir), keadilan, perburuan, dan penaklukan iblis; ia dilukiskan sebagai prajurit mulia yang mewujudkan keadilan dan kebenaran. Di Sichuan, legenda tentang dirinya mengakhiri banjir dahsyat diangkat dalam lukisan.
cultural_context.en: In folk religion and Daoism, Erlang is associated with water (flood control), justice, hunting, and demon subdual; he is portrayed as a noble warrior who embodies justice and righteousness. In Sichuan, the legend of his ending devastating floods was taken up in painting.

literal_meaning.id: Erlang berarti 'putra kedua/anak laki-laki' dan Shen berarti 'dewa'; jadi kira-kira 'Dewa Putra Kedua'.
literal_meaning.en: Erlang means 'second son/boy/lad/male' and Shen means 'God'; so roughly 'the Second Son God'.

who.id: Dewa Tiongkok pengendali banjir dan penakluk iblis yang digambarkan bermata ketiga dan ditemani anjing pemburu.
who.en: A Chinese god of flood control and demon subdual depicted with a third eye and accompanied by a hunting dog.

origin.id: Berasal dari dewa lokal Guankou di Sichuan, yang pemujaannya kemudian menyebar ke seluruh Tiongkok.
origin.en: He began as a local god of Guankou in Sichuan whose cult later spread across China.

role.id: Dalam kepercayaan ia menaklukkan iblis dan naga banjir; dalam novel Perjalanan ke Barat ia dikirim menangkap Sun Wukong.
role.en: In belief he subdues demons and flood dragons; in the novel Journey to the West he is sent to capture Sun Wukong.

famous_for.id: Paling dikenal sebagai dewa bermata ketiga bertombak bermata tiga yang ditemani anjing, dan sebagai lawan Sun Wukong dalam Perjalanan ke Barat.
famous_for.en: Best known as the third-eyed, three-pronged-spear god with his dog, and as Sun Wukong's opponent in Journey to the West.

did_you_know.id: Menurut Cleveland Museum of Art, lukisan bertema 'Searching the Mountains' yang terkait legenda Erlang jarang terlihat, dan hanya sekitar selusin yang diketahui masih ada.
did_you_know.en: According to the Cleveland Museum of Art, paintings of the 'Searching the Mountains' theme, linked to the Erlang legend, are rarely seen and only about a dozen are known to survive.

description.id: Dalam novel Perjalanan ke Barat, Erlang berubah menjadi sosok setinggi sepuluh ribu zhang dalam duelnya dengan Sun Wukong.
description.en: In the novel Journey to the West, Erlang transforms into a figure ten thousand zhang tall in his duel with Sun Wukong.

description.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Yang Jian melepaskan anjing dewatanya yang menggigit dan menahan siluman.
description.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Yang Jian sends out his immortal hound, which seizes and holds a monster.

description.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nuwa menyebut Yang Jian pandai 'delapan-sembilan perubahan'.
description.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nüwa says Yang Jian is skilled in 'eight-nine transformations.'

description.id: Dalam penafsiran yang paling lazim, Erlang adalah pendewaan Li Erlang, putra kedua Li Bing.
description.en: In the most common account, Erlang is the deification of Li Erlang, the second son of Li Bing.

description.id: Dalam kisah-kisah belakangan, Erlang adalah Yang Jian, putra dewi Yunhua dan keponakan Kaisar Giok; versi ini paling umum dalam media populer.
description.en: In later stories Erlang is Yang Jian, son of the goddess Yunhua and nephew of the Jade Emperor; this version is most common in popular media.

description.id: Erlang Shen juga diidentifikasi dengan Zhao Yu, pertapa Gunung Qingcheng yang diangkat sebagai Gubernur Jiazhou oleh Kaisar Yang dari Sui.
description.en: Erlang Shen is also identified with Zhao Yu, a Mount Qingcheng hermit appointed Governor of Jiazhou by Emperor Yang of Sui.

title.id: Mencari iblis di pegunungan (Searching the Mountains)

role.id: Pemimpin pasukan roh yang mengalahkan naga dan makhluk jahat.
role.en: Commander of the spirit soldiers who defeat the dragon and malevolent creatures.

summary.id: Menurut Cleveland Museum of Art, legenda ini berkisah tentang Erlang yang mengakhiri banjir dahsyat dengan mengalahkan naga ganas dan makhluk jahat lain di Gunung Guankou; sang naga dirantai oleh prajurit-iblis di bawah komandonya.
summary.en: The Cleveland Museum of Art ties this legend to Erlang, who stopped destructive floods by overcoming a fierce dragon and other evil beings on Mount Guankou; demon-soldiers under his command chain the dragon.

title.id: Erlang menangkap Sun Wukong (novel Perjalanan ke Barat)
title.en: Erlang captures Sun Wukong (novel Journey to the West)

role.id: Dewa yang dipanggil Kaisar Giok untuk menangkap Sun Wukong.
role.en: The god summoned by the Jade Emperor to capture Sun Wukong.

summary.id: Dalam novel, Guanyin merekomendasikan Erlang; ia menantang Sun Wukong, keduanya berduel dengan berubah wujud, dan akhirnya anjing Erlang menggigit betis Sun Wukong sehingga ia dapat diikat oleh tujuh dewa.
summary.en: In the novel, Guanyin recommends Erlang; he challenges Sun Wukong, the two duel through transformations, and finally Erlang's hound bites Sun Wukong's calf so that the seven sages can bind him.

title.id: Yang Jian dan siluman Meishan (novel Fengshen Yanyi)
title.en: Yang Jian and the Meishan monsters (novel Fengshen Yanyi)

role.id: Murid Yuding Zhenren yang membantu pihak Zhou menghadapi siluman.
role.en: Disciple of Yuding Zhenren who helps the Zhou side against the monsters.

summary.id: Dalam novel, Yang Jian melepaskan anjingnya melawan siluman Dai Li, menerima pusaka dari Nuwa, dan menyebut siluman Yuan Hong sebagai kera putih Meishan yang akan disingkirkan perlahan.
summary.en: In the novel, Yang Jian looses his hound on the monster Dai Li, receives a treasure from Nüwa, and calls the monster Yuan Hong a white ape of Meishan to be removed gradually.

title.id: Ibu Yang Jian dan Gunung Tao
title.en: Yang Jian's mother and Mount Tao

role.en: The son who seeks to free his mother.

summary.id: Menurut teks Erlang Baojuan, ibu Yang Jian, Putri Yunhua, dipenjara di bawah Gunung Tao karena menikahi manusia; dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, Sun Wukong menyinggung putra yang membelah Gunung Tao dengan kapak.
summary.en: According to the text Erlang Baojuan, Yang Jian's mother, Princess Yunhua, was imprisoned under Mount Tao for marrying a human; in Journey to the West, Sun Wukong alludes to a son who split Peach Mountain with an axe.

description.id: Tempat asal Li Erlang dan tempat Erlang bermula sebagai dewa lokal.

claims.quote: Erlang Shen, or simply Erlang, is a god in Chinese folk religion and Daoism, associated with water (flood control), justice, warriorhood, hunting, and demon subdual.

statement.id: Erlang Shen, atau Erlang saja, adalah dewa dalam agama rakyat Tiongkok dan Daoisme yang dikaitkan dengan air (pengendalian banjir), keadilan, keprajuritan, perburuan, dan penaklukan iblis.
statement.en: Erlang Shen, or simply Erlang, is a god in Chinese folk religion and Daoism, associated with water (flood control), justice, warriorhood, hunting, and demon subdual.

claims.quote: He is most commonly believed to be the deification of Li Erlang, the second son of Li Bing, a hydraulic engineer of the Qin dynasty (221–206 BC).

statement.id: Ia paling lazim dipercaya sebagai pendewaan Li Erlang, putra kedua Li Bing, seorang insinyur hidrolik zaman Dinasti Qin (221–206 SM).
statement.en: He is most commonly believed to be the deification of Li Erlang, the second son of Li Bing, a hydraulic engineer of the Qin dynasty (221–206 BC).

claims.quote: Erlang (Chinese: 二郎; pinyin: Èrláng; lit. 'Second Son/Boy/Lad/Male') is an ancient given name for boys.

statement.id: Erlang (二郎) secara harfiah berarti 'putra kedua/anak laki-laki' dan merupakan nama pemberian kuno untuk anak laki-laki.
statement.en: Erlang (二郎) literally means 'second son/boy/lad/male' and is an ancient given name for boys.

claims.quote: Shen (Chinese: 神; pinyin: Shén) means "God".

statement.id: Shen (神) berarti 'dewa'.
statement.en: Shen (神) means 'God'.

claims.quote: Since Li Erlang was from Guankou, Sichuan, the god Erlang is also known by the epithets Chuanzhu (Chinese: 川主; pinyin: Chuānzhǔ; lit. 'Lord of Sichuan') and Guankou Erlang (Chinese: 灌口二郎; pinyin: Guànkǒu Èrláng; lit. 'Erlang of Guankou').

statement.id: Karena Li Erlang berasal dari Guankou, Sichuan, dewa Erlang juga dikenal dengan julukan Chuanzhu (川主, 'Penguasa Sichuan') dan Guankou Erlang (灌口二郎, 'Erlang dari Guankou').
statement.en: Since Li Erlang was from Guankou, Sichuan, the god Erlang is also known by the epithets Chuanzhu (川主, 'Lord of Sichuan') and Guankou Erlang (灌口二郎, 'Erlang of Guankou').

claims.quote: He is commonly depicted as a young man with a third, truth-seeing eye in the middle of his forehead, wielding a three-pronged spear, and being accompanied by his loyal hunting dog, Xiaotian Quan.

statement.id: Ia biasa digambarkan sebagai pemuda dengan mata ketiga yang melihat kebenaran di tengah dahinya, bersenjata tombak bermata tiga, dan ditemani anjing pemburu setianya, Xiaotian Quan.
statement.en: He is commonly depicted as a young man with a third, truth-seeing eye in the middle of his forehead, wielding a three-pronged spear, and accompanied by his loyal hunting dog, Xiaotian Quan.

claims.quote: He originated as a local god of Guankou, Sichuan, where Li Erlang was from. During the Northern Song dynasty (960–1127 CE), the cult of Erlang spread to the rest of China.

statement.id: Ia bermula sebagai dewa lokal Guankou, Sichuan, tempat asal Li Erlang. Pada masa Dinasti Song Utara (960–1127 M), pemujaan Erlang menyebar ke seluruh Tiongkok.
statement.en: He originated as a local god of Guankou, Sichuan, where Li Erlang was from. During the Northern Song dynasty (960–1127 CE), the cult of Erlang spread to the rest of China.

claims.quote: Lord Erlang was originally worshiped during the Han as a hunting god and queller of mountain ghosts by the Qiang (羌) ethnic group of the western Sichuan region.

statement.id: Menurut Jim R. McClanahan (merujuk Wu 1987), Tuan Erlang semula dipuja pada zaman Han sebagai dewa pemburu dan penakluk hantu gunung oleh kelompok etnis Qiang di wilayah Sichuan barat.
statement.en: According to Jim R. McClanahan (citing Wu 1987), Lord Erlang was originally worshiped during the Han as a hunting god and queller of mountain ghosts by the Qiang ethnic group of western Sichuan.

claims.quote: The Er-lang cult became even more popular in Sichuan under the patronage of the Later Shu emperor, Meng Chang 孟昶 (r. 934-65), and in 965, when the Song dynasty conquered the kingdom, it adopted the cult, erecting temples for the god in the capital and throughout the country.

statement.id: Menurut kajian Wu (1987) yang dikutip McClanahan, kultus Erlang semakin populer di Sichuan di bawah dukungan kaisar Shu Kemudian, Meng Chang (berkuasa 934-65); pada 965, ketika Dinasti Song menaklukkan kerajaan itu, Song mengadopsi kultus tersebut dan mendirikan kuil bagi sang dewa di ibu kota dan di seluruh negeri.
statement.en: According to Wu (1987), quoted by McClanahan, the Erlang cult became even more popular in Sichuan under the patronage of the Later Shu emperor Meng Chang (r. 934-65); in 965, when the Song dynasty conquered the kingdom, it adopted the cult and erected temples for the god in the capital and throughout the country.

claims.quote: Searching the Mountains is associated with the legend of the god Erlang, who succeeded in ending devastating floods by defeating a vicious dragon and other malevolent creatures on Mount Guankou in Sichuan Province in southwest China.

statement.id: Menurut Cleveland Museum of Art, tema lukisan 'Searching the Mountains' (mencari iblis di pegunungan) dikaitkan dengan legenda dewa Erlang, yang berhasil mengakhiri banjir dahsyat dengan mengalahkan naga ganas dan makhluk jahat lain di Gunung Guankou, Provinsi Sichuan, Tiongkok barat daya.
statement.en: According to the Cleveland Museum of Art, the painting theme 'Searching the Mountains' is associated with the legend of the god Erlang, who ended devastating floods by defeating a vicious dragon and other malevolent creatures on Mount Guankou in Sichuan Province in southwest China.

claims.quote: A pivotal scene shows a giant dragon being chained by demon-soldiers under the command of Erlang, who appears in the civil robes of a court official.

statement.id: Menurut Cleveland Museum of Art, adegan penting dalam lukisan bertema ini memperlihatkan naga raksasa dirantai oleh prajurit-iblis di bawah komando Erlang, yang tampil dengan jubah sipil seorang pejabat istana.
statement.en: According to the Cleveland Museum of Art, a pivotal scene in paintings of this theme shows a giant dragon being chained by demon-soldiers under the command of Erlang, who appears in the civil robes of a court official.

claims.quote: Paintings of this theme are rarely seen and only about a dozen of them are known to be extant.

statement.id: Menurut Cleveland Museum of Art, lukisan bertema 'Searching the Mountains' jarang terlihat dan hanya sekitar selusin yang diketahui masih ada.
statement.en: According to the Cleveland Museum of Art, paintings of the 'Searching the Mountains' theme are rarely seen and only about a dozen are known to survive.

claims.quote: The third section, called “Clearing the Mountains,” features divine soldiers, led presumably by the deity Erlang Shen 二郎神, fighting undesirable creatures.

statement.id: Menurut Cleveland Museum of Art, bagian ketiga sebuah album lukisan bertajuk 'Clearing the Mountains' menampilkan prajurit ilahi yang diperkirakan dipimpin dewa Erlang Shen (二郎神) melawan makhluk-makhluk yang tidak diinginkan.
statement.en: According to the Cleveland Museum of Art, the third section of an album, called 'Clearing the Mountains,' features divine soldiers, presumably led by the deity Erlang Shen (二郎神), fighting undesirable creatures.

claims.quote: One anonymous 13th-century album leaf ink painting portrays Erlang seated in a kingly fashion and watching as his spirit soldiers round up and execute ape demons

statement.id: Menurut McClanahan, sebuah lukisan tinta lembar album anonim dari abad ke-13 menampilkan Erlang duduk bak raja sambil menyaksikan prajurit rohnya menangkap dan mengeksekusi iblis kera.
statement.en: According to McClanahan, one anonymous 13th-century album leaf ink painting portrays Erlang seated in a kingly fashion and watching as his spirit soldiers round up and execute ape demons.

claims.quote: The image of the deity as a queller of ape monsters culminated in an anonymous Yuan-Ming Dynasty play called The God Er-lang Locks up the Great Sage-Equal to Heaven (二郎神鎖齊天大聖, Er-lang Shen suo Qitian Dasheng).

statement.id: Menurut McClanahan, citra sang dewa sebagai penakluk monster kera memuncak dalam sebuah drama anonim zaman Yuan-Ming berjudul The God Er-lang Locks up the Great Sage-Equal to Heaven (二郎神鎖齊天大聖).
statement.en: According to McClanahan, the image of the deity as a queller of ape monsters culminated in an anonymous Yuan-Ming Dynasty play called The God Er-lang Locks up the Great Sage-Equal to Heaven (二郎神鎖齊天大聖).

claims.quote: 乃陛下令甥顯聖二郎真君，見居灌洲灌江口，享受下方香火。他昔日曾力誅六怪，又有梅山兄弟與帳前一千二百草頭神，神通廣大。
claims.locator: 第六回, Guanyin's speech to the Jade Emperor

statement.id: Dalam novel Perjalanan ke Barat (Xiyouji), Guanyin menyarankan kepada Kaisar Giok seorang dewa: Xiansheng Erlang Zhenjun, keponakan sang kaisar, yang tinggal di Guanjiangkou di Guanzhou dan menerima dupa persembahan dari bawah; ia pernah membinasakan enam siluman dan memiliki saudara-saudara Meishan serta seribu dua ratus 'dewa kepala rumput'.
statement.en: In the novel Journey to the West (Xiyouji), Guanyin recommends to the Jade Emperor a deity, the Illustrious Sage Erlang Zhenjun, the emperor's nephew, who lives at Guanjiangkou in Guanzhou and receives incense offerings from below; he once slew six monsters and has the Meishan brothers and twelve hundred 'grass-head gods'.

claims.quote: 吾乃玉帝外甥、敕封昭惠靈顯王二郎是也。今蒙上命，到此擒你這造反天宮的弼馬溫猢猻，你還不知死活。
claims.locator: 第六回, Erlang's challenge to Sun Wukong

statement.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, Erlang memperkenalkan diri kepada Sun Wukong sebagai keponakan Kaisar Giok yang bergelar Raja Zhaohui Lingxian (昭惠靈顯王), dan menyatakan datang atas perintah atas untuk menangkapnya.
statement.en: In Journey to the West, Erlang introduces himself to Sun Wukong as the Jade Emperor's nephew, enfeoffed as Prince Zhaohui Lingxian (昭惠靈顯王), and says he has come on higher orders to capture him.

claims.quote: 我記得當年玉帝妹子思凡下界，配合楊君，生一男子，曾使斧劈桃山的，是你麼？

statement.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, Sun Wukong menyebut bahwa adik perempuan Kaisar Giok turun ke dunia karena merindukan kehidupan manusia, menikah dengan seorang bermarga Yang, dan melahirkan seorang putra yang pernah membelah Gunung Tao dengan kapak; ia menanyakan apakah itu Erlang.
statement.en: In Journey to the West, Sun Wukong recalls that the Jade Emperor's sister longed for the mortal world, descended, married a man surnamed Yang, and bore a son who once split Peach Mountain with an axe, and asks whether that is Erlang.

claims.quote: 真君抖擻神威，搖身一變，變得身高萬丈，兩隻手舉著三尖兩刃神鋒，好便似華山頂上之峰

statement.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, dalam duel melawan Sun Wukong, Erlang mengerahkan wibawa ilahinya, berubah wujud menjadi setinggi sepuluh ribu zhang, dan mengangkat tombak sakti bermata tiga berbilah dua dengan kedua tangannya.
statement.en: In Journey to the West, in the duel with Sun Wukong, Erlang summons his divine might, transforms into a figure ten thousand zhang tall, and raises his three-pointed, double-edged divine spear with both hands.

claims.quote: 猴王只顧苦戰七聖，卻不知天上墜下這兵器，打中了天靈，立不穩腳，跌了一跤，爬將起來就跑。被二郎爺爺的細犬趕上，照腿肚子上一口，又扯了一跌。
claims.locator: 第六回, the capture of Sun Wukong

statement.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, ketika Sun Wukong sedang bertarung melawan tujuh dewa, sebuah senjata jatuh dari langit mengenai kepalanya sehingga ia terjatuh; anjing pemburu (細犬) milik Erlang mengejarnya, menggigit betisnya, dan menjatuhkannya lagi.
statement.en: In Journey to the West, while Sun Wukong is fighting the seven sages, a weapon falls from heaven and strikes his head so that he stumbles; Erlang's hound (細犬) catches up, bites his calf, and pulls him down again.

claims.quote: 腰挎彈弓新月樣，手執三尖兩刃槍。斧劈桃山曾救母，彈打鋋羅雙鳳凰。力誅八怪聲名遠，義結梅山七聖行。

statement.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, sebuah syair menggambarkan Erlang membawa busur peluru di pinggang dan memegang tombak bermata tiga berbilah dua; syair itu juga menyebut ia membelah Gunung Tao dengan kapak untuk menyelamatkan ibunya, serta mengikat persaudaraan dengan tujuh orang suci Meishan.
statement.en: In Journey to the West, a verse describes Erlang with a pellet bow at his waist and a three-pointed, double-edged spear in hand; it also says he split Peach Mountain with an axe to save his mother and swore brotherhood with the seven sages of Meishan.

claims.quote: 楊戩在腹內答曰：「吾乃玉泉山金霞洞玉鼎真人門徒楊戩是也。今已在你腹內。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Yang Jian menyebut dirinya murid Yuding Zhenren dari Gua Jinxia di Gunung Yuquan, ketika ia berbicara kepada lawannya dengan menyatakan dirinya sudah berada di dalam perut lawan itu.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Yang Jian calls himself a disciple of Yuding Zhenren of Jinxia Cave on Mount Yuquan, as he tells his opponent that he is already inside the opponent's belly.

claims.quote: 你雖是玉泉山金霞洞玉鼎真人門徒，善會八九變化，不能降伏此怪。吾將此寶授你
claims.locator: 第九十二回, Nüwa speaks to Yang Jian

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nuwa berkata kepada Yang Jian bahwa ia murid Yuding Zhenren yang pandai 'delapan-sembilan perubahan' tetapi tidak mampu menaklukkan siluman itu, lalu memberinya sebuah pusaka.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nüwa tells Yang Jian that, although he is a disciple of Yuding Zhenren skilled in 'eight-nine transformations,' he cannot subdue the monster, and gives him a treasure.

claims.quote: 楊戩祭起哮天犬，飛在空中。此犬乃是仙犬，看見此珠，十分兇惡，竟讓過他的珠來奔戴禮。戴禮見仙犬奔來，正欲抽身逃走，早被哮天犬一口咬住，不能掙挫。
claims.locator: 第九十二回, Yang Jian and Xiaotian Quan

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Yang Jian melepaskan anjing Xiaotian Quan (哮天犬) ke udara; anjing yang disebut anjing dewata itu menghindari manik (珠) milik Dai Li lalu menggigit Dai Li hingga tak bisa meronta.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Yang Jian sends up his dog Xiaotian Quan (哮天犬); described as an immortal hound, it dodges Dai Li's bead (珠) and seizes Dai Li in its jaws so that he cannot struggle free.

claims.quote: 子牙大喜；又謂楊戩曰：「只是袁洪此怪未除，如之奈何？」楊戩曰：「此怪乃梅山得道白猿，最是精靈，俟徐徐除之。」

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Yang Jian berkata kepada Jiang Ziya bahwa Yuan Hong (袁洪) adalah kera putih Gunung Meishan yang telah memperoleh Dao dan sangat cerdik, dan ia akan menyingkirkannya perlahan-lahan.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Yang Jian tells Jiang Ziya that Yuan Hong (袁洪) is a white ape of Mount Meishan who has attained the Way and is very cunning, and that he will remove him gradually.

claims.quote: According to an ancient text, Erlang Baojuan, Yang Jian's mother was Princess Yunhua, the Jade Emperor's sister, who was imprisoned under Mount Tao because she violated the Heavenly Rules by marrying a human named Yang Tianyou.

statement.id: Menurut teks kuno Erlang Baojuan, ibu Yang Jian adalah Putri Yunhua, adik perempuan Kaisar Giok, yang dipenjara di bawah Gunung Tao karena melanggar Aturan Langit dengan menikahi manusia bernama Yang Tianyou.
statement.en: According to an ancient text, Erlang Baojuan, Yang Jian's mother was Princess Yunhua, the Jade Emperor's sister, who was imprisoned under Mount Tao for violating the Heavenly Rules by marrying a human named Yang Tianyou.

claims.quote: Erlang Shen is also identified with Zhao Yu, a hermit who lived on Mount Qingcheng and was appointed by Emperor Yang of Sui as Governor of Jiazhou.

statement.id: Erlang Shen juga diidentifikasi dengan Zhao Yu, seorang pertapa di Gunung Qingcheng yang diangkat Kaisar Yang dari Sui sebagai Gubernur Jiazhou.
statement.en: Erlang Shen is also identified with Zhao Yu, a hermit who lived on Mount Qingcheng and was appointed by Emperor Yang of Sui as Governor of Jiazhou.

claims.quote: Li Erlang assisted his father in the construction of the complex irrigation system that prevented the Min River from flooding and irrigated the Chengdu Plain.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Li Erlang membantu ayahnya membangun sistem irigasi rumit yang mencegah Sungai Min meluap dan mengairi Dataran Chengdu.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, Li Erlang assisted his father in building the complex irrigation system that prevented the Min River from flooding and irrigated the Chengdu Plain.

claims.quote: In later stories, Erlang is the deification of Yang Jian, son of the goddess Yunhua, and nephew of the legendary Jade Emperor. This portrayal as Yang Jian is most common in popular media.

statement.id: Dalam kisah-kisah yang lebih belakangan, Erlang adalah pendewaan Yang Jian, putra dewi Yunhua dan keponakan Kaisar Giok yang legendaris. Penggambaran sebagai Yang Jian ini paling umum dalam media populer.
statement.en: In later stories, Erlang is the deification of Yang Jian, son of the goddess Yunhua and nephew of the legendary Jade Emperor. This portrayal as Yang Jian is most common in popular media.

claims.quote: Erlang is featured as a boss in the Game Science 2024 video game Black Myth: Wukong, voiced by Zhang Jie in Mandarin and Andrew Koji in English.

statement.id: Erlang tampil sebagai bos dalam gim video Black Myth: Wukong (Game Science, 2024), diisi suara oleh Zhang Jie dalam bahasa Mandarin dan Andrew Koji dalam bahasa Inggris.
statement.en: Erlang is featured as a boss in the Game Science 2024 video game Black Myth: Wukong, voiced by Zhang Jie in Mandarin and Andrew Koji in English.

claims.quote: As a god, Erlang is a noble and powerful warrior who vanquishes demons and monsters, and embodies justice and righteousness.

statement.id: Sebagai dewa, Erlang adalah prajurit mulia dan perkasa yang menaklukkan iblis dan monster, serta mewujudkan keadilan dan kebenaran.
statement.en: As a god, Erlang is a noble and powerful warrior who vanquishes demons and monsters, and embodies justice and righteousness.

claims.quote: In the Ming-era semi-mythical novels Investiture of the Gods and Journey to the West, Erlang Shen is the nephew of the Jade Emperor. In the former novel, he assists the Zhou army in defeating the Shang. In the latter, he is the second son of a mortal and the Jade Emperor's sister Yunhua, as well as an enemy-turned-ally of Sun Wukong.

statement.en: In the Ming-era semi-mythical novels Investiture of the Gods (Fengshen Yanyi) and Journey to the West, Erlang Shen is the nephew of the Jade Emperor. In the former he assists the Zhou army in defeating the Shang; in the latter he is the second son of a mortal and the Jade Emperor's sister Yunhua, and an enemy-turned-ally of Sun Wukong.

short_description.id: Sha Wujing adalah tokoh novel klasik Tiongkok Journey to the West: bekas jenderal langit yang dibuang menjadi monster pemakan manusia di Sungai Pasir Mengalir, lalu menjadi murid ketiga Tang Sanzang.
short_description.en: Sha Wujing is a character of the classic Chinese novel Journey to the West: a former heavenly general cast down to become a man-eating monster in the Flowing Sands River, who then becomes the third disciple of Tang Sanzang.

long_description.id: Sha Wujing adalah tokoh sastra dari novel Journey to the West, yang terbit pada abad ke-16 pada masa dinasti Ming dan dikaitkan dengan Wu Cheng'en. Ia salah satu dari tiga murid Tang Sanzang; latar belakangnya paling kurang dikembangkan di antara para peziarah, dan dalam kisah aslinya ia adalah monster pemakan manusia.
long_description.en: Sha Wujing is a literary character from Journey to the West, a novel that appeared in the 16th century under the Ming dynasty and is credited to Wu Cheng'en. He is one of Tang Sanzang's three disciples; his background is the least developed of the pilgrims, and in the original story he is a man-eating monster.

long_description.id: Menurut teks novel, ia dahulu Jenderal Pengangkat Tirai di langit. Setelah memecahkan cawan kaca pada jamuan persik, ia dipukul delapan ratus kali dan dibuang ke Sungai Pasir Mengalir, tempat pedang terbang menusuk dadanya tiap tujuh hari. Ia digambarkan berambut merah kusut dan bertaring (ulasan lain menambahkan janggut merah, kadang kulit biru, dan sebagian botak), dan memakan banyak pengembara; sembilan tengkorak pengambil sutra terdahulu mengapung dan ia rangkai untuk bermain.
long_description.en: According to the novel text he was once the Curtain-Lifting General in heaven. After breaking a glass cup at the peach banquet he was struck eight hundred times and cast into the Flowing Sands River, where flying swords pierced his flanks every seven days. He is described with tangled red hair and tusks (another account adds a red beard, sometimes blue skin and partial baldness) and ate many travellers; nine skulls of earlier scripture seekers floated and he strung them together to play with.

long_description.id: Guanyin menahbiskannya dengan marga "Sha" dan nama dharma Wujing, lalu menyuruhnya menunggu pengambil sutra. Setelah rombongan Tang Sanzang bertarung dengannya, Guanyin mengutus Muzha dengan labu merah; Wujing keluar, menjadi murid, dan membantu rombongan menyeberang dengan perahu dari tengkorak dan labu itu.
long_description.en: The bodhisattva ordains him with the surname "Sha" and the dharma name Wujing, and tells him to wait for the scripture seeker. After Tang Sanzang's party fights him, the bodhisattva sends Muzha with a red gourd; Wujing comes out, becomes a disciple and helps the party cross on a boat made of the skulls and the gourd.

long_description.id: Wikipedia melukiskannya sebagai murid yang patuh, logis, sopan, dan berguna karena kemampuan renangnya. Di akhir perjalanan ia menjadi arhat bertubuh emas, kedudukan yang lebih tinggi daripada Zhu Bajie. Para peneliti menelusuri asal tokohnya ke roh Shensha shen dalam kisah-kisah sebelum novel.
long_description.en: Wikipedia describes him as an obedient, logical, polite disciple whose swimming ability proved useful. At the end of the journey he becomes a golden-bodied arhat, a higher station than Zhu Bajie. Scholars trace the character back to the spirit Shensha shen in tales that predate the novel.

cultural_context.id: Dalam pengantar terjemahannya tahun 1913, Timothy Richard membaca Sa Wu Ching, si Pencari Kemurnian, sebagai sosok mirip orang Farisi yang ketat dan sekaligus "dandy Dolphin", yang mencapai surga lewat metode Tao; ini tafsiran penerjemah, bukan pernyataan novel itu sendiri.
cultural_context.en: In the introduction to his 1913 translation Timothy Richard reads Sa Wu Ching, the Seeker after Purity, as a figure like a strict Pharisee and also a "dandy Dolphin", who attains Heaven through Taoist methods; this is the translator's interpretation, not a statement of the novel itself.

literal_meaning.id: Nama dharma Sha Wujing berarti "pasir yang sadar akan kemurnian"; 沙僧 dan Sha Heshang berarti "Biksu Pasir" atau "Pendeta Pasir".
literal_meaning.en: The dharma name Sha Wujing means "sand aware of purity"; 沙僧 and Sha Heshang mean "Sand Monk" or "Sand Priest".

statement.id: Dalam pengantar terjemahannya tahun 1913, Timothy Richard menyebut Sa Wu Ching sebagai Pencari Kemurnian, semacam "dandy Dolphin" atau orang Farisi yang ketat, yang meraih surga lewat metode Tao.
statement.en: In the introduction to his 1913 translation Timothy Richard calls Sa Wu Ching the Seeker after Purity, a sort of dandy Dolphin or strict Pharisee who gains Heaven by Taoist methods.

claims.quote: and he was called Sa Wu Tsing, or Seeker after Purity. He was also called Sa Seng, (the monk Sand).

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan Richard (1913), ia dipanggil Sa Wu Tsing, atau Pencari Kemurnian, dan juga Sa Seng (biksu Pasir).
statement.en: In Richard's 1913 translation he is called Sa Wu Tsing, or Seeker after Purity, and also Sa Seng (the monk Sand).

claims.quote: But when the Queen of Heaven Ordered her peach banquet. By mischance some crystals broke, And I was sentenced to death,

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan Richard (1913) sang iblis mengisahkan bahwa ketika Ratu Surga mengadakan jamuan persik, beberapa kristal pecah secara tak sengaja dan ia dijatuhi hukuman mati.
statement.en: In Richard's 1913 translation the demon tells how, when the Queen of Heaven held her peach banquet, some crystals broke by mischance and he was sentenced to death.

claims.quote: 青不青，黑不黑，晦氣色臉；長不長，短不短，赤腳筋軀。眼光閃爍，好似灶底雙燈；口角丫叉，就如屠家火缽。獠牙撐劍刃，紅髮亂蓬鬆。一聲叱咤如雷吼，兩腳奔波似滾風。

statement.id: Dalam bab 8, monster dari sungai digambarkan berwajah suram tidak biru dan tidak hitam, berkaki telanjang, bermata berkilau seperti dua pelita tungku, bertaring mencuat seperti bilah pedang, berambut merah kusut, dan menggelegar seperti guntur.
statement.en: In chapter 8 the monster from the river is described with a gloomy face neither blue nor black, bare feet, eyes flashing like two stove lamps, tusks jutting like sword blades and tangled red hair, roaring like thunder.

claims.quote: 我不是妖邪，我是靈霄殿下侍鑾輿的捲簾大將。只因在蟠桃會上失手打碎了玻璃盞，玉帝把我打了八百，貶下界來，變得這般模樣。又叫七日一次，將飛劍來穿我胸脅百餘下方回。

statement.id: Si monster mengaku bukan siluman jahat melainkan Jenderal Pengangkat Tirai yang melayani kereta kaisar di Aula Lingxiao; karena tak sengaja memecahkan cawan kaca pada jamuan persik ia dipukul delapan ratus kali dan dibuang ke bumi, serta tiap tujuh hari pedang terbang menusuk dadanya seratus kali lebih.
statement.en: The monster says he is no evil demon but the Curtain-Lifting General who attended the imperial carriage at the Lingxiao Hall; for accidentally breaking a glass cup at the peach banquet he was struck eight hundred times and cast to earth, and every seven days flying swords pierce his flanks over a hundred times.

claims.quote: 凡吃的人頭，拋落流沙，竟沉水底。這個水，鵝毛也不能浮。惟有九個取經人的骷髏浮在水面，再不能沉。我以為異物，將索兒穿在一處，閑時拿來頑耍。

statement.id: Ia mengaku telah memakan banyak orang, termasuk para pengambil sutra sebelumnya; kepala mereka tenggelam di pasir mengalir, kecuali sembilan tengkorak yang mengapung, yang ia rangkai dengan tali untuk bermain.
statement.en: He admits to having eaten many people, including earlier scripture seekers; their heads sank in the flowing sands except nine skulls that floated, which he strung together on a cord to play with.

claims.quote: 菩薩方與他摩頂受戒，指沙為姓，就姓了沙；起個法名，叫做個沙悟淨。當時入了沙門，送菩薩過了河，他洗心滌慮，再不傷生，專等取經人。

statement.id: Guanyin menahbiskannya, memberinya marga "沙" (pasir) dan nama dharma "沙悟淨"; ia lalu membersihkan batinnya, tidak lagi membunuh, dan menunggu pengambil sutra.
statement.en: The bodhisattva ordains him, gives him the surname "沙" (sand) and the dharma name "沙悟淨"; he then cleanses his mind, no longer takes life, and waits for the scripture seeker.

claims.quote: 忽然見弱水三千，乃是流沙河界。菩薩道：「徒弟呀，此處卻是難行。取經人濁骨凡胎，如何得渡？」

statement.id: Guanyin dan muridnya tiba di wilayah Sungai Pasir Mengalir (流沙河), air lemah tiga ribu li, dan menilai bahwa pengambil sutra yang bertubuh fana sulit menyeberanginya.
statement.en: The bodhisattva and her attendant reach the region of the Flowing Sands River (流沙河), three thousand li of weak water, and judge that a scripture seeker of mortal flesh would find it hard to cross.

claims.quote: 那流沙河的妖怪，乃是捲簾大將臨凡，也是我勸化的善信，教他保護取經之輩。

statement.id: Dalam bab 22, Guanyin berkata bahwa monster Sungai Pasir Mengalir adalah Jenderal Pengangkat Tirai yang turun ke dunia, penganut yang telah ia bujuk untuk melindungi para pengambil sutra.
statement.en: In chapter 22 the bodhisattva says the Flowing Sands River monster is the Curtain-Lifting General come down to the mortal world, a believer she has persuaded to protect scripture seekers.

claims.quote: 你可將此葫蘆，同孫悟空到流沙河水面上，只叫『悟淨』，他就出來了。

statement.id: Guanyin menyuruh Muzha membawa labu merah bersama Sun Wukong ke permukaan sungai dan cukup memanggil "悟淨" agar ia keluar.
statement.en: The bodhisattva tells Muzha to take the red gourd with Sun Wukong to the river surface and simply call "悟淨" so that he comes out.

claims.quote: 悟淨道：「弟子向蒙菩薩教化，指沙為姓，與我起個法名，喚做沙悟淨，豈有不從師父之理？」三藏道：「既如此，」叫：「悟空，取戒刀來，與他落了髮。」大聖依言，即將戒刀與他剃了頭。又來拜了三藏，拜了行者與八戒，分了大小。三藏見他行禮真像個和尚家風，故又叫他做沙和尚。

statement.id: Wujing berkata bahwa Guanyin telah menunjuk pasir sebagai marganya dan memberinya nama dharma Sha Wujing; Tang Sanzang melihat sikapnya seperti biksu sejati dan memanggilnya 沙和尚.
statement.en: Wujing says the bodhisattva took sand as his surname and gave him the dharma name Sha Wujing; Tang Sanzang, seeing his bearing as a true monk, also calls him 沙和尚 (Sha Heshang).

claims.quote: 那悟淨不敢怠慢，即將頸項下掛的骷髏取下，用索子結作九宮，把菩薩葫蘆安在當中，請師父下岸。那長老遂登法船，坐於上面，果然穩似輕舟。

statement.id: Wujing melepas tengkorak dari lehernya, merangkainya dengan tali menjadi sembilan palas, dan menaruh labu Guanyin di tengah sebagai perahu pusaka; Tang Sanzang naik dan perahu itu setenang sampan ringan.
statement.en: Wujing takes the skulls from his neck, strings them into the nine palaces with the bodhisattva's gourd set in the middle as a dharma boat; the elder boards it and it proves steady as a light skiff.

claims.quote: 甚虧了悟能與他水面上大戰三次，只是不能取勝，被他攔阻，不能渡河。

statement.id: Sun Wukong melapor bahwa Wuneng (Zhu Bajie) bertarung tiga kali melawan monster sungai itu di permukaan air tanpa menang, sehingga rombongan tidak dapat menyeberang.
statement.en: Sun Wukong reports that Wuneng (Zhu Bajie) fought the river monster three times on the water without winning, so the party could not cross.

claims.quote: 沙悟淨，汝本是捲簾大將。先因蟠桃會上打碎玻璃盞，貶汝下界，汝落於流沙河，傷生吃人造孽。幸皈吾教，誠敬迦持，保護聖僧，登山牽馬有功，加陞大職正果，為金身羅漢。

statement.id: Di akhir novel Buddha berkata bahwa Sha Wujing dahulu Jenderal Pengangkat Tirai yang memecahkan cawan kaca pada jamuan persik, jatuh ke Sungai Pasir Mengalir dan memakan manusia; karena jasanya menjaga biksu dan menuntun kuda ia dinaikkan menjadi arhat bertubuh emas (金身羅漢).
statement.en: At the end of the novel the Buddha says Sha Wujing was once the Curtain-Lifting General who smashed a glass cup at the peach banquet, fell into the Flowing Sands River and ate people; for protecting the holy monk and leading the horse he is raised to the golden-bodied arhat (金身羅漢).

topic.id: Sebab Sha Wujing memecahkan cawan pada jamuan persik
topic.en: Why Sha Wujing broke the cup at the peach banquet

summary.id: Sebagian sumber menyebut ia melakukannya dalam kemarahan.
summary.en: Some sources say he did it in a fit of rage.

summary.id: Sumber lain, dan pengakuannya di bab 8, menyebut ia tidak sengaja ("失手").
summary.en: Other sources, and his own account in chapter 8, say it was unintentional ("失手").
